Description:
Job Summary
The High Court of Orissa, Cuttack is filling 31 posts of Junior Grade Typist / Data Entry Operator (Group-C) in its Establishment, in Level 4 of the Pay Matrix under ORSP Rules, 2017. Graduates in any discipline with PGDCA or equivalent and computer typing speed of 40 words per minute, aged above 21 and not exceeding 42 years, can apply as per Advertisement No. 07/2026.
Vacancy Details
Organisation: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack
Advertisement No.: 07/2026
Post Name: Junior Grade Typist / Data Entry Operator (Group-C)
Vacancies: 31 (including 10 for women)
Age Limit: Above 21 years and not exceeding 42 years
Application Fee: ; SC, ST and PwBD candidates exempted at their option
Job Location: Court's Establishment, High Court of Orissa, Cuttack
Application Mode: Online only
Of the total, 02 posts are for PwBDs and 01 post is for Ex-Servicemen. These posts are filled as per the relevant Acts, Rules, Orders or instructions of the State Government.
If eligible women candidates of a category are not available, the unfilled vacancies of that category will be filled by eligible male candidates of the same category.
Exchange of reservation between Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe will not be considered.
The number of vacancies is subject to change at the discretion of the Court.
Suitability for PwBD Candidates
Physical Requirement (SE, H, RW, MF): Functional Classification (OL, BL, HI)
SE - Work performed by seeing: OL - One leg affected (R and/or L)
H - Work performed by hearing/speaking: BL - Both legs affected but not arms
RW - Work performed by reading and writing: HI - Partially deaf
MF - Work performed by manipulating (with fingers)
Who Can Apply
Educational Qualification
A candidate must possess all of the following:
A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised University or such other qualification equivalent thereto;
Typewriting with a minimum speed of 40 words per minute in the Computer; and
PGDCA or such other qualification equivalent thereto from recognized Universities or AICTE recognized Institutions or any other Institutions recognized by the Government.
Age Limit
A candidate must be above 21 years and not exceeding 42 years of age. Name and date of birth are accepted only as entered in the High School Certificate / 10th Board Examination or equivalent certificate.
Age Relaxation
SC, ST, SEBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and Women: 5 years
PwBDs with permanent disability not less than 40% and not more than 50%: 10 years
PwBDs belonging to SC/ST/SEBC (Non-Creamy Layer): 15 years (10 years as PwBD + 5 years as SC/ST/SEBC)
Ex-Servicemen: As per relevant Acts, Rules, Orders or instructions of the State Government
A candidate who falls in more than one category gets only one age relaxation, the one most beneficial to him or her. Save as provided above, the age limit cannot be relaxed in any case.
Other Eligibility Conditions
The candidate must be a citizen of India, be of good character, and be of sound health and mind, good physique and free from any contagious or communicable disease, without bodily infirmity of more than 50%.
The candidate must not have more than one spouse living, if married.
The candidate must not have any past criminal antecedent or record, must not have been convicted by any Criminal Court for an offence involving moral turpitude, and must not have been debarred by any Government, Court or Public Service Commission or any other Commission from appearing in any Recruitment Test.
A candidate who changed name/surname after passing the High School Certificate Examination must furnish a copy of the notification in the Odisha Gazette; an application with a name discrepancy not supported by it shall be rejected.
Government servants can apply if they have the qualification and are within the age limit. They must inform their Heads of Offices in writing and produce a "No Objection Certificate" from them as and when directed.
Candidates should check the full eligibility conditions in the official notification before applying.
How to Apply for Orissa High Court Recruitment 2026
Applications are accepted only through online mode; forms sent by any other mode will be summarily rejected.

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Site Engineer to manage waterproofing, retrofit, repairs application projects across. Attend client meetings and provide project updates.
Handle site-related queries and ensure client satisfaction.
Coordinate for approvals, inspections, and certifications.
5. Planning & Material Management
Plan daily and weekly work schedules.
Ensure proper storage and usage of waterproofing materials.
Monitor material consumption and reduce wastage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
25 years of experience in waterproofing or construction site execution.
Good knowledge of waterproofing systems (PU coating, APP membrane, injection grouting, etc.).
Strong billing and measurement skills.
Basic knowledge of MS Excel and billing software.

Role description:
We are now recruiting talented individuals to fill our current vacancy for Junior Senior BIM Modeler to work on our projects in Bangalore, Mumbai, Noida and Hyderabad location

To be considered for a role we are seeking candidates with the following credentials:
Job title:

- Senior BIM Modeler - Revit - Process-Mechanical
Role accountabilities:
Prepare 3D MEP Model in Revit for Modeling for Mechanical, HVAC, Plumbing, and Fire components for projects related to Water Supply and Wastewater Treatment (Sewerage), Water and Wastewater (Sewage) Pumping Stations, Water and Wastewater Treatment Plants.
Work under direction of design professional and BIM Manager.

Collaborate and Coordinate with other disciplines design-changes and model challenges.
Adhere to BIM Execution Plan and BIM project workflow criteria.
Follow BIM content standards and development procedures
May take the lead on developing some discipline specific BIM modeling content for project
Print drawing sets for professional team and participate in discipline reviews.
Prepare own discipline model and/or content for BIM Coordination Meetings.
Ability to export DWF and other formats for collaboration internally and externally.
Good communication and good writing skills.
Leveraging BIM software and tools as a methodology to coordinate design documentation. Software Expectations
AutoCAD - for drawing linkage and cleanup.
Design Review - for collaboration with professional staff.
This role provides Design or redesign complex layouts and drawings from general written or verbal specifications from Group Leader.
Produce CAD drawings for new or improved products using industry, departmental and discipline standards.
Provide design input to CAD and co-ordinate with CAD staff for preparation of drawings.
Liaison with other team members to produce good design solution as per best design practice.
Qualifications & Experience:
Diploma / Engineering in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University.
10+ years experience as BIM Technician.
Experience in Revit MEP Modeling for Mechanical components, HVAC, Plumbing, and Fire layouts for projects related to Water Supply and Wastewater Treatment (Sewerage), Water and Wastewater (Sewage) Pumping Stations, Water and Wastewater Treatment Plants.
Exposure and experience in using BIM 360 preferred
Experience with preparation of 2D drawings preferred
Experience with Automation programming preferred (Dynamo, Python, Synchro, etc.)
Additional knowledge of Autodesk and Bentley Platform would be beneficial.
Preference will be given to experience in international projects (US/UK/Middle East)
Well-developed interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.

Automate MIS reports using advanced Excel, Power BI, and ERP reporting tools.

Drive standardisation and automation of AP reporting processes.
Ensure adherence to SOPs, audit requirements, and financial policies.
4. Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination
Lead and mentor the Accounts Payable team.
Coordinate with Procurement, Finance, Business Units, and vendors.
Monitor team productivity and ensure timely closure of monthly activities.
Support internal and external audits by providing relevant documentation and reports.

Strong knowledge of end-to-end Accounts Payable processes.
Excellent MIS reporting and financial data analysis skills.
Advanced MS Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, dashboards).
Working knowledge of Power BI and data visualisation.
Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to manage teams, deadlines, and multiple priorities.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Invoice processing accuracy and turnaround time.
Reduction in overdue invoices and pending payments.
Vendor reconciliation accuracy.

Audit compliance and control effectiveness.

B Tech/ Diploma (Electrical -Electronics) Must have exposure to products like Switchgear, Wiring Accessories, Control gear, Panel ,MCB, and DBs.

Demonstrated Business Acumen and Market/Customer Awareness.
Soft Skills & Attributes.

Description:
The upcoming Crowne Plaza & Holiday Inn Zirakpur marks an exciting new chapter in hospitality for the region. Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.
The cluster will offer a diverse range of F&B experiences, along with a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, and extensive banqueting facilities, including approximately 1,00,000 sq. ft. of meeting and event space. With excellent connectivity to Chandigarh and key destinations across North India, it will be well-positioned to cater to business and leisure travelers, while offering versatile spaces for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations.
A little taste of your day-to-day:
Every day is different at IHG, but you ll mostly :
Oversee the preparation of kitchen equipment for use
Manage the receiving and storage of kitchen goods
Assists to maximise employee productivity through the use of multi-skilling, multi-tasking and flexible scheduling to meet the financial goals of the business as well as the expectations of the guests.
Handle all guest and internal customer complaints and inquiries in a courteous and efficient manner, following through to make sure problems are resolved satisfactorily.
What We need from you:
Strong culinary expertise across multiple cuisines with at least 4 year in a supervisory capacity, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Excellent leadership, communication, and team-management skills.
In-depth knowledge of food safety, hygiene, and HACCP standards.
What you can expect from us:
We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out.
Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
SUMMARY
Finance Manager
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager to lead all aspects of financial strategy, including planning, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and internal control systems. In this role, you will oversee the complete financial lifecycle, ensuring full compliance with legal and regulatory requirements while managing critical closing activities at month and year-end. You will provide high-level strategic analysis to support business growth and profitability. Furthermore, the position involves managing the finance department and collaborating closely with senior executives and external stakeholders to ensure sound financial governance.

Location: Bhubaneswar

Experience: 5-10 years
Key Responsibilities
Lead the development of financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and conduct variance analysis.
Prepare and analyze comprehensive financial statements, including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow statements.
Manage the end-to-end execution of month-end and year-end financial close processes.
Oversee general ledger management, including the processing of journal entries and account reconciliations.
Utilize and maintain ERP and accounting software systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or QuickBooks.
Monitor critical financial metrics, including budget variances, gross and operating margins, working capital, DSO, DPO, and cash runway.
Manage cash flow strategies, treasury operations, and working capital requirements.
Ensure strict compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax laws, and statutory obligations.
Coordinate with external auditors, banks, tax authorities, and internal departments.
Strengthen internal financial controls and streamline workflows for accounts payable, receivable, and reporting.
Identify and implement opportunities to automate financial processes and enhance operational efficiency.
Provide guidance, mentorship, and direction to finance team members.
Present financial reports and strategic insights to senior leadership to support decision - making.
Mandatory Skills & Qualifications
Financial Planning & Reporting
Strong expertise in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A).
Skilled in budgeting, forecasting, and performing variance analysis.
Capable of preparing and presenting accurate financial statements.
Proficient in managing Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow data.
Knowledge of financial reporting frameworks such as GAAP, IFRS, or Ind AS.
Accounting & Financial Operations
Experienced in executing month-end and year-end closing procedures.
Competent in General Ledger (GL) administration.
Skilled in processing journal entries and performing account reconciliations.
Capable of managing Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) functions.
Proficient in cash flow management and optimizing working capital.
Experienced in implementing internal controls and coordinating audits.
Knowledgeable in statutory and tax compliance, including GST, VAT, and TDS where relevant.
Technical Skills
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, financial modeling, and macros.
Hands-on experience with ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or QuickBooks.
Familiarity with financial reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.


Requirements

A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
An MBA or Master's degree in Finance is highly desirable.
5-10 years of progressive experience within Finance or Accounting functions.
Relevant industry background in IT Services, Manufacturing, BFSI, Retail, Healthcare, or comparable sectors.
Preferred Skills
Experience utilizing financial planning platforms such as Anaplan, Adaptive Insights, or Hyperion.
Familiarity with M&A due diligence, investor reporting, or fundraising support.
Background in managing multi-entity and multi-currency financial consolidation.
Knowledge of SQL or Python for financial data analysis and automation.
Professional designations such as CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, or CFA.
Key Focus Areas: Financial Planning & Analysis, Budgeting, Forecasting, Financial Reporting, Month-End Closing, ERP Systems, Cash Flow Management, Statutory Compliance, Internal Controls, and Team Leadership.

Position: Tender Manager
Department: Tendering & Business Development
Industry: Building Construction / Real Estate / Infrastructure
Reporting To: COO / Managing Director
Location: Head Office
1. Job Summary
The Tender Manager will be responsible for managing the complete tendering process for building construction projects, from identifying tender opportunities and preparing technical and commercial bids to submission, negotiation, and handover of awarded projects to the execution team. The role requires strong knowledge of civil construction, estimation, costing, BOQ analysis, contract documentation, and government and private-sector tendering procedures.
2. Key Responsibilities
A. Tender Identification & Planning
Identify and evaluate new tender opportunities for residential, commercial, industrial, and high-rise building construction projects.
Review tender notices, eligibility criteria, scope of work, submission deadlines, and contractual requirements.
Coordinate with clients, consultants, government departments, and private developers regarding tender opportunities.
Maintain a tender database and prepare a tender submission schedule.
B. Tender Document Preparation
Study tender documents, drawings, technical specifications, BOQ, scope of work, and contract conditions.
Prepare and review technical bids, commercial bids, and prequalification documents.
Arrange required documents, including company credentials, work experience certificates, financial statements, GST, PAN, EPF, ESI, labour licences, and other statutory documents, as applicable.
Ensure compliance with tender eligibility requirements and submission guidelines.
C. Estimation & Costing
Prepare detailed project cost estimates for building construction works.
Analyse BOQ quantities, rates, material costs, labour costs, equipment costs, subcontractor quotations, overheads, and profit margins.
Obtain and evaluate quotations from suppliers, vendors, and subcontractors.
Coordinate with the estimation, purchase, planning, finance, and technical teams to finalise competitive tender rates.
Assess project risks, price variations, taxes, contingencies, and contractual liabilities before bid submission.
D. E-Tendering & Bid Submission
Manage online tender registration, document uploads, and bid submission through relevant e-procurement portals.
Coordinate EMD, tender fees, bank guarantees, and other bid security requirements.
Ensure timely and error-free submission of technical and financial bids.
Monitor tender corrigenda, pre-bid meeting notices, clarifications, and amendments.
Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of all tender-related information.
E. Client Coordination & Negotiation
Attend pre-bid meetings and technical discussions with clients and consultants.
Prepare responses to tender queries and clarification requests.
Participate in commercial negotiations and rate finalisation with management approval.
Track tender results, bid status, and client feedback.
F. Contract Award & Handover
Review letters of intent, work orders, contract agreements, and award conditions.
Coordinate with management and the legal team to review commercial terms and contractual risks.
Prepare a detailed tender handover to the project execution team, including BOQ, approved rates, scope, timelines, and key contract conditions.
Maintain records of submitted tenders, awarded projects, unsuccessful bids, and tender performance.
3. Educational Qualification
B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering preferred.
Diploma in Civil Engineering may be considered for candidates with substantial relevant experience.
Additional qualifications in construction management, quantity surveying, estimation, or contract management will be an advantage.
4. Experience
Minimum 710 years of relevant experience in tendering, estimation, costing, and bid management in building construction or infrastructure projects.
Experience in residential, commercial, industrial, or high-rise building projects is preferred.
Proven experience in handling government and/or private-sector tenders independently.
5. Required Skills
Strong knowledge of civil construction estimation, costing, BOQ, and rate analysis.
Expertise in tender documentation and e-tendering portals.
Knowledge of construction contracts, tender eligibility, EMD, BG, and statutory documentation.
Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and relevant estimation software.
Excellent negotiation, analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
Ability to manage multiple tenders and meet strict submission deadlines.
6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Timely and accurate submission of tenders.
Tender qualification and success rate.
Accuracy of project estimation and cost calculations.
Compliance with tender requirements and documentation standards.
Value of contracts secured and contribution to business growth.
Effective coordination and timely handover of awarded projects.
7. Personal Attributes
Strong commercial awareness and attention to detail.
Leadership and team management capabilities.
Proactive approach to identifying business opportunities.
Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
High standards of integrity and confidentiality.

SUMMARY
Technical Business Analyst

Summary
We are currently recruiting an experienced Technical Business Analyst to act as a vital bridge connecting business stakeholders with technical development teams. In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for identifying business needs, transforming them into detailed technical specifications, performing in-depth data analysis, and ensuring the effective deployment of technology solutions. The ideal applicant will demonstrate strong analytical skills, a comprehensive understanding of technical principles, a history of managing stakeholder relationships, and practical experience working within Agile delivery environments.

Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha

Experience: 5-10 years

Responsibilities
Identify, evaluate, and formally document both business and technical requirements.
Prepare essential documentation, including Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), Software Specifications (SRS), user stories, and acceptance criteria.
Translate high-level business objectives into actionable technical specifications.
Create process diagrams, wireframes, and data mapping schemas using tools like Visio, Lucidchart, or Figma.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, software developers, Quality Assurance teams, UX designers, and business stakeholders.
Perform data analysis and validation tasks using SQL queries.
Demonstrate expertise in REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML data formats, and system integration protocols.
Track project progress, monitor requirements and defects, and report on delivery metrics through Jira and other reporting platforms.
Identify operational inefficiencies and recommend workflow improvements.
Lead Agile and Scrum ceremonies, such as sprint planning and backlog grooming sessions.
Manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) efforts and assist in validating test cases.
Ensure all requirements remain aligned with business goals throughout the entire project lifecycle.


Requirements
Gathering & Documentation:
Proficiency in developing Business Documents (BRD).
Expertise in drafting Functional Documents (FRD).
Ability to produce Software Specifications (SRS).
Experience authoring user stories and defining acceptance criteria.
Technical Skills:
Advanced SQL usage for data analysis and verification.
Strong understanding of REST and SOAP API architectures.
Familiarity with JSON/XML structures and system integration patterns.
Competence in process modeling using BPMN and UML standards.
Skill in creating wireframes and process flowcharts.
Tools & Methodologies:
Proficiency with Jira and Confluence platforms.
Experience using Visio, Lucidchart, or Figma.
Strong working knowledge of Agile and Scrum frameworks.
Expertise in project documentation and requirement management.
Core Competencies:
Exceptional analytical and critical thinking skills.
Effective stakeholder management and communication abilities.
Strong problem-solving and negotiation capabilities.
High level of attention to detail.
Capacity to handle multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
Education & Experience:
A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
4-5 years of professional experience in a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst capacity.
Proven track record of collaborating with cross-functional business and technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into viable technical solutions.
Comprehensive understanding of software development and project delivery lifecycles.
Preferred Skills
Practical experience with data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Understanding of data warehousing principles.
Background in designing test cases and coordinating UAT processes.
Foundational knowledge of Python or other scripting languages.
Relevant industry experience within IT Services, BFSI, E-commerce, or Healthcare sectors.
Key Competencies
Analysis of Business and Technical requirements.
Data Analysis and Validation.
Process Optimization and Improvement.
Stakeholder Engagement and Collaboration.
Delivery of Projects within Agile Frameworks.
Technical Documentation and Reporting.
Key Focus Areas: Elicitation, BRD/FRD creation, SQL, REST/SOAP APIs, Jira, Confluence, BPMN/UML, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Note: Only female candidates are eligible.

We are looking for a talented Computer Vision Developer to design and implement advanced image and video processing solutions.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in computer vision algorithms, deep learning frameworks, and real-time image analysis, enabling innovative AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and optimize computer vision models for image classification, object detection, segmentation, and tracking.
Implement solutions using OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
Work on image preprocessing, feature extraction, and data augmentation techniques.
Integrate vision models into production systems and optimize for real-time performance.
Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, and product teams to deliver AI solutions.
Ensure model accuracy, scalability, and deployment efficiency.
Stay updated with the latest research and advancements in computer vision and deep learning.
Required Skills:
Strong experience with OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar libraries.
Proficiency in Python (and optionally C++ for performance-critical tasks).
Knowledge of image processing techniques and computer vision algorithms.
Experience with CNNs, object detection models (YOLO, Faster R-CNN), and segmentation models (Mask R-CNN, U-Net).
Familiarity with GPU acceleration and model optimization for deployment.
Preferred Skills:
Experience with video analytics, 3D vision, or AR/VR applications.
Knowledge of edge deployment (NVIDIA Jetson, TensorRT).
Understanding of cloud-based AI services (AWS Sagemaker, GCP AI Platform).

Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across the software engineering organization.

Development & Automation: Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, Git, Workflow Automation, Infrastructure as Code

8+ years of software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or developer productivity experience.
Experience leading technical teams and enterprise-scale engineering initiatives.
Experience administering and supporting GitHub Enterprise environments.
Experience deploying and governing GitHub Copilot Enterprise.
Experience implementing enterprise CI/CD and automation platforms.
Experience integrating AI technologies into software engineering workflows.
Experience supporting large-scale developer ecosystems.
Strong understanding of platform engineering, developer experience, and AI-enabled engineering practices.

Designation: Manager

Position description: We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to lead the mechanical operations within the Blast Furnace department at Jindal Ferrous Limited. This role demands a strategic thinker with deep expertise in blast furnace mechanical systems, committed to optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring equipment reliability, and driving continuous improvement initiatives in a mining and metals environment. The ideal candidate will oversee maintenance, coordinate cross-functional teams, and implement best practices to support the companys production goals while adhering to safety and environmental standards.

Primary Responsibilities:
Lead and manage all mechanical operations related to the blast furnace, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime.
Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance strategies to enhance equipment reliability and lifespan.
Coordinate with production, quality, and safety teams to align mechanical activities with overall plant objectives.
Supervise and mentor mechanical engineering staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
Oversee troubleshooting and root cause analysis of mechanical failures, implementing corrective actions promptly.
Manage budgeting, procurement, and inventory control for mechanical spare parts and equipment.
Ensure compliance with industry safety standards, environmental regulations, and company policies in all mechanical operations.
Drive process improvement projects using data-driven methodologies to increase operational efficiency and reduce costs.
Collaborate with external vendors and contractors for specialized maintenance and equipment upgrades.
Prepare detailed reports and presentations for senior management on mechanical performance, challenges, and improvement plans.

Description:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:-

Monitor daily operation of laboratory and reporting results to all concerns

Plan daily weekly monthly and annual maintenance required for the Instruments in the lab to ensure the availabilities through the year.

Responsibilities:

1. Chemical Analysis of Materials:

o Collection of samples received from yard, rakes, and trucks in process and customer end samples.

o Thorough knowledge on Sample collection, preparation as per International standard methods.

o Well conversant with NABL (ISO/IEC 17025), prepare and develop and update ISO documents to comply with company policies.

o Plan and arrange to carry out calibration of typical Instruments to ensure accuracy of results reported.

o Conduct routine chemical analysis of raw materials (e.g., iron ore, limestone, coke, and fluxes) and sinter products to ensure compliance with quality specifications.

o Analyze blast furnace materials, including coke, sinter, slag, and hot metal, to monitor chemical properties and optimize production processes.

o Perform both wet chemical analysis and instrumental techniques such as XRF, ICP, OES ,CS- combustion analysis ,GC, Orsat, Microscopy and other methods as required for accurate material testing.

o Monitor the quality of sinter and blast furnace materials, ensuring they meet the required chemical, physical and metallurgical specifications for optimal performance.

o Carry out periodic inspections and tests to ensure that the sinter plant and blast furnace operations adhere to quality standards.

o Investigate and address any discrepancies in material quality, reporting findings and suggesting corrective actions to the production team.

o Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all chemical analyses, test results, and quality control activities in both hard and soft form.

o Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols while handling chemicals, materials, and laboratory equipment.

o Comply with environmental regulations and company policies regarding waste disposal, emissions, and handling of hazardous materials.



Qualifications:

Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Chemistry, Diploma in Chemical Engineering/ Metallurgy.

Experience: Minimum of 7 years for AM, 5 years for Chemist /Executive and 3 years for Asst. Eng. in similar position in BF/SP Laboratory in a chemical analysis or metallurgical laboratory, preferably in integrated steel plant.

Computer knowledge is essential.

Skills:

o Strong understanding of chemical processes involved in sintering and blast furnace operations.

o Proficiency with laboratory techniques and equipment such as X-ray fluorescence (XRF), ICP, and other instrumental methods.

o Experience in quality control and assurance processes, specifically related to metallurgical materials.

o Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.

o Ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights to improve process efficiency.

Purpose of the Job:-

The purpose of the CI role is to ensure that the BHL sites are managed efficiently through proper maintenance of Equipments, management of stakeholders and OPEX control with the objective of driving higher uptime and Optimizing energy costs within company guidelines of Operations and Maintenance & Code of Conduct.







Prepare & monitor preventive maintenance (PM) Schedule; review the technician & vendor performance (Site visit, SLAs etc.).Periodically as per defined Parameters, ensure proper documentation of reports (Field service reports, log books etc.) accurately and Timely, supervise maintenance and working of Equipments like network monitoring systems, PIUs for Alarms to avoid major outage and drive better uptime and guide technicians in their work.
Conduct root cause analysis for breakdowns, analyses past PM data; review alarm status at the time of
Breakdown; guide technician on troubleshooting in order to identify causes of breakdown and ensure timely.
30% Compliance with PM Schedules, Site Audit compliance, Feedback, Higher Uptime, PIU working at Site, Accurate and timely Documentation No. of breakdowns at Site/Outages.



Conduct site visits to monitor site hygiene and safety, carry out periodic audits of log books, diesel filling
sheets and processes at site; supervise key management; monitor repair and maintenance in order to ensure that all assets are maintained in proper conditions and there is no discrepancy around rating of assets or any theft/misuse, No. of site visits, Repair & Maintenance cost.



Control energy OPEX by keeping DG on auto mode and utilizing battery back-up as planned, ensuring no overrated equipment is operated at site; monitor and analyses consumption patterns; identify discrepancies and negative trends; coordinate with technicians to take corrective actions to optimize diesel usage, monitor & document DG/battery/EB run hour and take corrective actions as required, control caretakers/landlords so that they do not interfere with operations & diesel-filling etc.
Liase with EB to ensure bills are generated and paid on time, resolve issues around line layout and bill
generation(especially meter reading), payment to avoid disconnection and any other EB related rectification and repair 20% Timely payment of EB bills No Disconnection/ penalties Diesel consumption



Engage with landlords to effectively deal with issues arising out of diesel theft, interference with equipment, usage and working, take timely feedback about rentals received etc. to pre-empt/minimize site outage due to landlord interference and protect company assets. Liase with community, local administration, police, EB officials etc
Create database of site history and issues to share experiences with team and proactively address
Potential problems. Follow up with internal stakeholders (legal/estate/Operations/ Infra/ Supply/ Purchase/Deployment/ Quality/ etc.) for tracking of equipment, work order, services etc. respond to & escalate unresolved issues to ensure timely closure of work orders and site support as required



Monitor details of equipments and their maintenance schedule, monitor vendor SLAs, cross verify FSRs filled by vendors with technician reports and site visit, coordinate with vendors in case of issues on site for timely service, give feedback to management for levy of penalties on default, resolve any escalated issues/ guide technicians on vendor management in order to ensure that all contractual obligations and SLA clauses are met by vendors and maintain asset lifespan.





B Tech/ Diploma in electrical/ Telecom/Mechanical /Automobile engineering with experience of 2-3 years in the Telecom sector (preferably).
Should possess good working knowledge of electrical equipments & past people management experience is preferred
Good knowledge of MS Office.
Equipment and Maintenance Knowledge Equipment Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of electrical equipment (PIU, SMPS, AC, Battery Bank, power plant, PCM, EB meter, panels etc.) and DG set.
Site Installation Demonstrates adequate knowledge of installation & commissioning procedures for equipment as well as cables, load connections, wires, required voltages etc. in order to ensure proper site setup and working.
Works in partnership with others, is flexible and willing to support others while achieving common goals.
Shows willingness to learn new methods by self-learning and learning by doing.
Identifies new ideas, solutions, in dealing with situations, suggesting new ways of doing things.
Execution Excellence- Strategic Agility Planning & Analysis.

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Helps drive company values and philosophy and ensures all training and development activities are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision. Works with property leadership team to identify and address employee and organizational development needs. The position is responsible for ensuring effective training is in place to enable the achievement of desired business results. Training programs focus on a variety of topics, including product knowledge, company philosophy, and customer service and leadership skills. Conducts needs assessments, designs and develops training programs and facilitates the delivery of both custom and corporate training programs. Measures the effectiveness of training to ensure a return on investment.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources or related professional area; certified trainer.
OR
- 4-year bachelors degree in Human Resources, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; certified trainer; no work experience required.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Administering Employee Training Programs
- Promotes and informs employees about all training programs.
- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.
- Helps employees identify specific behaviors that will contribute to service excellence.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Uses effective training methods to ensure employees have a good understanding of guest satisfaction and can demonstrate guest satisfaction skills.
- Meets with training cadre on a regular basis to support training efforts.
- Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals and/or managers.
Evaluating Training Programs Effectiveness
- Monitors enrollment and attendance at training classes.
- Meets regularly with participants to assess progress and address concerns.
- Partners with operational leaders to assess if employees demonstrate effective technical and leadership skills.
- Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.
- Measures transfer of learning from training courses to the operation.
- Ensures adult learning principles are incorporated into training programs.
Developing Training Program Plans and Budgets
- Ensures all training and development activities (department specific and general property training) are strategically linked to the organization s mission and vision.
- Identifies performance gaps and works with managers to develop and implement appropriate training to improve performance.
- Makes any necessary adjustments to training methodology and/or re-trains as appropriate.
- Aligns current training and development programs to effectively impact key business indicators.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Develops specific training to improve service performance.
- Drives brand values and philosophy in all training and development activities.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
Managing Training Budgets
- Participates in the development of the Training budget as required.
- Manages budget in alignment with Human Resources and property financial goals.
- Manages department controllable expenses to achieve or exceed budgeted goals.
- Utilizes P-card if appropriate to control and monitor departmental expenditures.

Description:
Areas of responsibility include Restaurants/Bars and Room Service, if applicable.
Supervises daily restaurant operations and assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards and assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods.
Strives to continually improve guest and employee satisfaction and maximize the ficial performance in areas of responsibility.
Determines training needed to accomplish goals, then implements plan.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area. CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Managing Day-to-Day Operations
- Supervises and manages employees.
Manages all day-to-day operations.
Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Maintains service and sanitation standards in restaurant, bar/lounge and room service areas.
- Reviews staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and ficial objectives are met.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound ficial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.
- Ensures and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Ensures compliance with all food & beverage policies, standards and procedures by training, supervising, follow-up and hands on management.
- Ensures compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
- Ensures compliance with food handling and sanitation standards.
- Ensures staff understands local, state and Federal liquor laws.
- Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.
- Establishes guidelines so employees understand expectations and parameters.
- Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

- Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifies excellent customer service and creates a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

- Handles guest problems and complaints.
- Meets with guests on an informal basis during meals or upon departure to obtain feedback on quality of food and beverage, service levels and overall satisfaction.
- Ensures corrective action is taken to continuously improve service results.
- Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of departmental meetings with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Manages service delivery in outlets to ensure excellent service from point of entry to departure (eg, greeting from hostess, speed of order taking and food and beverage delivery, fulfillment of special requests, collection of payment & invitation to return).

- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Ensures employees are treated fairly and equitably.
Strives to improve employee retention.
- Ensures employees receive on-going training to understand guest expectations.
- Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an "open door" policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.
- Strives to improve service performance.
- Ensures recognition is taking place across areas of responsibility.
Additional Responsibilities
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Assists servers and hosts on the floor during meal periods and high demand times.
- Recognizes good quality products and presentations.
- Supervises daily shift operations in absence of Assistant Restaurant Manager.
- Oversees the ficial aspects of the department including purchasing and payment of invoices.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

1) The candidate should have android smart phone.
2) The candidate should have personal Bike and driving licence.

Job role
1. On-Site Maintenance and Repairs: Conduct regular inspections, maintenance, and repairs on a wide range of oil and gas equipment, including fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps, to ensure their optimal performance and minimize downtime. 2. Troubleshooting: Diagnosing and troubleshooting complex technical issues that may arise during the operation of equipment, utilizing a deep understanding of the specific systems and processes involved in our industry.
3. Installation and Commissioning: Assisting with the installation, configuration, and commissioning of new equipment (fuel dispensers and other types of equipment at retail outstations like Petrol pumps), ensuring that it operates according to specified guidelines and safety standards.
4. Customer Support: Providing technical support and guidance to clients or customers, addressing their concerns, and offering solutions to maximize the efficiency and safety of their operations.
5. Safety Compliance: Ensuring that all work performed adheres to industry safety standards and regulations, and identifying potential safety hazards or risks to prevent accidents and promote a secure working environment.
6. Documentation and Reporting: Maintaining detailed records of service activities, including maintenance schedules, repairs performed, and any modifications made, and providing comprehensive reports to supervisors or management as required.
7. Training and Knowledge Sharing: Attending training sessions or workshops to enhance the understanding of equipment operations, maintenance procedures, and safety protocols.
8. Continuous Improvement: Identifying opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancement within the scope of equipment maintenance and service delivery, and proposing relevant solutions to management for consideration.
9. Field Operations Coordination: Collaborating with other team members, including engineers, technicians, and project managers, to coordinate field operations, prioritize tasks, and ensure timely and effective resolution of technical issues.
10. Adherence to Company Policies: Following company policies and protocols, including those related to quality control, health, safety, and environmental protection, to uphold the organization's reputation and maintain high operational standards.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Designation: Assistant Manager Civil

Department: Civil / Project Execution
Industry: Infrastructure / EPC / Construction
Reporting To: Project Manager / Construction Manager
Job Location: Manipur, Noney Market

Job Purpose

To manage and supervise civil construction activities at project sites, ensuring timely execution, quality standards, safety compliance and optimum utilization of manpower, materials and machinery in accordance with project specifications and approved drawings.

Roles & Responsibilities

1. Project Execution & Site Management

Supervise day-to-day civil construction activities at project sites.

Ensure execution of work as per approved drawings, specifications and project schedules.

Coordinate activities related to railway tunnels, hydro tunnels, bridges and other infrastructure projects.

Monitor daily progress and ensure achievement of project milestones.

Identify site-related challenges and take corrective measures.

2. Planning & Coordination

Coordinate with Project Managers, Planning, Billing, Procurement, Stores and other departments.

Prepare daily, weekly and monthly work progress reports.

Ensure timely availability of manpower, materials and equipment.

Monitor project schedules and highlight delays or deviations.

3. Quality Control

Ensure civil works comply with approved quality standards and technical specifications.

Coordinate inspections and quality checks at different stages of construction.

Ensure proper implementation of quality control procedures.

Maintain site records, inspection reports and relevant documentation.

4. Manpower & Resource Management

Allocate and supervise manpower, contractors and subcontractors.

Monitor workforce productivity and site performance.

Ensure optimum utilization of construction materials, machinery and resources.

Maintain discipline and coordination among site teams.

5. Safety & Compliance

Ensure implementation of safety policies and site safety procedures.

Coordinate with the Safety Department to maintain a safe working environment.

Ensure compliance with statutory requirements and company policies.

Report unsafe practices, incidents and site hazards.

6. Documentation & Reporting

Maintain daily progress reports, site measurement records and work registers.

Coordinate with the Billing Department for quantity verification and RA bills.

Maintain records of material consumption and work completion.

Submit periodic project updates to senior management.

Educational Qualification

B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering or Diploma in Civil Engineering.

Relevant technical certifications will be an added advantage.

6- 8 years of relevant experience in civil construction / infrastructure / EPC projects.

Experience in railway tunnels, hydro tunnels, underground construction or heavy civil infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Experience in site execution, contractor management and project coordination is essential.

Required Skills & Competencies

Strong knowledge of civil construction methods and engineering drawings.

Project planning and execution skills.

Manpower and contractor management.

Knowledge of quality control and safety standards.

Problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

Strong communication and coordination skills.

Proficiency in MS Office and AutoCAD.

Ability to work independently at project locations.

Job description

Roles and Responsibilities
The organization does fuelling and defueling of aircrafts at various airports throughout the country. The new recruits will be thoroughly trained in all operations and procedures which they will be required to perform in the course of their job and in all actions that are to be taken in the event of an emergency.
Since the activity of fueling & de-fueling is done with the aid of Mobilized machinery/ equipment the person concerned should be able to drive an LMV/HTV vehicle comfortably.

Carry out into plane service including refueling and defueling (Receive refueling instructions from Shift Manager)
Conduct Quality Control checks on the fuel on mobile facilities and necessary documentation
Issue and sign fuel delivery receipts with respect to fuel supplies
Conduct in-situ field tests
Carry Sampling of Jet A-1 and forward the same to laboratories
Perform verification of in-use pressure gauges, hydrometers, etc.
Conduct periodic preventive maintenance on all equipment
Conduct minor maintenance and operations checks/works on the equipment
Coordination with customers/ DGCA Officials/ BSSPL officials in conducting Audits & inspections
Give timely, safe, and courteous into plane services to the airline customers
Sales/ stock accounting to be made at the end of each shift
Tank Lorry/ pipeline receipts of product and related stock accounting
Other Admin/ operations related works

Desired Candidate Profile
Candidates who have completed their B.E. / B. Tech./Diploma may only apply.
Candidates should mandatorily have a Light Motor(LMV), minimum 3 years old driving license.
Candidates with Heavy Vehicle License and/or experience in Service/ Automobile Industry/ ground handling agencies at the airport will be preferred.
Candidate should be a team player and should have the ability to handle a team cordially.
Candidates Should be ready to work in round the clock Shift pattern
Candidates should have good command over English Language
Candidate should have good working knowledge of MS Office
Candidate should be ready to work at PAN India location.
AboutCompany: Bharat Stars Services Private Limited (BSSPL) is a Joint Venture Company of Bharat Petroleum Corporation limited (BPCL) - and St-Airport Services Pte Ltd (STARS) Singapore. BPCL & STARS own 50% equity each in the JV Company. Both BPCL & STARS are reputed specialists in the aviation fuel logistics & total supply chain management, including the provision of ITP services with many years of experience & outstanding track record.BSSPL was incorporated in September 2007 & started its commercial operation at Bangalore International Airport in September 2008, Delhi International Airport in July 2010 and Mumbai International Airport in January 2015.As on date, BSSPL has PAN India presence with operations at more than 40 airports across the country.

Description:
Role Overview
We are seeking proactive, target-oriented Admission Officers to drive student recruitment, brand visibility, and institutional outreach across key educational hubs in Northeast India-specifically Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, and Nagaland. The role entails end-to-end admission generation through active lead nurturing, building strong networks with educational consultants and institutions, and executing grassroots brand-building initiatives.


Key Responsibilities
Lead Calling Admissions Generation: Proactively call on prospective student leads, provide comprehensive academic counseling, nurture inquiries through systematic follow-ups, and convert leads into confirmed admissions.
Admission Consultant Network: Identify, onboard, and collaborate closely with education consultants and admission agencies across the designated territory to expand sourcing pipelines and drive partner-led admissions.
Brand Building Strategic Outreach: Formulate and execute field strategies to elevate institutional brand awareness, foster regional goodwill, and establish strong localized networks for ongoing business development.
School Institutional Engagement: Plan and conduct structured visits to schools, junior colleges, coaching centers, and educational hubs to host career seminars, workshops, and interaction sessions.
Stakeholder Relationship Management: Build and nurture productive working partnerships with school principals, academic counselors,community influencers, and key local education facilitators.
Fairs Spot-Admission Drives: Represent the institution at major regional education fairs, youth events, and spot-admission venues across assigned clusters.
Pipeline Management Market Intelligence: Maintain rigorous daily outreach logs, monitor student conversion metrics, and report on regional competitor activities and emerging trends.


Type of Employment
Contractual


Preferred Skills Qualifications
Bachelors degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
1 to 3+ years of proven experience in field outreach, education marketing, student recruitment, or academic counseling.
Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, negotiation, and counseling capabilities in English and Hindi.
Self-motivated with strong closing ability and a track record of meeting or exceeding admission targets.

4. A passion for social media and a deep understanding of how to use it to build brand awareness, engagement, and sales.
5. A strong understanding of brand messaging, tone, and voice, and the ability to consistently maintain a cohesive brand image across all social media channels.

ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
ATM Field Service Engineering (Manipur)
About the Role
An ATM Field Service Engineer is responsible for the entire lifecycle of ATMs, from pre-installation and setup to ongoing maintenance and repair. This includes training clients on ATM usage, performing preventive maintenance to avoid problems, troubleshooting malfunctions, and completing repairs to get ATMs back up and running quickly. They also interact directly with customers to address any concerns and provide excellent customer service. The role requires a proactive approach, responding immediately to all complaints and scheduling preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. For complex issues, collaboration with the customer support team and R&D department is necessary. A valid 2-wheeler license and motorbike are essential for travel to various ATM locations.
About the Company
Vortex Engineering is a Chennai, India-based Technology company focused on building innovative products for the ATM/self-service market. The company has a family of ATM HW & SW products with around 10K installations and a portfolio of software products for the management of multivendor ATMs and other value-added applications. Our customers include leading banks in India and a growing set of new customers in growth countries in Asia, ME & Africa.
Vortex Engineering is revolutionizing self-service product space with unique firsts in the industry

Lowest carbon footprint with ultra-low power design, making it viable for solar-powered deployments
Most sustainable, and the only commercially successful ATM to run on an open-source Linux platform
Only Indian company (and one of a few globally) to have developed and patented dispenser technology
Developing next-generation secured Hardware & Software products using IoT, AI, ML & 5G

The company has a partnership with IIT-Madras for R&D on the latest cutting-edge technologies and offers exciting career opportunities for dynamic individuals with a passion to innovate, lead, take larger responsibilities and grow with the company.

Description:
Job Description QA/QC Engineer (Railway Tunnel Project)
Designation: QA/QC Engineer
Department: Quality Control
Project: Railway Tunnel / Railway Infrastructure
Experience: 5–10 Years (relevant tunnel experience preferred)
Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Location: Project Site
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced QA/QC Engineer with railway tunnel construction experience to ensure that all civil construction activities comply with approved drawings, project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and maintain the project Quality Assurance and Quality Control (QA/QC) plan.
Inspect railway tunnel construction activities, including excavation, rock support, shotcrete, rock bolting, grouting, waterproofing, and concrete lining.
Monitor tunnel excavation and construction activities as per approved drawings and method statements.
Conduct inspections and coordinate material testing, laboratory tests, and field tests.
Verify the quality of concrete, reinforcement, cement, aggregates, and other construction materials.
Prepare and maintain Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), checklists, inspection requests, and quality records.
Coordinate with the client, consultant, and construction team for inspections and approvals.
Identify non-conformities (NCRs), recommend corrective actions, and ensure closure.
Ensure compliance with approved method statements, technical specifications, and relevant IS/IRC/railway standards.
Prepare quality reports, test reports, and documentation for audits.
Monitor subcontractor quality and ensure compliance with project requirements.
Support internal and external quality audits and ensure timely closure of observations.
Required Skills and Experience
Experience in railway tunnel construction projects is preferred.
Knowledge of tunnel excavation methods, including NATM, where applicable.
Knowledge of shotcrete, rock bolts, lattice girders, steel ribs, grouting, and tunnel lining.
Experience in QA/QC documentation, material testing, and site inspections.
Familiarity with drawings, specifications, method statements, and ITPs.
Good coordination and communication skills with clients and consultants.
Preferred Experience
Candidates with experience in railway tunnels, underground structures, highway tunnels, or other major infrastructure projects will be preferred.

Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Job Title: US IT Recruiter (Multiple Openings) Fresher to Senior Level
Location: Salem, Tamil Nadu, Pondicherry
Experience: 0-10+ Years
Shift: Night Shift ( US Staffing)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary:
We are looking for US IT Recruiters at different experience levels Freshers, Junior, Mid-Level, and Senior Recruiters — to join our recruitment team in Salem and Pondicherry.The role will be assigned based on the candidate's experience, skills, and knowledge of the US IT Staffing process.Freshers with good communication skills and a strong willingness to learn are welcome to apply. Experienced candidates should have hands-on experience in US IT Recruitment and candidate sourcing.Key Responsibilities
Source IT professionals using Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing platforms.
Understand job descriptions and identify suitable candidates based on client requirements.
Search and identify candidates using Boolean search, keyword search, resume databases, and other sourcing techniques.
Review resumes and shortlist qualified candidates based on technical skills and experience.
Conduct initial candidate screening to assess skills, experience, communication, availability, location, work authorization, and interest.
Communicate job opportunities and requirements clearly to candidates.
Maintain regular communication and follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
Coordinate interviews and follow up on interview feedback.
Negotiate candidate salary/rate expectations within approved guidelines.
Collect required candidate information and documentation.
Submit qualified candidates to clients/account managers within the required timelines.
Maintain accurate candidate records, submissions, interview status, and recruitment activities in the ATS.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals.
Meet daily, weekly, and monthly recruitment targets.
Maintain quality submissions and ensure timely completion of recruitment activities.
Experience-Level Expectations Fresher / Junior (0–2 Years):
Good communication skills and willingness to learn US IT Recruitment.
Learn and perform candidate sourcing, resume screening, candidate calling, and interview coordination.
Previous recruitment experience or internship is an advantage but not mandatory for freshers.
Mid-Level (2–7 Years):
Independently manage assigned US IT recruitment requirements.
Strong experience in sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, submissions, and interview coordination.
Ability to manage multiple requirements and consistently achieve recruitment targets.
Senior Level (7-10+ Years):
Handle complex, niche, and high-priority US IT requirements independently.
Strong expertise in advanced sourcing, candidate screening, rate negotiation, and candidate management.
Ability to mentor junior recruiters and contribute to team performance and recruitment strategies.
Required Skills
Good verbal and written communication skills.
Strong interpersonal and candidate engagement skills.
Good analytical and organizational skills.
Ability to work in a target-driven and fast-paced environment.
Basic understanding of IT technologies and technical terminology.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel, Word, and Outlook.
Willingness to work during US business hours / night shift.
Preferred Skills – Experienced Candidates
Hands-on experience in US IT Staffing / US IT Recruitment.
Experience with Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Monster, CareerBuilder, or similar sourcing platforms.
Knowledge of Boolean search and candidate sourcing techniques.
Understanding of W2, C2C, and 1099 hiring models.
Knowledge of US work authorization and visa categories such as H-1B, OPT, CPT, GC, and USC.
Experience with ATS platforms.
Knowledge of different IT skill sets and technical job requirements.
Experience working with VMS or client/vendor requirements is an advantage.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
MBA HR, B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, or other relevant qualifications are preferred.
Freshers are welcome to apply.
Candidate Profile
We are looking for candidates who are:
Interested in building or advancing their career in US IT Staffing.
Good at communication and relationship building.
Willing to work in a night-shift environment aligned with US business hours.
Target-oriented and committed to achieving recruitment goals.
Willing to learn and continuously improve recruitment skills.
Candidates will be considered for the appropriate level based on their experience, skills, and demonstrated recruitment capabilities.
