Description:
Role & Responsibilities 1. Manufacturing Line Quality Inspection
Conduct in-process quality inspections at all manufacturing stages to ensure products conform to approved drawings, specifications, and customer requirements.
Perform first-piece inspection, setup approval, patrol inspection, and periodic quality checks.
Verify Critical to Quality (CTQ) and Critical to Process (CTP) characteristics.
Ensure inspection activities are performed as per Control Plans, Work Instructions, and approved inspection standards.
Identify, report, and escalate quality abnormalities and process deviations.
Ensure only conforming products are released to the next process.
2. Process Quality Monitoring
Monitor manufacturing processes to ensure compliance with approved process parameters and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Verify machine settings, fixtures, tools, gauges, and inspection equipment during production.
Monitor critical process parameters and ensure operators follow approved work instructions.
Verify process changeovers, model changes, and production setup approvals.
Ensure process controls, Poka-Yoke systems, and defect-prevention mechanisms are functioning effectively.
Conduct process verification following machine breakdowns, maintenance activities, parameter changes, or abnormal production conditions.
3. First-Piece Inspection & Setup Approval
Conduct first-piece inspection following production setup, model changes, tooling changes, or process adjustments.
Verify product dimensions, visual characteristics, electrical parameters, and functional requirements, as applicable.
Ensure production starts only after the required quality approval.
Maintain first-piece inspection records and ensure proper traceability.
Verify setup approval effectiveness and monitor initial production for abnormalities.
4. Defect Identification & Containment
Identify, segregate, and control non-conforming products.
Implement immediate containment actions for process defects and critical quality abnormalities.
Ensure defective and suspect materials are clearly identified and physically segregated.
Stop production or escalate to the concerned team in case of critical quality issues.
Ensure containment covers affected machines, production lines, shifts, batches, and products.
Verify rework and repair activities as per approved instructions.
Prevent rejected products from being mixed with accepted products.
5. Inspection & Testing
Perform visual, dimensional, electrical, functional, and other specified inspections.
Verify product characteristics against approved drawings, specifications, inspection standards, and sample criteria.
Conduct inspections using appropriate measuring instruments, gauges, and testing equipment.
Verify the calibration status and condition of inspection equipment before use.
Record inspection results accurately and maintain proper traceability.
Support destructive testing and validation activities, as required.
6. Quality Documentation & Traceability
Maintain inspection reports, patrol inspection records, first-piece approval records, defect records, and quality check sheets.
Ensure inspection results and process abnormalities are properly documented.
Maintain product traceability through lot number, batch number, date code, machine number, and shift details.
Ensure quality records are completed accurately and within specified timelines.
Support quality documentation updates following engineering or process changes.
7. Problem Solving & Corrective Actions
Support root cause analysis of manufacturing defects and quality abnormalities.
Participate in problem-solving activities using:
5 Why Analysis
Fishbone Diagram
Pareto Analysis
8D Problem Solving
Provide defect samples, inspection data, and process information to support investigations.
Verify corrective action implementation at the manufacturing line.
Monitor corrective action effectiveness and ensure recurrence prevention.
Escalate repeated defects and abnormal trends to Quality Engineers and Supervisors.
8. Product & Process Audits
Conduct layered process audits, product audits, and process compliance checks.
Verify adherence to:
Control Plans
Work Instructions
Standard Operating Procedures
Inspection Standards
Customer-Specific Requirements
IATF 16949 requirements
Verify operator compliance, process parameters, product identification, traceability, and defect-prevention controls.
Identify audit findings and ensure timely corrective action implementation.
9. Quality Data Monitoring
Collect and analyze manufacturing defect data.
Monitor rejection, rework, scrap, and defect trends.
Maintain daily defect reports and quality performance records.
Support Pareto analysis and defect-reduction activities.
Monitor process rejection trends and communicate abnormal performance.
Support PPM reduction and continuous improvement initiatives.
10. Cross-Functional Coordination
Coordinate with Production Supervisors, Operators, Quality Engineers, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Process Engineering, NPI/Engineering, Incoming Quality, and Warehouse/Logistics teams.
Communicate quality abnormalities promptly and ensure effective containment.
Support production teams in maintaining process discipline and quality standards.
Participate in daily quality meetings and continuous improvement activities.

Job Description
Job Title: RA- Credit Life Reporting To- Manager - Credit Life
Location :
Will be responsible for managing a leading bank Loan Verticals and branches. Purpose of the Job (overall high level summary of the job)
Managing the Group credit life business, across locations and to achieve business volume (premium) and desired penetration. Regularly engage and provide market update, training & drive the ASCs (Loan Centre) to implement the set processes and ensuring seamless functioning of Grp Cr Life product within ASCs. He/she will be closely working with the Retail Asset Teams of the Bank to sell Group credit life Scheme along with the bank s primary product. He/she would plan, monitor, coach, communicate and execute sales strategies and gain mind share of the bank officials (at all levels) and then provide feedback. He/she will also in turn work with the Group Operations to follow up on issuance and clearing of pendency, if any.
Principal Accountabilities How they are achieved/measured
Manage the Group business with the Bank employees
Liaison with different departments for closure of the cases
Champion product and process to drive top line sales through business sales team and maintaining penetration levels of group insurance products with channel partner.
Coordinate and train key officials (ASSL, DSA, other bank officials) to enhance their understanding of the business to increase seller activisation
Provide market feedback on competition and other products in the market.
Manage and strengthen relationship through engagement with Partner s Zonal Leadership team, Ops & Credit Team, DSAs, SMs, Field Sales Staff at all levels and across functions. Values add in key initiatives to enhance attachment ration & business volume through training and service.
Tracking penetration performance and publishing dashboards, along with Group Operations.
To measure & monitor the various metrics (Files and sum assured Penetration rates, seller activation, Claim denial rates/ pending rates, rejection ratios , medical TATs etc), to minimize the same and adhere to TATs and contribute to product improvement.
Monitoring and control process of Post Sales.
Managing complete claims operation & end to end process.

Description:
About the company

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising
the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market economy to
mid-market to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel
over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price
point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.
We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:
Itsy (1000–1500)
Treebo and Treebo Premium (1500–3000)
Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10
across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the companys strategic vision of
democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure
highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing
the operations and enabling sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio
across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect
balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a business development mindset.

Key Responsibilities
1) Operational Excellence Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to
brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service
quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners
to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and
timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery
mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the
assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures
before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed
properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to
achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your
portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the
segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association

What Are We Looking For
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and
business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability

Description:
About the Role:

The NRI Relationship Manager will be responsible for nurturing NRI client relationships through continuous client engagements and risk profiling. The NRI RM will be responsible for identification of potential customers and providing them customized solutions as per their requirements. The position entails client management and acquisition with a key focus on expanding the Asset under Management. Key capabilities include working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment with cross-functional teams to design, collaborate with multiple stakeholders and provide tailored investment products aligned to customer needs. The center of all client engagements will be to ensure superior customer experience.

Key Skills

Client relationship management: Strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain high trust and long term relationship with clients
Communication: Excellent verbal and communication skills for conveying complex concepts clearly
Sales and Negotiation Skills: Proven track record in sales, with the ability to meet and exceed targets. 
Financial Acumen: In-depth understanding of banking products, services, and financial markets. Ability to analyse financial statements and provide sound financial advice. 
Problem-Solving Abilities: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address needs and challenges. 

Key Responsibilities

Provide financial solutions to the NRI customers while maintaining high service standards
Maintain complete customer profile including the risk profile, demographics and assets in the bank
Maintain relationships with the existing customers through mailers and phone calls and share insights on the fluctuations in interest rates, exchange rates and various product offerings
Enrich relationships and garner higher wallet share through customer engagement activities
Deepen the existing relationships by cross selling the Bank's products and services/ third party investment products
Review the inflows and outflows in the mapped NRI accounts and also proactively track NRI visits to India
Identify potential customers who can be sold tailored products to enhance product penetration
Acquire new customers by converting referral leads generated through existing clients, NRI brokers, stock brokers, expats of shipping companies and overseas branches
Achieve targets as assigned by the organization on a monthly basis
Record and track all engagement activities through the CRM system
Comply with KYC/SEBI rules, regulations, and legislation governing the Bank

Qualifications:

Optimal qualification for success on the job is:
Graduation from a recognized institute
AMFI and NCFM certifications

Role Proficiencies:

For successful execution of the job, the candidate should possess the following:
Knowledge of banking products and services
Ability to manage complex client situations
Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language
Ability to multitask, adaptive and responsive towards evolving customer and organization asks.
Good networking and relationship building skills
AboutCompany: At Axis Bank, we go much beyond addressing the financial needs of our customers. We give them reasons to strengthen their trust in us, at every step. This belief has paid us rich dividends, bringing with it steady growth, rapid expansion and an opportunity for you to propel your career further.

About the Role:

The Branch Head (BH) is responsible for coordinating and overseeing all branch operations and implementing strategies to increase productivity and performance levels in order to achieve the branchs financial targets. Ensure efficient daily operation of a branch, including lending, product sales and customer service in accordance with the banks objectives
Prepare the plan for the growth of branch business in consultation with the Cluster Head

Establish and strengthen relations with key customers (e.g. top 10%) to generate sustained business.
Review daily/ periodic reports (e.g. overdrawn accounts, temporary overdrafts, cash retention limit, office accounts, etc.) and take proactive action to ensure profitable and ethical business.
Ensure audit related deliverables, both internal and external are met as per the prescribed norms

Create a performance oriented environment leading to high employee motivation and productivity

Resolve, report any disruptions (e.g. strike or local disturbance) and take appropriate action to ensure that the branch operations are run smoothly.
Liaison with the cluster office and other branch offices to ensure the smooth management of operations and the achievement of overall business goals.
Ensure proper upkeep of branch premises and assets including safety and security

Graduate/ MBA (Marketing) preferred from a recognized institute

Knowledge of banking products and services
Knowledge of regulatory guidelines and norms
Good communication (both verbal and written) skill in both English and the local language
Ability to manage complex client situations

Description:
1. Customer Complaint Management
- Receive, analyze, and respond to customer complaints within the agreed timeline.
- Coordinate containment, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions.
- Prepare and submit 8D reports, 5-Why analysis, and other customer-required reports.
- Ensure effectiveness verification and obtain customer closure approval.
2. Customer Quality Assurance
- Ensure products meet customer drawings, specifications, standards, and quality requirements.
- Monitor PPM, rejection rates, warranty claims, and field failure trends.
- Establish containment and corrective actions to prevent defective parts reaching customers.
- Ensure compliance with customer-specific requirements and quality agreements.
3. Customer Audits and Visits
- Plan and coordinate customer audits, assessments, and plant visits.
- Ensure audit readiness, documentation availability, and closure of audit findings.
- Present quality performance, improvement activities, and corrective action status.
- Coordinate cross-functional teams to address customer observations.
4. New Product Development (NPD) and Launch Quality
- Review customer quality requirements during new product development.
- Coordinate APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plan, MSA, SPC, and validation activities, as applicable.
- Ensure process readiness, product validation, traceability, and error-proofing before launch.
- Coordinate safe launch and enhanced inspection until the required approval and stability criteria are met.
5. Cross-Functional and Supplier Coordination
- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Materials, Supplier Quality, RD, and Marketing.
- Drive supplier corrective actions for customer-related component issues.
- Ensure defective material segregation, replacement, traceability, and disposition.
- Monitor action owners and timelines until effective closure.
6. Quality Performance and Continuous Improvement
- Track customer PPM, complaints, rejection costs, warranty, and repeat failures.
- Prepare monthly quality performance reports and management reviews.
- Identify recurring issues and implement horizontal deployment across similar products and processes.
- Drive lessons learned, defect prevention, and continual improvement initiatives.
India Nippon Electricals is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in the design, development, and implementation of innovative electrical solutions for automotive applications. The Senior Engineer will be responsible for leading projects from concept through to completion, ensuring that all engineering deliverables meet quality, reliability, and performance standards.

(i) To advise the concerned departments in planning and organizing measures necessary for Safe Work Practices for all employees thus prevent personal injuries.
(ii) To implement Work Permit System across the Plant and create awareness on importance adhering to Safe Work Practices.
(iii) To carry our Safety Audit periodically and evaluate the effectiveness of the action taken or proposed to be taken to prevent personal injuries.
(iv) To ensure availability of personal protective equipment and usage appropriately.
(v) To advise on matters relating to carrying out of plant safety inspections.
(vi) To carry out plant safety inspections in order to observe the physical conditions of work and the work practices and procedures followed by workers and to render advise on measures to be adopted for removing the unsafe physical conditions and preventing unsafe actions by workers.
(vii) To render assistance on matters relating to reporting and investigation of industrial accidents and occupational diseases.
(viii) To encourage reporting of Near Miss and Potential hazard and address all those observations to prevent incident/accident.
(ix) To render assistance for the cases of industrial diseases contracted and in respect of dangerous occurrences reportable under rule 106 of the Pondicherry Factories Rules, 1964.
(x) To render assistance on the maintenance of such records as are necessary relating to accidents, dangerous occurrences and industrial diseases.
(xi) To conduct safety committee meeting periodically and address all such observation.
(xii) To organize in association with the concerned departments, campaigns, competitions, contests and other activities which will develop and maintain the interest of the workers in establishing and maintaining safe conditions of work and procedure; and
(xiii) to design and conduct either independently or in collaboration with the training department, suitable training and educational programs for the prevention of personal injuries and for the propagation of safety awareness.
xiv) To work for obtaining the certification of EOHS, ESG and GreenCo.
The Safety Officer will be responsible for ensuring the safety and health of all employees within the organization. This role includes developing, implementing, and overseeing safety programs and policies to maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations. The Safety Officer will conduct regular safety inspections, risk assessments, and audits to identify potential hazards in the workplace. This position requires the development and delivery of safety training programs to enhance employee awareness and compliance. The Safety Officer will also investigate accidents and incidents, prepare reports, and recommend corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.

Description:
About the Role:
The role involves coordinating activities related to new product introductions within the organization. It emphasizes ensuring that components are ready for production and managing the overall process of product rollouts. The position will require active engagement with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth transitions from development to manufacturing.

About the Team:
You will be working with a dynamic and collaborative cross-functional team consisting of members from engineering, production, and quality assurance. The team is focused on driving innovation and efficiency in product development, ensuring that all members actively contribute their expertise to achieve common goals.

You are Responsible for:
Coordinating all aspects of new product introduction activities and ensuring that all parts are ready on time. Conducting production tryouts and addressing any manufacturing line issues that arise during the process. Securing necessary approvals at each stage of the product rollout and working in collaboration with the cross-functional team to resolve any challenges encountered.

To succeed in this role - you should have the following:
A strong background in electronics products such as Sensors, ECUs, DC-DC converters, Ignition coil and Rectifier and regulator. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Problem-solving abilities to quickly address manufacturing issues and the capability to adapt to changing project requirements. Experience in coordinating product introduction activities will be highly beneficial.
Job Title: Senior Engineer - NPI

Company Name: India Nippon Electricals


The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating new product introduction activities in the organization. This includes ensuring part readiness for production, conducting production tryouts to validate processes, obtaining necessary approvals, and effectively resolving any manufacturing line issues in collaboration with the cross-functional team (CFT). The role requires a strong focus on detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate new product introduction activities to ensure timely and efficient rollout.
- Ensure all parts are ready for production and meet quality standards.
- Conduct production tryouts to assess the manufacturing process and product functionality.
- Obtain necessary approvals from relevant stakeholders at each phase of the product introduction.
- Work closely with the cross-functional team to resolve any issues that arise on the manufacturing line.
- Monitor and report on the progress of new product initiatives and provide updates as required.

Description:
To create network of high performing agencies and promulgate initiatives within each agency
to achieve sales & productivity targets through sustainable partnership with Licensed Agents and partners.Recruit ,Coach,Mentor,Support and Retain qualified agents and partners and Drive them to achieve New business productivity & Renewal Targets.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES :
Organize and run recruitment events (BOP) for Partner and Agents.
Identify the prospective Partners and Licensed Agents.
Selection to on boarding of the Partners/Agents and responsible for Partners/Agents income
Own the operational aspects of coding of a new Partner/Agent and other day to day interactions with support functions whenever required.
Plan goals & performance needs for Partners and Agents in a periodic manner
Set weekly production target for team of agents and partners
Identify partner/ agents development needs and work with team to schedule appropriate technical, product and skills training and coaching. Develop agents in line with career development / training requirements of the Company.
Accompany agents on customer visits to support and improve sales skill. Help whenever needed in prospecting activity in the field by joint field work activity with Partners/Agents.
Responsible for the activation and productivity of the agents and partners on business month on month.
Motivate by providing support, recognizing good performers and arranging appropriate team-building activities.
Operate as a product Subject Matter Expert and run Train-Audit-Retrain cycle on skills of Partners and Agents.
Conduct weekly / monthly meeting to review performance, disseminate Company information, address common problems and concerns and rally the team to achieve goals.
Ensure Partners and agents work in accordance with Company standards, the regulation and ethics and maintain licensed status.
Make necessary decisions based on agent performance. Contact Partners and Agents who are falling short of Contract Maintenance criteria to re- activate them or arrange training.
Host events for customers to develop new and long-term relationship and promoting the brand.
Ensure submitting DSR through companys sales report management tool.
Maintain up to date knowledge of all insurance products and company regulations.
Stay informed about industry trends, competitors offerings and regulatory updates
MINIMUM/SPECIFIC EXPERIENCE :
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
Good communication skills English & regional language (mandatory)
Age group: 25-38 years
Minimum 2 years of Sales experience
Preferably has own conveyance
Previous experience of BFSI industry is preferred
Competencies and Skills -
Competency- Result Orientation
Definition-
Encourages the team to set challenging yet achievable sales, recruitment and persistency goals (13th and 25th month)
Regularly reviews self and team performance on KPI, incentive targets and provides feedback to help them improve
Recognizes and rewards team members who consistently exceed their sales, recruitment and persistency targets (KPI)

Skillset required-
Goal Setting, Time Management, Target Focus, Performance Review, Feedback Use
Competency - Sales Orientation
Definition-
Proactively researches and stays updated on new life insurance products and services
Identifies customer needs and recommends appropriate solutions
Develops strong relationships with existing distributors to drive repeat business
Meets or exceeds monthly/quarterly sales targets

Skillset required-
Product Knowledge, Prospecting, Communication, Customer Understanding, Closing Skills
Competency- Customer Delight
Definition-
Proactively identifies and addresses customer needs and concerns
Knows customer segments in the locality and develops strong relationships with customers to foster loyalty and trust
Provides product knowledge training to sales team to enhance customer experience
Analyzes customer feedback and implements improvements to processes and services

Skillset required-
Customer Service, Relationship Building, Active Listening, Problem Solving, Feedback Handling
Competency- Work Ethics
Definition-
Promotes a culture of integrity and ethical behavior within the team
Ensures sales practices comply with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards
Provides guidance to sales representatives on ethical dilemmas and decision-making
Takes prompt action to address any unethical conduct or misconduct towards brand values

Skillset required-
Integrity, Compliance, Fairness, Responsibility, Ethical Behavior

Competency - People and Team Leadership
Definition-
Communicates a clear vision and strategy for the team to achieve organizational objectives
Motivates and inspires the team to perform at a high level
Delegates tasks and responsibilities effectively to leverage team members' capabilities
Provides constructive feedback and coaching to help team members develop their skills
Skillset required-
Motivation, Teamwork, Delegation, Coaching, Support

Competency - Recruitment/Distribution Skills
Definition-
Proactively identifies and maintains a diverse pipeline of potential advisors and partners using established criteria, competitor mapping, and professional networking.
Develops and delivers a compelling value proposition that clearly articulates the career opportunity, compensation, and support structure, effectively influencing and convincing high-potential advisors and partners to join the team.
Skillfully anticipates and manages advisor objections through clear communication, factual evidence, and motivational techniques.
Effectively leverages existing networks, professional referrals, and natural market opportunities to consistently generate quality leads for distribution expansion.
Demonstrates the ability to attract established and high-performing distributors or teams from competitor organizations by highlighting the unique advantages and growth opportunities the company offers.
Ensures a good selection process is followed, and successful recruits are smoothly integrated by providing initial training and necessary resources to facilitate a fast start in the role.
Skillset required-
Lead Generation, Networking, Prospecting, Communication, Interviewing

Conduct daily CFT meetings and coordinate with cross-functional teams.

The position requires a deep understanding of manufacturing principles, tools, and technologies, as well as strong leadership capabilities to mentor junior engineers and coordinate team efforts.

Description:
We are looking for a highly driven Zonal Sales Manager to drive zonal sales, channel expansion and the development of our premium franchise and dealer network across key national hubs.

This is a field-intensive Individual Contributor (IC) and managerial role, involving direct sales responsibilities and leadership of a team of 2 to 3 members.

Employment Type: Full-Time | Hybrid | 6 Days (MondaySaturday)

1. Mandatory Industry & Product Experience

Candidates must have 5 to 10 years of core and zonal sales experience within South 2 zone comprising of the states Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep, specifically in the Automotive Detailing Industry, with direct sales/channel exposure to the following product categories:
Ceramic Coatings
Graphene Coatings
Paint Protection Films (PPF)
Automotive Window Films / Window Tints / Sun Films

Strict Eligibility Criteria: Experience in general automotive sales, automobile dealerships, car accessories, auto components or unrelated automotive products will NOT be considered relevant unless accompanied by direct sales experience in the automotive detailing products mentioned above.

Candidates without relevant automotive detailing industry experience are requested NOT to apply.

2. Sales & Channel Management
Proven experience in channel/distribution sales, territory management and dealer/franchise network development.
Ability to drive business growth, develop customer relationships and achieve zonal sales targets.
Experience in managing and leading a team of 2 to 3 members while independently driving sales closures.

3. Travel & Territory Requirements
Willingness to travel extensively, with an expected 15 to 20 travel days per month across assigned zonal hubs and territories.
Travel expenses will be covered as per the Company's Travel Allowance Policy.
The role will primarily be territory-focused, involving dealer/customer meetings, business development, relationship management and sales closures.
Occasional visits to Hyderabad may be required for business reviews, meetings, training or other organizational requirements. Wherever possible, such visits will be communicated in advance.

4. Location & Initial Training
Permanent relocation to Hyderabad is NOT required.
Selected candidates must be willing to undergo an initial 15 to 30-day training period at our Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad office.
The training duration will be mutually discussed and agreed upon during the interview process.

5. Language Proficiency
Fluency in English, Hindi and the relevant local language(s) is mandatory.
Strong professional communication skills are essential for interacting with dealers, distributors, customers and stakeholders in the premium automobile segment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Revenue Growth
Own end-to-end sales and revenue generation for Ceramic Pro and Kavaca across the SOUTH 2 Zone: Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Puducherry, Andaman & Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep.
Develop sales strategies, identify business opportunities, strengthen existing accounts and drive consistent revenue growth aligned with company objectives.

2. Network Expansion & Development
Identify, evaluate, onboard and develop a strong network of detailing studios, PPF installers, car dealerships and franchise partners.
Expand market presence, improve product penetration and build a sustainable partner network.

3. Partnership & Relationship Management
Build and maintain long-term relationships with franchisees, automotive detailers, workshops, dealerships and car enthusiast communities.
Understand partner requirements, strengthen engagement, resolve operational challenges and maximize sales potential.

4. Product Knowledge & Technical Awareness
Educate partners on the applications, benefits and fundamentals of Ceramic Pro's ceramic coatings and Kavaca's PPF products.
Coordinate with technical teams to ensure adequate product knowledge, application awareness, quality standards and consistent customer experience.

5. Sales Target Achievement
Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets through territory planning, partner engagement, lead conversion and business development.
Track sales performance, identify gaps, implement corrective actions and drive revenue growth.

6. Market Intelligence & Business Development
Monitor regional market trends, customer preferences, competitor activities, pricing and emerging business opportunities.
Identify potential franchise locations and sales channels, and recommend strategies to strengthen brand visibility, competitive positioning and market share.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with technical, marketing, operations and customer support teams to facilitate partner onboarding, product training, promotional activities and ongoing business support.
Ensure effective coordination to address partner requirements, resolve business challenges and execute sales and network expansion initiatives.

Company Overview
Saboo Automotive Pvt. Ltd. is a well-established and trusted name in the automotive industry. One of our fastest-growing verticals is the premium vehicle protection segment, where we proudly represent two globally renowned brands:
Ceramic Pro: The global pioneer in advanced nanoceramic surface protection coatings, present in over 55 countries with a network of 2,500+ professionals.
Kavaca: Premium paint protection films (PPF) and advanced window films engineered for superior performance.
With an existing network of 60+ express centers (franchises) across India, we are entering an exciting phase of aggressive expansion.

Learn more at https://ceramicpro.co.in/

With operations in over 55 countries and a network of 2,500+ detailing professionals, Ceramic Pro offers premium products including ceramic coatings, paint protection films, and window films. The brand is known for innovation, quality, and setting new benchmarks in automotive care.

Job Description:
The Purchase Manager will be responsible for end-to-end management of the Sheshyon shop. This includes establishing and maintaining supplier relationships, negotiating favorable deals, overseeing inventory, ensuring timely purchases and sales, handling invoices, tracking budgets, and managing records. The role requires an individual who is highly organized, skilled in negotiation, and capable of fostering efficient and cost-effective operations.

Key Responsibilities:

1.Supply Chain Management:
Establish and maintain relationships with suppliers to ensure a reliable flow of quality goods.
Identify new suppliers and vendors when necessary, expanding options to meet the shop's diverse needs.
2.Negotiations and Vendor Relations:
Negotiate terms, pricing, and conditions with suppliers to achieve cost-effective procurement.
Report on supplier performance to ensure adherence to quality and service standards.
3.Procurement and Inventory Control:
Make timely purchases based on the needs of HIAL, public customers, and budget guidelines.
Manage stock levels, reorder points, and work with suppliers to prevent stockouts.
4.Billing, Budgeting, and Accounting:
Prepare and manage invoices, maintain bill records, and ensure accurate accounting for all purchases and sales.
Track and report on budget allocations, and provide regular updates to management.
5.Customer Service and Sales:
Serve as the main point of contact for both internal HIAL departments and external customers. Ensure a high standard of customer satisfaction and timely responses to inquiries.
6.Returns, Charges, and Price Adjustments:
Assist in the return of goods to suppliers when necessary and handle related documentation. Review carriage charges, price increases, and communicate changes to relevant departments.

Qualifications:
Bachelor's/ Master's or MBA in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
Proven experience in purchasing, vendor management, and inventory control.
Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in accounting and budgeting.
Ability to multitask and work in a dynamic environment.

Job Description:
We are seeking a talented and creative Media Executive to join our team . The ideal candidate will have proven photography and videography skills, with a keen eye for capturing compelling visuals that tell a story. As a Media Executive, you will play a key role in documenting our projects, events, and initiatives through various forms of media, including photography, videography, and multimedia content creation. Responsibilities:
Capture high-quality photographs and videos that showcase the work and impact of HIAL's projects and initiatives.
Edit and enhance photos and videos using Adobe Creative Suite or similar software to ensure a polished and professional final product.
Collaborate with team members to develop creative concepts and visual storytelling strategies for various media projects.
Manage and maintain a library of multimedia assets, including photos, videos, and graphics.
Support social media and marketing efforts by providing engaging visual content for digital platforms.
Assist in the production of promotional materials, including brochures, presentations, and videos.
Travel with project teams to remote locations in Ladakh and other regions as needed to document fieldwork and events.

Bachelor's degree in photography, videography, media production, or related field preferred.
Proven experience in photography and videography, with a strong portfolio demonstrating technical proficiency and creative vision.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, and/or After Effects.
Strong attention to detail and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Willingness to travel and work in challenging environments, including remote Himalayan regions, and be flexible with assignments and schedules.
Benefits:
Opportunity to work with a dynamic team dedicated to making a positive impact in the Himalayan region.
Experience the rich cultural heritage and breathtaking landscapes of Ladakh.
Professional development opportunities and training in media production and storytelling techniques.
If you are passionate about using your media skills to make a difference and are excited about the opportunity to work in the beautiful Himalayan region of Ladakh, we encourage you to apply for the Media Executive position at HIAL. Join us in our mission to create a more sustainable and resilient future for Himalayan communities.

Description:
Position Overview:
HIAL is looking for a dynamic and people-centered HR Manager who can lead and manage the institute's human resource functions in a proactive, empathetic and organized manner. The ideal candidate should be passionate about creating an inclusive, growth-oriented and values-driven work culture while aligning HR practices with the institute's mission.

Key Responsibilities:

1. HR Strategy & Policy Development:
Design, review and implement HR policies and procedures that reflect the institute's ethos and ensure legal compliance.
Support long-term HR planning, including workforce planning, succession planning and talent development.
2. Recruitment & Onboarding:
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process for faculty, administrative and support staff.
Develop effective strategies for talent acquisition, including campus outreach and collaborations.
Ensure smooth onboarding and orientation of new employees.
3. Performance Management & Capacity Building:
Design and implement fair and constructive performance appraisal systems.
Identify training needs and coordinate internal and external capacity-building initiatives.
Support managers in developing individual growth plans for their teams.
4. Employee Engagement & Culture:
Foster a healthy, inclusive and collaborative work environment rooted in mutual respect and collective purpose.
Plan and execute employee engagement activities, feedback mechanisms and team-building initiatives.
Serve as a bridge between staff and leadership, ensuring two-way communication.
5. HR Operations & Compliance:
Maintain accurate and confidential employee records including attendance, leave and service history.
Manage HR-related documentation, including contracts, policies and compliance with labor laws.
Oversee payroll coordination, benefits and timely employee reimbursements in collaboration with the Finance team.
6. Conflict Resolution & Welfare:
Address staff grievances with empathy and fairness, ensuring timely resolution.
Promote mental health and staff well-being initiatives.

Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Human Resource Management, Organizational Development, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of progressive HR experience; prior experience in an academic or social sector organization is preferred.
Strong understanding of HR laws, best practices and systems.
Excellent interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a multicultural, high-altitude and mission-driven environment.
Desirable Attributes:
Sensitivity to local culture and a passion for sustainable development in the Himalayan region.
Adaptability and willingness to live and work in a remote, cold desert setting.
Experience with HR tech platforms and digital tools.
Ability to handle both strategic HR planning and hands-on operational tasks.

Job Summary

The Commis I Indian Kitchen is responsible for assisting in the preparation, cooking, and presentation of Indian cuisine while maintaining the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and kitchen operations. The role requires sound knowledge of Indian cooking techniques, ingredients, and kitchen procedures, along with the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

Prepare and cook Indian dishes according to established recipes and standards.
Assist senior chefs in mise en place and daily kitchen operations.
Ensure consistency in taste, presentation, and portion control.
Monitor the quality and freshness of ingredients before use.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the assigned work station.
Follow all food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure proper storage, labeling, and rotation of food items (FIFO).
Support in receiving and storing kitchen supplies and ingredients.
Minimize food wastage and contribute to cost-control initiatives.
Assist during buffet service, la carte operations, banquets, and special events.
Report equipment malfunctions, stock shortages, and quality concerns to supervisors.
Work collaboratively with other kitchen team members to ensure smooth operations.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or Degree in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts, or a related field preferred.
Minimum 2 4 years of experience in an Indian kitchen, preferably in a luxury hotel or fine-dining restaurant.
Knowledge of North Indian, Mughlai, Tandoor, and regional Indian cuisines is desirable.
Familiarity with food safety and hygiene standards.

Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of Indian cooking methods, spices, and ingredients.
Ability to work under pressure and meet service timelines.
Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
Good organizational and time-management skills.
Team-oriented attitude with a willingness to learn.
Ability to maintain a clean and disciplined work environment.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work in a luxury hospitality environment.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.
Competitive compensation and benefits.
A collaborative and supportive workplace culture.

Description:
The Marketing Manager at the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies to promote responsible tourism-related events, projects and activities, as well as promoting various courses, conferences, and workshops offered by the institute. The role will encompass a range of marketing activities, including digital marketing, content creation, event promotion, and brand management.

Key Responsibilities:

Promote Responsible Tourism Events:
Develop and implement marketing plans to promote responsible tourism-related events and activities curated by HIAL.
Collaborate with local and international partners to create awareness and attract participants.
Utilize digital marketing channels, social media, and content marketing to reach the target audience.
Promote Institute Courses:
Create marketing campaigns to promote the various courses offered by the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh.
Develop course-specific marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and digital content.
Implement strategies to increase course enrollment and participation.
Promote Conferences and Workshops:
Plan and execute marketing initiatives to promote conferences, workshops, and seminars held at the institute.
Coordinate with speakers, sponsors, and participants to ensure successful event promotion.
Manage event registration and attendee communication.
Digital Marketing:
Implement digital marketing strategies, including SEO, SEM, email marketing, and social media campaigns.
Create and curate content that highlights the institute's mission and values.
Monitor website traffic, engagement, and conversion rates to optimize digital marketing efforts.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Content Creation:
Develop compelling and informative content, including blog posts, videos, and infographics, to engage the target audience.
Ensure that content aligns with the institute's values and promotes sustainable practices.
Collaboration:
Collaborate with the institute's teams, including academic, administrative, and event planning, to align marketing efforts with organizational goals.
Foster relationships with local and regional stakeholders to enhance the institute's presence.
Budget Management:
Create and manage marketing budgets, optimizing resource allocation for maximum impact.
Monitor spending and provide regular reports

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, preferably in the field of education, sustainable tourism, or related areas.
Strong knowledge of digital marketing techniques and tools.
Excellent communication and content creation skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a diverse team.
Passion for sustainable and responsible tourism practices.
Familiarity with Ladakh and the local community is a plus.
This Marketing Manager will play a crucial role in promoting the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives Ladakh's mission to promote responsible tourism and education in the region, while also fostering awareness and participation in its various courses, conferences, and workshops.

Description:
The Himalayan Institute of Alternatives, Ladakh, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Finance Head to lead our finance department. As the Finance Head, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the financial stability and success of our organization. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining financial forecasting models, supervising a team of accountants, and identifying cost-saving solutions. Additionally, you will collaborate with senior management to explore alternative funding options, manage resource allocation, and ensure compliance through audits.

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Forecasting:
Develop and maintain forecasting models for monthly, quarterly, and annual financial results to provide accurate and timely financial insights to the organization.
Team Leadership:
Provide strong leadership and supervision to a team of accountants, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in all financial transactions. Foster a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development within the team.
Cost Optimization:
Identify opportunities for cost-saving solutions to optimize financial performance, enhancing the financial sustainability of the organization.
Funding Exploration:
Collaborate with senior management to explore alternate funding options for projects and initiatives, including grants, partnerships, and investment opportunities.
Resource Management:
Oversee resource allocation and cash flow management to maintain financial stability and ensure that the organization can meet its financial obligations and strategic goals.
Budget Approval:
Review and approve budgets, ensuring they align with the organizational goals and financial constraints. Monitor budget performance and recommend adjustments when necessary.
Vendor Payments and Payroll:
Ensure timely payments to vendors and the punctual release of employee salaries, maintaining strong vendor and employee relationships.
Financial Integrity and Compliance:
Conduct regular audits to maintain financial integrity and compliance with relevant laws and regulations. Develop and implement corrective measures as needed.

Qualifications:
Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA or a relevant advanced degree is preferred.
Proven experience in financial management, including forecasting, budgeting, and cost analysis.
Strong leadership and team management skills with a minimum of 5 years of supervisory experience.
Proficiency in financial modeling, accounting software, and Microsoft Office Suite.
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of funding opportunities in the nonprofit sector is a plus.

Description:
Job Description: Associate / Senior Associate Used Commercial Vehicle
Finance (Ahmedabad, Baroda, Mumbai (all areas), Pune)
Job Summary
We are seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Field Sales Executive to drive growth in our
Used Commercial Vehicle (CV) Finance division. The ideal candidate will have a
minimum of 2 years of direct field experience in used CV financing, a strong local
network of brokers, dealers, and fleet operators, and a proven track record of meeting
monthly disbursement targets.
Key Responsibilities & KRAs
• Achieve Sales Targets: Meet and exceed monthly and quarterly disbursement
targets for Used Commercial Vehicles and any new CV products introduced by
the company.
• Lead Generation & Sourcing: Identify and develop new business opportunities
through direct field visits, cold calling, and local networking.
• Channel Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with used
vehicle dealers, brokers, mechanics, and local transport hubs.
• Customer Assessment: Conduct preliminary credit and financial screenings of
customers, evaluating their profile, repayment capacity, and asset condition.
• End-to-End Logistical Management: Oversee the loan process from document
collection and login to verification, valuation, and final disbursement.
• Portfolio Health & Collections: Assist the credit and collections team in
monitoring early delinquencies and ensuring timely recovery from acquired
portfolios.
Required Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: Minimum 2 to 5 years of core field experience specifically in Used
CV Finance (experience in Light, Medium, or Heavy Commercial Vehicles).
• Education: Graduate or Under-Graduate degree in any stream.
• Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the local used commercial vehicle
market, asset valuation nuances, and competitor practices.
• Skills: Strong negotiation, interpersonal communication, and relationship-
building skills.
• Mobility: Must possess a valid driving license and a personal two-wheeler for
extensive field travel.

What We Offer
• Competitive fixed salary and a highly lucrative performance-based incentive
structure.
• Travel allowances.
• Fast-tracked career progression opportunities within a growing financial
institution.

Job Title: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager Mid-Market (B2B Sales)

Company: G4S Secure Solutions India
Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs
Experience: 2 – 8 Years
Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor

About the Role
We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts.
You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team.

What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth)
Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts.
Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus.
Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles.
Key Responsibilities
1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time)
Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking.
Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals.
Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins.
Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment.
2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time)
Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites.
Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers.
Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates.
3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time)
Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM).
Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing.

Who We Are Looking For
Experience & Education:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus).
Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales.
Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience.

Skills & Competencies:
Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly.
Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers.
Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures.
Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel.
(Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

Role & responsibilities

About the role: The Territory Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for deploying financial solutions across residential and commercial societies to help digitize their accounting and operational functionalities. The role involves direct client engagement, product demonstrations, and driving revenue through effective lead generation and business conversions. The ideal candidate will combine financial understanding with strong communication and sales acumen to deliver impactful results.

Deploy financial solutions to automate and digitize society-level accounting and billing operations.
Conduct product demonstrations for clients, emphasizing features, benefits, and overall solution value.
Connect with committee members of residential societies and apartment associations to identify needs and present suitable solutions.
Prospect, educate, and qualify leads through a consultative approach to improve client satisfaction and business conversion rates.
Engage in calling efforts and on-ground visits to generate leads and convert them into business opportunities.
Achieve assigned revenue and acquisition targets within the allocated territory.
Maintain accurate data of leads, client meetings, and conversions in CRM tools.
Ensure consistent follow-ups and client engagement for renewals and satisfaction.

Preferred candidate profile

Minimum 15 years of proven track record in deploying financial solutions and ability to meet targets
The candidate must have a basic accounting and finance background (e.g. Graduated with BAF degree)
Should have interest in business development for software application products/solutions (B2C)
Must be energetic, well-spoken, and eager to generate revenue for the organization
Should be proficient in Hindi and English
Fluency in the regional language is a plus
Should be comfortable working on weekends
(Saturday & Sunday are compulsory working days, with a week off between Monday to Thursday)
Effective presentation and negotiation skills
The candidate should have proficiency in Tally and MS Office

Benefits

Performance Bonus
Corporate Health Insurance
Travel Allowance
Monthly R&R awards
Early promotions to outstanding performers

Position Title: Regional Sales Manager

Department: Sales and Distribution

Work Location: Regional office

Grade: M3/ M4

Travel Required: Yes(50%)

Reporting to:
Administrative: Regional Manager

Reported by: ASMs

Functional: Regional Manager Category Head

Educational Qualification: Graduate and MBA in Sales/ Marketing

Experience: 8 12 years

Any additional requirement:
Purpose of the Position (Job Summary)
The purpose of this position is to drive sales in the specific sub-region to meet AOP targets by implementing trade promotions, ensuring stock availability, distributor expansion, etc.

Key Roles and Responsibilities
Financial
Sales strategy: Design & execute sales strategies defined for each sub-category and state to ensure month-on-month achievement of sales target (value and volume). The RSM is responsible for overall sales in his assigned territory.
New product launches: Ensure revenue from sales of new products as per AOP target
Distributor expansion: Drive incremental revenue from distribution expansion
Customer Orientation
Distributor calls: Conduct calls as per the agreed plan with each distributor. Review call cycle, reporting (weekly) on calls made and stock ordered for the team
Distributor management: Build and maintain distributor relationships to grow regional sales
Marketing: Work closely with distributors to develop & execute annual plan for promotions, advertising campaigns and retailer meets; Coordinate with the Marketing team to ensure that distributors are fully aware of and support planned promotions
Merchandising: Provide merchandising assistance (i.e., through point of sale material, brochures, etc.) and advice to distributors in order to maximise sales
Distributor investments: Ensure distributors have appropriate investments to cater to market needs (stock levels, credit, salesmen, etc.)
Complaints management: Resolve product issues (such as recurring faults) at distributor level, arranging credits, replacement stock as required and providing feedback to Brand Managers for recurring issues; Ensure timely settlement of distributor issues like pending schemes/ discounts/ reversal of debit note, etc.
Product intelligence: Provide support to develop products as per region's demands
Exception approvals: Authorise and allocate transit damage rebates and credits effectively and within Company guidelines in order to maintain a positive relationship with distributors and maximise profitability. Report any exceptions to the Regional Manager
Market metrics: Track distributor order fulfilment of demand generated from Retailers by the field force
Competitor benchmarking: Benchmark market/ competitor best practices through ASMs & derive actionable recommendations from the same
Distributor appointment: Scouting and appointing new distributors as per defined norms
Distributor onboarding: Ensuring distributor gets all relevant post appointment support
Distributor exclusivity: Ensuring adherence of exclusivity to Relaxo by designated exclusive distributors
People Orientation
Market expansion: Motivate & lead ASMs & SOs to establish coverage, distribution and display objectives to meet Sales targets
Targets: Cascade targets for team & provide necessary support such as coaching, feedback, training & development to meet targets
Trainings: Provide inputs on training needs for the team to Regional Manager/ HR
Recruitment: Recruit and develop team members. Support HR in creation of a talent pipeline to ensure business continuity in case of attrition
Mentorship and supervision: Mentoring, coaching and supervising the work of ASMs
Internal Business Process
Sales planning: Overseeing creation of monthly/ weekly/ daily distributor-wise, sub category-wise sales plan for the month
Collections: Track & minimize average outstanding at end of each month as a % of month's sales
Balanced billing: Improve sales billing phasing to reduce month end skew
Channel partner engagement: Drive distributor/ retailer engagement and scale up efforts to increase number of participating distributors/ retailers
Market working plan adherence: Ensure adherence to market working plan for self & team. Report regularly to Regional Manager
Distributor quality tracking: Review quality of distribution by tracking the range of articles billed out of the identified focus articles and target fulfilment
Scheme success: Maximizing enrolment into trade schemes
Stock availability: Ensure improvement in article wise stock availability
Process sanctity: Ensure adherence to key sales processes
Distributor-retailer mapping: Prepare territory-wise distributor to retailer mapping records and ensuring adherence
Sales forecasting: Provide inputs to Regional Manager for accurate & timely sales forecasts
Reviews: Conduct and attend timely reviews as per sales governance model
Documentation from distributors: Collect no pending issue letter from distributors on quarterly basis

Competencies
Technical/ Functional
Sales planning
BTL implementation
Distributor management/ engagement
Product knowledge
Behavioral
Customer Focus
Collaboration
Adaptability
Result orientation
Execution excellence

Key Result Areas
Quantitative
% Target achievement on AOP for the sub-region
% revenue contribution from NPDs
Average outstanding at end of each month as % of month's sales
Incremental revenue from distribution expansion
(Billing in last 3 days/Total Billing) averaged over four quarters
Attrition
# of participating distributors/ retailers in promotions/ engagement programs
% adherence to monthly market working plan (self & team)
% Improvement in forecast accuracy

Salesforce effectiveness
Distributor coverage expansion
On time target cascade for team

Marketing/ Brand team

Sales Support

Role & responsibilities
• Provide prompt & efficient service to customers for the printers supplied by the company and are under warranty / AMC.
• Ensure immediate response & low resolution time for all such printers.
• Efficiently demonstrate the printers to Customer and its operators.
• Installation of printers to be effectively done, to avoid break downs due to improper installations.
• Take technical guidance/ help timely, in resolving customer issues, if any.
• Raise requisition for correct spare after proper diagnosis and to obtain such spare from reporting office without losing much time for warranty/ CAMP printers.
• To promptly return the defective spare part used for warranty/ CAMP printers.
• Ensure AMC/ spare quotes are sent to customers for the respective territory through office promptly & escalate in case of abnormal pendency.
• Regularly update on technical briefings and bulletins and periodically upgrade technical and commercial skills.
• Ensure diligent follow ups for business in terms of AMC/CAMP & Filter sales etc.
• Guide customers regarding stocking of consumables.
• 100% adherence on installation standards and ensure the same is maintained as long as it is under company's obligation.
• Follow customer given safety norms whilst in their premises & maintain discipline.
• 100% compliance to guidelines given by the superiors from time to time.
• Develop good rapport / relations with customers.
• Timely submit service reports/ monthly reports along-with travel expenses and provide feedback as per prevalent system to office/ seniors regarding service calls status on real time basis.
• Ensure proper upkeep of tool kit on regular basis.
• Should be well dressed, tidy & presentable when on duty.
• Should have a mobile in working condition round the clock & attend
promptly customers calls on mobile.
• Should be prepared to attend service calls beyond office hours, in case of any emergency & situation demands.
• Undertake frequent upcountry travelling & sometimes even at short notice.

Job Purpose
To develop, review, and coordinate instrumentation design deliverables for FEED, Detailed Engineering, and EPC projects. Review vendor drawings and ensure proper integration into project documentation.
Perform interdisciplinary checks and resolve model clashes.

Description:
Company: R K Gems

Job Title: GM Assistant / Executive Assistant to General Manager

Location: Sachin SEZ, Surat, Gujarat

Salary Package: Up to 20,000 / Month (Based on skills, administrative experience & interview performance)

Experience Required: 1-3 Years / Freshers

Number Of Vacancies: 01

Role Summary
We are looking for an organized, proactive, and professional GM Assistant to provide high-level administrative, operational, and coordination support to the General Manager at R K Gems. The ideal candidate will act as a key bridge between the GM's office and various internal departments (Production, Accounts, HR, Merchandising, and Dispatch), ensuring smooth daily scheduling, documentation, and follow-up on operational tasks.

Key Responsibilities
Executive Coordination & Scheduling: Manage the General Managers daily calendar, schedule internal meetings, coordinate visitor appointments, and ensure timely reminders for key tasks.

Inter-Departmental Follow-ups: Act as the communication link between the GM and department heads to track the status of daily instructions, production targets, and project deliverables.

MIS Reporting & Documentation: Prepare and compile daily/weekly operational reports, meeting minutes, performance trackers, and presentations using MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

Correspondence & Communication: Handle official emails, phone calls, and written correspondence with professional etiquette on behalf of the management office.

Confidential Record Management: Maintain structured physical and digital files for management records, policy documents, audit summaries, and confidential correspondence.

General Administration: Assist in organizing internal company events, guest hospitality, and general office administration tasks within the manufacturing unit.

Candidate Requirements & Qualifications
Education: Graduate in any stream (B. Com / BBA / BA / BCA or equivalent).

Experience: 1 to 3 years of proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, or Office Coordinator (experience in a manufacturing or jewelry export environment is an advantage).

Technical Skills: Strong working proficiency in MS Office (Advanced MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint) and Google Workspace.

Core Competencies:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Hindi, and Gujarati.

High level of integrity, discretion, and confidentiality.

Strong multi-tasking abilities, attention to detail, and time management skills under a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Email: hr@rkgems.in

Provident fund, Annual bonus, Food allowance, Leave encashment

Description:
Company: R K Gems

Job Title: Jewelry CAD Designer (Gold & Diamond Studded Jewellery)

Location: Sachin SEZ, Surat, Gujarat

Salary Package: Up to 50,000 / Month (Based on design portfolio, software proficiency, experience level & interview performance)

Gender Eligibility: Male & Female Both

Number Of Vancinis: 10

Experience Required: Freshers (with strong CAD training/portfolio) to 5+ Years of Experience

Software: Matrix, Rhino, Jewel CAD, Brush, and MS Excel

Role Summary
We are looking for a creative, skilled, and detail-oriented Jewelry CAD Designer to join our design and manufacturing unit at R K Gems. Whether you are a talented fresher with strong rendering/modelling training or an experienced designer with a proven portfolio, you will be responsible for transforming artistic concepts and client sketches into precise, manufacturable 3D CAD models for high-end gold and diamond studded jewelry (Rings, Earrings, Pendants, Bracelets, Necklaces).

Key Responsibilities
3D Modelling & Design Creation: Develop accurate, high-quality 3D CAD models from client sketches, mood boards, or designer concepts keeping manufacturing feasibility in mind.

Diamond & Stone Setting Preparation: Accurately layout and place stone parameters (prong, bezel, channel, pave, micro-pave, and invisible setting) with precise weight and count calculations.

Technical Detailing for Production: Ensure correct metal thicknesses, prongs, undercuts, locking mechanisms, and hinges so the design passes casting, filing, and setting stages smoothly with minimal weight variance.

Rendering & Visualization: Create photorealistic renderings and product images for client approvals, catalogs, and marketing collaterals.

Coordination with CAD/Wax Department: Coordinate with the 3D printing and wax-growing team to ensure print-ready file formats (.3dm, .stl) are delivered on time without mesh errors.

Revision & Modification: Update designs efficiently based on client feedback, production testing results, or weight adjustment requirements.

Candidate Requirements & Qualifications
Education: Diploma/Degree in Jewelry Design & CAD or Graduation in any stream with professional certification in Jewelry CAD software.

Experience:

Freshers: Must possess a strong digital portfolio showcasing clean 3D modeling and rendering skills.

Experienced Candidates: 1 to 5+ years of hands-on jewelry CAD experience in a manufacturing or export setup.

Software Mastery: Strong proficiency in Matrix / Rhino / JewelCAD and rendering tools (KeyShot / V-Ray).

Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of gold weights, diamond sizes/sieve standards, shrinkage factors, and manufacturing processes (Casting, Setting, Polishing).

Core Competencies: Strong aesthetic sense, high attention to detail, and ability to meet strict design deadlines.

How to Apply
Call / WhatsApp: +91 6351564248

Email Resume & Portfolio: hr@rkgems.in

Stakeholder & Ecosystem Engagement: Build and maintain high-level relationships with institutional landlords, developers, corporate occupiers, investors, and third-party channel partners/agents.
Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate with CBRE Research, Capital Markets, Project Management, and Occupier Services to deliver integrated solutions and cross-sell business lines.
Team Leadership & Performance: Mentor junior and mid-level team members, manage channel partner ecosystems, and ensure alignment with regional revenue and occupancy targets.

Candidate Profile

Experience: 712+ years of relevant commercial real estate experience, with a proven track record in Landlord Representation, agency leasing, and developer account management.
Occupier Relationship: Experience in engaging with regional and international occupiers, institutional landlords, developers, and corporate real estate (CRE) heads.
Portfolio Capabilities: Proven capability to manage multi-asset, portfolio-wide leasing mandates across geographic markets.

Description:
Job Title: Team Leader - HNI Dealing - Branch Broking

Company Name: Bajaj Broking

Job Description
As a Team Leader - Branch Broking, you will be responsible for driving individual business performance as well as leading the branch dealing team to achieve overall business objectives. The role involves managing your own HNI client portfolio, generating revenue through client acquisition and trading activities, and simultaneously guiding the team to achieve their respective targets.

You will be accountable for individual revenue generation, team productivity, client acquisition, retention, and overall business growth while ensuring superior client servicing, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve overall business and revenue targets.
Drive team-level revenue generation, client acquisition, activation, and retention.
Monitor individual team members' performance and ensure achievement of assigned targets.
Support team members in acquiring new clients, increasing client engagement, and improving revenue productivity.
Oversee trading activities across equity, derivatives, Nifty, and stock options.
Ensure timely sharing of stock, sector, and market updates with clients.
Handle key HNI relationships and resolve escalated client queries.
Conduct regular performance reviews, provide coaching, and develop team capabilities.
Coordinate with research and internal teams to provide relevant investment insights and strategies.
Ensure accurate trade execution, documentation, and adherence to regulatory and internal compliance requirements.
Track individual and team performance through regular business reviews and reporting.
Identify opportunities to improve revenue, operational efficiency, and overall client experience.
Coordinate with Branch and Regional leadership to achieve business objectives.
Achieve assigned individual revenue targets through HNI client acquisition, relationship management, and trading activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA will be an added advantage.
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in dealing, sales, or business development within the financial services industry, preferably with exposure to HNI clients.
Prior experience in team handling or a supervisory role will be preferred.
Strong knowledge of financial markets, equity, derivatives, and investment products.
Strong leadership, communication, relationship management, and people-management skills.
NISM Series VIII Certification is mandatory.
