Description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT / TEAM LEAD - PHARMA SALES
Department: Sales Business Development
Industry: Pharmaceutical / Pharma OTC / Generics
Experience: 2-5 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Role Objective
The candidate will be responsible for driving sales and brand promotion through local market visits, retail/store engagement, dealer and distributor management, and market development. The role requires a candidate with practical knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic products market and experience in handling channel sales.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and grow sales across assigned local markets and territories.
Visit medical stores, pharmacies, retail outlets, and other relevant local stores for product promotion and sales development.
Build and maintain strong relationships with dealers, distributors, stockists, and retailers.
Identify new dealers/distributors and expand the distribution network.
Promote assigned pharmaceutical, OTC, or generic products within the retail and distribution channel.
Generate orders and achieve monthly/quarterly sales targets.
Monitor product availability, stock movement, and market demand.
Coordinate with distributors and retailers to ensure regular product supply.
Conduct regular market visits to understand competitor activities, pricing, product availability, and customer requirements.
Support brand promotion activities and execute local-market sales initiatives.
Follow up on outstanding orders and coordinate for timely delivery.
Collect market feedback and communicate customer/product requirements to the management.
Prepare regular sales, market visit, and distributor activity reports.
For a Team Lead position, guide team members, monitor field activities, and support achievement of territory-level targets.
Required Experience
2-5 years of relevant sales/business development experience in the pharmaceutical sector.
Candidates must have experience in Pharma / Pharma OTC / Generic products.
Candidates with experience as Medical Representatives (MRs) may be considered only if their experience includes retail, distributor, dealer, stockist, or channel sales.
Experience in dealer/distributor handling and market development is mandatory.
Experience in local store/pharmacy visits and product promotion will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
Candidates with B.Pharm / D.Pharm / B.Sc. / B.Com / BBA / equivalent qualifications may be preferred, depending on relevant sales experience.
Key Skills
Pharma Sales Business Development
Dealer Distributor Management
Retail/Local Market Visits
Brand Product Promotion
Channel Sales Market Development
Sales Target Achievement
Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented sales professional with strong knowledge of the pharmaceutical/OTC/generic market, good communication and negotiation skills, and practical experience managing dealers, distributors, stockists, pharmacies, and retail outlets.
Budget: Maximum 30,000 net per month, depending on experience and suitability.

Job Summary
Programme Lead - Community Libraries
Location: Shillong, Meghalaya, India
Contract: Fixed term consulting contract
Based on previous CTC and experience
Project Background
Sauramandala Foundation is an NGO founded in 2018 with a vision to bring about systemic change in the lives of remote communities through empathetic, collaborative, and contextual solutions that are co-created with the communities themselves.
About the Project (CM Youth Center):
The Government of Meghalaya, in partnership with Sauramandala Foundation, has established 22 rural community centres for youth, called the Chief Ministers Youth Centers (CMYC) with an aim to build resilience, agency and problem-solving skills in the community. The key programmes in the CMYCs are - Self Designed Learning, Entrepreneurship Development, Sports Coaching, Arts and Theatre and a Community Library Programme. The learning is open to all ages to have more involvement from the community. The CMYCs are set to expand from 22 centers to cover all 55 blocks of Meghalaya over a 2 year period.
Objective of the Engagement
To design and operationalize well-resourced, welcoming libraries in CMYCs that:
Build a culture of reading by working closely with children, young adults and youth in the community.
Serve as learning hubs supporting adolescent well-being and development.
Scope of Work
Curation
Build vibrant, culturally rooted, multilingual collections for children, young adults and youth.
Curate collections across themes of well-being, mental health, coming of age, gender, environment, sci-fi, indigenous knowledge and local culture and so on.
Ensure enough reading materials for beginner to confident and advanced readers.
Programme Design
Support the design of libraries and child and youth-friendly spaces.
Design a joyful community library programme that makes reading social, engaging and meaningful.
Create spaces for dialogue and self expression - reading circles, book discussions, open mics, writing labs, movie screenings and debrief reflections.
Integrate life skills and SEL into the library programme to build empathy, self-confidence, critical thinking etc.
Design for the library activities to travel to nearby villages around the Youth Center and to engage with existing Youth Clubs.
Building Community Ownership
Position the CMYC and the libraries as a community asset by engaging the community especially the adults to build a connection with the space.
Organise reading festivals, youth showcases, and community celebrations.
Create systems to encourage youth to play an active role in shaping the libraries - youth volunteers, library leaders and so on.
Strengthening libraries as safe, welcoming, learning hubs
Develop a simple monitoring framework for smooth operations.
Train first-time libraries with tools and techniques on youth engagement, creating safe spaces, facilitating shared reading experiences in the libraries.
Bring in low-cost digital tools and offline e-resources where possible.
Document learnings and adolescent and youth stories from the libraries.
Expected area of expertise
Master's Degree in Education/Library & Information Science or related field (preferred, not mandatory).
8-9 years of experience in setting up community libraries, training librarians and educators to build a culture of reading.
Any certifications on library science or engagements with organisations working in the field is preferred.
Strong knowledge of curation for different age groups from children to young adults and youth.
Ability to design and facilitate training workshops for first-time librarians.
Adaptability to an agile, cross-functional, collaborative working environment.

Description:
ABOUT THE HANS FOUNDATION
The Hans Foundation (THF), established in 2009, is a Public Charitable Trust that works towards creating an equitable society to enhance quality of life for all through the empowerment of marginalized and underprivileged communities in India. The Hans Foundation works for the Health and Wellbeing of remote and under-served groups, with an additional focus on children, persons with disabilities and women. THF also works for holistic Education and Livelihood development of our communities. Our Two-Fold Strategy involves identifying and working within Aspirational Districts and high poverty index in the North, North-East and East regions within specific states, as well as catering to lower-income and migratory populations in cities, through urban programs.
Over its 15 years of existence, THF has reached more than 35 million beneficiaries through its programs. THF works with communities through direct implementation of projects on the ground in addition to providing local management and monitoring support to not-for-profit organisations in India funded through THF USA and RIST.
PROJECT OVERVIEW: HANS HEALTH & WELLNESS CENTRE
The Hans Health & Wellness Centre, Meghalaya, is a transformative initiative aimed at addressing the fundamental healthcare needs of rural and hard-to-reach populations. Recognizing the limitations of government resources, The Hans Foundation (THF) has committed to bridging the gap by taking over 50 sub-centres in the first phase. This project is designed to make a substantial impact on health parameters, particularly in reducing maternal mortality rates. Through a meticulous gap assessment, THF will provide the necessary equipment and facilities, deploy skilled human resources, and ensure comprehensive training to meet the project s demands. The initiative is not just a short-term intervention but a long-term commitment, with regular operations and monitoring to ensure sustained improvement. THF envisions this project as a model for community healthcare at the grassroots level, aspiring to set a benchmark that other states might seek to replicate, ultimately expanding its reach across the region in a phased manner.
GENERAL
Location of Job: South West Khasi Hills (Meghalaya)
Type of Employment: Contractual for a period of one year, renewable basis of performance and project requirements
No. of Position: 1
Reporting to: Project Coordinator
1. JOB PURPOSE
Nurse (ANM/GNM) will be responsible for providing preventive, promotive and curative health care services through VHSND in the assigned villages. S/he will accompany the team and will be responsible for providing counselling services to the community and other field level communication, counseling and health education support to the program. S/he will ensure participation of the community. S/he will maintain records of patient registrations and provide health education using IEC materials.
2. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES
Visit along with the team in VHSND Programs.
Ensure support and work in coordination with local community workers such as Anganwadi workers, ASHA workers for effective service delivery.
Provide preventive, promotive and curative health care services.
Conduct individual and group sessions on reproductive health, mother and child health and nutrition, communicable and non-communicable diseases, and adolescent health.
Support in the management of Sub Center especially, record keeping, management of the patient flow and medicine distribution.
Coordinate to refer the patients to nearest health facility for secondary level treatment and follow up.
Responsible for supervision of village health workers and their capacity building.
Maintain relevant reports and documents.
3. Other Indicative Requirements
Educational Qualifications : Bachelor s degree in nursing /ANM/GNM training or a related field with good knowledge in public health or hospitals
Functional / Technical Skills and Relevant Experience & Other requirements (Behavioural, Language, Certifications etc.)
Experience of working in field/clinic for 1-3 years.
The candidate should be well versed with Hindi and local dialect.
Community mobilization and communication skills
THF is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions. Job Description

The/Nudge is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals and youth on rural development, agriculture, skilling and economic inclusion, along with 15+ central and state government partners.

Our economic inclusion journey for 25 million Indians, has reached 10 states with $250M of government funding to cover 1.25M people. Our incubator, accelerator and grand challenges have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs including 17 Forbes 30U30, 3 EarthShot Prize winners, 1 Time Magazine cover and more.

Set up with support from 90+ eminent philanthropists , 40+ corporates and 15+ foundations including Gates, Mackenzie Scott, Vinod Khosla, Nandan Nilekani, Tata Trusts, Skoll, Meta, LinkedIn, HDFC, Mphasis, KPMG and LOreal, we are contributing towards a "poverty-free India, within our lifetime".

What are we solving for
We are solving for households in poverty who are also financially and socially vulnerable through a targeted, multi-faceted, and sequenced model called the graduation approach, which has demonstrated that we can durably pull households out of poverty.
At The/Nudge Institute, we are in the process of catalyzing the propagation of the same. Our purpose is to contribute to making the most excluded individuals a contributing member to the economy:

Enable govt to adopt by providing research, design, and implementation support
Continue to implement on its own to iterate the design for impact at scale
Enable more NGOs to adopt technical and capacity-building support
Continue to generate data on poverty and evidence on graduation approach to nudge governments to adopt at-scale
Build technology solutions for NGOs and governments to adopt and implement at scale with quality.

What will you do
The/Nudge is working with various state SRLMs to help increase adoption of the graduation approach/ economic inclusion program by targeting vulnerable rural women through community institutions.
To understand and practice the Spirits of The/Nudge Institute and the respective SRLMs
Ensure all project activities are implemented on time with utmost quality as per approved Project Implementation Plan (PIP)/ Standard Operating Procedure (SoP)/ Package of Practice (PoP)/ Community Operational Manual (COM) in the respective districts.
Support the district in projects under PVTG Domain.
Coordinate with DMMU and BMMU to ensure smooth implementation of the project .
Coordinate and facilitate in organizing capacity building training of project team and community.
Coordinate and lead in organizing any project related event at regional and district.
Coordinate and support in any field visits of dignitaries and officials.
Ensure timely planning and implementation of project activities.
Ensure proper documentation and reporting related to the project to respective offices.
Facilitate the timely collection/ entry, processing and reporting of data.
Support and practice monitoring evaluation of projects.
Good stakeholder management at the grassroots level.

Who are we looking for in this role
Candidate must be graduate; post-graduate will be preferred, in relevant streams like rural development, rural management, agriculture, forestry, social work, anthropology etc.
Candidate must have 4-6 years of relevant experience in the development sector/ rural development projects/ poverty eradication projects/ livelihood promotion projects/ tribal development projects.
Candidate with work experience working in district-level positions in National Rural Livelihood Mission/ State Rural Livelihood Missions in Institution Building, Capacity Building, Social Inclusion, Social Development, and Livelihood promotion will be preferred.
The candidate must have her/his own two-wheeler with a valid driving license as it is a field job.
The Location for this role is based in Eastern West Khasi Hills

What s in it for you

Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including LD wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India s largest social sector convening forum.
Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

You can learn more about what we do and how we do it through this deck .

Role & responsibilities :-
Hospital Revenue Cycle Management (RCM): Practical exposure to IPD and OPD billing cycles, multi-tier tariff plans, cash/credit billing audits, and plug of revenue leakages.
TPA & Corporate Insurance Claims: Experience with pre-authorizations, query resolution, handling rejection/deduction patterns, and liaison with insurers/TPAs for outstanding claim realization.

Organization: The Akshaya Patra Foundation

Department: Procurement

Work Location: Bangalore, Karnataka

Experience: 0 to 1 Years

Qualification: Bachelor's Degree

About the Organization
The Akshaya Patra Foundation is a not-for-profit organization committed to providing unlimited food for education. The organization leverages technology and efficient supply chain processes to deliver nutritious meals to children across India.
Job Summary
The candidate will be responsible for managing e-bidding, digital auctions, vendor participation, and procurement analytics for The Akshaya Patra Foundation. The role involves driving competitive pricing through online bidding platforms, ensuring transparent and compliant procurement processes, and providing data-driven insights to support procurement decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Formulate and launch digital tenders (RFQs/RFPs) and manage online reverse auctions across e-procurement and corporate bidding platforms.
Coordinate with TAPF buyers and provide weekly bidding summaries and insights to management.
Analyse BOQs, technical specifications, commercial bids, and cost-benefit data to support procurement decisions.
Track local and global commodity trends to identify optimal pricing windows for bidding cycles.
Onboard, train, and manage suppliers to ensure active and fair participation in the digital bidding ecosystem.
Ensure transparency, risk mitigation, audit compliance, and adherence to ethical sourcing guidelines.
Use tools such as Power BI, GEP, and SAP MM to analyse MRP data, purchase history, bidding performance, purchase price variance (PPV), and cost savings.
Maintain dashboards and reports to monitor procurement performance and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
01 years of relevant experience in e-procurement, digital reverse auctions, or government e-marketplaces such as GeM, preferably within FMCG, food manufacturing, retail, or related sectors.
Hands-on experience with e-bidding platforms such as Ariba, JAGGAER, GEP, GeM, or similar enterprise procurement portals.
Working knowledge of SAP MM and advanced MS Excel, including VLOOKUP and Pivot Tables.
Understanding of procurement processes, supply chains for perishable food commodities, and technical parameters of industrial packaging materials.
Strong analytical, commercial negotiation, stakeholder management, and time management skills.
High level of integrity and attention to transparency, compliance, and ethical procurement practices.
AboutCompany:
The Akshaya Patra Foundation :-
The Akshaya Patra Foundation is one of the worlds largest not-for-profit organisations implementing the Government of Indias Mid-Day Meal Programme. With operations across 16+ states and 78+ kitchens, the Foundation serves over 2.35 million meals and 1 million morning snacks daily to school children.
With a vision to serve 6 million meals per day by 2030, the organisation is committed to eliminating classroom hunger and enabling education through a scalable and sustainable model.

What would you do?

Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses.
Accentures Trust & Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. They often systematically test, evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society.
You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content andor investigating, escalating andor resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Therefore, Trust & Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities.
This role requires active participation in Accentures well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust & Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.

Develop and execute prompt strategies to interrogate large language models on various topics related to responsible AI, including medical advice, legal advice, and other sensitive areas.
Analyze the model s responses for appropriateness, inappropriateness, refusal to answer, or appending disclaimers to the response according to client definitions and guidance.
Collaborate with other team members to create a comprehensive understanding of responsible AI issues based on a model s responses.
Contribute to the development of best practices and guidelines for content moderation and responsible AI governance and policy.

Description:
We welcome you to join one of the world s top five most admired and prominent companies. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Come join us to be the best financial services company in the world which is formed to foster a creative, inclusive work environment that always values employees personal and professional development.

As a Fund Servicing Analyst within JPMorganChase, you will play a crucial role in our fund servicing operations. Your primary focus will be on executing routine transactions and collaborating with various teams. You will also apply your knowledge of fund servicing to ensure smooth operations, while also identifying opportunities for process improvements. Your emotional intelligence will help you build strong relationships and influence better outcomes. This role is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and contribute to our teams success.

Job responsibilities
Act as a secondary control check on positions booked by Trade Capture by performing counterparty reconciliations.
Ensure the client s books and records in accounting platforms remain synchronized with counterparty data received via TriOptima.
Investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks/exceptions across multiple break types.
Execute daily/weekly/monthly TriOptima reconciliations between client files and broker data.
Perform timely break management and follow-ups with brokers/vendors/clients to drive resolution.
Engage with clients on a weekly/fortnightly cadence to review outstanding items and agree next steps.
Manage an exception queue, including aging controls, SLA adherence, and timely escalation.
Required qualifications, capabilities and skills
Bachelor s degree.
Understanding of trade lifecycle events and data quality controls.
Baseline knowledge (or equivalent expertise) in fund servicing operations, including executing routine transactions and supporting process improvements.
Strong client handling skills, including active listening and effective questioning to identify needs and resolve issues.
Ability to work independently, with strong follow-through and attention to detail.
Strong prioritization and ability to manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Hands-on proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word.
Working knowledge of Tableau and Alteryx (preferred).
Experience in reconciliations / middle office / operations (OTC & Non-OTC exposure preferred).
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

Job Summary
Purpose of Role - Conducting Strategic Sourcing, Market Intelligence, Opportunity Assessment, Spend Analytics, Contract Analytics, Category Strategy development support, Contract Extension & Renewals, spot buys, tactical sourcing, market engagement and buying channel optimization, tail spend management, executing projects through GEP S2C platform, perform risk, governance & compliance checks, supporting procurement operations etc. and thereby optimize the way we source & procure and generate value.
What you'll be doing
Should be proficient in Strategic Sourcing: Analyzing spend data, creating internal & external category profiles, Market intelligence reports, Opportunity assessments, devising category strategies, identifying sourcing levers for respective market categories, analyzing costing for a product or service, conduct structured supplier negotiations, understand the nuances of contracting and execute the same with suppliers in co-ordination with legal teams, managing statutory compliances and sustainability requirements etc.
Executing projects through GEP Source to Contract platform, performing procurement risk, governance & compliance activities, supporting procurement operational activities etc.
Experience working in reputed S2C platforms shall be appreciated specifically GEP S2C.
Day to day performance of procurement activities, managing workloads and priorities, co-ordinate with the team and escalating/reporting to sourcing & procurement manager on a regular basis.
Ensure high-quality stakeholder engagement both internal (procurement) & external (suppliers, agencies, business contacts).
Support Team Lead in managing agreed objectives/deliverables and provide timely & appropriate updates until project closure.
Collecting, communicating and documenting requirements from stakeholders.
Execute strategic sourcing projects in co-ordination with category teams and sourcing & procurement manager.
Analyze buying patterns, volumes to determine appropriate buying channel e.g. catalogue, P-card, PO purchase etc.
Providing specialist administrative support from beginning to end of a tendering project/RFP ensuring the integrity of the process.
Keeping an audit trail for each project and ensuring required documentation is in place.
Providing a professional, efficient and effective response to stakeholders when handling clarification questions and responding to other enquiries.
Competencies, Knowledge and Experience
Digital Dexterity, Collaboration, Critical Thinking, Developing Self (Learning to Learn) Curiosity, Creativity and Innovation, Stakeholder Management and Business, Partnership, Strategic Business Acumen, Responsible Procurement, Managing Supplier Relationships, Contract Development, Negotiation, Contract and Performance Management, Change Management, Leadership, Strategic Sourcing, Managing and Developing People, Category Planning.
What you'll need
Proficient in strategic sourcing and procurement methodology and process.
Experience in working on Source2Contract platforms.
Demonstrated ability to devise and provide insight on spend categories and supply markets based internal & external category profiles.
Strong procurement operational skills, legal understanding and RFI/RFP activities.
Who you'll be working with
Key External Relationships:
Suppliers
Professional and Industry Groups
Key Internal Relationships:
Head Procurement Category Management
Business Stakeholders
Procurement Sourcing & Operations
Business Partners
Procurement Leadership
Who you are
You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.
You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures for our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.
You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.
#LI-Hybrid

Job Summary
The opportunity: Senior Analyst-AMI-Business Consulting Risk-CNS - Risk - Process & Controls - Mumbai
The Advanced Manufacturing, Mobility & Infrastructure (AMI) Industry Market contains the following industries: Aerospace and Defence, Chemicals, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Automotive, and Transportation that includes Mobility-as-a-Service. We help our clients to address the rapidly changing needs of our business world on not only how goods and services are bought and sold, but also on how they are designed and created. AMI builds and shares resources across sectors facing common challenges and aims to drive more effective cross-sector collaboration while enabling greater resource-pooling and developing more cohesive market responses. AMI also presents an opportunity to connect regional sector communities with a more robust, global priority sector infrastructure.
CNS - Risk - Process & Controls :
EY Consulting is building a better working world by transforming businesses through the power of people, technology and innovation. Our client-centric approach focuses on driving long-term value for our clients by solving their most strategic problems. EY Consulting is made up of three sub-service lines: Business Consulting (including Performance Improvement and Risk Consulting), Technology Consulting and People Advisory Services.
We help our clients in identifying and managing the interplay between upside and downside risk in order to make the long-term decisions to prevent risk and impact on their organizations ability to meet its future business strategy and objectives. The 3 key fields of play are :
Enterprise Risk - helps clients identify and address key risk areas, while building the agility to respond quickly. The areas of focus include Enterprise risk and resilience, Internal audit, Compliance and Internal controls
Technology Risk - helps clients to achieve sustainable growth by supporting their efforts to protect their business performance and by providing trusted communications on internal control and regulatory compliance to investors, management, regulators, customers and other stakeholders. EY teams accomplish this by assessing the technology risks that are introduced to businesses.
Financial Services Risk - helps clients in the financial sector to identify, manage and monitor the risks in their business. It is done through a transformative and agile approach including process and procedures, risk, data modeling and analytics, reporting to stakeholders and third parties, business requirements (for software selection and IT implementation), analysis of assets and liabilities, and capital and liquidity management.
Your key responsibilities
Technical Excellence
CA with 0-2 years of Internal Audit experience
To qualify for the role you must have
Chartered Accountant
Experience
0 to 2 years of experience
What we look for
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.

Description:
We welcome you to join one of the world s top five most admired and prominent companies. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Come join us to be the best financial services company in the world which is formed to foster a creative, inclusive work environment that always values employees personal and professional development.

As a Fund Servicing Analyst within JPMorganChase, you will play a crucial role in our fund servicing operations. Your primary focus will be on executing routine transactions and collaborating with various teams. You will also apply your knowledge of fund servicing to ensure smooth operations, while also identifying opportunities for process improvements. Your emotional intelligence will help you build strong relationships and influence better outcomes. This role is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and contribute to our teams success.

Job responsibilities
Review primary financial statements in line with accounting standards and regulatory disclosure requirements, ensuring delivery within agreed deadlines.
Review regulatory and other reports as required.
Review financial statements and related accounting/portfolio information for accuracy and completeness.
Perform ongoing analysis of client accounting records; identify and escalate potential issues where appropriate.
Resolve team queries and provide guidance on accounting / reporting matters.
Liaise with partner sites to manage deliverables and ensure timely, accurate deliveries.
Engage with stakeholders to respond to accounting and financial reporting queries as they arise.
Identify and drive process improvement opportunities; develop recommendations for change and encourage team ideation for efficiency.
Ensure risk and control checks are in place; liaise with OCM team to address any issues.
Required qualifications, capabilities and skills
Strong understanding of financial reporting and regulatory reporting requirements.
Knowledge of financial instruments and their accounting treatment.
Knowledge/experience in Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, and/or Capital Markets.
Strong understanding of fund administration and valuation functions, and the broader operating model.
Professional, client-service-oriented approach with a quality mindset.
Demonstrated ability to lead in challenging situations and support team execution under pressure.
Flexible and willing to work additional hours during peak reporting periods; able to instill the same discipline within the team.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills
Experience with IFRS and/or US GAAP (advantage).
Postgraduate qualification and/or professional certification such as CA/CPA, preferably with specialization in Finance/Accounting.
Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

Description:
Are you ready to make an impact in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment Join our international team and help shape the future of regulatory reporting at JPMorganChase. You will have the opportunity to work on high-profile projects, collaborate across regions, and develop your skills in a dynamic, supportive environment. We offer career growth, exposure to cutting-edge technology, and the chance to contribute to meaningful change within the firm.
Job summary:
As a Business Analyst/Associate, International Regulatory Projects within the International Regulatory Projects Team in Regulatory Reporting, you will play a key role in managing the implementation of new regulations and business process enhancements. You will work closely with colleagues across India, London, and Warsaw, driving project delivery and integration into Finance. You will help define project scope, ensure requirements are met, and support technology deployments and business initiatives. Your work will directly impact our ability to meet regulatory obligations and support business growth.
Job responsibilities:
Establish and maintain effective communication and engagement with key contacts across teams and regions.
Contribute to project scope, approach and timelines, ensuring regulatory impacts are understood and addressed.
Document, communicate and deliver business requirements and testing strategies against Critical Success Criteria.
Articulate and agree on test environment requirements.
Raise, escalate and resolve issues throughout the project lifecycle.
Highlight risks and dependencies, presenting mitigation options to Project Management and the Regulatory Reporting team.
Draft and deliver regulatory business requirements and user test documentation for sign-off.
Plan and execute user acceptance testing, including issue investigation and defect resolution.
Draft and deliver user test completion reports for sign-off.
Obtain sign-off approval from the Regulatory Reporting team.
Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
Knowledge of regulatory reporting rules, including credit risk, market risk and financial reporting.
Experience in user testing planning and execution.
Understanding of the project life cycle.
Organization and planning skills.
Issue and risk management and resolution skills.
Communication, negotiation and relationship management skills.
Creative problem-solving and business process reengineering skills.
Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and independently progress multiple tasks.
Ability to execute tasks under challenging targets and manage changes effectively.
Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:
Experience with Jira or similar testing tools.
Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
Experience documenting current and future state business processes.
Self-motivation and ability to work independently.
Ability to multi-task in a constantly changing environment.
Shift timing:
Europe, Middle East and Africa shift timings: 1:30 pm to 10:30 pm India Standard Time

Description:
Position: CMA Intern
Qualification: CMA Intermediate Both Groups Cleared / Newly Qualified / CMA Finalists, as applicable
Location: Andheri East
Date: 26th November 2026 (Thursday)
Time: 2:00 PM 5:00 PM
Duration: 15 months

Job Summary
We are looking for motivated and detail-oriented CMA Inters to join our Global Business Services (GBS) team. The role offers an opportunity to work across finance and accounting operations, financial reporting, cost analysis, budgeting, and business support processes while collaborating with global stakeholders.
The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in accounting and finance, analytical skills, a willingness to learn, and the ability to work in a dynamic, process-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities
Support day-to-day finance and accounting activities, including general ledger, reconciliations, and month-end closing.
Assist in financial reporting, management reporting, and preparation of financial statements.
Support budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost control activities.
Perform financial data analysis to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement.
Assist in accounts payable, accounts receivable, and other Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, as assigned.
Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of financial information in accordance with established policies and procedures.
Support internal and external audits by preparing relevant schedules, documentation, and reconciliations.
Follow internal controls, compliance requirements, and standard operating procedures.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and global stakeholders to resolve queries and meet service delivery requirements.
Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, automation, and reporting accuracy.

Required Qualifications and Skills
CMA Intermediate Both Groups Cleared / Newly Qualified / CMA Finalists.
Strong understanding of accounting principles, cost accounting, financial management, and management reporting.
Good analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
Proficiency in MS Excel and familiarity with MS Office applications.
Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to meet deadlines.
Willingness to learn new systems, processes, and technologies.
Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented, multicultural environment.

What We Offer
Opportunity to build a career in global finance and accounting operations.
Exposure to international business processes and stakeholders.
Structured learning and professional development opportunities.
Experience working with finance systems, reporting tools, and process improvement initiatives.
A collaborative work environment with opportunities for career growth.

And we re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
EY- Assurance - Senior Associate
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
The opportunity
We re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.
Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.
Ideally, you ll also have
Proficiency in MS - Excel, MS - Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.
What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

BDO is an international network of accounting, tax, and advisory firms which perform professional services to clients throughout the country and around the globe. The local knowledge of network member firms combined with the international expertise and strength of our network ensures effective and efficient service delivery to all our clients in every country where BDO is represented. This year’s GLOBAL REVIEW aims to demonstrate and clarify how we’re going about achieving this. BDO India builds on foundations of quality and a business-focused & result-oriented approach to servicing clients. Job Description Branch Operations Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager

Company: Rentokil PCI

Department: Branch Operations / Administration

Experience: 1–4 Years

Qualification: Any Graduate

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Assistant Branch Manager / Branch Manager

About Rentokil PCI

Rentokil PCI is India's leading pest control service provider and a brand of Rentokil Initial. Established in 2017 through a joint venture between Pest Control India and Rentokil, the company operates across 300 locations in India.
With a strong focus on customer service, operational excellence, innovation, and digital technologies, Rentokil PCI continues to strengthen its market leadership. In 2024, the company further expanded its presence and service capabilities through the acquisition of HiCare.

Website: https://www.rentokil-pestcontrolindia.com

Job Overview

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive professional to manage and support end-to-end branch operations and administrative activities.
The role involves handling customer communication, back-office operations, invoicing, documentation, compliance, MIS reporting, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
The candidate will work closely with the Branch Manager / Assistant Branch Manager and collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Business Support teams to ensure smooth and efficient branch functioning.

Key Responsibilities

1. Branch Administration & Customer Coordination
Handle incoming calls, customer queries, and email communications.
Manage the branch's central email ID and ensure timely responses and query allocation.
Coordinate with internal teams for customer requests and issue resolution.
Assign and monitor iCABS tickets and ensure timely updates and closure.
2. Billing, Invoicing & Commercial Operations
Manage invoice-related activities, including forecasting, suspension, printing, and distribution.
Process price change requests (CR tickets), credit note requests, and invoice adjustments.
Generate renewal reports and prepare renewal letters.
Process customer contract renewals at existing or revised pricing.
Raise termination requests through the designated portal.
3. Documentation & Compliance Management
Maintain customer documentation, including quotations, purchase orders (POs), warranties, OCCs, and compliance records.
Maintain SHE documentation, fumigation certificates, and relevant registers.
Track license renewals and ensure compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
Support internal and external audits by maintaining accurate documentation.
4. Finance & Cash Management
Enter customer receipts and deposit slips into the system.
Handle necessary receipt adjustments for other branches.
Manage credit note requests and petty cash portal activities.
Coordinate with local banks for branch-related transactions.
5. HR & General Administration
Prepare and submit incentive calculations within defined timelines.
Maintain attendance inputs and employee-related administrative records.
Coordinate mediclaim requirements, contract labour details, and material indents.
Maintain technician conveyance records.
6. Reporting & Operational Support
Upload service dockets for key accounts.
Prepare and submit operational reports within defined timelines.
Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and Business Support teams.
Perform additional administrative and operational activities as assigned by the Branch Manager.

Key Skills & Competencies

Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Good knowledge of MS Excel, MS Office, and Google Workspace.
Knowledge of back-office operations and branch administration.
Basic understanding of billing, invoicing, and commercial documentation.
Good documentation and data management skills.
Strong coordination and interpersonal skills.
Ability to multitask and manage deadlines.
High attention to detail and accuracy.
Problem-solving and time-management abilities.

Educational Qualification & Experience
Any Graduate (Bachelor's degree in any discipline).
1–4 years of experience in Back Office Operations, Branch Administration, Office Administration, or Operations Coordination.
Experience working with an MNC or service-based organization will be preferred.
Proficiency in MS Office, particularly MS Excel, and Google Workspace.
Experience in invoicing, MIS reporting, documentation, and customer coordination will be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Timely and accurate completion of branch operational activities.
Error-free documentation and data entry.
Timely processing of invoices, renewals, and commercial requests.
Effective coordination with internal teams and customers.
Timely submission of reports and incentive calculations.
Compliance with audit, SHE, and regulatory requirements.

Key Working Relationships

Internal Stakeholders: Sales Team, Operations Team, Branch Management, and Business Support Functions.
External Stakeholders: Customers, Customer Representatives, Banks, and Other Business Partners.

Why Join Rentokil PCI?

At Rentokil PCI, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe in building a workplace driven by four core values:
Service
Relationships
Teamwork
Responsibility
We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where individuals from all backgrounds are welcomed, respected, and encouraged to grow.

Join Rentokil PCI and become part of a team committed to delivering excellence in customer service and operational performance.

About QI Spine Clinic
QI Spine Clinic is India's first chain of medical centres dedicated to the accurate diagnosis and non-surgical treatment of back and neck pain. Founded in 2011, QI Spine operates 22 clinics across 5 cities Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Bangalore and Hyderabad.
With a team of over 200 spine specialists and leading orthopaedic experts, QI Spine focuses on advanced diagnosis, technology-driven treatment and non-surgical recovery. The clinic has achieved a 91% success rate and helped over 13,000 patients recover without surgery.

Job Overview
We are looking for a confident, empathetic and sales-oriented Patient Counsellor who can guide patients through their treatment journey.
The role involves counselling first-time patients about doctor-recommended treatment plans, explaining treatment packages, addressing patient concerns and converting consultations into treatment enrolments while ensuring an excellent patient experience.

Key Responsibilities
Welcome patients and ensure a comfortable and positive clinic experience.
Assist patients with consultation forms and collect relevant medical history and concerns.
Explain doctor-recommended treatment plans, procedures, benefits, timelines and packages in simple language.
Educate patients about treatment options, pricing and expected outcomes.
Counsel patients and recommend suitable treatment packages based on doctors' advice and patient requirements.
Address patient queries, concerns and objections with empathy and professionalism.
Drive treatment package conversions and achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.
Follow up with prospective and existing patients to improve conversions and retention.
Build strong patient relationships to encourage repeat visits and referrals.
Coordinate with doctors, clinic operations and support teams to ensure a smooth patient journey.
Maintain accurate patient records, counselling reports and documentation.
Coordinate with the finance team for billing, invoicing and discount approvals.

Eligibility Criteria
HSC pass candidates with at least 6 months of relevant work experience.
Graduates/Freshers can also be considered, provided they have excellent communication skills.
Candidates with experience in sales, customer service, counselling or healthcare will be preferred.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Good convincing, negotiation and objection-handling abilities.
Basic proficiency in MS Excel and computer operations.
Well-groomed, presentable and professional personality.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.

Shift & Working Details
Shift Duration: 8.5 hours.
Weekly Off: 1 Rotational Off
Shift Timings: Any shift between 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM.
Candidates must be flexible with shift timings.

Interested Candidates

Description:
JOB SUMMARY
Position responsible for all the food and beverage operations, which includes all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations. Oversees guest and employee satisfaction, maintaining standards and meeting or exceeding financial goals. Demonstrates knowledge and proficiency of all applicable food and beverage laws and regulations. Develops and implements business plan for food and beverage.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
Education and Experience
- High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
OR
- 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.
CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
Developing and Maintaining Budgets
- Develops and manages all financial, employee engagement and guest satisfaction plans and actions for Food and Beverage departments.
- Maintains a positive cost management index for kitchen and restaurant operations.
- Utilizes budgets to understand financial objectives.
Leading Food and Beverage Team
- Manages the Food and Beverage departments (not catering sales).
- Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees absence.
- Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.
- Oversees all culinary, restaurant, beverage and room service operations.
- Creates and nurtures a property environment that emphasizes motivation, empowerment, teamwork, continuous improvement and a passion for providing service.
- Provides excellent customer service to all employees.
- Responds quickly and proactively to employees concerns.
- Provides a learning atmosphere with a focus on continuous improvement.
- Provides proactive coaching and counseling to team members.
- Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.
- Monitors and maintains the productivity level of employees.
- Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish work.
- Provides the leadership, vision and direction to bring together and prioritize the departmental goals in a way that will be efficient and effective.
- Sets clear expectations with the employees and team leaders and verifies that appropriate rewards are given if expectations are exceeded.
Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service
- Provides excellent customer service.
- Responds quickly and proactively to guests concerns.
- Understands the brands service culture.
- Drives alignment of all employees, team leaders and managers to the brands service culture.
- Sets service expectations for all guests internally and externally.
- Takes ownership of a guest complaint/problem until it is resolved or it has been addressed by the appropriate manager or employee.
- Verifies all banquet functions are up to standard and exceed guests expectations.
- Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.
- Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.
- Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.
- Manages day-to-day operations, drives quality, and verifies standards are meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.
Managing and Conducting Human Resource Activities
- Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.
- Conducts performance reviews in a timely manner.
- Promotes both Guarantee of Fair Treatment and Open Door policies.
- Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaches, mentors, or otherwise helps others to improve their knowledge or skills.
- Identifies the educational needs of others, develops formal educational or training programs or classes, and teaches or instructs others.
- Develops an action plan to attack need areas and expand on strengths based on employee engagement and guest satisfaction results.
Additional Responsibilities
- Complies with all corporate accounting procedures.
- Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.
- Analyzes information and evaluates results to choose the best solution and solve problems.
- Drives effective departmental communication and information systems through logs, department meetings and property meetings.

Role - Senior Associate
Experience: 5-9 years
Oracle Finance Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
Location: Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Gurugram



Role & responsibilities

We are looking for an Oracle Finance P2P Lead to manage functional delivery across the Procure-to-Pay lifecycle. The role involves understanding business requirements, designing and configuring solutions, and collaborating with stakeholders to support implementation, enhancement and production support activities.
Key Responsibilities
- Lead requirements gathering and process discussions with finance and procurement stakeholders.
- Translate business requirements into functional designs and Oracle configurations.
- Manage P2P processes covering requisitions, purchase orders, receipts, supplier invoices and payments.
- Configure and support Oracle Payables, including invoice matching, approvals, payment processing and supplier-related setups.
- Collaborate with Procurement, General Ledger and Cash Management teams to support end-to-end process integration.
- Prepare functional specifications for reports, interfaces, conversions and enhancements.
- Coordinate with technical teams to resolve functional issues and deliver solutions.
- Lead functional testing, support SIT and UAT, and track defects through resolution.
- Support data migration, reconciliation, cutover and post-go-live activities.
- Guide team members, manage deliverables and provide timely stakeholder updates.
- Ensure process documentation and user training materials are maintained.
Required Skills and Experience
- 59 years of relevant Oracle Finance functional experience, with strong expertise in P2P.
- Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials and/or Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS)**.
- Strong knowledge of Oracle Payables and its integration with Purchasing, General Ledger and Cash Management.
- Understanding of invoice processing, two-way/three-way matching, payment methods, accounting and period-end activities.
- Experience in Oracle implementation, rollout, enhancement or support projects.
- Ability to lead a functional workstream and coordinate across business and technical teams.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, IT or a related discipline.
- CA, CMA, MBA in Finance or relevant Oracle certification is an advantage.
- Experience with global stakeholders and shared-services environments is preferred.

Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

Dear Pankaj,
Greetings from Axtria! (Axtria is a global provider of cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences & Healthcare industry).
As discussed,  please find below the generic job specifications for your reference.
Location Hyd | Bangalore | Noida | GGN | Pune
About The Role
We are looking for a Data Governance Consultant to drive core data governance engagements for our clients. This role combines hands-on governance program design with client-facing consulting and pre-sales responsibilities, working closely with business and IT stakeholders to stand up sustainable governance operating models.
Key Responsibilities
Data Governance Program Delivery
Define and own the data governance charter, including scope, guiding principles, roles & responsibilities, and success metrics
Partner with business and IT teams to design and implement escalation matrices for data issues, policy exceptions, and change requests
Establish and facilitate the Data Governance Council, including cadence, decision rights, and reporting structures
Formulate, document, and maintain SOPs covering data quality, stewardship, issue resolution, and data ownership processes
Define data ownership and stewardship models (data owners, stewards, custodians) across business domains
Design and roll out data policies, standards, and metrics/KPIs to track governance maturity and adoption
Tools & Technical Fluency
Demonstrate working proficiency in leading data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Atlan, and Alation
Support tool evaluation, configuration recommendations, and policy/workflow design within these platforms
Collaborate with data engineering and analytics teams to align governance policies with underlying data platforms
Client Engagement & Business Development
Lead or support client discovery sessions, workshops, and governance maturity assessments
Own or contribute to RFP/RFI responses, including solutioning, effort estimation, and proposal narrative
Build client-facing deliverables (decks, SOPs, charters, maturity frameworks) and present to senior stakeholders
Act as a trusted advisor to client governance leads, balancing pragmatic delivery with long-term governance maturity
Stakeholder & Project Management
Drive cross-functional alignment between business, IT, compliance, and data teams
Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies for governance workstreams within larger data management programs
Mentor junior consultants and contribute to CoE assets and reusable governance frameworks
Required Qualifications
12+ years of experience in data governance or related consulting roles
Proven experience defining data governance charters, councils, and operating models in a real client/enterprise setting
Hands-on exposure to at least one major data governance/catalog tool (Collibra, Atlan, or Alation); familiarity with multiple is a plus
Experience responding to RFPs/RFIs and supporting pre-sales or proposal development
Strong understanding of data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK) and concepts such as data lineage, data quality, and stewardship
Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with experience engaging both business and IT audiences
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience building executive-ready presentations
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in life sciences/pharma or other regulated data environments
Prior consulting/CoE experience with both offshore and onshore delivery models
Relevant certifications (DAMA CDMP, Collibra/Alation/Atlan certifications)
Why Axtria: -
Axtria (www.Axtria.com) is truly a New-Age Software Product Unicorn, a first of its kind in providing the cloud software and data analytics to the Life Sciences industry globally. We help Life Sciences companies transform the product commercialization journey to drive sales growth and improve healthcare outcomes for patients. We are acutely aware that our work impacts millions of patients and lead passionately to improve their lives.
Since our founding in 2010, technology innovation has been our winning differentiation, and we continue to leapfrog competition with platforms that deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Our cloud-based platforms - Axtria DataMAX, Axtria InsightsMAX™, Axtria SALESIQ™, Axtria CUSTOMERIQ™ and Axtria MarketingIQ- enable customers to efficiently manage data, leverage data science to deliver insights for sales and marketing planning and manage end-to-end commercial operations. With customers in over 20 countries, Axtria is one of the biggest global commercial solutions providers in the Life Sciences industry. We continue to win industry recognition for growth and are featured in some of the most aspirational lists - INC 5000, Deloitte FAST 500, NJBiz FAST 50, SmartCEO Future 50, Red Herring 100, and several other growth and technology awards.
Axtria is looking for exceptional talent to join our rapidly growing global team
People are our biggest perk! Our transparent and collaborative culture offers a chance to work with some of the brightest minds in the industry
Our data analytics and software platforms support data science, commercial operations, and cloud information management. We enable commercial excellence through our cloud-based sales planning and operations platform
We are leaders in managing data using the latest cloud information management and big data technologies
Axtria Institute, our in-house university, offers the best training in the industry and an opportunity to learn in a structured environment. A customized career progression plan       ensures every associate is setup for success and able to do meaningful work in a fun environment. We want our legacy to be the leaders we produce for the industry
3500+ employees worldwide – growing rapidly & strengthening our product engineering team. We would almost double our India headcount in the coming year
Feel free to reach out in case of any queries

brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation

Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines

Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field

Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus

Job Description
Line of Service: Advisory Consulting
Industry: Commodities Trading and Risk Management Consulting
Technology Focus: Hands-on Azure cloud development, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database, Azure Blob Storage, cloud integrations and ETL
Designation: Senior Associate RightAngle Development
Location: Bangalore or Gurugram, India
Travel Requirements: Travel to client locations may be required as per project requirements.
Job Summary:
Join our Commodities Practice as a Senior Associate specializing in hands-on ION RightAngle development. Build and support technical solutions for global energy and commodities trading clients across implementation, enhancement, integration, migration and production support engagements.
Position Requirements:
Design, develop, test and deploy RightAngle customizations, plugins, extensions, reports and interfaces.
Develop, deploy and troubleshoot Azure Logic Apps and Azure Functions for RightAngle integrations, data orchestration and automated processing.
Build and maintain Azure SQL Database solutions and Azure Blob Storage-based data exchange, ingestion and archival workflows.
Write and optimize C#/.NET code, SQL queries, stored procedures and supporting database objects.
Build integrations using APIs, web services, XML, JSON, file interfaces and batch processing patterns.
Develop ETL, data mapping, transformation, reconciliation and validation routines for RightAngle implementations and migrations.
Troubleshoot technical defects across RightAngle transactions, interfaces, database processes and scheduled jobs.
Work with functional consultants to interpret requirements and produce detailed technical designs and impact assessments.
Execute unit and integration tests, document results, resolve defects and support SIT, UAT, cutover and stabilization.
Use Git, code reviews, engineering standards and AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery quality and speed.
Communicate task status, dependencies and risks to the technical lead and engagement team.
Knowledge Preferred:
Working knowledge of RightAngle architecture, database entities, custom development approaches and transaction lifecycle.
Understanding of physical trading, scheduling, inventory, pricing, invoicing, accounting and risk reporting.
Experience integrating RightAngle with SAP, price services, tax engines or enterprise data platforms is desirable.
Skills Preferred:
RightAngle Development: Hands-on RightAngle customization, plugins, reporting, interfaces and debugging; C#, .NET, SQL Server and T-SQL.
Integration and Data: REST/SOAP, XML/JSON, flat files, ETL, mappings, data quality, exception handling and reconciliation.
Engineering Practices: Version control, code review, unit testing, performance tuning, release support and AI-assisted code/test development.
Azure Cloud Engineering (Mandatory): Hands-on development with Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database and Azure Blob Storage; cloud integration, monitoring, error handling and deployment.
Industry Experience:
Must have: Refined Products, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Pipeline and Terminal Operations, and Commodity Risk Management.
Good to have: Power and Utilities, Rack/Retail and Wholesale Fuel Distribution, and Natural Gas Liquids (NGLs).
Qualifications:
Educational Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, Accounting or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Past Experience: 5+ years of relevant CTRM/ETRM experience, with the role-specific RightAngle capabilities and delivery experience described above.
Mandatory: hands-on RightAngle development using C#/.NET and SQL Server, plus practical development and troubleshooting experience across Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure SQL Database and Azure Blob Storage.

Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will enable clients to optimize financial processes, improve financial reporting, and achieve their strategic objectives. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.

You will analyze and identify the linkages and interactions between the component parts of an entire system, partnering with team leadership to validate collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables. You will embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same, effectively mentoring others and addressing conflicts or issues with clients and team members.
Responsibilities
- Analyzing client requirements to implement SAP finance solutions effectively
- Leading teams in the integration and utilization of SAP finance applications to optimize financial processes

Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.

Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Job description
Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) Senior Associate (19-23 Years of Experience)
As an OAC Senior Developer, you will work with technical and project teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade data integration solutions for some of our Fortune 1000 clients. You will have the opportunity to contribute to work that may involve building new ELT/ETL pipelines; migrating on-premise integration workloads to the cloud; modernizing legacy Data Warehouse feeds; and integrating Oracle Data Integrator with GoldenGate, OCI Data Integration, and other Oracle data platform services. Our teams have a diverse range of skills, and we are always looking for new ways to innovate and help our clients succeed. The primary focus of this role is to design, develop, and support enterprise data integration solutions using Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Data Integration/Data
Role & responsibilities
As OAC developer you will have multiple responsibilities depending on the project type. One type of project may involve migrating existing reporting applications to Oracle cloud infrastructure.Another might involve building new reporting solutions directly within Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) .The key responsibilities may involve some or all the areas listed below:
Role & responsibilities
19-23 years of hands-on experience with Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) , including KM development and topology configuration.
Experience with Oracle Data Integrator 11g/12c/ODI Marketplace Edition.
Exposure to Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Fusion Data
Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills, with experience on one or more relational databases on Oracle.
Solid understanding of ELT/ETL architecture, data warehousing concepts, and dimensional modeling.
Experience with Oracle GoldenGate for real-time replication and Change Data Capture (CDC).
Exposure to OCI Data Integration / Data Transforms and cloud-native, serverless integration patterns.
Experience migrating on-premise ETL workloads to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Working knowledge of Oracle Autonomous Database and Oracle Exadata Cloud Service as integration targets.
Exposure to Big Data connectivity (Hadoop, Hive, Spark, Kafka) within ODI or GoldenGate for Big Data.
Experience with job scheduling, load plans, and ODI agent (Standalone/JEE/Colocated) administration.
Preferred
Experience with Oracle GoldenGate 21c/23ai.
Exposure to Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) or Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) as downstream consumers of ODI pipelines.
Experience in Oracle BI Apps (OBIA).
Exposure to one or more of the following: Python, R, or UNIX shell scripting.
Expertise in analyzing and troubleshooting large-scale, high-volume data integration jobs.
Systematic problem-solving approach.
Ability to debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks.
Exposure to ODI SDK and Groovy scripting for automation.Role & responsibilities
CompanyAddress: 4th Floor, Bagmane Tech Park, Byrasandra Village, KR Puram Hobli, CV Raman Nagar, Bangalore, KA, BANGALORE, Karnataka, India

Greetings from Pwc!
Role- Senior Engineering Manager AI Platform & Deployment
Experience Required-15+years
Location-Hyderabad/Bangalore

If interested please kindly share cv on Mashal.ahmad@pwc.com
Job Description-
Responsibilities-• Own the asset hardening method end to end — built asset through to production in a client estate
Lead estate-fit assessment: enterprise architecture, systems of record, PHI/PII classification
Take assets through architecture review board, cybersecurity and AI governance approval
Own approved-tool substitution where a client register excludes our default stack
Design and operate the managed run layer — tenancy model, release control, version governance
Own the agent control set: autonomy tiers, human-in-the-loop policy, evaluation gates, decision audit
Set engineering standards consistent across engagements; drive reuse over rebuild
Act as technical counterpart to client architects, security reviewers and governance boards
Line-manage Engineering Managers and set the offshore capability plan
Technical Skills
Agentic AI architecture — orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP, multi-agent patterns
Production RAG — chunking, embeddings, vector stores, retrieval quality, grounding evaluation
LLMOps — evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, drift detection, regression gates, tracing
Cloud-native on at least two of AWS (Bedrock), Azure (AI Foundry), GCP; plus Snowflake
Security engineering — IAM and OIDC, RBAC, secrets management, network isolation, PII/PHI redaction
Infrastructure-as-code and release engineering — Terraform, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, change control
Data platform fluency — pipelines, data quality, lineage, semantic and metric layers
Delivery experience in a regulated estate — healthcare, financial services or equivalent
