Role & responsibilities


Strategic Account Manager (SAM)
Company: G4S Secure Solutions India (An Allied Universal Company)
Locations: Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad
Experience: 8 15 Years
Department: Business Development Strategic Accounts
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About the Role
Are you a senior B2B sales leader who loves growing large corporate accounts and dealing with top executiveswithout getting stuck in daily operational firefighting?

G4S Secure Solutions India is hiring a Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to manage, retain, and grow a focused portfolio of 7 to 8 major national enterprise accounts.
You will focus on growing revenue, pitching new solutions, protecting profit margins, and renewing multi-year contracts.

Role Snapshot
Role Level: Senior Manager / General Manager (Individual Contributor Expert Track)
Reporting To: Sales Director – India
Core Focus: 100% Account Growth (Grow) & Client Retention (Keep)
What You Will Do

1. Grow Existing Accounts & Sell More Services (45%)
Create and run 3-year growth plans for your 7–8 assigned enterprise clients across India.
Track client business expansions early—such as new offices, data centers, and corporate campuses—to win new site contracts.
Prepare winning commercial proposals for new locations, tech upgrades, and expanded services.
Cross-sell integrated G4S solutions, including remote monitoring (SROC), access control, Electronic Security Systems (ESS), and Facilities Management (FM).
2. Renew Contracts & Improve Profit Margins (35%)
Manage multi-year contract renewals well in advance to ensure zero preventable client loss (Target: 95%+ retention).
Negotiate annual statutory wage revisions, management fee hikes, and contract restructurings with clients.
Keep a close eye on account profitability, fix margin leaks, and renegotiate underpriced contracts.
3. Build C-Suite & Senior Client Relationships (10%)
Build strong, long-term relationships with client decision-makers—CSOs, Procurement Heads (CPOs), CFOs, and Real Estate Directors.
Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and annual strategy meetings with client leadership.
Act as the main point of contact to resolve major commercial or contract issues.
4. Work Closely with Operations & Finance (10%)
Hold weekly sync-ups with your paired Operations KAM to track service quality (SLAs) and catch any client risks early.
Partner with Finance and Operations teams to solve major billing issues and speed up overdue payments.

What We Are Looking For
Experience & Education:
Experience: 8–15+ years of experience managing and growing large B2B corporate accounts (in Security, Facility Management, Industrial Services, Telecom, or Enterprise Solutions).
Proven Track Record: Experience retaining and expanding multi-million-dollar corporate accounts across multiple cities in India.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or Engineering (Required). MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or International Business is strongly preferred.

Key Skills:
Financial & Pricing Sense: Good understanding of contract P&L, costing sheets, profit margins, and labour compliance rules.
Executive Confidence: Comfortable pitching to and negotiating with CXOs and central procurement teams.
Solution Selling: Experience selling bundled manpower and technology solutions.
CRM Skills: Regular, disciplined use of Salesforce CRM to track sales pipelines and opportunities.

Why Join G4S (An Allied Universal® Company)?
Zero Daily Operations Hassle: Your paired Operations KAM handles day-to-day site delivery so you can focus 100% on commercial growth and deals.

Global Brand & Career Growth: Work with the world’s leading security solutions company with clear growth paths into National Account Leadership or Hub Commercial Director roles.
AboutCompany:
G4S in India: 
Founded in 1989, G4S India is the leading security solutions group in the country. The company today has more than 1,35,000 employees with 4 Hubs and a strong network of over 100+ offices spread throughout India. Besides its core business of Secure Solutions, Integrated Facilities Management Services and Electronic Security Systems, G4S also offers a range of services including; Training (29 Training Schools across India), Event Security, Executive Protection, Security Consultancy & Risk Management, Central Monitoring Services, Fire Alarm and Emergency Evacuation System, People Transport Solutions, CCTV Surveillance Solutions etc. G4S has an impressive clientele in various sectors including business process outsourcing, retail, healthcare, infrastructure, IT, banking, diplomatic missions & embassies, residential facilities, hospitality establishments, communications etc. We have a diverse range of services to meet our customers requirements and have a broad geographic footprint to meet the demand for security globally.
In 2021, G4S, a London-based global security company, was acquired by Allied Universal®, a leading security and facility services company that provides proactive security services and cutting-edge smart technology to deliver tailored, integrated security solutions. This acquisition expands Allied Universal’s footprint and infrastructure on a global and local level. Through the company’s vast network of more than 800,000 employees, we leverage global best practices in communities all over the world. With revenues of $18 billion, we are supported by efficient processes and systems that can only come with scale to help deliver our promise locally: keeping people safe so our communities can thrive. In Asia Pacific, we have an extensive network of offices and more than 192,000 employees to support our local communities and customers. We believe there is no greater purpose than serving and safeguarding customers, communities, and people in today’s world. Allied Universal is There for you™. For more information, please visit  www.g4s.com or www.aus.com

Role Overview
We are looking for professionals with experience in healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.
Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:
Healthcare Back Office Transformation
Healthcare Middle Office Transformation
Payer Analytics & Data Strategy
Key Responsibilities
Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.
Assess existing processes and develop process maps, workflow assessments, operating models, and improvement recommendations.
Conduct benchmarking, workforce assessments, research, and cost-benefit analyses to identify improvement opportunities.
Support transformation across payer functions such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, care management, utilization management, pharmacy/PBM, network management, payment integrity, and risk adjustment.
Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, operational issues, and actionable business insights.
Support technology-enabled operating model transformation, including workflow redesign, system implementation, platform optimization, and process automation.
Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity.
Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
Use GenAI to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.
Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI/ML, NLP, interoperability, and data exchange to improve payer processes.

Essential Knowledge & Experience
Understanding of healthcare payer operations and core functions.
Experience supporting operational, strategic, technology, analytics, or transformation initiatives.
Understanding of payer workflows such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, benefits, care management, and utilization management.
Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.
Experience working with complex datasets.
Understanding of payer technology platforms and system-enabled process improvement.
Ability to communicate analytical and technical insights clearly to business stakeholders.

Preferred Knowledge & Experience
Understanding of Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models.
Familiarity with risk adjustment, HCCs, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and compliance-driven payer activities.
Understanding of Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) concepts such as formulary design, utilization management, rebates, pharmacy networks, and drug-spend analytics.
Awareness of CMS oversight, payer regulatory requirements, audits, and compliance processes.
Understanding of value-based care and payment models.
Experience with payer analytics use cases involving risk adjustment, quality, care management, utilization, pharmacy, or payment integrity.
Exposure to predictive modeling, forecasting, risk scoring, or anomaly detection.
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, data exchange, provider data platforms, and automation concepts.
Exposure to digital transformation and analytics programs.

Technical Skills
Essential
Experience analyzing large and complex datasets.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to perform benchmarking and basic cost-benefit analysis.
Basic proficiency in GenAI-enabled research and insight development.

Preferred
SQL
Python or R
Automation tools
AI/ML and NLP concepts
Predictive modeling and forecasting
Healthcare analytics and data visualization
GenAI-based research and storyboarding
Core Competencies
Strategic and structured thinking
Strong analytical mindset
Problem solving
Stakeholder communication
Independent research
Business and technology alignment
Data-driven decision making
Innovation and continuous improvement
Ability to operate effectively in transformation environments

Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate combines healthcare payer domain knowledge with strong analytical and transformation capabilities. They should be comfortable understanding payer workflows, analyzing complex information and datasets, identifying improvement opportunities, and supporting technology- and data-enabled modernization initiatives.
Candidates with deeper specialization in payer operations, Medicare/Medicaid, PBM, risk adjustment, care/utilization management, healthcare analytics, data strategy, or payer technology transformation would be particularly relevant depending on the specific capability area.
What You Must Have
- Master's degree full- time
- At least 2-4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

Description:
Project Role : Technology Platform Engineer

Project Role Description : Creates production and non-production cloud environments using the proper software tools such as a platform for a project or product. Deploys the automation pipeline and automates environment creation and configuration.

Must have skills :Network Infrastructures

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required

Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Network Engineer with 10+ years of experience in enterprise network operations, routing & switching, and Cisco ACI environments. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and optimizing large-scale enterprise and datacenter networks. The role requires strong technical expertise in LAN/WAN technologies, Cisco Nexus platforms, Cisco ACI fabric, and network troubleshooting within complex enterprise environments.

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, implement, and support enterprise Routing & Switching infrastructure.
Manage and troubleshoot Cisco ACI fabric including tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, contracts, and policies.
Configure and support Cisco Catalyst, Nexus, and ISR/ASR platforms.
Perform advanced troubleshooting for LAN, WAN, WLAN, and datacenter network issues.
Handle routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, and static routing.
Configure and troubleshoot Layer 2 technologies including VLANs, STP, EtherChannel, HSRP/VRRP, VXLAN, and trunking.
Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity utilization.
Participate in major incident management and provide RCA for critical outages.
Implement network changes following enterprise change management processes.
Work closely with security, server, cloud, and application teams for end-to-end connectivity solutions.
Support datacenter migration, network transformation, and automation initiatives.
Maintain network documentation, diagrams, SOPs, and operational runbooks.
Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers and operations teams.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in core routing and switching (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, HSRP/VRRP, Switching, ACLs, NAT, DHCP, QoS)
Hands-on experience with Cisco ACI deployment and support.
Experience in enterprise NOC or production support environment.
Strong troubleshooting and incident management skills.
Experience handling P1/P2 incidents and RCA preparation.

Responsibilities:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and identify opportunities to apply Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI) solutions to solve complex enterprise problems.
Design, develop, and implement advanced GenAI and Agentic AI systems, including ReAct agents (Reasoning + Acting frameworks), multi-agent architectures, and autonomous AI workflows.

Develop and deploy production-ready AI applications using object-oriented programming principles, ensuring modularity, scalability, maintainability, and robustness.
Implement containerized AI solutions using Docker and Kubernetes for orchestration, scaling, and cloud-native deployments.
Design and implement tool-augmented agents, API-integrated workflows, and autonomous decision-making systems using modern AI agent frameworks.
Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate AI insights and business impact clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously stay updated with advancements in GenAI, Agentic AI, multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, and emerging AI frameworks, recommending innovative approaches to enhance enterprise AI capabilities.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
7+ years of relevant technical/technology experience, with a focus on GenAI projects.
Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, or Scala.
Proficiency in machine learning libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or scikit-learn.
Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and data wrangling techniques.
Solid understanding of statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and experimental design.
Familiarity with cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Knowledge of data visualization tools and techniques.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, C++, or C#.
Experience developing and deploying machine learning applications in production environments.
Understanding data privacy and compliance regulations.
Relevant certifications in data science or GenAI technologies.
Development experience in system designing, proven track record of software delivery through all phases of development, critical thinking, ability to clearly communicate, present and lead.
Nice to Have Skills:
Experience with Azure AI Search, Azure Doc Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, AWS Textract, AWS Open Search, AWS Bedrock.
Familiarity with LLM backed agent frameworks such as Autogen, Langchain, Langgraph Semantic Kernel, etc.
Experience in chatbot design, frontend and development.
Certification of cloud or Genai
Designed and implemented enterprise-grade GenAI solutions using Databricks Mosaic AI, enabling scalable LLM deployment and governance.
Built Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using Mosaic AI Vector Search and Foundation Models for domain-specific knowledge querying.
Fine-tuned and deployed LLMs using Mosaic AI Model Serving, optimizing inference latency and cost.

Strong background in the Healthcare domain, with deep understanding of Payer operations and working knowledge of Provider ecosystems.
Experience in consulting engagements, including direct interaction with client stakeholders and managing client relationships.
Demonstrated leadership experience managing and mentoring teams of 510 members.

Description:
Project Role : Custom Software Engineer

Project Role Description : Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.

Must have skills :Automotive ECU Software

Good to have skills:NA
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification:15 years full time education

Summary:
Lead systems engineering for production-oriented tire intelligence solutions delivered to global OEM and Tier-1 customers. Translate customer and product needs into complete, traceable system requirements and architectures coordinate embedded software, algorithms, sensors, gateways, cloud interfaces, functional safety, cybersecurity, integration, and validation from concept through vehicle launch and field support.

Roles & Responsibilities:


Own end-to-end systems engineering for OEM tire intelligence applications, including system context, use cases, operating scenarios, interfaces, performance targets, diagnostics, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
Elicit, analyze, and negotiate OEM requirements perform gap and impact analysis establish bidirectional traceability across customer, system, software, hardware, algorithm, safety, cybersecurity, and test work products.
Develop and maintain system architecture and interface definitions across tire-mounted sensors, vehicle networks, ECUs/TCUs, receivers/gateways, embedded algorithms, cloud services, and customer applications.
Convert tire intelligence functions such as tire health, pressure/load estimation, leak detection, road or friction insights, and aquaplaning-related features into implementable and verifiable system specifications.
Lead technical reviews with OEMs, Tier-1s, suppliers, and global engineering teams drive decisions, interface alignment, risk closure, and resolution of system-level issues.
Plan and support integration and verification through model-, software-, processor-, hardware-in-the-loop, bench, vehicle, and fleet testing ensure requirements-based coverage and evidence.
Apply Automotive SPICE and systems V-model practices, including change control, baselining, configuration management, design reviews, defect management, and release readiness.
Integrate functional safety and cybersecurity needs in coordination with specialists, supporting ISO 26262 and ISO/SAE 21434 work products, safety/security analyses, technical concepts, and customer evidence.
Support production launch and lifecycle activities, including calibration/interface changes, root-cause analysis, field issue resolution, technical documentation, and lessons learned for reusable platforms.
Mentor engineers and strengthen India-based systems capability through structured reviews, knowledge transfer, and consistent global engineering practices.
SUCCESS PROFILE :Systems thinker who combines technical depth, disciplined execution, customer orientation, and pragmatic decision-making in a global matrix environment.

Professional & Technical Skills:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Systems, Electrical, Electronics, Computer, Automotive, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
7-10 years of automotive/embedded product-development experience, including 4+ years in systems or requirements engineering for OEM or Tier-1 programs.
Hands-on experience with requirements engineering, architecture, interface management, integration, verification, and customer technical reviews.
Working knowledge of Automotive SPICE, ISO 26262, ISO/SAE 21434, and production software/hardware release processes.
Proficiency with Polarion, DOORS, or equivalent familiarity with SysML/UML modeling and tools such as Enterprise Architect or Cameo.
Knowledge of CAN/CAN FD, J1939, UDS/OBD-II, Ethernet, BLE/RF, sensor interfaces, telematics, and embedded/cloud connectivity.
Ability to interpret MATLAB/Simulink models and analyze data using MATLAB or Python experience with Vector and/or dSPACE environments is preferred.
Strong technical writing, analytical problem-solving, and communication skills able to collaborate across India, Europe, Asia, and North America.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Tire/vehicle dynamics, TPMS or tire-mounted sensing, signal processing, estimation algorithms, gateways/TCUs, or connected-vehicle platforms.
OEM production programs from concept and RFQ through SOP, including HIL/vehicle validation, calibration, and issue management.
AUTOSAR, embedded C/C++, model-based development, cloud/IoT architectures, CI/CD, and test automation.

Additional Information:

- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Automotive ECU Software.
- This position is based at Bangalore /Hyderabad facility
- A 15 years full time education is required.

Location: Bangalore, India
The Linear Power team is looking for bright engineers to drive our next generation of cutting-edge power products across Automotive, Industrial, Data Center, and Personal Electronics markets. Debug device and setup-related issues and drive the issue to closure independently
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Design, DV and Test) and contribute to device success.

8+ years experience in analog validation.
Good basic analog, power and mixed-signal fundamentals
Good understanding of semiconductor device fundamentals
Good knowledge of test and measurement equipment
Python based automation
Experience with power circuits is an add-on.
Hands-on PCB Design knowledge
Bachelors / Masters in Electrical / Electronic Engineering
Interest to own EE based validation of a team.

Ability to function independently

Amazon Connect Solution Architect | 8 to 15 yrs

Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Amazon Connect Professional with 8-15 years of overall IT experience and strong expertise in cloud-based contact center solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Amazon Connect solutions, IVR platforms, and customer engagement applications.

Roles & Responsibilities
Design and implement end-to-end contact center solutions using Amazon Connect.
Develop and configure IVR flows, call routing strategies, queues, and customer engagement workflows.
Integrate Amazon Connect with AWS services, CRM platforms, APIs, and enterprise applications.
Lead migration and modernization initiatives from legacy contact center platforms to Amazon Connect.
Work closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Optimize contact center performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide technical guidance to development and support teams.
Mentor junior team members and drive best practices in contact center architecture.
Technical Requirements
8-15 years of IT experience with at least 8+ years of hands-on Amazon Connect experience.
Strong expertise in Amazon Connect, Contact Flows, Lex Bots, and IVR Concepts.
Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, SNS, and Kinesis.
Knowledge of contact center technologies including ACD, CTI, IVR, Routing Strategies, Workforce Optimization, and Omnichannel Support.
Experience integrating Amazon Connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, Zendesk, or Microsoft Dynamics.
Proficiency in REST APIs, web services, and cloud integrations.
Understanding of contact center reporting, analytics, and monitoring solutions.
AWS certifications are desirable.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. Production Support & Incident Management

Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support

Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.

CAD & Integration Support

Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.
Workflow & System Administration Support

Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Minimum 4+ years of experience implementing and managing IAM solutions.
2. Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience implementing and supporting the Saviynt Enterprise Identity Cloud (EIC) platform in enterprise environments.
3. Design, configure, and deploy Saviynt EIC solutions tailored to client-specific identity governance and compliance requirements.
4. Experience onboarding applications using Saviynt's out-of-the-box connectors, including Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, Workday, Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, and Oracle DB.
5. Experience with REST APIs, SCIM, and JIT provisioning for real-time identity orchestration.
6. Hands-on scripting using Groovy, JavaScript, and SQL within Saviynt.
7. Knowledge of Saviynt's Risk-Based Access, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policies, and Compliance Campaigns.
8. Understanding of Saviynt's Delegation Framework, Workflow Engine, and Custom Attributes Mapping.
9. Experience integrating Saviynt with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow and cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, and GCP.
10. Saviynt Certified Professional (SCP) or Saviynt Certified Advanced Professional (SCAP) certification is highly desirable.

Job Title: SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant

Location: Bangalore / Pune / Mumbai / Gandhinagar
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and passionate SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant to join our growing SAP practice. As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant at Capgemini, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate business processes and enhance operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, business users, and technical teams to deliver innovative workflow-based solutions across SAP landscapes.
As an SAP ABAP Workflow Consultant, you will:
Design, develop, and implement SAP Business Workflow solutions to automate end-to-end business processes.
Configure and develop workflow components including Tasks, Standard Tasks, Workflows, Events, Methods, Rule Resolution, and Agents.
Create and enhance Business Objects (BOR) and ABAP OO-based workflow objects.
Develop custom workflow functionalities using ABAP programming techniques, User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancements, and Function Modules.
Configure event management and workflow triggering mechanisms using change documents, business transactions, and custom events.
Develop and troubleshoot workflow notifications, work items, inbox configurations, and approval processes.
Integrate workflows with SAP modules such as MM, SD, FI, CO, HCM, and SRM based on business requirements.
Perform workflow administration activities including monitoring, debugging, error handling, and performance optimization.
Work with functional consultants and stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical workflow solutions.
Ensure adherence to SAP development standards, best practices, and quality processes throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP Workflow Development.
Expertise in SAP Business Workflow configuration and development.
Experience with BOR (Business Object Repository) and ABAP OO Workflow.
Good knowledge of Workflow Administration, Event Management, Agent Determination, and Rule Resolution.
Strong ABAP development skills including Reports, Enhancements, BAdIs, User Exits, Function Modules, and Object-Oriented ABAP.
Experience in workflow debugging, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA workflow framework will be an added advantage.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.Role & responsibilities

About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Role
National Strategic Accounts Manager
Job Level/ Designation
M2/AGM
Function / Department
Enterprise/Strategic Accounts
Location
Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore
Job Purpose

The Client Manager is responsible to understand the business and most important be a bearer of relationship with Enterprise Customer, with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for the assigned Enterprise Customers. End to end operational excellence for the entire customer life cycle journey from opportunity to closure. The role of Client Manager is to focus on incremental product wise Revenue Market Share from those assigned accounts.
Key Result Areas/Accountabilities
Single & Most important bearer of Relationship with Enterprise Customer with Ownership of Entire Customer Life Cycle for all assigned Enterprise Customers.
Responsible for the incremental revenue growth on all product lines.
Farming - Protecting the Existing Revenue Stream from Competition & Downward Tariff Revision
Seeding New Products & Services - Cross Selling & Up selling - to enhance overall revenue
Business planning & Accurate Forecasting on Revenue, Order booking, Gross Addition, Gross Net, Net Addition, Churn, Billing, Collection & Bad debts.
Coordination with Cross Functional team to ensure sync in terms of tariff offering, other circle acquisitions, Order fulfilment, Issues Resolution & various other day to day activities
Monitor the service delivery and service assurance aspects are in line with agreed SLA / MSA
Facilitating Collections Team to ensure timely payments and reduction in bad debts
Manages detailed Account Dossier, Accont plans , Heat Map and update periodically.
Adhere and comply to all processes and systems of VIL & VIBS
Collaborative aproach within the team and organisation
Account Engagement and Account Mapping across multi levels /verticals
End to end operational responsibility leading to CXX
Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience
Competencies
Experience in managing global and a track record of global accounts/ enterprise solution selling
Experience in complex change management and operating in a matrix, fast moving and technical environment.
Experience in working in multi-cultural environment ability to manage an international and distributed team.
Team player, strong influence and relationship management skills, customer centric.
Strong communication and decision making skills– ability to balance conflicting interests and ability to lead in a high-growth, high-uncertainty environments
Learning
To learn new products and services so as to be updated with the Customer needs and market trends
Apply the learning in own Customer scenario
Must have technical/ professional qualifications
Experience handling Strategic Accounts and C-level engagement
Education: MBA and Engineering background preferred
5+ years of experience
Should have preferably worked with Telecom, Technology Companies

We are looking for an experienced SAP CAR Consultant with expertise in SAP Customer Activity Repository (CAR), CAR Planning, and UDF (Unified Demand Forecast) solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.

Total Exp - 6yrs to 20yrs
Location - Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Gandhinagar
Mandatory Skill set - SAP CAR , UDF,Implementation


Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting
Forecasting & Replenishment
Design and configure forecasting models using SAP UDF.
Support demand planning, inventory planning, and replenishment optimization processes.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, promotions, and forecast accuracy.
Develop forecast strategies to improve inventory availability and reduce stock-outs.
Integration
Integrate SAP CAR with:
SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications
Support master data and transactional data integration.
Business & Functional Activities
Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.
Prepare functional specifications and work with technical teams for developments.
Perform SIT, UAT, and production deployment activities.
Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions

Mentor junior consultants and provide functional expertise during project execution.
Work directly with client leadership, plant maintenance teams, operations teams, and external stakeholders in a customer-facing consulting role.

Strong hands-on expertise in SAP PM configuration and business process design.
Experience working on SAP S/4HANA PM implementations, migrations, or transformation projects.
Good understanding of Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) and maintenance management best practices.

Strong integration knowledge with SAP MM, QM, PP, PS, and FICO modules.

Experience: 14 - 24 Years
Location: Pune, Mumbai, Noida, Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced GenAI Lead / Agentic AI Architect with 14+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, NLP, Generative AI and enterprise solution architecture.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in designing and developing enterprise-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using Azure and/or AWS ecosystems. The role involves architecting scalable AI solutions, designing multi-agent systems, implementing advanced RAG architectures, developing Python-based applications, and providing technical leadership to engineering teams.
The candidate should be capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure and production-ready AI architectures while guiding customers and stakeholders on GenAI transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
1. GenAI & Agentic AI Architecture
Architect and design end-to-end Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for enterprise applications.
Design and implement multi-agent systems supporting planning, reasoning, memory management, tool invocation and complex workflow orchestration.
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP and other agent orchestration frameworks.
Design and develop advanced RAG architectures, including:
Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
Knowledge Graph RAG
RAG Fusion
Context Augmented Generation (CAG)
Multi-agent RAG and context enrichment pipelines.
Evaluate and select appropriate commercial and open-source LLMs, SLMs and VLMs based on business requirements.

2. Cloud AI Platforms Azure / AWS
Experience with at least one major cloud ecosystem is mandatory.
Microsoft Azure:
Azure OpenAI Service
Azure AI Foundry
Azure AI Agents / Agent Service
Microsoft Agent Framework
Azure Machine Learning
Azure AI Search / Cognitive Search
Cosmos DB, Redis, pgvector
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Functions
Azure DevOps, Azure Monitor, Application Insights
Amazon Web Services (AWS):
Amazon Bedrock
AWS AgentCore
Strands SDK / Multi-Agent Framework
Agents for Amazon Bedrock
Knowledge Bases and Guardrails for Bedrock
Amazon SageMaker
Amazon OpenSearch Serverless
AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS
ECS / EKS, DynamoDB, API Gateway
CloudWatch and AWS X-Ray

3. Python Development & Application Engineering
Strong hands-on Python programming experience is mandatory.
Develop Python-based microservices and GenAI applications using FastAPI / Django.
Build LLM-powered applications, agent orchestration workflows, embeddings pipelines and tool integrations.
Develop reusable components, frameworks and accelerators.
Establish coding standards, review code and mentor development teams.

4. RAG, LLMOps & Data Engineering
Design enterprise-grade RAG pipelines for structured and unstructured data across multiple file formats and data lakes.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, vector indexing and hybrid search.
Implement LLMOps/MLOps pipelines, model evaluation, fine-tuning and deployment workflows.
Experience with CI/CD, Kubernetes, serverless deployments and cloud-native architectures.
Implement observability, monitoring, logging, performance optimization and cost governance.

5. Security, Governance & Responsible AI
Design and implement LLM guardrails, prompt security and content filtering.
Establish agent governance, responsible AI practices and secure model invocation.
Experience with private endpoints, IAM/RBAC, cloud security and enterprise compliance.
Conduct architecture reviews, threat modelling and performance benchmarking.

6. Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Lead architecture discussions, solution design and technical assessments with customers.
Translate business requirements into scalable GenAI solutions.
Mentor developers and engineering teams on GenAI, Agentic AI, Python and cloud technologies.
Define architecture blueprints, reusable frameworks and engineering best practices.
Support pre-sales, PoCs, technical demonstrations and enterprise GenAI transformation initiatives.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications
14+ years of overall experience in Data Science, AI/ML, NLP and software engineering, with substantial hands-on experience in Generative AI and Agentic AI.
Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLMs, NLP and enterprise AI architecture.
Expertise in Agentic AI frameworks LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP or equivalent.
Strong experience designing and implementing RAG-based solutions and multi-agent architectures.
Experience with commercial and open-source LLMs, including Azure OpenAI and/or AWS Bedrock.
Strong hands-on Python programming experience.
Experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud ecosystems.
Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search and hybrid retrieval.
Strong understanding of prompt engineering, LLM evaluation and guardrails.
Experience in Kubernetes, microservices, serverless deployment and observability.
Excellent architecture, technical leadership and customer-facing communication skills.

Company
Qualcomm India Private Limited
Job Area
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering
Job Summary
Qualcomm graphics is the best in the mobile GPU world with the best perf/watt, perf/area and in raw performance. The GPU team has well established RnD teams from Architecture and Design to Post Silicon Validation and Functional Debug in Bangalore. The team delivers on products from the Snapdragon 800 series to the low tier 200 series. You will be joining a successful engineering department whose deliveries can be found in billions of smartphones, wearables.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
OR PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.
Experience
3 Years
Eligibility
Fresh graduates and early-career engineers from
Education
B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, ECE, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related disciplines
Role Overview
Qualcomm's GPU team is looking for highly motivated fresh graduates and early-career engineers interested in next-generation GPU, AI/ML, computer architecture, and high-performance computing technologies.
You will work alongside architecture, design, software, and validation teams on performance analysis, system-level debugging, research, automation, and development of future computing platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Work on next-generation GPU and compute architectures.
Contribute to architecture analysis, performance studies, validation, and debugging.
Investigate complex hardware/software and system-level issues and perform root-cause analysis.
Develop tools, automation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.
Collaborate with architecture, design, software, and validation teams.
Research and prototype innovative solutions for future GPU and computing platforms.
Required Skills
Strong fundamentals in Computer Architecture and Computer Organization.
Good understanding of Operating Systems and Memory Systems.
Strong programming skills in C/C++.
Good knowledge of Data Structures and Algorithms.
Basic understanding of AI/ML concepts.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to quickly understand complex hardware/software systems.
Good to Have
Exposure to GPU Architecture and Parallel Computing.
Knowledge of CUDA, OpenCL, or SYCL.
Understanding of High-Performance Computing (HPC), accelerators, or heterogeneous computing.
Academic/research projects involving Computer Architecture, GPU, AI/ML, Systems, or HPC.
Research publications, patents, open-source contributions, or strong technical projects are an advantage.
Candidate Profile
We are particularly interested in candidates with:
Strong academic and technical fundamentals.
Genuine interest in GPU, AI, and emerging computing architectures.
Research aptitude and strong problem-solving skills.
Relevant academic projects, internships, publications, or technical contributions.
Freshers from Tier 1 and Tier 2 institutes with strong fundamentals and relevant academic/project exposure are encouraged to apply.
Key Screening Areas
Must Have: Computer Architecture + C/C++ + strong problem-solving + good academic/project background.
Added Advantage: GPU Architecture, CUDA/OpenCL/SYCL, AI/ML, HPC, publications, or significant research projects.
Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law.
If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers.

Job Title: Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore / Mumbai / Pune
Department: Customer & Retail Analytics
Employment Type: Full-time
About FedEx: FedEx provides customers and businesses worldwide with a broad portfolio of transportation, e-commerce, and business services and also serves our customers through our retail presence. We foster an environment of growth and learning, where innovative ideas are encouraged, and diverse teams are valued for their contributions. As part of our commitment to excellence, were seeking a highly skilled Data Analyst to join our analytics team.
Job Summary: As a Data Analyst, you will play a key role in gathering, processing, and analyzing data to drive informed decision-making and actionable insights for FedEx. Your quantitative expertise and business acumen will help develop analytical solutions to improve operations, customer experience, and business outcomes. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to develop meaningful data analysis, insights summarizations/ visualizations and communicate findings that guide strategy and operational decisions.
Key Responsibilities:
Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets using Python and SQL to support business objectives.
Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, formulate analytic solutions, and provide actionable insights.
Develop and maintain data models and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics.
Create meaningful data visualizations to communicate findings, trends, and actionable insights to non-technical stakeholders.
Conduct exploratory data analysis and identify patterns, trends, and opportunities for business improvement.
Support data quality initiatives, ensuring accuracy and consistency across data sources.
Utilize statistical and quantitative techniques to support problem-solving and business optimization efforts.
Mandatory Skills:
Python: Proficiency in data manipulation, data analysis libraries (Pandas, NumPy), and data visualization libraries (Matplotlib, Seaborn).
SQL: Strong command of SQL for data extraction, transformation, and complex queries.
Business Acumen: Ability to understand business context and objectives, aligning analytics with organizational goals.
Quantitative Aptitude: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
Data Visualization: Basic skills in data visualization to effectively communicate insights.
Statistical Analysis: Foundational understanding of statistical methods (e.g., regression, hypothesis testing).
Communication Skills: Ability to distill complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
Good-to-Have Skills:
Power BI: Experience with Power BI for data visualization and report development.
Machine Learning Fundamentals: Basic knowledge of machine learning concepts for deeper pattern analysis.
Advanced Excel: Skills in advanced Excel functions, pivot tables, and data cleaning for quick analyses.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
3+ years of experience in data analysis, preferably within the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills and a collaborative mindset.
Join Our Team: If you are passionate about Data analytics to drive business impact and enhance the customer experience, we invite you to join our team at FedEx. Apply now to be part of a dynamic, innovative environment where your skills and expertise will make a difference.
Application Process: To apply for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications. Qualified candidates will be contacted for further evaluation.

Company Description
We are a technology-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent thats bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com Looking to jump-start your career? We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast-track career where you can grow along with Indegenes high-speed growth. We are purpose-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision-making, and industrious in the way we work.
We are a rapidly growing global organization and are scouting for the best talent for this phase of growth. With us, you are at the intersection of two of the most exciting industries of healthcare and technology. We offer global opportunities with fast-track careers while you work with a team that is fueled by purpose. The combination of this will lead to a truly differentiated experience for you.
If this excites you, then apply below.
Who are you?
We are looking for a talented professional with Dutch and English copywriting skills focused on the Medical Industry, who can work on developing copy content for brand deliverables. This role would complement the design team, while working for our client in the pharmaceutical industry.
The focus of the role will be to create promotional communication content. You should be recognized as a brand expert with an ability to translate the science and data into compelling promotional copy complying with medical, regulatory, legal and compliance guidelines. The aim is to make the complex simple’ adapting larger pieces of content to create smaller, easy-to-read materials for digital and non-digital channels, maintaining key medical messaging and being able to anchor medical literature references.
Creativity, innovative thinking, and problem-solving should be at the heart of all you do.
Job Description:
The role and responsibilities of the Medical Copywriter includes the following:
The main focus is to develop and update content for various commercial assets, with an additional focus upon omnichannel implementation on digital channels (including but not limited to banner ads, emails, sales rep materials such as i-detail, social media posts/content and websites) – as well as printed material (including but not limited to posters, slide kits, patient guidelines, sales content, leaflets and conference materials).
The role works within medical, regulatory, and legal guidelines to ensure compliance with legislation and regulations in the Netherlands, including the client's internal policies. It also ensures that all content is supported by authentic, current, and up-to-date references. A working understanding of the CGR Code (Code Geneesmiddelenreclame) and the Dutch Medicines Act is required.
There may be occasional opportunities to be involved in creative projects involving ideation and moving image for campaign level activity.
Working in partnership with a graphic design team (on the needs for copy and content), with the brand and production teams on briefs, workshops and project deliveries.
Ensuring compliance to local legislation and regulations including client internal policies, ensuring that content development & activities are supported by authentic and up-to-date references.
Follow best practices in the department regarding processes, communication (internal and external), project management, documentation and technical requirements such as language, grammar, stylization, content search, summarizing, data conflicts, and referencing
Adherence to the highest editorial standards is expected while creating copy drafts
Participating in assigned training programs and working on assignments as per requirement.
Participating in client calls as per project requirements
Use of, overseeing and harnessing the advantages of AI tools in providing accurate and relevant copy content.
Being compliant to quality, confidentiality, and security; adhering to and following quality systems, processes, and policies; and being compliant to training and specifications.
Ideal Profile:
Education— related healthcare Degree/Masters or equivalent qualification preferable
Minimum of 3+ years of experience, including an in-house creative or agency role working with Pharma sector clients
Awareness of local and country/region specific regulatory requirements
Familiarity with / intermediate understanding of, the fields of medicine and good to have respiratory & immunology, cardiovascular, renal & metabolic, oncology therapy areas
Be open to developing such knowledge, outlined immediately above, further working with relevant Medical teams
Strong flair, skills and passion for writing with conceptual ability and a solid knowledge of the digital landscape
Strong written and verbal communication/presentation skills
To have had relevant experience and being skilled in SEO copywriting, pairing best practices that drive traffic (keyword research), with compelling copy, encouraging a desired action, is a distinct advantage.
Passion for networking and stakeholder engagement.
Being up to date with the latest technical/scientific developments and relating them to various projects
Client-oriented attitude with focus on creating strong long-term relationships with clients and encouraging others to work toward this goal
Ability to assure timely completion of assignments
Skilled in problem identification and problem solving
Detail oriented, well organized and timeline driven with the ability to multitask.
Experience working within a large multi-national company in a matrix corporate environment preferable.
Should have both strong written and verbal communication skills in native Dutch language and good business English language skills.
Qualifications
(Lifescience BSC/ MS/ MSC) + MBA

Experience: 5 to 9 years
Notice Period - Immediate to 30 Days

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity:

Were looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles

Your key responsibilities:

Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement teams expectations
Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key engagement team counterparts, such as Assurance executives based in Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure that these are embedded into the engagement teams work.
Work closely with the engagement team to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance while maintaining the highest levels of quality of service.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the engagement teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for ones team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and engagement teams.
Establish expectations regarding value to be delivered to the respective aligned GDS or engagement teams.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS Assurance.
Standardize assurance processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Help team members grow by encouraging them to actively contribute to the team.
Lead by example, delegate work successfully and develop and maintain high performing teams.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback and training.
Use technology and tools to continually learn, share knowledge with team members, and enhance service delivery.
Contribute to technical and soft-skills training to continually develop the team’s skills.
Actively participate in organizational initiatives, such as recruitment, diversity and inclusiveness, trainings, and others.

Skills and attributes for success:

Expert knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards
Knowledge of UK GAAP or US GAAP and International assurance standards is an added advantage.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.

Job Title: Senior Java Developer
Experience: 7-12 Years
Location: Pune / Mumbai / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Senior Java Developer with 7-12 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and implementing enterprise-grade applications using Java and related technologies. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices architecture, REST APIs, cloud technologies, and modern software development practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and high-performance enterprise applications.
Build and maintain Microservices-based applications using Java and Spring Boot.
Develop RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external systems.
Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Implement security, logging, monitoring, and observability best practices.
Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Architects, QA teams, and DevOps engineers.
Perform code reviews and mentor junior developers.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide timely resolutions.
Follow Agile/Scrum methodologies and participate in sprint planning, estimations, and retrospectives.
Required Technical Skills
Strong experience in Java 8/11/17
Expertise in Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA
Hands-on experience with Microservices Architecture
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, SOAP Web Services
Experience with Hibernate/JPA
Proficiency in SQL databases such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server
Experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB/Cassandra preferred)
Knowledge of Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or JMS Messaging
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
Strong understanding of Git, Maven, Gradle
Experience with AWS/Azure/GCP Cloud Platforms
Knowledge of Design Patterns, SOLID Principles, and Clean Code practices
Familiarity with SonarQube, Nexus/Artifactory, and Code Quality tools
Preferred Skills
Experience with Event-Driven Architecture
Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
Experience with Monitoring tools (Splunk, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus)
Knowledge of OAuth2, JWT, SAML, and Identity Management
Certification in AWS, Azure, or Java technologies is a plus
Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
7-12 years of experience in Java application development.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Nice to Have
Experience in Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Telecom, Retail, or Healthcare domains.
Experience leading technical teams or serving as a Technical Lead.
Cloud-native application development experience.

The position interfaces with International Team Members of BNP Group and its Clients or Vendors or Sub-Custodians

The candidate should be able to read, write and speak in French language

Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. Overview
Our team within the Canada Business is dedicated to delivering cutting-edge engineering solutions for water infrastructure projects. We specialize in designing and managing complex systems that ensure sustainable water supply, treatment, and distribution. Our focus is on creating resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible solutions that support communities and industries worldwide.
We leverage Building Information Modelling (BIM) to enhance collaboration, improve design accuracy, and optimize project delivery across the entire lifecyclefrom concept and planning through construction and operation. BIM enables us to integrate civil, structural, and mechanical elements seamlessly, ensuring cost efficiency and reducing risks.
Atkins Global Technology Centre (GTC) is seeking a Civil 3D Designer to join our Water BIM team. This role will be based at our Bangalore & Gurugram office, contributing to world-class projects by creating detailed 3D models, coordinating multidisciplinary designs, and ensuring compliance with international standards.

Your Role
Roles & Responsibilities
Excellent in 3D Modelling of Pipe networks (Dry and Wet), Grading, Corridors, Cut and Fill using Civil 3D.
Excellent in Multidisciplinary 3D model coordination using Navisworks
Check model for Stage Completeness, Dimensional accuracy against modelling standards.
Ensure Level of Quality control for Completeness and adherence to company standards of all Drawings produced.
Stay informed the best practices & methodologies in BIM implementation.
Able to perform and coordinate on multi-disciplinary projects and effective implementation of BEP and BIM workflows.
Ability to determine appropriate record/As-built, test pit, drawings and point cloud data.
Identify and solve drawing/ modelling problems and troubleshooting Civil 3D issues.
Identify new logical ideas for automation to improve efficiency.
In depth knowledge of engineering drawings and specifications. Ability to work using engineers calculations and design in producing drawings / 3D modelling.
Ensures accuracy and adapts a detail-conscious approach; carefully checks details at each stage to avoid errors.
Ensure timely planning and delivery by proactively managing assumptions, dependencies, and risk.
Follow GTC BMS processes to projects
Use of Vehicle tracking

Autodesk Civil 3D
AutoCAD
Navisworks
MicroStation, ORD (Preferred )
ProjectWise / Forma
Microsoft Office (Excel, Word)

Required Skills & Competencies
Strong understanding of: Civil engineering drawings and construction methods
Ability to work with Survey data, point clouds
Good communication and coordination skills
Attention to detail and quality-focused approach
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

MBA from a tier 1 institute

Role & responsibilities
We are seeking a Network Implementation Engineer to perform the staging, configuration, migration, and cutover of enterprise and data center network environments. This role is responsible for turning Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and High-Level Designs (HLDs) into production reality across Cisco routing, switching, wireless, and security ecosystems. The ideal candidate has deep Cisco CLI expertise, hands-on experience executing maintenance windows, and familiarity with Cisco's controller-led architectures (Catalyst Center).
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Implement and configure Router and Switches in enterprise environment.
Replacement and migration of EOL router and Switches in enterprise setup.
Understating and experience on ACL and Qos configuration.
Bootstrap and apply golden configurations across Cisco Catalyst (9200/9300/9400/9500/9600) and ASR/ISR/Catalyst 8000,4300,1100 series routers.
Provision Cisco Catalyst Wireless infrastructure, including 9800,5520,8500 Series Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 Access Points (APs).
Onboard devices into Cisco Catalyst Center (formerly DNA Spaces/DNAC) for automated template deployment.
Lead scheduled, off-hours maintenance windows to perform core/distribution cutovers, legacy hardware decommissioning, and software upgrades (IOS-XE / NX-OS).
Run post-cutover operational verification: ARP/MAC table validation, OSPF/BGP neighbor adjacency checks, STP root bridge verification, and interface error monitoring.
Implement and configure APs and WLC in enterprise environment.
Perform AP onboarding, provisioning and configuration on WLC.
Configure SSID, WLAN, Vlan Mapping and Wireless authentication policies.
Configure AP groups, RF profile, Power Settings, Mobility and roaming parameters.
Perform WLC Software upgrade, SSL certificate installation.
The skills Required
Routing- Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in BGP and OSPF.
Knowledge on MPLS will be a advantage.
Switching- Deep understanding on switching concept like STP, HSRP, VRRP, Portchannel, Switch Stacking, VTP.
Wireless- Hands on experience on cisco air OS and catalyst controllers (8500,5520,9800), Access point, RF fundamentals, WLAN fundamentals.
Experience & Certifications
Experience: 6 months of hands-on deployment and migration experience specifically within production networks.
Education Graduate from any stream (Engineering graduates preferred) or equivalent practical field experience.
Certifications (Required or Strongly Preferred):
Cisco CCNA (minimum prerequisite if accompanied by deep field experience),CCNP preferred.
Cisco CCNA Wireless is a strong plus.
Participation in off-hours change windows (nights and weekends) to minimize operational disruption.


Location Pune /Noida/Chennai/Bangalore
Shift – 24*7
Work Mode – Work from office
Looking for immediate joiners

Title: Key Account Manager | Enterprise & Growth Portfolio

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks & financial instruments. To further enhance merchant & business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
PPSL enables thousands of online merchants to offer world class frictionless payment experience to their customers. We are present across large enterprises and startups including well known unicorns alike. We strive to take payments beyond an enabler and an instrument to drive revenue and user growth for our merchants. Online Payment Gateway is Paytm's B2B Business regulated by RBI as it allows only authorized entities to conduct PA PG (Payment Aggregator Payment Gateway) business. This team is responsible for growing the penetration of Paytm Payment PG business in the Indian merchants.

About the role:
We are looking for a highly driven Enterprise Sales professional with a strong hunting mindset to acquire and onboard new enterprise merchants for Paytm Payment Gateway. This is primarily a new business acquisition role focused on identifying, engaging and closing enterprise opportunities. While account nurturing forms part of the role, the primary expectation is consistent new merchant acquisition, revenue generation and market expansion.

Expectations/ Requirements:
Drive new enterprise merchant acquisition by identifying, prospecting and closing strategic accounts.
Own the complete sales lifecycle from lead generation, hunting, solutioning, commercial discussions and merchant onboarding.
Generate new business opportunities through self-sourcing, networking, referrals and market intelligence.
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of enterprise prospects to consistently achieve acquisition targets.
Engage CXOs and decision makers to understand business needs and position Paytm Payment Gateway solutions.
Manage relationships with newly acquired merchants during onboarding and activation.
Drive upsell and cross-sell of UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI and other payment solutions.
Partner with Product, Technology, Operations and Integration teams for successful merchant onboarding.
Monitor GMV, transaction trends and revenue growth across acquired merchants.
Negotiate commercials and contracts while ensuring timely closures.
Track competition, market trends and white-space opportunities.
Deliver monthly and quarterly acquisition, activation, GMV and revenue targets.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree (MBA preferred).
5+ years of Enterprise Sales, New Business Development, Merchant Acquisition or Strategic Sales experience in Payments, FinTech or BFSI.
Proven track record of enterprise hunting and achieving acquisition targets.
Excellent stakeholder management, consultative selling, negotiation and presentation skills.
Understanding of Payment Gateway, Merchant Acquiring, UPI, Cards and Digital Payments ecosystem.

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
Strong hunter mindset with passion for acquiring new enterprise merchants.
Comfortable with outbound prospecting and CXO engagement.
Experience in enterprise payments/fintech preferred.
Candidates seeking predominantly account management/farming roles may not find this role aligned.

Location - Noida, Mumbai or Bangalore

Why join us:
We give immense opportunities to make a difference and have a great time doing that. You are challenged and encouraged here to do meaningful work for yourself and customers/clients. We are successful, and our successes are rooted in our people's collective energy and unwavering focus on the customer, and that's how it will always be.

Compensation:
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you. With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants and we are committed to it. India's largest digital lending story is brewing here. It's your opportunity to be a part of the story!
