Description:
what does a Learning Experience Leader really do? Think of yourself as the someone who will
create and maintain a positive and professional learning environment, so not just anyone is
qualified for this role! We make sure we get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good
company so we make sure our employees are top notch. Now we need your full concentration because
its time to imagine what it’s like being a Learning Experience Leader.
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: that you will be designing and
expanding training and development programs. As you tackle your new tasks for the day, you know
that it comes down to one thing: that you will ensure that Foundation Skills Training is aligned with
Product Specific Training methodologies and initiatives.
TaskUs believes in being transparent with our new employees about their job duties and the possible
impact. Some of our campaigns include disturbing content. Examples of these types of material may
include but are not limited to:
Child exploitation and abuse
Animal torture
Gang Violence
Murder
Hate Speech
As a trainer of content moderators it is important for you to know the potential risks related to this
type of work. While TaskUs is focused on employee wellness by having counselors on-site, resiliency
programming, and other wellness initiatives, exposure to graphic and disturbing content is
unavoidable. Some individuals with a sensitivity to viewing graphic or disturbing content may be at risk
for developing distress, mental health symptoms, or, in rare instances, Secondary Traumatic Stress
based on the content they are viewing.
TaskUs reserves the right to reassign trainers in content moderation to other TaskUs projects based on
staffing needs, employee performance, and other considerations.
In order to help create a community that is safe for all employees, the Resiliency and Wellness Team
takes an active role in the primary prevention of mental health concerns through direct practice efforts,
e-learning, skills training, and outreach efforts to the TaskUs community. Our programs seek to raise
awareness about psychological issues, challenge ideas that contribute to social inequity,
disempowerment, and discrimination, as well as the underlying structures that support them. In
addition, our programs empower employees to find and use their voices in a healthy and productive
way.

As a Learning Experience Leader, think of yourself as a leader that sets the standards and expectations
through your conduct, work ethic, integrity and character. You can also think of yourself as a creator in
a way that you must create and deliver end-user, partner, and distributor training which includes
curriculum, training, and exams, for all general preparatory courses prior to enterprise endorsement.
You will also need to deliver preparatory training that is sufficiently technical, covering the basic skill
requirements as identified by enterprise needs. You will also need to be able to deliver projects and
motivate trainees through effective trainings. Think of yourself as a manager in terms of design,
delivery, and you want to always continuously improve the training programs and the other learning
opportunities across the organization. You will also amend and revise programs as necessary, in order
to adapt to the changes occuring in the work environment. You will also act as the content expert and
maintain relevant training documents and training materials for training conducted. You’re also a
developer because you need to create effective induction programs. You will also need to monitor and
review the progress of the trainees through questionnaires and discuss with the managers. You have to
ensure that statutory training requirements are met and you must have an understanding of E-learning
techniques, and where relevant, being involved in the creation and/or delivery of e- learning packages.

Job Title: Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist
Location: Bangalore/Noida
Qualification: Any Graduation
Level: P3-2/P4-1
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM / based on business requirements
Job Summary
The Network Provisioning Escalation & Insights Specialist will provide operational visibility across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Hot Cut and related provisioning activities. The role will focus on data validation, identifying aging orders and operational risks, analyzing trends and ensuring the right issues are escalated to the right teams at the right time.
The role will work across provisioning teams, Operations, internal stakeholders and external carriers/vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor operational data across network provisioning activities.
Validate order, milestone and provisioning information for accuracy and completeness.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, recurring issues and delivery risks.
Analyze operational trends and highlight areas requiring attention.
Identify data discrepancies and work with the responsible team to correct them.
Determine which issues require escalation based on aging, customer impact, due date and operational risk.
Drive the right escalation to the right team at the right time.
Track escalated issues through closure rather than only raising the escalation.
Coordinate with Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations and other internal teams.
Coordinate with carriers/vendors regarding provisioning delays and unresolved dependencies.
Provide clear operational insights and status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
Support root-cause analysis for repeat issues.
Identify process gaps based on data and operational trends.
Recommend improvements to reduce aging, exceptions and repeated escalations.
Support reporting and dashboard automation to improve operational visibility.
Required Skills
Good understanding of telecom/network provisioning.
Experience working with operational data, reports or dashboards.
Strong analytical and data-validation capability.
Ability to identify trends, exceptions and operational risks.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning/order escalations.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies and dependencies.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
Ability to coordinate across multiple teams and vendors.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Confidence to raise risks and communicate issues to stakeholders.
Strong ownership and follow-through.
Good to Have
Experience across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design or Network Provisioning.
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience.
Experience with Granite/XNG or similar telecom systems.
Advanced Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and formulas.
Power BI/dashboard development experience.
SQL knowledge for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience.
Experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.

Description:
Job Description: Disconnect Lead
Operational leadership across Order Entry, Design, ASR/LSR and disconnect execution
Location-Bangalore / Noida

Qualification-Any Graduation (technical field preferred)

Shift / Coverage-6:30 PM-2:30 AM or 10:00 PM-6:00 AM; aligned to U.S. core hours 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST
The Disconnect Lead provides day-to-day operational leadership for customer disconnect activities, including Order Entry, circuit and design validation, inventory removal, Access Service Requests (ASRs), Local Service Requests (LSRs), circuit implementation and disconnect cost optimization. The role oversees automated and manual workflows, manages workload and priorities, ensures milestones and SLAs are achieved, maintains quality and data accuracy, and guides the team through complex issues and fallout.
The role works across Order Entry, Transport, IP, Planning, Order Management, Finance, Implementation Coordinators, Operations, carriers, off-net vendors and automation platforms to ensure disconnect orders are completed cleanly, accurately and within committed timelines.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the disconnect workstream, including Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR/LSR submission, inventory removal and circuit implementation.
Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders, critical due dates and shift coverage; balance urgent restorals, supplements/cancels and production commitments.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT, aging, fallout and delivery performance; take corrective action when performance or committed dates are at risk.
Review and guide disconnect design validation, including disconnect scope, ECCKT, circuit history, CFA/PON details, prior order activity and inventory records.
Ensure ASRs/LSRs comply with ASOG and vendor-specific ordering requirements, using automated workflows and manual fallback processes when required.
Oversee the end-to-end disconnect lifecycle across data, notifications, vendor maintenance, fallout, reports, escalations, documentation and closure.
Drive disconnect cost optimization by working with internal teams to eliminate avoidable or unhealthy vendor costs to Lumen.
Review and troubleshoot complex disconnect, provisioning and automation-workflow issues; determine when escalation or specialist support is required.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, Order Entry, Transport, IP, Operations, Finance, implementation teams, carriers and off-net vendors.
Recognize competing priorities and operational risks early, taking action or escalating before customer or business commitments are affected.
Ensure process adherence, accurate account notes, logs, communications, inventory updates and compliance with company, regulatory and customer requirements.
Coach team members, provide telecom/process/tool guidance, support knowledge transfer and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Identify process gaps, recurring issues and data-integrity risks; drive standard work, quality assurance, process improvement and automation.
Provide clear operational updates to stakeholders and leadership, including status, risks, dependencies, decisions and recovery actions.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning, circuits, carrier provisioning, disconnect workflows and network operations.
Experience creating or managing ASRs/LSRs in a telecom or network-operations environment.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASOG, vendor ordering requirements and/or network implementation.
Ability to interpret circuit designs, ECCKTs, CFA/PON data, order history and disconnect documentation.
Proven experience leading or coordinating an operational team, including workload, priorities, coaching and delivery controls.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging, operational KPI, quality and productivity management.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making; ability to pivot quickly and expedite resolution in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to manage multiple orders, critical deliverables and competing priorities without losing ownership or accuracy.
Strong stakeholder and vendor coordination, with clear written and verbal communication and confidence leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership, adaptability and willingness to learn and improve processes.
Good to Have
Experience supporting customer disconnects, service terminations or disconnect cost optimization.
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Familiarity with FlightDeck automation and manual fallback processes; knowledge of Swift, SAM/Razor, PRIME, PRO/XLR or ASRI.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals, telecom OSS/BSS and Lumen provisioning/disconnect/inventory systems.
Advanced Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.
Performance Measures
Performance Area

Measures
Delivery

SLA/TAT attainment, milestone adherence, aging reduction and due-date performance.
Quality

Order, ASR/LSR, inventory and documentation accuracy; minimal fallout and rework.
Operational Control

Work allocation, backlog/WIP health, risk identification and timely corrective action.
People Leadership

Team readiness, coaching effectiveness, knowledge transfer and capability development.
Continuous Improvement

Process-gap closure, automation adoption and disconnect cost optimization.
Work Environment
Shift-based schedule as noted above; flexibility and extended hours may be required based on business and customer needs.
Frequent interaction with technicians, coordinators, managers, vendors and customer-service teams using Microsoft Teams and email.
Desk-based role requiring sustained concentration, accuracy and review of detailed information across multiple applications.

Job Description
A Change Communications Consultant is responsible for developing and implementing communication strategies that support organizational change initiatives. During periods of change, this role helps keep stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned with organizational goals, ensuring a smooth and successful transition.
Key Responsibilities
Collaborate with change management teams to understand the impact of change initiatives and develop communication strategies that reduce resistance and drive adoption.
Design and tailor communication approaches for different audiences, translating complex concepts into clear, engaging, and impactful messages.
Create and deliver communication materials to support change programs, including presentations, newsletters, email campaigns, and leadership communications.

Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure communication activities are aligned across the organization.
Facilitate communication between leadership, project teams, and employees to maintain transparency and engagement.
Required Skills & Experience
Proven experience in developing and executing communication strategies for organizational change initiatives.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong project management and organizational capabilities.
Experience using communication and collaboration tools/platforms.
Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
Ability to adapt and thrive in dynamic and evolving environments.
Strategic mindset combined with creative problem-solving skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience with PTC Windchill and/or PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems.
Automotive industry experience or strong domain knowledge in the automotive sector.
Background in change management or organizational development initiatives.
Change Management certification such as Prosci or ACMP.
Familiarity with digital communication tools and employee engagement platforms.
Experience working in large, complex, and matrixed organizations.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

Job Description: Disconnect Escalation & Resolution Specialist

Location-Bangalore / Noida


Shift / Coverage-6:30 PM-3:30 AM or 10:00 PM-6:00 AM; coverage aligned to 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST, with on-call/tier support


Job Summary
The Disconnect Escalation & Resolution Specialist owns the end-to-end lifecycle of disconnect escalations and network restorals, including intake, triage, prioritization, escalation to the right team at the right time, coordinated resolution, stakeholder communication and closure. The role combines real-time escalation ownership with data-driven visibility into aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies and recurring issues.
The role protects disconnect production teams from ad-hoc interruption by enforcing a single approved intake path, applying defined engagement criteria and using a tiered support model. The specialist works across provisioning teams, Operations, IP/Transport, internal stakeholders, carriers and vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Coverage and Operating Model
Coverage aligns to Lumen Disconnect core hours of 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST, with after-hours/on-call support based on the approved tier model.
Assignment to the Restoral & Escalation pod is time-bound, with a recommended minimum rotation of 90 days to build proficiency and consistent ownership.
Primary intake is through Salesforce email-to-case/ticketing and approved escalation channels; ad-hoc technician requests are redirected to the approved intake path.
Priority order: (1) restoration of services, (2) supplement/cancel requests, (3) Salesforce tickets and disconnect tasking by priority, and (4) backlog/WIP.
Tiered support: Tier 1 Restoral & Escalation pod, Tier 2 identified SMEs/leads and Tier 3 leadership escalation based on formal thresholds.
Key Responsibilities
Own real-time restoral and Salesforce escalation intake; triage and assign work using defined engagement criteria such as outage/restoral impact, PON/off-net impact, executive escalation, supplements/cancels, aging, customer impact and due date.
Determine the priority, required owner and escalation path; move issues to the right team at the right time when SLA, priority or risk thresholds are met.
Own escalation tickets and associated tasks through resolution and closure, ensuring clear handoffs, actions, owners and time-bound follow-through.
Coordinate restoration and disconnect execution across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations, Transport, IP, SMEs/leads, carriers, LECs and vendors.
Provide proactive stakeholder updates covering status, ETA, dependencies, next action and next update time; prepare executive-ready risk and status reporting.
Monitor operational data and validate order, milestone and disconnect information for accuracy and completeness; identify and correct discrepancies with the responsible team.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, exceptions, repeated follow-ups and delivery risks; prioritize according to service/customer impact and business urgency.
Analyze recurring issues and trends, support root-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions that reduce aging, exceptions and repeat escalations.
Apply guardrails to protect disconnect production teams from unnecessary context switching; engage non-pod technicians only when approved outage/escalation criteria are met.
Document actions, decisions, outcomes and lessons learned; contribute to standard work, operational controls and continuous improvement.
Support reporting, dashboards and automation for escalations, aging, response times, throughput, update cadence and operational trade-offs.
Participate in the Restoral & Escalation rotation, on-call/tier model and outage bridges; mentor others toward steady-state proficiency.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Experience in telecom/network operations, restoration, incident/escalation management or disconnect/provisioning workflows such as Order Entry, Design/ASR or IP/Transport.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning, disconnect or order escalations through closure.
Working knowledge of ticketing/intake processes such as Salesforce and disciplined case-management practices.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies, dependencies and business/customer impact.
Ability to manage multiple time-sensitive workstreams without losing ownership, documentation quality or communication cadence.
Strong analytical and data-validation skills, with the ability to identify trends, exceptions, discrepancies and operational risks.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis capability.
Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams, carriers and vendors and to work effectively within a tiered escalation model.
Strong written and verbal communication, including executive-ready updates and confidence to raise risks and request decisions.
Ability to apply engagement criteria and operating guardrails while balancing production protection with restoration urgency.
Strong ownership and follow-through; comfort working in a rotation/on-call model and supporting outage bridges or major incidents.
Good to Have
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience and knowledge of off-net or multi-vendor disconnect scenarios.
Experience with Granite/XNG, Salesforce or similar telecom provisioning, ticketing and inventory systems.
Advanced Excel capability, including PivotTables, lookups and formulas; Power BI/dashboard development and SQL for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience and experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.
Performance Measures
Performance Area

Measures
Restoration

Mean time to restore and adherence to priority/restoration thresholds.
Escalation Responsiveness

Response time, update cadence compliance and time to engage the correct support tier.
Triage Quality

Correct priority and resource selection, complete intake, minimal rework and effective handoffs.
Operational Health

Aging reduction, backlog/WIP visibility, closure rate and repeat-escalation reduction.
Stakeholder Experience

Clear ownership, fewer repeated follow-ups and useful executive-ready updates.
Sustainability

After-hours load visibility and adherence to rotation/coverage guardrails.
Work Environment
May require participation in on-call/tiered escalation schedules, after-hours support and rapid response during outages.
Frequent coordination through Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, email, outage bridges and operational dashboards.
Role success depends on disciplined intake, accurate documentation, clear ownership, consistent communication and follow-through.

Description:
Escalation & Resolution Specialist
Location-Bangalore / Noida
Shift / Coverage-6:30 PM-3:30 AM or 10:00 PM-6:00 AM; coverage aligned to 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST, with on-call/tier support
Job Summary
The Disconnect Escalation & Resolution Specialist owns the end-to-end lifecycle of disconnect escalations and network restorals, including intake, triage, prioritization, escalation to the right team at the right time, coordinated resolution, stakeholder communication and closure. The role combines real-time escalation ownership with data-driven visibility into aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies and recurring issues.
The role protects disconnect production teams from ad-hoc interruption by enforcing a single approved intake path, applying defined engagement criteria and using a tiered support model. The specialist works across provisioning teams, Operations, IP/Transport, internal stakeholders, carriers and vendors to drive issues through resolution.
Coverage and Operating Model
Coverage aligns to Lumen Disconnect core hours of 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST, with after-hours/on-call support based on the approved tier model.
Assignment to the Restoral & Escalation pod is time-bound, with a recommended minimum rotation of 90 days to build proficiency and consistent ownership.
Primary intake is through Salesforce email-to-case/ticketing and approved escalation channels; ad-hoc technician requests are redirected to the approved intake path.
Priority order: (1) restoration of services, (2) supplement/cancel requests, (3) Salesforce tickets and disconnect tasking by priority, and (4) backlog/WIP.
Tiered support: Tier 1 Restoral & Escalation pod, Tier 2 identified SMEs/leads and Tier 3 leadership escalation based on formal thresholds.
Key Responsibilities
Own real-time restoral and Salesforce escalation intake; triage and assign work using defined engagement criteria such as outage/restoral impact, PON/off-net impact, executive escalation, supplements/cancels, aging, customer impact and due date.
Determine the priority, required owner and escalation path; move issues to the right team at the right time when SLA, priority or risk thresholds are met.
Own escalation tickets and associated tasks through resolution and closure, ensuring clear handoffs, actions, owners and time-bound follow-through.
Coordinate restoration and disconnect execution across Order Entry, ASR, Circuit Design, Provisioning, Operations, Transport, IP, SMEs/leads, carriers, LECs and vendors.
Provide proactive stakeholder updates covering status, ETA, dependencies, next action and next update time; prepare executive-ready risk and status reporting.
Monitor operational data and validate order, milestone and disconnect information for accuracy and completeness; identify and correct discrepancies with the responsible team.
Identify aging orders, missed milestones, jeopardies, exceptions, repeated follow-ups and delivery risks; prioritize according to service/customer impact and business urgency.
Analyze recurring issues and trends, support root-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions that reduce aging, exceptions and repeat escalations.
Apply guardrails to protect disconnect production teams from unnecessary context switching; engage non-pod technicians only when approved outage/escalation criteria are met.
Document actions, decisions, outcomes and lessons learned; contribute to standard work, operational controls and continuous improvement.
Support reporting, dashboards and automation for escalations, aging, response times, throughput, update cadence and operational trade-offs.
Participate in the Restoral & Escalation rotation, on-call/tier model and outage bridges; mentor others toward steady-state proficiency.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Experience in telecom/network operations, restoration, incident/escalation management or disconnect/provisioning workflows such as Order Entry, Design/ASR or IP/Transport.
Experience managing or coordinating provisioning, disconnect or order escalations through closure.
Working knowledge of ticketing/intake processes such as Salesforce and disciplined case-management practices.
Good understanding of aging, due dates, milestones, jeopardies, dependencies and business/customer impact.
Ability to manage multiple time-sensitive workstreams without losing ownership, documentation quality or communication cadence.
Strong analytical and data-validation skills, with the ability to identify trends, exceptions, discrepancies and operational risks.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis capability.
Ability to coordinate across multiple internal teams, carriers and vendors and to work effectively within a tiered escalation model.
Strong written and verbal communication, including executive-ready updates and confidence to raise risks and request decisions.
Ability to apply engagement criteria and operating guardrails while balancing production protection with restoration urgency.
Strong ownership and follow-through; comfort working in a rotation/on-call model and supporting outage bridges or major incidents.
Good to Have
Carrier/LEC/vendor coordination experience and knowledge of off-net or multi-vendor disconnect scenarios.
Experience with Granite/XNG, Salesforce or similar telecom provisioning, ticketing and inventory systems.
Advanced Excel capability, including PivotTables, lookups and formulas; Power BI/dashboard development and SQL for validation and analysis.
Power Automate, VBA or Python experience and experience automating operational reporting or exception identification.
      Performance Measures
Performance Area
Measures
Restoration
Mean time to restore and adherence to priority/restoration thresholds.
Escalation Responsiveness
Response time, update cadence compliance and time to engage the correct support tier.
Triage Quality
Correct priority and resource selection, complete intake, minimal rework and effective handoffs.
Operational Health
Aging reduction, backlog/WIP visibility, closure rate and repeat-escalation reduction.
Stakeholder Experience
Clear ownership, fewer repeated follow-ups and useful executive-ready updates.
Sustainability
After-hours load visibility and adherence to rotation/coverage guardrails.
Work Environment
May require participation in on-call/tiered escalation schedules, after-hours support and rapid response during outages.
Frequent coordination through Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, email, outage bridges and operational dashboards.
Role success depends on disciplined intake, accurate documentation, clear ownership, consistent communication and follow-through.

Shift / Coverage-6:30 PM-3:30 AM or 10:00 PM-6:00 AM; aligned to U.S. core hours 6:00 AM-6:00 PM MST

Job Summary
The Disconnect Lead provides day-to-day operational leadership for customer disconnect activities, including Order Entry, circuit and design validation, inventory removal, Access Service Requests (ASRs), Local Service Requests (LSRs), circuit implementation and disconnect cost optimization. The role oversees automated and manual workflows, manages workload and priorities, ensures milestones and SLAs are achieved, maintains quality and data accuracy, and guides the team through complex issues and fallout.
The role works across Order Entry, Transport, IP, Planning, Order Management, Finance, Implementation Coordinators, Operations, carriers, off-net vendors and automation platforms to ensure disconnect orders are completed cleanly, accurately and within committed timelines.
Key Responsibilities
Lead day-to-day activities across the disconnect workstream, including Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASR/LSR submission, inventory removal and circuit implementation.
Manage work allocation, priorities, aging orders, critical due dates and shift coverage; balance urgent restorals, supplements/cancels and production commitments.
Monitor productivity, quality, SLA/TAT, aging, fallout and delivery performance; take corrective action when performance or committed dates are at risk.
Review and guide disconnect design validation, including disconnect scope, ECCKT, circuit history, CFA/PON details, prior order activity and inventory records.
Ensure ASRs/LSRs comply with ASOG and vendor-specific ordering requirements, using automated workflows and manual fallback processes when required.
Oversee the end-to-end disconnect lifecycle across data, notifications, vendor maintenance, fallout, reports, escalations, documentation and closure.
Drive disconnect cost optimization by working with internal teams to eliminate avoidable or unhealthy vendor costs to Lumen.
Review and troubleshoot complex disconnect, provisioning and automation-workflow issues; determine when escalation or specialist support is required.
Coordinate with Planning, Order Management, Order Entry, Transport, IP, Operations, Finance, implementation teams, carriers and off-net vendors.
Recognize competing priorities and operational risks early, taking action or escalating before customer or business commitments are affected.
Ensure process adherence, accurate account notes, logs, communications, inventory updates and compliance with company, regulatory and customer requirements.
Coach team members, provide telecom/process/tool guidance, support knowledge transfer and identify skill or knowledge gaps.
Identify process gaps, recurring issues and data-integrity risks; drive standard work, quality assurance, process improvement and automation.
Provide clear operational updates to stakeholders and leadership, including status, risks, dependencies, decisions and recovery actions.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Strong understanding of telecom/network provisioning, circuits, carrier provisioning, disconnect workflows and network operations.
Experience creating or managing ASRs/LSRs in a telecom or network-operations environment.
Working knowledge of Order Entry, Circuit Design, ASOG, vendor ordering requirements and/or network implementation.
Ability to interpret circuit designs, ECCKTs, CFA/PON data, order history and disconnect documentation.
Proven experience leading or coordinating an operational team, including workload, priorities, coaching and delivery controls.
Knowledge of SLA/TAT, aging, operational KPI, quality and productivity management.
Strong problem-solving and decision-making; ability to pivot quickly and expedite resolution in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to manage multiple orders, critical deliverables and competing priorities without losing ownership or accuracy.
Strong stakeholder and vendor coordination, with clear written and verbal communication and confidence leading operational discussions.
Positive attitude, ownership, adaptability and willingness to learn and improve processes.
Good to Have
Experience supporting customer disconnects, service terminations or disconnect cost optimization.
Experience as a Team Lead, SME or senior provisioning engineer.
Familiarity with FlightDeck automation and manual fallback processes; knowledge of Swift, SAM/Razor, PRIME, PRO/XLR or ASRI.
Exposure to Granite/XNG, carrier portals, telecom OSS/BSS and Lumen provisioning/disconnect/inventory systems.
Advanced Excel, Power BI or dashboard/reporting experience.
Power Automate, VBA, Python or other automation experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced AWS Data Engineer to design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data platforms on AWS. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in AWS data services, ETL development, data warehousing, big data technologies, SQL, and Python. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, data architects, analysts, and engineering teams to build reliable and high-performance data solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines using AWS services.
Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows for ingesting, transforming, and loading large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
Develop cloud-native data solutions using AWS Glue, EMR, Lambda, S3, Redshift, and other AWS services.
Implement data integration processes from various source systems, databases, and APIs.
Develop and optimize data models for reporting, analytics, and business intelligence.
Ensure data quality, governance, security, and compliance requirements are met.
Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and resolve performance bottlenecks.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business teams to support advanced analytics and reporting initiatives.
Implement CI/CD practices and infrastructure-as-code methodologies.
Participate in architecture discussions and recommend best practices for cloud data platforms.

Description:
Role Summary:
HCLSoftware is seeking a Domain and Product Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join the Incubate Delivery function. This role sits within the build pool and is responsible for customising and configuring Incubate solutions to deliver the specific business outcomes each customer engagement requires. The Domain and Product FDE acts on behalf of the client. They take the requirements and detailed design produced by the Value Owner and Context and Data Strategist and turn them into working solutions inside the product, designing workflows, configuring orchestrations, building workbenches, and implementing process-led use cases using deep product fluency and domain understanding. This is not a core product development role. The Incubate product and solution teams own the architecture, engineering, and roadmap of the core products. This role makes those products work in the customers environment, configuring, extending, and customising them to deliver the outcomes the engagement has been designed to achieve. In traditional delivery, this would be recognised as a Product Specialist or Domain SME. In AIcentred delivery, the distinction matters more. Solutions built on AI, orchestration, and agentic capabilities need people who understand both the product and the business domain well enough to configure intelligently without defaulting to unnecessary custom development, and without losing sight of what the customer is actually trying to achieve. The role requires the judgement to know when to configure versus when to customise, when to use product capability as intended versus when to extend it, and when to push back on a requirement that would be better served by a different approach. That judgement comes from combining product knowledge with practical domain understanding. Role Scope in Practice Design, configure, and build customer-specific solutions within Incubate products, including workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases. Work from the documented requirements and detailed design produced by the Context and Data Strategist, translating specification into working product configuration. Apply domain understanding and product fluency to make informed configuration decisions that deliver the desired outcomes without unnecessary custom development. Collaborate with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues where solutions require integration, API connectivity, or technical build beyond product configuration. 2 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Support the Quality and Compliance team by ensuring that what is built is testable, traceable, and aligned to the documented requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in delivery calls and technical discussions where product and domain input is needed, without owning customer communication directly. Contribute to the reuse and maturity of solution patterns, configuration approaches, and domain-specific knowledge across engagements. Configure and maintain the behavioural controls that shape how AI agents operate within each customer's context, including prompt templates, agent personas, business guardrails, and escalation logic, ensuring agents behave in line with the process, the client's operating context, and the documented acceptance criteria. Key Responsibilities 1. Solution Configuration and Build Design and configure solutions within Incubate products to meet the specific requirements of each customer engagement. Build workflows, orchestrations, workbenches, agents, and process-led use cases using the product’s native capabilities and tooling. Make informed decisions about when to use standard product configuration, when to extend or customise, and when to escalate where a requirement may be better addressed through a different approach. Ensure that configured solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to the product’s intended architecture and design patterns. Work iteratively, delivering incremental capability that can be reviewed, validated, and refined through the engagement lifecycle. Design and configure prompt templates, agent personas, and behavioural parameters that control how AI agents interact with users, data, and business processes within each use case. Implement business guardrails and constraints that keep agent behaviour aligned to the customer's expectations, regulatory context, and risk appetite, including tone, scope boundaries, escalation triggers, and response limitations. 2. Domain Expertise and Product Fluency Bring practical understanding of the business domain to inform how solutions are designed and configured, ensuring they reflect how the customer’s processes, decisions, and workflows actually operate. Maintain deep fluency in Incubate product capabilities, tooling, and configuration options, staying current as products evolve. Use domain and product knowledge together to identify the most effective solution approach for each use case, avoiding over-engineering and unnecessary complexity. Advise the Context and Data Strategist and Value Owner where requirements may benefit from adjustment based on product capability or domain insight. Establish and maintain SME feedback loops working with customer subject matter experts to review agent behaviour, validate output quality, and iteratively refine prompt templates and behavioural configuration based on real-world performance. 3 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes 3. Working from Requirements and Detailed Design Take documented requirements and detailed design from the Context and Data Strategist as the primary input for build work. Seek clarification from the Context and Data Strategist where specifications are ambiguous, incomplete, or where product constraints create a gap between what is specified and what can be delivered. Ensure traceability between documented requirements and what is actually built, so that QA and validation activities have a clear baseline. Flag risks, constraints, and dependencies back to the delivery team early, particularly where product limitations or data readiness issues may affect the planned approach. 4. Collaboration and Delivery Integration Work as part of the integrated delivery team, collaborating closely with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues, the Context and Data Strategist, and the Quality and Compliance team. Participate in delivery ceremonies, technical discussions, and review sessions as needed. Support solution walkthroughs and demonstrations where product and domain expertise is required, without owning customer communication directly. Coordinate with other Domain and Product FDEs where multiple use cases or workstreams are running in parallel within an engagement. 5. Quality, Testing, and Handover Ensure that configured solutions are built to a standard that supports effective testing, validation, and acceptance. Support the Quality and Compliance team in validating that delivered solutions meet the documented requirements, acceptance criteria, and governance standards. Contribute to go-live readiness activities, including solution documentation, configuration records, and handover materials for the operate phase. Support operate-phase activities where ongoing configuration, refinement, or extension of solutions is required after initial go-live. 6. Knowledge Sharing and Reuse Contribute to the development of reusable solution patterns, configuration templates, and domain-specific knowledge across the function. Document configuration decisions, design rationale, and lessons learned so that knowledge is retained and transferable. Share product and domain expertise with colleagues across engagements, supporting the function’s ability to mobilise and deliver consistently. Required Experience Experience in a product configuration, solution delivery, or domain specialist role within enterprise software environments. Practical experience designing and building solutions using enterprise software products, configuring workflows, orchestrations, business rules, or process automation. 4 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Demonstrable domain understanding in one or more relevant business areas, able to translate business processes and requirements into product configuration decisions. Experience working from documented requirements and detailed design, collaborating with business analysts or equivalent roles to clarify and refine specifications. Experience working as part of a multi-disciplinary delivery team, coordinating with engineering, QA, and advisory colleagues. Comfortable working iteratively, delivering incremental capability and adapting as requirements are refined through delivery. Skills and Capabilities Product fluency: able to work confidently within enterprise software products, using native tooling and configuration capabilities to build effective solutions. Domain understanding: brings practical knowledge of business processes, operational workflows, and industry context that informs how solutions are designed and configured. Configuration judgement: knows when to use standard configuration, when to extend, and when to push back, including the judgement to shape agent behaviour through prompt design and guardrails rather than defaulting to custom development. Analytical thinking: able to interpret requirements, identify gaps or ambiguities, and translate specification into working solutions. Collaboration: works effectively as part of an integrated team, particularly alongside Context and Data Strategists, AI Orchestration engineers, and QA colleagues. Communication: able to articulate technical decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues. Attention to detail: builds solutions that are robust, traceable, and aligned to documented requirements. Desirable Experience Experience with HCLSoftware products or comparable enterprise software platforms. Experience in AI, automation, orchestration, or agentic workflow delivery, understanding how product configuration differs when AI is at the centre of the solution. Experience with process mining, process mapping, or operational analytics tools. Familiarity with integration patterns, APIs, and data connectivity in the context of enterprise solution delivery. Experience in environments where governance, compliance, and auditability are embedded in the delivery process. Experience supporting operate-phase activities: extending, optimising, and refining solutions after initial go-live. Experience configuring or managing AI agents, conversational AI, or LLM-based solutions, including prompt engineering, behavioural tuning, and agent persona design. 5 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Success Measures Months 1 to 3: Embedded and Building Integrated into active engagements and building solutions productively within Incubate products. Working effectively from documented requirements, with minimal rework caused by misinterpretation of specifications. Demonstrating product fluency and domain understanding that inform sound configuration decisions. Collaborating well with Context and Data Strategists, AI Orchestration colleagues, and the Quality and Compliance team. Months 3 to 6: Quality and Consistency Configured solutions consistently meet documented requirements and acceptance criteria, with minimal defects or rework at validation. Configuration decisions reflect good judgement: using product capability effectively, avoiding unnecessary custom development, and escalating appropriately where product constraints arise. Positive feedback from the delivery team on the quality, reliability, and maintainability of built solutions. Contributing to solution documentation and configuration records that support operatephase handover. Months 6 to 12: Depth and Reuse Recognised as a reliable, high-quality contributor to solution build across Incubate engagements. Contributing reusable solution patterns, configuration templates, and domain-specific knowledge to the function. Building depth of product and domain expertise that supports more complex use cases and engagement scenarios. Supporting the mobilisation of new engagements with established patterns and lessons from prior work. Candidate Profile Technically capable and product-oriented, with a genuine interest in how enterprise software solves business problems. Pragmatic and outcome-focused, builds solutions that work for the customer, not just solutions that are technically elegant. Comfortable working from documented requirements and collaborating closely with advisory and QA colleagues. Good judgement on when to configure, when to customise, and when to push back. Curious about the business domain, not just the product, wants to understand why something is being built, not just how. 6 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes Reliable, thorough, and motivated by delivering quality work that others can build on. Eager to learn, develop product depth, and grow domain expertise over time.

Description:
SQL DBA Azure
Pune / Bangalore / Noida:
5 Days – Work from Office
What does a successful SQL DBA – Azure do at Fiserv?
We are looking for a skilled SQL DBA with hands-on Azure experience to join our team and support the administration, performance, availability and security of critical database environments. In this role, you will manage SQL Server databases across on-premises and cloud environments, support production systems and help ensure reliable, scalable, and high-performing database operations.
A successful candidate brings strong SQL Server database administration experience, practical knowledge of Azure services and the ability to work across infrastructure, application, and development teams. This role is important to maintaining database stability, supporting cloud initiatives and driving operational excellence.
What you will do
Administer, monitor and maintain SQL Server database environments across development, test and production systems
Manage databases in Azure environments, including support for cloud-hosted database services and related platform operations
Perform database installation, configuration, upgrades, patching and migration activities across on-premises and Azure platforms
Monitor database health, performance, storage and availability and take proactive action to prevent issues
Perform backup, recovery, restoration and disaster recovery support for business-critical databases
Troubleshoot database issues and optimize performance through tuning, indexing, query analysis and configuration improvements
Support high availability and disaster recovery solutions for SQL Server environments
Ensure database security, user access management and compliance with operational and security standards
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, cloud and application support teams to resolve issues and support new initiatives
Automate routine database administration tasks where appropriate
Support production releases, environment readiness and operational transitions
Maintain technical documentation, standards, support procedures and runbooks
Participate in incident management, root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts
What you will need to have
4 to 10 years of experience in SQL Server database administration
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server in production environments
Hands-on experience with Azure, including Azure SQL Database, Azure virtual machines or other Azure data services
Experience in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, security and monitoring
Strong knowledge of SQL Server installation, configuration, patching and upgrade processes
Experience supporting high availability and disaster recovery configurations
Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience working in cross-functional support and delivery environments
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, work and military experience
What would be great to have
Experience with Snowflake
Familiarity with Azure automation, scripting or infrastructure support
Experience with PowerShell or other scripting tools
Knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps or infrastructure-as-code practices
Experience in financial services, payments or other regulated environments
Familiarity with enterprise monitoring and alerting tools

Description:
MS Dynamics Developer/Consultant
Location: Pune, India
Experience: 4 to 10 years

What does a successful MS Dynamics Developer do at Fiserv?

In this role, you will design, develop and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions that help drive operational efficiency, improve user experience and support business growth. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, configure and customize solutions, and deliver scalable, high-quality applications that align with enterprise standards.
What you will do:
Design, develop, customize and support Microsoft Dynamics solutions based on business and technical requirements
Work with stakeholders to gather, analyze and translate business needs into functional and technical specifications
Configure and customize Dynamics modules, workflows, forms, dashboards and integrations
Develop plugins, custom workflows, reports and enhancements within the Microsoft Dynamics environment
Integrate MS Dynamics with other enterprise applications and third-party platforms
Support data migration, system upgrades, deployments and environment management activities
Troubleshoot application issues, identify root causes and provide timely resolution
Perform unit testing, system testing and support user acceptance testing
Create and maintain technical documentation, process documents and support materials
Collaborate with development, infrastructure, QA and business teams to deliver reliable solutions
Ensure solutions follow security, compliance and coding best practices
Provide ongoing production support and continuous improvement recommendations

What you will need to have:

4 to 10 years of overall IT experience
Hands-on experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Microsoft Dynamics CRM
Strong experience in customization, configuration and development within MS Dynamics
Create and manage copilot agents
Experience with C#, .NET, JavaScript, plugins, workflows and web services
Experience in integrating Dynamics with external systems using APIs or middleware
Good understanding of Power Platform, including Power Automate and Power Apps
Experience with SQL Server and data migration activities
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
Good verbal and written communication skills
Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field

What would be great to have:
Experience with Dynamics 365 CE, CRM or ERP modules based on business need
Knowledge of Azure services and cloud-based integrations
Experience in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines and release management
Familiarity with reporting tools and dashboards
Microsoft Dynamics certifications
Experience working in an enterprise environment with global teams
Understanding of Agile delivery methodologies

Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! About Us -
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
About the role:
Candidate will join as a generalist ops manager, rotate across merchant onboarding, risk, chargebacks and core payment ops

What will Associate do
• Run daily operations for a payments workflow end to end: SLAs, TATs, queues, escalations
• Track and improve core metrics: success rate, approval rates, dispute ratio, onboarding TAT, fraud and loss rates
• Analyze transaction, merchant and dispute data to find root causes, then fix the process, not just the case
• Coordinate with Product, Tech, Compliance, Sales, banks for closure of open items with TAT
• Draft and improve SOPs and playbooks, and push automation requirements to Tech
• Handle merchant and partner escalations with clear, quick communication

Who we're looking for
• MBA (Operations / Finance / Analytics / General Mgmt) from a reputed B-school, 0–1 yrs experience
• Interest in fintech and payments (UPI, cards, PA/PG flows, settlements)

Skills we screen for (common across all four teams)
1. Analytical ability: Excel/SQL comfort, reads data and gets to the "why" fast
2. Process thinking: breaks a workflow into steps, spots bottlenecks and leakages
3. Risk and control mindset: attention to detail, knows when to stop a transaction or merchant
4. Ownership under pressure: handles volume spikes (festive season), tight SLAs and escalations without waiting to be told
5. Stakeholder communication: crisp written and verbal updates to internal teams, merchants and banks
6. Regulatory awareness: KYC/AML basics (learnable, but curiosity is a must)

Good to have:
Internship in fintech, banking or e-commerce ops; SQL/Python/Power BI; a case study or project on payments, fraud or disputes.

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits etc
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep ie while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Additional Responsibilities: Insummary, the Gold appraiser is responsible for the end-to-end transactionprocess for gold loans - from valuation to disbursal to closure, along withcustomer service

CTC Upto 3 Lacs ( for Non-Metro) / 4

20 Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

Support school events, orientation programs, and parent interactions as part of the admission and branding process.

Ensure adherence to school admission policies and guidelines.
Maintain a professional, courteous, and service-oriented approach at all times.

Description:
Location: Bangalore, India
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
Thales India Engineering Competency Center in Bangalore is seeking a HW Test bench Lead- maintenance role.
In this role, you will manage Test Bench/ Automated Test Equipments maintenance and sustenance activities, which includes conducting scheduled maintenance procedure, inspecting, and troubleshooting test bench equipment.
These test benches primarily support various Thales defense applications and its products.

Essential skills:
Test Bench Hardware systems knowledge such as COTS Test and measurement instruments from different OEMs including NI Hardware including PXI systems, Industrial PC (PICMG SBC ) and VME systems.
5 +yrs Experience in handling various interface form factors such as PCI, PCIE, PCIe, CPCI, PXI, PXIe, VME etc.
Experience in Test Bench development or maintenance using COTS test measurement equipment, custom designed interface test adapters, PCBAs
Experience of testing avionics communication interfaces/buses such as MIL-STD-1553B, ARINC 429 , Serial RS 485 / 422, CAN etc is desirable.
Experience on interface cards such as Discrete IO, Analog, serial (RS232/422/482), synchro etc on various form factors listed above.
Problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
Experience in testing and knowledge of test equipment for measurement and control.
Hands on experience in handing various measuring tools such as Digital Oscilloscope, Function / wave generators up to 18GHz, Spectrum Analyzers, RF power meters etc.
Experience in analyzing / understanding electrical schematics, Cable Harness drawings and block diagrams.

Responsibilities:
As a maintenance engineer you will be responsible for undertaking periodic maintenance procedure and ensure the test system / bench are reliable.
Identify faults, efficiency and safety issues.
Respond to equipment breakdowns, provide first line diagnostic and arrange repairs or replacements.
Execute functional tests and validate the results against established standards
Perform quality inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations.
Should work closely with multi discipline teams and organize to fix the issues.
Preparation of the associated report and log maintenance to keep track of tasks
Collaborative work applying quality standards and internal processes
Should be able to estimate and monitor costs of maintenance.

Job Description
Overview
As Wastewater Modeller, you will be working on diverse range of sewerage related projects that deliver sustainable benefits to communities and the environment through a range of public and private sector clients.
Your role
Perform a role bringing together hydraulic modelling (1D-2D) and engineering aspects of the project. You will have to understand the engineering constraints and opportunities associated with modelling solutions to drainage problems to ensure model outputs are realistic.
Undertake technical work including hydraulic modelling like model build (1D - 2D), model verification, evaluation, feasibility, optioneering and outline design of solutions.
Understand the client requirements and deliver the work in smarter way by developing some automation tools along with high quality.
Demonstrate high standards deliverables by adopting various self-check methods and documentations.
Assist with project management and take a proactive approach to managing client relationships, clarifying expectations and outcome measures in order to meet their requirements and deliver successful projects.
Support wider business lines and develop and strengthen internal team.
About you
Has a Bachelor or Master's degree in Civil Engineering or Water Resources or Environmental engineering or Geology or Geography.
10+ years of experience in hydraulic design or modelling.
Working towards achieving chartership with appropriate institution (i.e. ICE, CIWEM).
Good working knowledge or experience of Infowork ICM, Mapinfo, QGIS, Sewer Gems, HEC-RAS, MicroDrainage or similar.
A strong, self-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
Good communication writing skills.
Flexible to adopt new work /challenge work as per business requirement.
Reward benefits
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.
Premium medical insurance for you and your dependents.
Generous annual leave balance.
Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Your role

Job Description


Overview


Water Management Consultancy (WMC) is a key part of the Infrastructure division within AtkinsRalis' Water and Environment Business. Serving both UK and international clients, our projects span flood defence, hydraulic structures, ports, and maritime engineering. The WMC team brings together a diverse range of expertise, including river and coastal engineering, hydrology, hydraulics, dam engineering, hydraulic gates, and maritime engineering.
In this role, you'll be instrumental in delivering a variety of projects, with a particular emphasis on integrated water management. This includes hydrodynamic catchment modelling, sustainable drainage, water-sensitive urban design, river restoration, software development, research, and client and stakeholder engagement. This opportunity is ideal for those seeking technical challenges and looking to contribute to advanced, industry-leading projects.




Your role
Be highly motivated, proactive, and possess a "can-do" attitude.
Be skilled in collaborative working, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate strong organizational and time management abilities.
Be flexible and open to new challenges.
International experience.
Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards Chartership.
Proficiency in coding/programming (R, VBA, Python) is a plus.


About you
A strong academic background with a degree in Civil Engineering and/or a master's degree in Water Management/Hydrology, with 8 to 15 years of experience in the water industry.
Experience in 2D modelling using TUFLOW.
Significant experience with 1D-2D modelling using FMP-TUFLOW, ESTRY-TUFLOW, Infoworks ICM, especially with UK clients.
Build, refine and analyse hydraulic models (1D, 2D, and 1D2D) to represent river channels, floodplains, and potentially pipe networks.
Experience in leading flood modelling projects and managing a small team.
Provide modelling inputs and analysis to support the production of Flood Risk Assessments (FRAs) for planning applications.
Perform sensitivity testing to quantify uncertainty in model parameters and components.
Proficiency in GIS, including QGIS, MapInfo, ArcGIS, and open-source GIS tools.
An understanding of the overall fluvial model development process.
Experience in undertaking Flood Risk Assessments and developing drainage strategies.
Familiarity with FEH (Flood Estimation Handbook) methods.
Working towards achieving Chartered status.
Ability to produce clear and concise technical reports in English.
Effective communication skills for collaborating with colleagues and clients via video conferencing.
Adherence to quality procedures and maintaining high standards in your work.
Enthusiasm for learning new skills and work procedures.


Reward benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
Comprehensive life insurance coverage.

Flexible and hybrid work solutions.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Role & responsibilities
Job Description International Sales
Function: International Business / Global Feed Sales
Location: Noida / Mumbai / Bangalore
Travel: International travel as required
Experience: 12+ years | Media / Broadcast / News / Content Sales
Role Overview
We are looking for a senior International Sales leader responsible for driving the global commercial growth of the organisations international news feed and broadcast content business.
The role will focus on selling and monetising the news channel’s international feed, content and associated media products across global markets, building distribution partnerships with broadcasters, DTH/IPTV operators, OTT platforms, digital platforms, content aggregators, media networks and other strategic partners.
The incumbent will be responsible for developing international markets, identifying new revenue opportunities, negotiating commercial partnerships and expanding the channel's global footprint.
This is a pure B2B international media sales role, requiring deep understanding of the global broadcast ecosystem, strong commercial acumen and an established network across international media and distribution businesses.
Key Responsibilities
1. International Feed Sales & Distribution
Develop and execute the global sales strategy for the organisation's international news feed.
Drive distribution of the channel/feed across international broadcasters, cable operators, DTH, CTV, IPTV, OTT and digital platforms.
Identify and penetrate new geographies and high-potential international markets.
Build and manage a pipeline of international distributors and strategic media partners.
Negotiate carriage, distribution, licensing and commercial agreements with international partners.
2. International Business Development
Identify new revenue streams for the international content and news-feed business.
Develop market-entry strategies for priority region U.S other high-value markets.
Identify whitespace opportunities across territories, platforms and distribution ecosystems.
Build strategic partnerships that increase the channel's international reach and monetisation.
3. Content & Media Licensing
Drive commercialisation of live news, linear feed, digital content, video packages and other eligible content assets.
Develop syndication and licensing opportunities with international media organisations and platforms.
Structure customised content partnerships based on market and partner requirements.
Work closely with legal, content and editorial teams to ensure commercially viable licensing arrangements.
4. Revenue Ownership
Own international sales revenue and business targets across assigned markets.
Build annual revenue plans, forecasts and territory-wise sales strategies.
Consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets.
Monitor market performance, pricing, competitor activity and commercial opportunities.
Develop new accounts while increasing revenue from existing strategic partners.
5. Global Client & Partner Management
Establish strong relationships with CEOs, Managing Directors, Heads of Distribution, Content Acquisition Heads, Commercial Heads and senior executives across global media organisations.
Build long-term relationships with international broadcasters, distributors, aggregators, platforms and media groups.
Act as the senior commercial point of contact for strategic international accounts.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will provide support, from administrative, customer service, and sales lead development perspectives, for the Sales & Marketing team to develop future and repeat business. As a Coordinator - Events / Marcom / Sales, you re not just supporting event delivery/sales lead development perspectives - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
At least 1 year of experience in a hotel sales admin/coordinator role preferred.
Diploma or degree in Marketing, Hospitality, Communications, or related field.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Experience in customer service, event coordination, or marketing preferred.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and hotel/event management software.
Creative mindset with attention to detail.
Ability to multitask and manage time effectively.
Analytical thinking and data-driven decision-making.
Team player with a proactive attitude and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with digital marketing tools and CRM platforms is a plus.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Communication & Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, vendors, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
Customer Service: Deliver exceptional service to guests and clients, ensuring satisfaction throughout the event or campaign lifecycle.
Project Coordination: Assist in planning and executing events and marketing projects, managing timelines and logistics.
Market Research: Conduct research to identify customer preferences, market trends, and competitive insights.
Budget Support: Help manage budgets, track expenses, and ensure cost-effective execution.
Digital Marketing: Support online campaigns and create engaging content for social media and digital platforms.
Sales Support: Assist the sales team with proposals, client negotiations, and promotional activities.
Vendor & Stakeholder Relations: Maintain strong relationships with external partners to ensure quality and reliability.
Problem-Solving: Address issues promptly during planning and execution phases.
Performance Analysis: Evaluate the success of campaigns and events using data and KPIs.
Team Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with departments to align efforts and achieve goals.
Innovation & Adaptability: Stay current with industry trends and apply innovative approaches.
Technical Tools: Use hotel systems such as Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, and Market Planner Survey tools effectively.

Description:
Job Summary:
We are looking for a customer-oriented female CRM cum Tele caller Executive to handle customer interactions, lead management, follow-ups, and maintain customer relationships. The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to coordinate effectively with the team.

Key Responsibilities:
Make outbound calls to prospective and existing customers and handle incoming inquiries.
Follow up with prospects, and maintain customer relationships.
Maintain and update customer databases and records in CRM software.
Handle customer queries, provide relevant information, and ensure timely follow-ups.
Schedule appointments, coordinate meetings, and support the sales team.
Track leads, customer interactions, and follow-up activities.
Prepare daily calling reports and achieve assigned targets.


Required Skills:
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic computer knowledge and proficiency in MS Office.
Good convincing, customer-handling, and follow-up skills.
Ability to work in a team and manage multiple tasks.
Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and target-oriented approach.


Candidates with 0-3 years of experience are welcome. Freshers with good communication skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
AboutCompany:
At Shine Enterprise, we believe that uninterrupted power is the foundation of every successful business. With 16+ years of experience in the power generation industry, we are committed to providing reliable, efficient, and dependable power solutions that keep businesses running with confidence.
Based in Guwahati, Assam, Shine Enterprise is an Authorised Dealer of Kirloskar Diesel Generators (KOEL DG Sets), serving customers across Northeast India. We cater to the diverse power requirements of industries, builders, contractors, electrical consultants, hotels, hospitals, commercial establishments, infrastructure projects, and government organizations

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for the general work order maintenance work assigned by your superior, or assisting the Engineering department s maintenance team in completing other maintenance work. As an Engineering Technician , you re not just responsible for ensuring the normal operation of hotel equipment - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Familiar with the operation principle and fault judgment method of large data centre infrastructure (power supply, air conditioning, fire control, security, monitoring, network, etc. ).
Willing to be engaged in the monitoring post for day shift and night shift for a long period, and have enough time to study.
Strong sense of responsibility, teamwork, professionalism, and learning ability.
Active and motivated in work, with a good sense of service.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, able to work independently.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Regulatory Compliance: Strictly adhere to staff rules, regulations, and management commands, ensuring careful operation and safe equipment use.
Operational Management: Ensure the normal operation of the hotel s power, water, gas, heating, and cooling equipment.
Record Keeping: Promptly and accurately inspect equipment operation records and shift handover records.
Equipment Maintenance: Inspect and maintain equipment and facilities under your jurisdiction, ensuring they are in good working condition.
Energy Management: Save energy and control energy consumption, implementing measures to enhance efficiency.
Event Support: Follow up on maintenance works for banquets and meetings, ensuring all related equipment functions well.
Emergency Preparedness: Regularly test-run the generator to ensure power generation and transmission during power failures.
Fire Safety Supervision: Supervise and inspect the hotel s fire preventive works, taking measures to stop any violations.
Training & Development: Supervise and train technicians and apprentices, developing their skills.
Tool Management: Manage working tools, registering team members names upon usage, and recommend disciplinary actions for subordinates as needed.

Responsibilities
Service Operations Technical Leadership: Plan, allocate and supervise daily PM schedules, breakdown call, route rationalization/route loading to ensure timely and high-quality service delivery.
Monitor response time, shutdown duration, call-back trends and implement corrective actions to improve reliability and cost efficiency.
Guide technicians in troubleshooting and repair activities, providing on-site technical support for complex faults.
Conduct AES and Safety Tests, PM Audits, ensure proper documentation of all the audits and safety tests, equipment inspections and other statutory requirements.
Reporting of Incidents and Near Missed in line with the company s process.
Organize service inspections of new installation units prior to handover to customers and ensure that incomplete jobs are not handed over.
