Improve service quality to ensure timely AMC renewal follow-up, collection of pending dues and promotion of OEM spares and value-added services to enhance customer loyalty.
Customer Relationship Management: Act as the single point of contact for key customers in the territory, handling escalations, service reviews and communication on equipment performance.
Conduct regular review meetings, non-price visits and performance presentations to strengthen long-term partnerships and understand future customer needs.
Coordinate internally to ensure commitments on response time, uptime and quality are met, and that customer complaints are resolved promptly and effectively.
People Management, Training and Vendor Development: Organize, mentor and develop the service team, including technicians, through regular coaching, performance reviews and skill-gap analysis.
Plan and conduct technical, safety and behavioural training for field staff, ensuring adherence to safe work practices and service standards.
Process, Inventory Compliance: Implement and sustain company service processes, documentation standards and digital tools for call logging, work order closure, billing and collection.
Oversee spare parts planning, ordering, inventory control and consumption analysis to support uptime targets and cost optimization.
Prepare and present MIS reports and periodic reviews to the Head Office team covering service KPIs, revenue performance, safety, quality and improvement plans.


Qualifications
Diploma in Electrical Engineering is mandatory.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering preferred.


Experience
Minimum 15 years of experience in the elevator industry for Diploma Engineers or 10 Years for Graduate Engineers with strong exposure to service, repairs and modernization.
Thorough knowledge of elevator systems, troubleshooting, testing and commissioning across multiple control and drive technologies.
Proven track record of leading service teams and delivering results in a demanding field environment.

Position: TSM
Function: Retail Sales

Purpose of Role:
The Sales Officer Retail Sales will be responsible for expanding the dealer network, driving sales growth, strengthening market penetration, and ensuring product availability across the assigned territory. The role involves managing dealer relationships, implementing sales strategies, executing promotional activities, and monitoring market and competitor performance to achieve business objectives.

Reporting to:
This role reports to the Area Sales Manager.

Key accountabilities:
Identifying and appointing dealer for deeper market penetration and reach in depth market share.
Analyze and compare sales plans with the last year base and implement appropriate sales activities to achieve targeted sales.
Overseeing the sale activities of products thereby achieving increased sales growth/ maximized volume and value growth in depth.
Assisting the dealers in achieving the targets and providing them with training
Ensuring the seeding of new product in right Channel.
Ensuring the SKU range availability at key outlets
Conceptualizing and implementing sales promotional programs for brand building
Ensuring profitability of dealers, in alignment with organization's policies and interest
Making a territory monitoring report every month including competitor's activities.
Conducting the retail audit to assess market potential, estimation of sale of competitors with a view to adopt suitable strategies for sale.
Solving all the issue of dealer for making smooth business relation.

Behavioral Competencies:
Highly energetic, motivated, confident candidates with good communication and selling skills.
Should have the ability to get the 'feel' of the market and to convert products into business.
Must be a go-getter with high drive and initiative.
Should be a local candidate.

Educational Qualification:
UG : B. Tech/B.E. - Any Specialization, B.Sc - Any Specialization, B.Com - Commerce

Experience:
Candidate should be a Graduate and a Post Graduate Degree / Diploma in Marketing Management with an experience of 3-6 years in Channel Sales preferably from Paints or Building material industry.

Job Summary
Function Summary: The agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience, especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customers in a) resolving policy service needs; b) renewal collection to resolve policy holder's service needs; cross-sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Recruitment - Develop various sources of agent hiring; build a team of agent pipeline.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referrals for new agent hiring.
Agent Recruitment - Conduct Career Seminar of prospects.
Agent Recruitment - Follow agent hiring mechanism and other hiring norms.
Agent Development - Ensure product knowledge by AMLI ways of training; Field demonstration (FODs).
Agent Development - Development of agent prospecting habits, calling habits and work habits.
Agent Development - Work with agent on planning and reviewing of activities and goals.
Agent Development - Identify the training needs of the agent and work with Trainers to improve the same.
Meet Business Targets - Achievement of monthly, quarterly yearly business plans.
Meet Business Targets - Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc.
Meet Business Targets - Ensure company's product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Meet Business Targets - Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan.
Customer Centricity - Be AMLI brand ambassador, a customer champion.
Customer Centricity - Follow AMLI sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty.
Customer Centricity - Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Customer Centricity - Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.
Measures of Success - Achievement of business plan GPA.
Measures of Success - Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Measures of Success - Number MTD Active; Persistency as per grid; Number of EC/MDRT agent.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
AuditExecutive Gold Loan (Onsite)
Position Title- Audit Executive
Job Summary
The Audit Executive Gold Loan (Onsite) is responsiblefor conducting branch-level audits to ensure compliance with internal policies,regulatory requirements, and operational standards. The role involves verifyinggold loan documentation, assessing gold valuation processes, identifyingcontrol weaknesses, and supporting the implementation of corrective actions tomitigate operational and compliance risks.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct onsite audits of gold loan branches as per the approved audit plan and audit schedule.
Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Description:
Role: Business Development / Expansion Role OYO (Field Profile)

What is this role about?
This role is about *expanding OYOs hotel network in new and upcoming markets

You will identify hotels, meet property owners, explain OYO’s vision, and help them partner with OYO. From the first discussion to the hotel going live, you will manage the full journey.

This is a field-based role and requires regular travel.

What will you do in this role?

* Find hotels and properties that can partner with OYO
* Generate leads through market visits, brokers, and referrals
* Visit properties and meet hotel owners face to face
* Explain how partnering with OYO can grow their business
* Negotiate commercials and close property signings
* Build a joint business plan with property owners for long-term profitability
* Coordinate with internal teams to launch the property on OYO
* Review agreements and service levels with property owners
* Resolve issues between property owners and internal OYO teams

How is your performance measured?

* Number of sellable rooms signed every month
* Number of rooms made live and available for booking
* Gross margin generated from signed properties

Education:
* Graduation mandatory
* MBA preferred

*Experience & Skills:*
* 1–5 years of relevant experience
* Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills
* Comfortable reading and understanding legal agreements
* Analytical and data-driven mindset
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment
* Basic working knowledge of ERP or mobile apps
* Good Excel skills and professional email writing

Stakeholders you will work with:

Internal:
* Business Development Head
* Hub Head
* Central Team
* Operations Team
* Transformation Team
* Legal Team

External:
* Property Owners
* Real Estate Brokers

In simple words:

Your role is to find hotels, sign them, launch them on OYO, and ensure the partnership is profitable.
AboutCompany: OYO is a global platform that aims to empower entrepreneurs and small businesses with hotels and homes by providing full-stack technology products and services that aims to increase revenue and ease operations; bringing easy-to-book, affordable, and trusted accommodation to customers around the world. OYO offers 40+ integrated products and solutions to patrons who operate over 157K hotel and home storefronts in more than 35 countries including India, Europe, and SEA. OYO operates a unique business model that helps its patrons transform fragmented, unbranded and underutilized hospitality assets into branded, digitally-enabled storefronts with higher revenue generation potential and provides its customers with access to a broad range of high-quality storefronts at compelling price points

AboutCompany:
Bajaj Electricals Limited is a globally renowned Indian Consumer Appliances and Lighting Solutions company (its Power Transmission and Distribution projects business has been demerged to form Bajel Projects Limited). Headquartered in Mumbai with a turnover of INR 4641 crores (FY 23-24), it is a part of the $100 bn multinational conglomerate Bajaj Group founded by Shri Jamnalal Bajaj. The Company was established in 1938 and has stood the test for almost 85 years. It continues to enjoy consumer trust across various sectors it operates in and remains at the forefront of developing modern, technologically superior and aesthetic products and solutions.

Bajaj Electricals’ business portfolio spans Consumer Products (Appliances, Fans, Cookware) and Lighting Solutions (Consumer and Professional Lighting). They are a front runner in the industry with their key brand offerings comprising BAJAJ, Nirlep, Morphy Richards and Nex. They have an expansive network of 18 branch offices, 660+ distributors, and ~ 2 lakh retail outlets across India, combined with over 620 consumer care centres reaching 19,000 pin codes, fortifying their dominant presence in the consumer products sector. Under their Lighting Solutions business, they offer a wide range of innovative LED lamps and fixtures, including panels and battens, to consumers and are known for their prowess in street lighting, sports lighting, industrial commercial and infrastructural lighting, and undertaking specialised illumination projects on a turnkey basis amongst other solutions.

The Company executes its CSR and philanthropic initiatives through Bajaj Electricals Foundation by focusing on the key areas like ensuring environmental sustainability & promoting its education, rural transformation, promotion of education, vocational skills and livelihoods, promoting preventive health care and promoting Indian arts & culture. Additionally, they run a large-scale Employee Volunteering Program where each employee contributes time and efforts towards uplifting the community through various self-started activities.

About us :
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytms mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.


About the team :
QR and Soundbox is one of Paytms business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.


About the role :
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of QR & Soundbox through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.


Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Grow Distribution and Market share in the assigned area of operations.
2. Visibility Accountability through Extensive QR & Sound box deployment and sale of the product.
3. Identify and Recruit the sales team to align and drive business in the market.
4. Skilled in coaching and mentoring, a quick learner who grasps and puts into application new learned ideas and concepts.
5. Plan the market size, span and geographies for FSE.
6. Should be able to devise the best methods for communication of plans/targets to the team so as to minimize the expectations vs delivery gap.
7. Monitor the Quality parameters as suggested by the management.
8. Validate and conduct the audits on the acquisitions and sales done by the team.
9. Ensure the team members are in the market where sales & usage are done regularly
10. Should have good networking capabilities and be willing to travel extensively throughout their specified area.


Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role :
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset


Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.


Qualification :
Graduate/Post Graduate.


Compensation :
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you With enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 21 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

SUMMARY
Summary
We are currently seeking dedicated and detail-oriented individuals to serve as Off-Role Quality & Process Control Representatives (OPC) for a leading paints manufacturing firm across various locations throughout India. This role offers an excellent opportunity for professionals with a background in quality control, production, or manufacturing operations to contribute to maintaining high standards within a respected industry name. The position is pivotal in ensuring product integrity and operational compliance from raw material sourcing through to final dispatch.

Responsibilities
Oversee the quality of raw and packaging materials at vendor sites to ensure they meet established standards.
Execute quality inspections, sampling procedures, and testing protocols in strict accordance with approved specifications.
Supervise production workflows to guarantee adherence to approved formulations and recipes.
Validate batch charging procedures, premix measurements, and the accuracy of production records.
Manage token systems effectively and reconcile them against finished goods shipments.
Perform final quality assessments on completed goods and maintain comprehensive batch-specific documentation.
Track filling weights, verify laboratory equipment calibration, and monitor critical quality parameters.
Generate and submit daily activity reports via a mobile application equipped with geo-tagging capabilities.
Detect any deviations in quality standards and promptly escalate significant findings to management.
Assist in scheduled quality audits and ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory and internal activities.


Requirements

Possess a Graduate degree or Diploma in Science, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
Have between 0.6 to 3 years of professional experience in quality control, production, manufacturing, or conducting plant and vendor audits.
Demonstrate practical knowledge of quality testing methods, sampling techniques, and documentation processes.
Exhibit strong observational, reporting, and analytical capabilities.
Be willing and able to work at external vendor or plant locations and utilize mobile applications for reporting tasks.

Location: Guwahati

* Eligibility Criteria:
Graduate/Diploma in Science, Chemistry or a related discipline.
0.6 3 years of experience in Quality Control, Production, Manufacturing or Plant/Vendor Audits.
Knowledge of quality testing, sampling and documentation
Good observation, reporting and analytical skills.
Comfortable working at vendor/plant locations and using mobile applications.

Job Summary
As a Business Analyst - you will support business analysis and requirement management activities by working closely with Analysts, Senior Analysts and project leadership. You will contribute to translating business needs into clearly documented requirements and support the delivery of digitally enabled solutions across client engagements. This role focuses on learning Accenture delivery methodologies, tools and ways of working while building foundational consulting and analysis skills.
Roles and Responsibilities
Support the analysis of current-state (as-is) processes and assist in documenting future-state (to-be) processes under the direction of senior team members.
Assist in planning, preparing and documenting client workshops, interviews and requirement gathering sessions.
Work with client and internal stakeholders to understand stated requirements and contribute to documentation using process models, basic story maps, data analysis, and document reviews.
Support day-to-day communication with delivery teams by helping clarify documented requirements and assumptions.
Assist with iteration planning, backlog refinement and sprint activities, including drafting user stories and acceptance criteria under guidance.
Support stakeholder engagement activities and help maintain alignment between the project team, client, and project leadership.
Contribute to the identification of solution options by documenting business needs, dependencies and constraints to support decision-making.
Create and maintain requirement artefacts (user stories, process flows, functional documentation) based on Accenture and client-defined standards.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to gather inputs required for analysis and documentation.
Support alignment between requirements, solution design and implementation artefacts, escalating gaps or inconsistencies when identified.
Assist in maintaining requirement traceability, accuracy and version control throughout the delivery lifecycle.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skill
Foundational knowledge of business analysis and requirement documentation practices using structured templates and tools.
Ability to understand project scope, objectives, and inception documentation with guidance.
Exposure to Agile and iterative delivery methodologies, including backlog refinement and sprint execution.
Ability to proactively raise issues, risks and clarifications to Analysts, Senior Analysts or Project Managers.
Basic application awareness of enterprise or commerce platforms (e.g. SAP Hybris, Salesforce or similar) is beneficial.
Demonstrates structured thinking and clear communication, shows learning agility, proactively takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, and collaborates effectively within a team-based delivery environment.
Ability to think in terms of systems, roles & system capabilities
Ability to aid clients in making data driven decisions by using data analysis tools such as Excel & guide clients towards solutions to their business problems
Ability to do market research to understand client's business
Ability to use AI tools efficiently
Exposure to the following is considered a plus
JIRA / Azure DevOps for backlog management
Basic SQL
Basic understanding of APIs / system integrations
Analytics tools

Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.

Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviews, process mapping and requirements elicitation.

eCommerce domain knowledge across browse, search, PDP, cart, checkout, payments, promotions, order capture and order status.

Experience with one or more relevant platforms such as SAP Commerce/Hybris, commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud/Revenue Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento, Shopify, PROS, Conga or similar is considered a plus.
Understanding of SDLC phases including development, testing, deployment, maintenance and release governance.

Pricing domain knowledge including price books, price lists, promotions, discounts, taxation, regional pricing and price engine integrations.
Working knowledge of delivery automation, version control, deployment strategies and DevOps collaboration sufficient to govern cross-functional delivery.
Search, merchandising, CMS, CDP, web analytics, payments, OMS or customer service platform exposure.
PSPO I, PSPO II, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master or relevant commerce platform certifications.
Exposure to headless commerce, composable commerce, microservices, event-driven integrations or cloud-native delivery.
Experience with automation pipelines, version control, deployment strategies or DevOps collaboration.

We want to build a legacy of improving the business environment and our communities. At EY, we are proud of our inclusive culture, which supports individuals to achieve their potential without barriers.
About EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) Assurance practice supports global EY client-serving teams with their reviews across industry sectors, including financial services, manufacturing and technology, among others. Through the right multidisciplinary team of professionals with the sector knowledge and subject matter expertise, EY GDS Assurance enables EY client teams in over 30 countries to help world s leading companies meet their audit requirements.
Position Summary
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Technical support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS to help drive growth and support delivery teams, bring subject matter expertise around technical accounting and accounting standards to our FAAS services.
The staff individual should be competent to support team for the timeliness and quality of the work as per EY Global Standards for our FAAS team. While the staff individual will be based out of our Cochin office, the individual will be responsible for supporting EY practices and clients across markets. Also, the individual will be required to travel to other countries (short-term/long term) for executing the client engagements.
.
Primary Responsibilities
The Staff will be responsible for the following tasks:
Support the team in executing client engagements across Technical Accounting, Gap Assessments, Accounting Policies, Financial Statement Preparation and Review, Carve-outs, Consolidation, and Financial Reporting.
Deliver high-quality client service by effectively executing assigned responsibilities and providing timely updates to supervisors on engagement progress, key issues, and deliverables.
Respond to client requests in a timely and professional manner, supporting the team in meeting agreed timelines and client expectations for deliverables and reports.
Conduct technical research, industry analysis, and benchmarking of client information against relevant industry practices and data.
Apply independent and objective professional judgment while interpreting and applying accounting standards to address client-specific accounting and reporting matters.
Demonstrate a strong understanding of accounting concepts and professional standards, stay current with relevant technical developments and firm policies, including guidance in the EY FAAS Policy Manual, and apply this knowledge effectively to moderately complex and complex client situations.

Enterprise Business Office: Global C&I Strategic Operations Senior Specialist
About EY
At EY, we re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
The Opportunity
The Global C&I Strategic Operations Senior Specialist role provides senior operational leadership for the aligned domain, translating strategic priorities into scalable operating models, measurable outcomes and disciplined execution. The role combines hands-on ownership of complex priorities with leadership of matrixed contributors and, depending on assignment needs, direct team management.
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
This position sits within Enterprise Business Office (EBO) and supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
Success in this model depends on agility-the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Operations
Partner with Domain and EBO leadership to translate strategic objectives into actionable operational plans, owning the operating model, governance and execution approach within the aligned domain.
Lead short- and long-term strategic initiatives, monitoring delivery against milestones.
Oversee domain-specific processes, driving clarity, consistency, and timely execution across stakeholders.
Provide executive-level recommendations and business insights to support domain strategy, prioritization and decision-making.
Drive portfolio-level oversight across strategic initiatives, priorities, resources, risks and interdependencies, ensuring alignment and disciplined execution.
Collaborate with the Strategic Operations Team Lead, counterparts and Domain teams to align cross-domain priorities, dependencies and delivery.
Partner with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to monitor performance, generate actionable insights and assess the impact of strategic initiatives.
Operational Excellence
Lead operational transformation through process improvement, automation and standardization, strengthening process maturity, reporting quality and business visibility.
Build scalable operating controls that strengthen accountability, execution discipline and organizational effectiveness.
Assess emerging technologies, approved AI and productivity tools to enhance operational agility and responsiveness.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the Strategic Operations team.
Coordinate governance forums and prepare executive-ready performance and decision materials leveraging data analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Essentials, Dynamics, etc.) in coordination with Performance & Data Insights.
Drive quality and alignment with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights across domain processes, ensuring clarity in roles, handoffs, and workflows.
Manage reporting and analysis demand, set stakeholder expectations and promote self-service solutions.
Stakeholder Engagement
Build trusted relationships and influence senior leaders, aligning stakeholders across domains and functions around shared strategic priorities and outcomes.
Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing recommendations based on operational insights.
Facilitate communication across domains, functions and pods, resolving stakeholder issues and maintaining alignment during execution.
EBO Leadership and Contribution
Contribute to EBO-wide priorities, communities and improvement initiatives, leading them where appropriate.
Champion One EBO ways of working by sharing practices, connecting teams and supporting employee experience, learning, recognition, wellbeing, inclusion and compliance initiatives.
Enable colleagues to lead initiatives beyond their core roles, building leadership capability, networks, visibility and organizational impact.
People
Coach matrixed contributors, clarify priorities and strengthen quality, delivery discipline and capability.
Build a connected, inclusive and high-performing team through collaboration, knowledge sharing, recognition and engagement across locations and reporting lines.
Strengthen succession pipelines by identifying talent, creating stretch opportunities and preparing individuals for expanded responsibilities.
Help team members define career pathways by connecting individual aspirations and capability gaps with assignments, mentoring, learning and exposure.
Support team formation and capability planning through effective onboarding, role clarity, knowledge continuity and sustainable coverage.
Skills & Attributes for Success
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience in operational process creation, improvement, and handoff.
Proficiency in reporting tools, data visualization, and storyboarding to create impactful prompts for decision-making.
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities, delivering high-quality output under tight timelines.
A client-focused mindset, with the ability to manage expectations and redirect activity as required.
Resilient, embraces ambiguity, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities including working flexibly across global time zones, stakeholder groups and changing business priorities, based on assignment requirements.
Excellent executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, decision-ready narratives.
Strong people and matrix leadership, including coaching, delegation, quality oversight and capability development.

Engagement Business Partner
The Engagement Business Partner (EBP) is a finance professional with comprehensive knowledge of systems, processes, and policies. In this internal role, the EBP acts as the Finance single point of contact, collaborating closely with client-serving engagement teams to enable the successful delivery of engagements across the full engagement lifecycle, from opportunity creation to final record archiving. Please note: this is not a technical accounting role.
The opportunity
As an Engagement Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in supporting client-serving teams by ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all engagement lifecycle activities. The main components of this role are:
Serving as the Finance single point of contact for Engagement Partners and Managers, offering guidance and overseeing all aspects of the Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL).
Overseeing the completion of OEL tasks by delegating to Centres of Excellence (CoEs), and monitoring progress to ensure timely delivery.
Proactively managing financial and quality related risks across your engagement portfolio, intervening where needed to provide strategic advice to uplift the compliance and revenue stability of your portfolio.
Ensure compliance with service line specific policies and parameters.
Supporting the annual external audit process.
This is a dynamic and rewarding role that contributes to profitable growth and high-quality client service.
Your key responsibilities
Manage a portfolio of client opportunities and engagements as the Finance single contact point for assigned Engagement Partners and Managers.
Coordinate with client servers and CoEs to:
Apply knowledge of service line specific OEL policies and guidelines to ensure compliance across the OEL lifecycle.
Monitor and advise on risk assessment and compliance processes.
Advise on pricing models and engagement budgets.
Assess financial implications of engagement structures and budgets.
Support and challenge the Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) processes and related financial updates.
Support the portfolio s working capital activity.
Provide challenge and best practice insights to client servers where required such as through optimal margin, pricing plans or engagement structures.
Upskill and share knowledge with client servers on OEL best practice, standards and tools.
Develop a diverse network of relationships across Finance and non-Finance stakeholders to provide holistic Finance support for Engagement Partners and escalate queries beyond remit to other functional experts within Finance (e.g. PFAs).
Review work performed by CoEs for accuracy and take ownership of OEL tasks when urgent needs arise.
Seek to understand client-server needs, demands, and the nuances of the specific Service Line to deepen insights and strategic thinking.
Share best practices across the EBP group to drive consistency and excellence.
Engage with CoE Managers to flag issues, trends or knowledge required for CoE upskilling.
Provide subject matter expertise in delivering training on OEL best practices for CoEs.
Support continuous improvement through identifying opportunities for innovation and automation.
Skills and attributes for success
Deliver with pace ensuring activities are executed accurately in a fast-moving environment.
Ability to engage proactively with Engagement Partners to anticipate upcoming needs and ensure OEL requirements are met on time.
Strong interpersonal skills with a good understanding of the client server perspective and ability to build relationships with them.
Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
Excellent analytical and commercial acumen, with high attention to detail.
Take ownership of monthly activities, driving progress and proactively managing business outcomes to meet deadlines and performance targets.
Quick learner with a proactive approach and eager to share knowledge with others.
Ability to translate complex technical system language into business-relevant terms.
Skilled listener with sound judgment and the ability to escalate appropriately.
To qualify for the role, you must have
A minimum of two to three years experience in a client-facing or finance-related role within a professional services or corporate environment.
Experience managing stakeholders and delivering high-impact client service.
Experience working in hybrid and fast-paced environments.
Used to working in a fast-paced environment with a strong work ethic
Ability to build relationships with people at all levels within the firm.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments.
What we look for

Job Description
Unified Support Services (USS) Functional Excellence Leader (U6. USS Functional Excellence)
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. Fueled by a US$1.5+B investment in technology and innovation, EY is primed to guide clients in their efforts to drive sustainable growth, create new value, and build new and better ways of working. As part of Enterprise Technology, you ll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
The Opportunity
EY s global enterprise technology group provides various enabling services (ERP, infrastructure, platforms, service desk) to assist over 300K employees in creating and delivering solutions and services to Fortune 500, privately held and government like entities.
The USS Functional Excellence (FE) leader will be an experienced senior operations leader who will play a crucial role providing comprehensive operational support to the USS Global, Areas and Regional leaders to manage the delivery of the integrated Onsite Support Services (OSTS) and Service Desk (SD) services across EY. The candidate will be responsible for managing approximately 38 professionals and overseeing five distinct sub-functions within USS Functional Excellence. This pivotal role requires a strategic thinker with an operational mindset who can ensure that all the sub-functions operate cohesively and effectively support the USS objectives. The function will be responsible for a range of operational activities, including Reporting & Analytics, managing Vendor SLAs & Vendor relationships, spearheading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Product Management, administering End User IT Support Knowledge Management, overseeing Transition Management, and conducting Asset Management activities.
EY is seeking a forward-thinking IT executive to design, build and transform this newly envisioned group.
This executive must:
Lead and create a customer-centric culture that focuses on innovative and best-in-class customer service design and execution
Serve as an innovative inspiring leader to align technology solutions with customer needs to deliver an integrated customer experience
Is responsible for best-in-class service solutions that exceed organization and customer needs and expectations
Effectively operate in a complex global organization, collaborating with a global customer and partner groups
Assemble and lead a high performing team with a laser focus on exceptional customer service and promotes an inclusive and mentoring culture
Your key responsibilities
Responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive strategy to deliver operational support to the Unified Support Services (integrated OSTS & Service Desk) Global, Area and Regional leaders.
Assemble, lead and mentor a team of professionals dedicated to operational excellence.
Oversee and advise the Reporting & Analytics sub-function to ensure the provision of precise and valuable data that aids in decision-making and adheres to the needs of USS Global, Area, Regional leaders, and other key stakeholders.
Provide guidance to the Vendor and SLA management sub-function to efficiently manage Vendor SLAs and cultivate strong Vendor relationships to ensure service quality and alignment with business objectives.
Champion Continuous Improvement initiatives to optimize processes and enhance efficiency of operations.
Guide the Product Management of the End User platform products, ensuring that it meets the user needs and the USS objectives.
Direct the End User IT Support Knowledge Management team to maintain a comprehensive and accessible knowledge base.
Oversee and direct the Transition Management efforts to ensure smooth transitions for operational changes, new product releases or integrations.
Oversee End User IT Asset Management to ensure the effective utilization and tracking of the firm s End User IT assets.
Drive innovation in operational support through the adoption of new technologies and methodologies, such as AI, automation, and self-service tools.
Uphold global IT security standards within the USS domain, ensuring compliance and protection of EYs information assets.
Support crisis management efforts for support services, ensuring rapid response and resolution to maintain business operations.
Support the cost-effective delivery of Unified Support Services to meet business and customer needs and respond with the agility required to address changing customer and business priorities
Skills and attributes for success
To qualify for the role, you must have
Customer-obsessed-passionate about customer and support services and the impact technology capabilities can have on our customers satisfaction and productivity
Demonstrated focus on creating and sustaining exceptional customer service
Over 17 years of experience in IT support services, with significant leadership experience in managing global, large-scale operations.
Demonstrated expertise in leading large teams and managing complex operational functions.
Proven track record in strategic planning and execution of operational initiatives.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and develop a diverse team.
Extensive experience in Vendor Management, SLA oversight, and building vendor partnerships.
Knowledge of Continuous Improvement methodologies and their application in a business context.
Familiarity with Product Management for IT platforms and End User IT Support structures.
Experience in managing transitions and asset management within a large organization.
Strong understanding of ITIL service management frameworks with relevant certifications.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with all levels of the organization and external partners.
Strategic and analytical thinker with robust problem-solving skills.
Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
Demonstrates an in-depth knowledge of how IT service solutions support customer fulfillment and productivity to achieve short- and long-term business goals
Visible leadership skills and executive presence
Extensive experience developing, managing and adjusting the P&L of the managed group
Demonstrated ability to develop teams through functional transformations in a fast-paced environment, including improving team skills and efficiency, and applying mentoring for talent development
Ideally, you ll also have
Education:
Advanced college degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experience
Certification Requirements (preferred):
ITIL, PMP
Data Analytics
:
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. :

Description:
Senior Developer / Technical Lead (MS SQL / Databricks / Power Platform)
Job Summary:
As our Senior Application Engineering Developer / Technical Lead, you will combine hands-on technical leadership and direct engineering contribution. You will remain close to solution design, estimates, development and delivery while working on the EMEIA and APAC engagements.
You will be expected to guide engineers, challenge technical decisions, review designs and code, troubleshoot complex solutions and contribute directly to development when needed. The role supports solutions across both established on-premises technologies and Azure-based platforms.
Responsibilities:
Personally design, code, test, troubleshoot and enhance application and data-engineering solutions across Databricks, Python, SQL, Azure and all Power Platform technologies.
Provide technical leadership to Application Engineers on projects, including solution design, estimation, engineering work breakdown, code and design reviews, implementation guidance and delivery oversight.
Coordinate the Application Engineering function across EMEIA and APAC, supporting counselor responsibilities, regional priorities, cross-team alignment and deputy coverage for the Application Engineering leader.
Hands-on development and coding are a core expectation of the role.
Key responsibilities include:
Build and enhance solutions personally using the core technology stack, taking responsibility for code quality, unit testing, troubleshooting, documentation and operational readiness.
Translate business requirements and solution architecture into practical technical designs, estimates and implementable engineering work.
Apply hands-on proficiency in AI and emerging technologies to create prototypes, integrations, automations or targeted enhancements where they provide practical value.
Lead engineers assigned to projects through technical decisions, solution and code reviews, problem resolution, testing and deployment readiness.
Challenge proposed approaches constructively, including work involving AI and emerging technologies, by assessing technical fit, maintainability, security, data considerations and delivery risk.
Promote secure, maintainable and reusable engineering practices and identify opportunities to simplify or consolidate platforms and solutions.
Support delivery and operational escalations, ensuring clear communication between engineers, project teams, leadership and other IT groups.
Coordinate Application Engineering priorities and capability across EMEIA and APAC, support counselor activities and act as deputy to the Application Engineering leader when required.
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:
The role requires strong technical judgment and the ability to make pragmatic decisions across solution design, development, delivery and operational support. The successful candidate will anticipate technical and delivery risks, identify root causes, evaluate options and guide the team toward solutions that appropriately balance quality, security, maintainability, timelines and business needs. The role also requires the ability to prioritize across concurrent projects and operational demands and to influence outcomes across a globally distributed organization.
Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
The role requires deep hands-on data and application engineering capability together with the technical credibility to lead other engineers. For AI and emerging technologies, this means both personal technical proficiency and the ability to lead, review and constructively challenge engineers working with them. The candidate must be comfortable moving between technical design, coding, troubleshooting, code review, project technical leadership and regional coordination.
Primary skillset - must have
Strong hands-on Databricks experience, including use of PySpark and Spark SQL for data processing and transformation.
Strong hands-on Azure SQL and Azure Data Factory (ADF) experience for cloud data integration and transformation.
Strong Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL development experience, including on-premises solutions and SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
Strong practical GitHub experience for source-code management and collaborative development, including branching, pull requests, code reviews and merge-conflict resolution.
Practical Power BI experience to maintain, troubleshoot and enhance reporting solutions.
Working or junior-level Microsoft Power Apps and Power Automate knowledge sufficient to troubleshoot defects and deliver small enhancements to existing applications.
AI / emerging technologies - hands-on ability to use relevant AI-enabled development tools, services, APIs and Python libraries to prototype, build, integrate, test and troubleshoot practical solutions.
Ability to design solutions, develop and review code, unit test, troubleshoot and support enterprise applications.
Experience providing technical leadership to engineers while continuing to contribute directly to engineering delivery.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to work effectively in diverse, global and virtual teams.
Secondary skillset - nice to have
Broader Microsoft Azure development knowledge, particularly Azure Blob Storage and Azure Functions.
PowerShell, Microsoft Fabric
CI/CD knowledge supporting engineering and deployment practices (GitHub Actions)
Experience with Agile and Waterfall delivery approaches.
Relevant Microsoft Azure, Databricks, GitHub or related technical certifications.
Supervision Responsibilities:
The role provides counselor leadership for Application Engineering colleagues across EMEIA and APAC and technical leadership for engineers assigned to projects. The position acts as deputy to the Application Engineering leader and is expected to influence and guide colleagues across a global, matrix environment. Continued technical engagement is essential: the role should remain capable of operating as a hands-on technical leader rather than becoming a coordination-only people-management position.
Other Requirements:
Ability to work effectively with teams and stakeholders across EMEIA, APAC and other global regions.
Flexibility for occasional calls outside the home time zone where global project delivery or operational escalation requires it.
Comfort working across both established on-premises solutions and evolving Azure-based platforms.
Job Requirements:
To qualify, candidates must have:
A degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Substantial hands-on experience delivering enterprise applications and data solutions in complex organizational environments.
Demonstrated experience combining technical delivery with technical leadership, including guiding other engineers while remaining hands-on.
Experience working with both on-premises Microsoft technologies and Azure-based data or application engineering solutions.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, interpersonal and communication skills.
Ability to communicate fluently in English, both written and verbal.

Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.

Job Summary
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
At EY Technology, we understand that technology is the key to unlocking our clients potential and creating lasting value through innovation. We're building a better working world by providing EY and our clients the products, services, support & insights to win in the market.
We create value by helping clients solve complex business problems through differentiated technological solutions. We innovate in how we deliver products and support to the enterprise to enable our success.
And we achieve this by assuring our work and client information are safe from increasingly sophisticated threats.


The opportunity
The GDS Technology team is seeking an experienced Technical Manager to lead the solution architecture development for software solutions utilizing the Microsoft stack, including C#, .Net, SQL, Data Lake, as well as AI and ML technologies.
You will be responsible for designing and implementing highly modular, scalable, and robust applications, both on-premises and in the cloud, primarily using Azure. Your role will involve collaborating with teams to propagate best practices and formalize processes to ensure compliance and excellence in delivery.
As a champion for change and growth, you will be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
The opportunity is for self-driven and organized individuals who can learn and adopt new technologies and methodologies and is willing to innovate new things which can improve the existing technology.


Your key responsibilities
Lead the Solution Architecture team in developing software solutions predominantly using Microsoft Technology stack including C#, .Net, Angular, AI, ML and Advanced Analytics.
Oversee the solution delivery for complex projects, leveraging strong technical capabilities and hands-on experience.
Design and implement advanced software architectures and infrastructure architectures, ensuring alignment with business and user requirements.
Develop and integrate AI and ML solutions into software applications to enhance functionality and user experience.
Solve complex technical challenges in coding, testing, and deployment across various programming languages.
Take accountability for the design, development, delivery, and maintenance of solutions, driving compliance with relevant standards.
Engage in business development activities, including solutioning for pursuits and collaborating with sales teams to create compelling proposals.
Provide advanced technical expertise to maximize efficiency, reliability, and value from current solutions and emerging technologies.
Solves complex and escalated aspects of a project, performing coding, debugging, testing, and troubleshooting throughout the development process.
Develop strong working relationships with peers across Development & Engineering and Architecture teams to create leading solutions.


Skills and attributes for success

To qualify for the role, you must have
B.E/ B.Tech/ MCA/ MS or equivalent degree preferably in Computer Science discipline.
Minimum 10 - 15 years of experience in software development and architecture
Experience in architecting, designing and rolling-out enterprise scale business solutions using Angul - WebAPI - SQL tech stack
Hands-on experience with Azure services, including Azure App Services, SQL Server, Blob Storage, Synapse, ADF, DataBricks, and Azure Functions.
In-depth knowledge of AI/ML technologies, particularly in the context of Generative AI applications.


Ideally, You'll Also Have:
A solid understanding of Agile Development methodologies, along with experience using Azure DevOps and GIT.
Proven experience in large-scale technical implementations and digital transformation initiatives.
Exposure to Data Science, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning concepts.
Lead team in supporting and enhancing legacy apps built on top of .Net framework
Knowledge on PMI & Agile Standards
Industry recognized certifications in Azure offerings would be a plus

Job Title: Global Sustainability Finance Manager
Function:
Finance
Sub Function:
Global Sustainability
Job Summary:
Global Sustainability supports EY s growth ambitions by helping clients address critical sustainability and ESG priorities through multidisciplinary services.
This role provides an opportunity for a high-performing GDS Finance professional to join the Global Sustainability Finance team and gain direct exposure to the strategic and financial priorities shaping the Sustainability business and EY s All in strategy.
Working closely with the Global Sustainability Finance Lead and senior Sustainability stakeholders, the role will provide financial and Markets reporting, data analytics, management information and decision support. The successful candidate will combine strong financial acumen with Power BI, SQL, Excel and executive-level presentation skills to translate complex financial, sales and pipeline data into clear, actionable insights for leadership.
The role will also support GMIC and Executive Layer budget management, planning and forecasting, executive reporting, scenario modelling and Sustainability Finance initiatives, while working closely with the wider G&I, Program Management team, Markets stakeholders and Finance teams.
Key areas of responsibility:
Management information, leadership reporting and executive presentations
Financial, Markets, sales and pipeline analysis and insights
Power BI reporting, SQL-based analysis and data quality
GMIC and EL budget management and financial governance
Planning, budgeting, forecasting and scenario analysis
Sustainability Finance infrastructure and reporting structure
External survey and strategic data submissions
Ad hoc financial analysis and leadership decision support
Detailed responsibilities
Take operational ownership of weekly and monthly Sustainability financial and management reporting, providing clear analysis, commentary, insights and recommended actions. Maintain a robust month-end reporting process and ensure leadership reporting is timely and accurate.
Analyse Sustainability financial performance, Markets data, sales and pipeline information to identify trends, opportunities and areas requiring management attention. Translate complex information into clear messages and actionable insights for senior leadership.
Develop a strong understanding of the Global Sustainability Dashboard, Reporting Hub and underlying Markets and Finance data, ensuring consistency and integrity of management information.
Act as a key Finance contact for Global, Region and Service Line Sustainability stakeholders, building trusted relationships and supporting leadership with financial and operational decision-making.
Analyse and present complex financial, Markets, sales and pipeline data in a concise and visually effective manner, including through leadership presentations, Power BI dashboards and other management reporting.
Demonstrate hands-on proficiency in Power BI and SQL, translating agreed business and financial requirements into data queries, reporting views and analytical outputs. Support data validation and external survey submissions where required.
Support leadership in managing GMIC and Executive Layer budgets, including budget-versus-actual analysis, forecasting, spend monitoring and identification of risks and opportunities. Liaise with central Finance and initiative teams as required.
Lead and deliver ad hoc financial and business analysis in response to leadership requirements, including scenario modelling, projections, trend analysis and identification of key financial or operational issues.
Support Finance and Program initiatives including Sustainability Finance KPIs, external surveys, Budget vs. Actual scenarios, year-end accruals, planning, budgeting and forecasting (PBFA), revenue planning and Sustainability leadership reporting.
Maintain Sustainability Finance infrastructure, including Sustainability Topics, Global Service Codes and code blocks, working with Central Finance to ensure structures remain aligned with the Global Sustainability strategy and support data integrity.
Support firmwide strategic priorities relevant to Sustainability, including Growth & Innovation, AI-enabled transformation and other value-added initiatives.
Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:
Ability to independently analyse complex financial, Markets and operational information, identify underlying trends and issues, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations. The individual should exercise sound judgement, challenge assumptions where appropriate and provide high-quality insights that support leadership decision-making.

Supervision Responsibilities:
The role requires a high degree of independence and accountability for assigned deliverables. The individual should be able to manage workstreams end-to-end, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and provide guidance or oversight to team members where required.

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:
Strong financial, analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently assess issues and develop practical solutions.
Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, including analysis of large datasets and preparation of senior leadership presentations.
Strong hands-on Power BI capability and working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to develop moderately complex queries for reporting and analytical requirements.
Strong understanding of financial reporting, management information, budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
Experience analysing Markets, sales, pipeline or commercial performance data would be highly desirable.
Ability to convert complex financial and operational data into clear, concise and actionable leadership insights.
Strong stakeholder-management skills and the confidence to engage with senior Finance and business leaders.
Ability to constructively challenge existing processes and recommendations and build alignment across multiple stakeholders.
Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deliver to challenging deadlines in a global and virtual environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong executive presentation capability.
Understanding of EY s business model and Finance/Markets reporting environment would be advantageous.
Experience leading workstreams and/or junior team members is preferred.
Strong spoken and written English.
Other Requirements:
The role will operate in a global environment and requires flexibility to collaborate across time zones. Hybrid working arrangements will apply in accordance with GDS India policies.

Job Requirements:
Education:
Bachelor s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Professional accounting qualification is preferred.
Experience:
Minimum 9 - 12 years of relevant experience in Finance, management reporting, business analysis or Markets reporting, with demonstrated experience in financial analysis and leadership reporting.
Advanced skills in financial/markets reporting, developing innovative reporting frameworks, data analysis and performance measurements.
Experience working with Power BI and large datasets, with exposure to SQL-based reporting analysis.
Experience working in a global, matrixed organization and engaging with senior stakeholders is preferred.
Certification Requirements:
Professional accounting qualification (e.g., CA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) is preferred but not mandatory.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively in a global, cross functional team environment.
Flexibility in managing work hours due to the volatile nature of Application Management work including ability to do shifts and being on call for critical business requirements
Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
