Job Introduction:
Job Title: Security Officer
Department: Operations - Manned Guarding
Reports To: Site In-charge / Assignment Manager / Branch Operations Manager
Company: G4S Secure Solutions (India) Pvt. Ltd.
Position Summary:
The Security Officer acts as the operational lead at the site level, responsible for implementing security procedures, supervising guard personnel, coordinating with clients, and ensuring all security and safety standards are consistently met. This is a critical leadership role that bridges field operations and client expectations.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Site Command and Control:
Function as the second-in-command or site head (depending on site size).
Lead and monitor all security operations at the designated client site.
Ensure guards follow all post duties, site-specific instructions (SSIs), and G4S protocols.
2. Team Supervision:
Supervise the deployment and performance of Security Supervisors and Guards.
Conduct daily muster, uniform inspection, and tool checks.
Address absenteeism, disciplinary issues, and performance shortfalls.
3. Client Coordination:
Serve as the primary point of contact for the client at the site.
Conduct regular meetings with client representatives to address concerns or updates.
Ensure client satisfaction through prompt issue resolution and quality service delivery.
4. Operational Execution:
Ensure access control systems, patrolling routines, visitor management, and asset protection are functioning as per SOP.
Monitor surveillance systems and review CCTV footage in coordination with client security teams.
Supervise material movement, vehicle access, and contractor/staff entry protocols.
5. Incident Management:
Act promptly in case of incidents like theft, fire, medical emergencies, or safety violations.
Guide guards during emergencies and implement evacuation protocols as needed.
File detailed incident and investigation reports with photographic/log support.
6. Documentation & Reporting:
Maintain daily shift logs, occurrence reports, visitor data, and material movement records.
Prepare and submit weekly performance summaries and manpower deployment reports.
Ensure all statutory registers (muster rolls, PF, ESI) are updated and audit-ready.
7. Training & Compliance:
Conduct on-the-job training, drills, and refreshers for site guards.
Ensure adherence to G4S grooming, behavior, and discipline standards.
Support HR and compliance teams during audits, inspections, or client reviews.
Eligibility Criteria:
Education: Minimum 12th Pass; Graduate preferred.
Experience:
4-8 years of experience in the security industry, with at least 2 years in a supervisory or officer-level role.
Background in defence/police/paramilitary preferred.
Age: 28 to 50 years (Flexible for ex-servicemen).
Physical Standards: Fit and alert; Minimum height 170 cm.
Key Skills & Attributes:
Strong leadership and coordination skills.
Good written and verbal communication (English, Hindi, and local language).
Proficiency in report writing, basic computer use (MS Office, email).
Knowledge of safety procedures, emergency protocols, and fire prevention.
Ability to handle pressure and work rotational shifts.
Working Conditions:
Site-based duty with 8/12-hour shifts depending on deployment.
6-day work week or rotational off, as per duty schedule.
Uniform, mobile phone (if applicable), ID card, and duty gear provided.
PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, leave benefits, and insurance as per statutory norms.
Remuneration:
As per G4S internal grade structure and prevailing Minimum Wages for Security Officer/Supervisor category in the respective state/UT.
Site-based allowances, night duty allowance, and performance incentives may apply.

Security Officer Site In-charge Assignment Manager Area Operations Officer Regional Operations Manager

Civil Execution Engineer / Manager

Job Location - Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata, Bangalore, Vizag, Sanand, NCR, Bhubaneswar, Sambalpur, Tarapur,

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Senior Civil Execution Engineer with 4 -15 years of experience in high-rise residential and commercial building projects. The candidate will be responsible for planning, execution, monitoring, and timely completion of civil works while ensuring quality, safety, and adherence to project schedules.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute and supervise RCC, finishing, and structural activities at site.
Coordinate with consultants, contractors, and stakeholders for smooth project execution.
Monitor project progress, manpower, materials, and equipment utilization.
Ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, quality, and safety standards.
Conduct site inspections, review work progress, and resolve execution-related issues.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports.
Verify subcontractor bills, quantities, and measurements.
Ensure timely completion of milestones within budget and quality requirements.

Requirements:

B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
8-12 years of experience in high-rise residential, industrial and commercial projects.
Strong knowledge of RCC, finishing works, project execution, and quality management.
Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Office, and project planning tools.
Good communication, coordination, and team management skills.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), MCP (Model Context Protocol), and AI Agent Frameworks. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous agents, and advanced retrieval systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop AI-powered applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build and deploy Agentic AI solutions capable of autonomous reasoning and task execution.
Implement RAG architectures using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
Develop integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI tool and data connectivity.
Build multi-agent systems using modern Agent Frameworks.
Fine-tune prompts and optimize LLM performance for business use cases.
Develop AI workflows for document processing, knowledge management, and conversational AI.
Integrate AI services with enterprise applications using APIs and microservices.
Collaborate with data scientists, product teams, and software engineers to deliver AI solutions.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend best practices.
Required Skills
2-6 years of software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models.
Experience building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Knowledge of Agentic AI architectures and autonomous AI agents.
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration and AI tooling.
Hands-on experience with AI Agent Frameworks such as:
LangGraph
LangChain
CrewAI
AutoGen
Semantic Kernel
LlamaIndex
Experience with Vector Databases:
Pinecone
ChromaDB
Weaviate
Milvus
FAISS
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Open Source LLMs.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI application development.
Experience with REST APIs and Microservices.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with AI Observability and Evaluation Tools.
Knowledge of Fine-Tuning and Model Optimization.
Experience with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Exposure to NLP, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning concepts.
Knowledge of CI/CD for AI deployments (LLMOps).
Experience building AI Chatbots, AI Assistants, and Enterprise Search solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.

Description:
Job Role : Security Assignment Manager
Location: Mumbai & Pune

Job Description :
1. Graduate with 7 to 10 years in the security field, including 3 years of supervisory experience. Certification in security/fire and experience in the Banking Sector will be an added advantage.
2. Must possess a valid Police verification certificate prior to deployment in client sites.
3. Fluency in reading, writing, and speaking English and the regional language is preferred. Ability to comprehend and follow written and verbal communications.
4. Working knowledge in MS office (word, excel & power point), outlook mail and proficiency in report writing.
5. Overall-in-charge of outsourced physical security personnel deployed at the Client facility, manage & monitor the performance of supervisory level and guarding staff.
6. Conduct risk assessment to ensure compliance with security procedures and update Client's Corporate Security Manager about incident/issues.
7. Be a connecting bridge between the Supplier and Client's Corporate Security for smooth operations and also maintain good relationship with other internal stakeholders.
8. Manage recruitment, deployment and leave plan of security manpower, prepare and manage weekly/monthly shift schedule for physical security personnel for adequate staffing of guard.
9. Responsible for physical security personnels appearance, turnout, and discipline at Client's facilities. Escalate any disciplinary issues to the Client's Corporate Security Manager immediately.
10. Ensure 100% compliance of all documentation of security personnel including Police verification before the deployment at Client's facilities. Keep a track of Police verification for all security personnel and reconcile on monthly basis.
11. Ensure complete statutory compliance of all security personnel (wages, PF, ESI, wage dispersing, weekly- off, OT, leave, vacancies. and submitting of security deployment monthly reports, deduction details if any as per SLA every month as directed by Client Corporate Security Manager.
12. Ensure security personnel perform their designated duties and responsibilities. Take care of registers and maintenance of records at the security desks. Reconcile and sign on daily/weekly/fortnightly basis as instructed by Client's Corporate Security Manager.
13. Ensure 24X7 alertness of security personnel periodical and surprise night checks to check the alertness of security personnel and ensure all the areas are secure.
14. Provide Security escort for Women employees availing cab facility and ensure Breath Analyzer test is carried out for cab drivers and escort security.
15. Ensure the safety and security of lady supervisors and guards and all grievance of security personnel grievances are addressed in timely and appropriate manner.
16. Respond to any security, fire and any emergency related incidents. Be aware of location of fire extinguishers and other safety equipment placed in the Client's facility and ensure all security personnel are trained in firefighting.
17. Shall perform any other security-related work assigned to him from time to time by Corporate Security team.

Description:
We are looking for experienced and quality-driven Quality Analysts HCC Medical Coding to join our growing team.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on expertise in HCC and ICD-10-CM coding, practical quality auditing experience, and the ability to drive coder performance through effective feedback and continuous improvement.
Eligibility & Requirements
Graduate/Postgraduate in Life Sciences or Allied Medical Sciences (BHMS, BAMS, BPT, BDS, Nursing, Pharmacy, etc.).
Certified Medical Coder with AAPC/AHIMA credentials (CPC, CCS, CCS-P, CPC-H).
Minimum 4 years of relevant medical coding experience, including hands-on quality auditing experience.
Strong practical knowledge of HCC and ICD-10-CM coding.
Good understanding of risk adjustment coding, HCC capture, MEAT criteria, diagnosis validation, and documentation requirements.
Strong knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, and pathophysiology.
Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Key Responsibilities
Perform quality audits of medical records to ensure accurate HCC and ICD-10-CM coding.
Identify missed HCCs, unsupported diagnoses, coding discrepancies, and documentation gaps.
Provide daily error feedback to coders with clear explanations, coding rationale, and guideline references.
Conduct coder coaching and training to improve coding accuracy and minimize recurring errors.
Analyze error trends, perform root cause analysis, and drive quality improvement initiatives.
Review coder rebuttals and participate in calibration sessions with SMEs and operations teams.
Ensure compliance with coding guidelines, client requirements, HIPAA, and internal quality standards.
Stay updated with ICD-10-CM guidelines and HCC model changes.
Meet defined quality, productivity, and turnaround time (TAT) targets.
Key Expectations
We are looking for QA professionals who can independently perform audits, demonstrate strong HCC and ICD-10 coding knowledge, provide effective daily error feedback, and take ownership of improving coder performance and overall quality metrics.
Interested candidates can share their updated resumes or connect with us for further details.

About the Role:
We are looking for an organized and detail-oriented Vendor Management Executive to oversee
vendor-related activities and support the sourcing process. This role involves managing documentation,
tracking deliverables, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring smooth operational flow.

What Youll Be Owning
1. Vendor Management
Identify, evaluate, and onboard vendors for Recruitment services (India and US), US SME
sourcing, freelancer talent pools, and project-based outsourcing
Manage contract negotiations, rate finalizations, and Service Level Agreement (SLA)
definitions.
Track vendor performance, quality of submissions, and fulfillment timelines.
Maintain a live vendor database, contract repository, rate cards, and engagement trackers.
Coordinate closely with the US Sourcing Team to align on talent needs.
Support pricing discussions, RFP/RFQ processes, and build scalable sourcing pipelines.
Present regular vendor performance reports, dashboards, and procurement health metrics
to leadership

2. Invoicing & Financial Coordination
Manage vendor invoices, verify accuracy, and ensure timely processing.
Maintain invoice trackers and reconcile discrepancies.
Coordinate with Finance for approvals and payment follow-ups.
Statement of Work (SOW) Management
Create, review, and maintain Statements of Work and related documentation.
Track SOW timelines, extensions, renewals, and closures.
Ensure compliance with internal policies and governance standards.

3. Tracking & Reporting
Maintain trackers for vendor activity, deliverables, and project status.
Generate periodic reports (weekly/monthly) for leadership and sourcing teams.
Monitor contract expiration dates, project progress, and resource utilization.

4. Database & Documentation Maintenance
Maintain accurate databases related to vendors, agreements, and project records.
Ensure data integrity and timely updates in internal systems/tools.
Organize and store documents for audit readiness

5. Coordination & Stakeholder Management
Act as a liaison between the Outsourcing team and the Sourcing team.
Support sourcing activities by providing required data and documentation.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams for smooth process execution.
Handle vendor communication where needed

Success in This Role
8-10 years of experience in vendor management, procurement, or sourcing operations.
Previous experience with managing a team.
Strong experience in US sourcing and vendor ecosystems (mandatory).
Solid negotiation, contract management, and vendor relationship-building skills.
Proficiency in Excel, vendor management platforms, Zoho Recruit, or similar systems.
Exposure to freelance workforce models, SME staffing, and project outsourcing
management

Description:
Key Responsibilities
1. Digital Deployment Strategy
Define the overall deployment and rollout strategy for enterprise digital products, platforms, and services.
Develop deployment roadmaps covering PoC, Pilot, MVP, Production, Phased Rollout, and Enterprise Scale.
Determine rollout sequencing across business units, locations, channels, customer segments, or operating environments.
Identify deployment dependencies, constraints, risks, assumptions, and readiness requirements early in the lifecycle.
Define repeatable deployment frameworks, playbooks, and patterns that can be used across multiple digital initiatives.
Align deployment strategy with business priorities, technology strategy, enterprise architecture, security requirements, and operational capabilities.
2. Solutioning & Deployment Architecture
Translate business and product requirements into deployable enterprise solutions.
Lead solutioning discussions across application, API, integration, cloud, data, AI, security, infrastructure, and operations.
Work with Enterprise and Solution Architects to determine the appropriate technical approach and deployment model.
Assess build, buy, partner, reuse, and platform-based options.
Identify gaps in existing enterprise capabilities that could prevent successful deployment.
Ensure solutions are designed with production deployment, scalability, resilience, security, observability, and supportability in mind.
3. Cross-functional Program Orchestration
Drive execution across multiple product, engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, operations, business, and partner teams.
Establish a common deployment plan with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and decision points.
Track cross-team dependencies and actively drive closure of blockers.
Manage deployment risks, issues, assumptions, and escalations.
Establish governance and operating cadence for large or strategically important rollout programs.
Ensure all participating teams remain aligned to the deployment objective, timelines, and production outcomes.
Facilitate executive-level reviews and decision-making where cross-functional intervention is required.
4. Deployment Readiness
Define and manage deployment readiness criteria across technology and business dimensions.
Ensure readiness of environments, infrastructure, integrations, data, security controls, observability, support processes, documentation, and operational teams.
Coordinate UAT, pilot readiness, production readiness, cutover, and go-live activities.
Identify gaps that may create operational or business risk after launch.
Establish readiness checkpoints and ensure exceptions are explicitly assessed and managed.
5. Product Rollout & Enterprise Scale
Drive successful production deployment and phased rollout of digital products and services.
Coordinate launch activities across technology and business teams.
Monitor deployment progress, adoption, operational issues, and business readiness during rollout.
Lead resolution of issues that prevent or delay deployment and scale.
Define expansion strategies for successful pilots and early deployments.
Standardize successful deployment approaches for reuse across other products, business units, and markets.
6. Business & Stakeholder Alignment
Work closely with business leaders and product teams to understand deployment objectives, constraints, and expected outcomes.
Translate business priorities into actionable deployment strategies and execution plans.
Communicate complex technical dependencies and risks in a clear business context.
Build alignment across stakeholders with potentially conflicting priorities.
Drive timely decisions on scope, sequencing, dependencies, investment, and deployment approach.
Act as a key interface between business leadership and technology execution teams.
7. Technology & Platform Readiness
Assess whether existing enterprise platforms and technology capabilities are sufficient to support large-scale deployment.
Drive reuse of enterprise capabilities such as identity, integration, data, cloud, AI, observability, security, and common platforms.
Identify platform capabilities that need to be enhanced to enable product rollout.
Promote standardization of deployment and integration approaches across digital initiatives.
Ensure new deployments do not create unnecessary technology duplication or fragmented architectures.
8. Partner & Vendor Orchestration
Work with system integrators, technology vendors, cloud providers, startups, and strategic partners involved in deployment.
Define technical and delivery boundaries between internal and external teams.
Review partner solution approaches and deployment plans.
Ensure partner dependencies and deliverables are aligned with enterprise rollout milestones.
Drive resolution of cross-partner integration and deployment issues.
9. Post-deployment Scale & Continuous Improvement
Ensure structured transition from implementation into stable business-as-usual operations.
Track deployment outcomes, adoption, operational performance, and user feedback.
Identify recurring deployment bottlenecks and opportunities for process or platform improvement.
Capture lessons learned and convert them into reusable deployment patterns.
Continuously improve the enterprise approach to digital rollout and scale.
Key Deliverables
The role will own or contribute to:
Enterprise deployment and rollout strategies
Deployment roadmaps and rollout plans
Solutioning and deployment approaches
Pilot-to-production plans
Cross-functional execution plans
Deployment readiness frameworks and checklists
Dependency, risk, issue, and escalation management
Cutover and go-live plans
Deployment playbooks and reusable rollout patterns
Production-readiness assessments
Scale-up and enterprise adoption strategies
Executive deployment reviews and decision papers
Success Measures
Success in this role will be demonstrated through:
Successful and timely deployment of digital products and services
Reduction in time from pilot to production
Successful enterprise rollout and coverage
Reduction in deployment-related blockers and delays
Effectiveness of cross-functional execution across multiple teams
Production readiness and operational stability after launch
Adoption and utilization of deployed capabilities
Reuse of enterprise platforms and deployment patterns
Reduction in duplicated technology and implementation effort
Ability to scale successful pilots across the enterprise
Required Experience & Skills
5+ years of experience in digital transformation, enterprise technology, solutioning, technology strategy, product deployment, program delivery, or related roles.
Demonstrated experience in large-scale deployment or rollout of digital products, platforms, or technology services.
Strong experience coordinating multiple technology and business teams toward a common production outcome.
Strong understanding of enterprise technology and solution architecture.
Experience working across:
Cloud and hybrid-cloud environments
APIs and enterprise integration
Distributed systems and microservices
Data platforms and event-driven architectures
AI / ML / GenAI platforms
Identity and cybersecurity
Kubernetes and modern application platforms
Observability and production operations
CI/CD and DevSecOps
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles and technology governance.
Ability to evaluate technology options based on business value, scalability, cost, deployment complexity, risk, and time-to-market.
Strong program management capabilities, including dependency management, risk management, stakeholder alignment, governance, and escalation.
Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with senior business and technology leadership.
Preferred Experience
Experience deploying digital products across multiple business units or large enterprise environments.
Experience in enterprise digital transformation and platform-led transformation.
Experience across one or more major cloud platforms such as AWS, OCI, etc.
Experience with AI/GenAI solution deployment and enterprise adoption.
Experience working with system integrators, technology partners, and strategic vendors.
Experience in complex environments involving legacy systems, multiple technology stacks, regulatory requirements, or geographically distributed operations.
Experience creating reusable enterprise deployment methodologies and operating models.

This person will lead the design of AI-led and AI-enabled enterprise solutions from sales qualification through contract award. Partnering with Sales and clients, the role will translate business requirements into scalable solution architectures and compelling RFP/proposal responses. The position is revenue-facing, with success measured by solution quality and conversion of opportunities into signed business. The architect will guide delivery teams post-award to ensure alignment between the proposed and delivered solution. Strong enterprise application/platform expertise is essential, with the ability to identify where AI creates genuine business value and where conventional solutions are more appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Advisory and Thought Partnership
Serve as a principal technical consultant throughout the sales lifecycle, collaborating with stakeholders to refine business problems prior to architectural mapping.
Evaluate client infrastructure, data maturity, and operational workflows to architect pragmatic and sustainable AI implementation roadmaps.
Provide expert guidance on the functional utility and constraints of AI, distinguishing between high-value AI use cases and areas where traditional methods excel.
Enhance the organization's market presence by contributing to executive briefings, industry workshops, and thought leadership collateral regarding AI in education.
Prioritize organizational change readiness and stakeholder alignment as critical success factors, ensuring technical architectures are sequenced for successful adoption.
Pre-Sales Support and Lead Response
Act as the lead technical authority for the sales organization on all high-potential enterprise opportunities.
Provide technical qualification, comprehensive effort modeling, and conceptual solutioning for incoming qualified leads.
Lead discovery sessions and deep-dive requirement gathering with prospective enterprise clients.
Advise leadership on technical feasibility, risk profiles, and strategic differentiation to improve competitive win rates.
Proposal and RFP Development
Develop high-quality technical content for RFPs, RFI responses, and detailed Statements of Work (SOWs).
Deconstruct complex bid requirements to align organizational capabilities with client needs, identifying strategic build or partner opportunities.
Produce sophisticated AI architecture visualizations, technical narratives, and operational assumptions for client-facing submissions.
Define robust positions on data privacy, model governance, and ethical AI mitigation to satisfy rigorous procurement and security reviews.
Collaborate across legal, finance, and delivery teams to ensure technical solutions remain consistent with commercial objectives and timelines.
Optimize bid turnaround by maintaining a centralized repository of validated architectural patterns and solution templates.
Solution Design and Architecture
Contextualize requirements within specific industry domains, including EdTech, publishing, Life Sciences, BFSI, and manufacturing.
Architect modular, AI-centric enterprise solutions designed to solve business challenges within complex technical constraints.
Deploy optimized AI methodologies, ranging from RAG and LLM applications to agentic workflows and traditional ML as required.
Integrate rigorous evaluation frameworks, human-in-the-loop protocols, and safety guardrails as foundational elements of the system design.
Establish comprehensive integration frameworks, data lineage, and infrastructure requirements for end-to-end delivery.
Analyze buy-vs-build scenarios to recommend the most efficient and scalable deployment strategy.
Quantify and articulate the trade-offs between accuracy, latency, and operational costs for AI-driven approaches.
Engineer holistic enterprise ecosystems including non-functional requirements (SLAs, scalability, observability) and secure integrations with legacy systems (CRM, ERP, LMS) via robust API patterns.
Harmonize traditional and AI technologies within a unified architecture to ensure optimal system performance and reliability.
Generate standardized EA artifacts, including reference architectures and decision records, aligned with client data and cloud governance.
Formulate Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models, encompassing licensing, capacity planning, and scaling economics for AI solutions.
Prototyping and Demonstrations
Develop high-impact proofs of concept (PoCs) and functional prototypes to demonstrate the tangible value of AI solutions.
Deliver customized technical demonstrations that speak directly to the client's unique operational context and pain points.
Iterate on architectural designs based on stakeholder feedback from prototype reviews to ensure final submission alignment.
Client Presentation and Stakeholder Engagement
Present complex architectures to C-suite leadership, procurement committees, and specialized academic governing bodies.
Champion technical strategies during bid reviews and provide evidence-based responses to technical clarifications.
Address concerns regarding AI ethics, IP protection, and data security with technical depth and industry-specific insight.
Calibrate technical communication to suit varied audiences, from business stakeholders to deep-technical and procurement specialists.
Qualifications & Experience
Experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, or Solution Engineering, with strong client-facing and revenue-linked exposure.
Proven expertise architecting large-scale, mission-critical enterprise platforms, across both AI and non-AI solutions, with strong integration, API, cloud, data, security, IAM, and DevOps capabilities.
Hands-on experience delivering production-grade AI solutions, including LLMs, RAG, agentic/multi-agent workflows, prompt/context engineering, evaluation, guardrails, and human oversight.
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, privacy, IP, bias, transparency, and compliance, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, DPDP, HIPAA/GxP, security, and data residency.
Proven ability to lead technical proposals/RFPs, client-facing POCs/prototypes, multi-vendor bids, and advise senior stakeholders on AI strategy, adoption, and organizational readiness.
Experience with enterprise learning technology including LMS/LXP, SCORM, xAPI, LTI, WCAG 2.2, and Section 508; exposure to academic/institutional governance is preferred.
Excellent technical writing, presentations, stakeholder advisory, Agile/Scrum, and modern front-end/rapid AI prototyping skills, with public contributions to AI/learning technology preferred.
Bachelors degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent; cloud certification (AWS/Azure/GCP), Scrum certification, and TOGAF/Enterprise Architecture certification or equivalent experience preferred.

About us:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Paytm provides consumers with services like utility payments and money transfers, while empowering them to pay via Paytm Payment Instruments (PPI) like Paytm Wallet, Paytm UPI, Paytm Payments Bank Netbanking, Paytm FASTag and Paytm Postpaid - Buy Now, Pay Later. To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks financial instruments. To further enhance merchants business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. Operating on this platform leverage, the company then offers credit services such as merchant loans, personal loans and BNPL, sourced by its financial partners.

About the team: EDC Retail – EDC is one of Paytm‘s business tools to help merchants grow and manage their business through simplicity and data driven technology.

About the role:
The person should be capable of increasing the sale of EDC machines through proper channels to the merchants across multiple locations.
Expectations/ Requirements :
1. Create an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture
2. Need to drive swiping device sales in the assigned area.
3. Resolving merchant queries 
4. Drive overall engage merchant base 
5. Capable of hiring and building team
6. Set clear team goals
7. Delegate tasks and set deadlines
8. Oversee day-to-day operation
9. Monitor team performance and report on metrics
10 .Motivate team members
11. Discover training needs and provide coaching
12 .Listen to team members feedback and resolve any issues or conflicts
13. Recognize high performance and reward accomplishments
14. Encourage creativity and risk-taking
15. Suggest and organize team building activities

Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role  
1. High level of drive, initiative and self-motivation
2. Must Have Experience in Leading Team
3. Must Be a Graduate
4. Growth Mindset

Why join us :
We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Our success is rooted in our people’s collective energy and unwavering focus on the customers, and that’s how it will always be. We are the largest merchant acquirer in India.

Qualification:- Graduate/Post Graduate

Vendor Management & Expediting
Drive proactive vendor engagement with a go-getter attitude to ensure timely deliveries.

Track delivery performance, escalate critical delays, and ensure adherence to monthly supply plans.

Develop and maintain procurement dashboards for performance tracking and reporting.

Operational Procurement & P2P Cycle

Ensure the Long Lead Time parts are well planned based on Season requirement
Supplier RM wise (ABS) monitoring and ensure uninterpreted supplies.

Inventory & Material Management
Manage raw material inventory and refine lead times based on plant requirements.
Measure and report RM/component availability against production plans.
FSN Analysis & Aging Inventory Analysis
Indirect Purchase (Opex/Capex) Experience.

Governance & Compliance
Ensure adherence to government norms related to taxation, safety, and environmental regulations.
Apply 5S, QC tools, and process control charts to enhance procurement operations.
Support corporate SCM initiatives across logistics, planning, strategic sourcing, and supplier development.
Desired Skills & Experience
Strong analytical and communication skills.
Exposure to vendor negotiations, import/export regulations, and compliance frameworks.
SAP End user skill level important
Must have experience in relevant Consumer durable /Appliance industry, handled Metals/Plastics/Packaging/Fabrication item.
Indirect purchase experience

Description:
Key Responsibilities
Image Interpretation & Reporting: Analyze X-rays, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and nuclear/PET scans to detect abnormalities and prepare clear diagnostic reports.
Clinical Consultation: Advise referring physicians and specialists on choosing the right imaging study, correlating results with patient history, and managing critical or urgent findings.
Image-Guided & Interventional Procedures: Perform or assist with minimally invasive procedures (such as biopsies, drainages, or vascular interventions) and evaluate contrast safety or patient risks.
Supervision, Safety & Quality: Guide radiologic technologists, enforce radiation safety and infection control protocols, and maintain image quality standards.
Teaching & Administration (Setting-Dependent): Train residents/technologists, participate in clinical audits or research, or support remote teleradiology reporting.

Qualifications & Core Skills
Education & Licensure: Medical degree (such as MBBS) plus postgraduate MD in Radiology (3 years in India) and active medical registration/licensure; optional 12 year sub-specialty fellowships are common.
Technical & Analytical Skills: Strong cross-sectional and anatomical knowledge, visual pattern recognition, attention to detail, and familiarity with PACS/imaging workflows.
Workplace & Soft Skills: Clear communication with clinicians and patients, sound clinical judgment, and adaptability in hospitals, diagnostic centers, or teleradiology settings.

Description:
Senior Resident Paediatrics

Role Overview
The Senior Resident Paediatrics is a full-time, post-MD/DNB clinical and academic tenure position at a leading university-run super speciality teaching hospital and medical college integrating compassionate care, advanced medicine, teaching and research. The role delivers round-the-clock paediatric and neonatal care across the wards, emergency, NICU, PICU and outpatient services, while supporting the training of undergraduate and postgraduate medical students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of the Department of Paediatrics through the assigned unit faculty and supervises Junior Residents, interns and nursing teams on duty. It is a tenure position of up to 3 years under National Medical Commission (NMC) norms, suited to a qualified paediatrician seeking clinical depth alongside teaching and research exposure.

Work Mode
Work mode: work from hospital (fully on-site), with working days per hospital/NMC norms, including duty, on-call and emergency rosters as assigned by the department. No travel requirement has been specified for this role.

Key Responsibilities
Provide first-line senior clinical care to neonates, infants, children and adolescents admitted to paediatric wards, NICU and PICU, including daily rounds and clinical decision-making.
Assess, stabilise and manage paediatric and neonatal emergencies, including resuscitation, shock, respiratory distress, seizures, sepsis and poisoning.
Lead neonatal resuscitation at high-risk deliveries and caesarean sections in coordination with the obstetrics team.
Perform and supervise essential procedures such as endotracheal intubation, umbilical and peripheral vascular access, lumbar puncture, intraosseous access and surfactant administration, as clinically indicated.
Initiate and monitor respiratory support, including oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation, under faculty guidance.
Conduct paediatric outpatient and specialty clinics, including growth and development assessment, nutrition counselling, well-baby care and follow-up of high-risk newborns.
Implement immunisation services in line with the national immunisation schedule and Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) recommendations, including counselling of parents.
Take on-call and emergency duties as per the departmental roster, ensuring timely handover and continuity of care across shifts.
Teach and mentor MBBS students, interns and Junior Residents through bedside teaching, case presentations, skills sessions and assessments under competency-based medical education.
Maintain accurate, timely and legally sound medical records, including admission notes, progress notes, consent, discharge summaries and death certification.
Communicate clearly and compassionately with parents and families on diagnosis, prognosis and treatment plans, including breaking difficult news and obtaining informed consent.
Adhere to infection control, antimicrobial stewardship, patient safety and quality protocols, and participate in clinical audits and mortality and morbidity reviews.
Participate in departmental academic activities and clinical research, including journal clubs, seminars, case reports and approved research projects.
Coordinate with paediatric surgery, obstetrics, radiology, laboratory and other super speciality teams for multidisciplinary care and timely referrals.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a medical college recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MD (Paediatrics) or DNB (Paediatrics) from an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited institution, completed with results declared by the date of joining.
Valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, with the postgraduate qualification registered or eligible for registration.
Age below 45 years at initial appointment, as per prevailing NMC norms for Senior Residents in broad specialties.

Required Experience
Experience range: 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB paediatric clinical experience. Freshly qualified MD/DNB Paediatrics doctors are eligible to apply.
Relevant experience: postgraduate residency in Paediatrics with substantial rotations in NICU, PICU, paediatric emergency and general paediatric wards in a tertiary care or teaching hospital.
Preferred experience: prior work as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in Paediatrics in a medical college, teaching hospital or multi-specialty tertiary care hospital.
Industry preference: medical colleges, university teaching hospitals, super speciality hospitals and high-volume tertiary paediatric or neonatal care centres.

Technical and Functional Skills
Neonatal resuscitation and stabilisation in line with Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) and National Neonatology Forum (NNF) guidelines.
Paediatric emergency and critical care management in line with Paediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS) principles, including airway, breathing and circulation support.
Working knowledge of respiratory support: oxygen therapy, CPAP, high-flow nasal cannula and conventional mechanical ventilation.
Procedural competence: intubation, umbilical venous and arterial catheterisation, intraosseous access, lumbar puncture, surfactant administration and exchange transfusion.
Fluid, electrolyte and nutritional management, including parenteral nutrition in neonates and critically ill children.
Management of neonatal jaundice, prematurity, sepsis, respiratory distress, malnutrition, diarrhoeal disease and common infectious diseases of childhood.
Interpretation of blood gases, laboratory results and paediatric and neonatal imaging.
Growth monitoring, developmental assessment, immunisation practice and preventive paediatrics.
Clinical documentation on hospital information systems or electronic medical records, and adherence to evidence-based IAP and NNF protocols.
Bedside teaching and assessment methods under competency-based medical education.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Compassionate, family-centred communication with children and parents, including counselling under stress and breaking difficult news.
Composure, sound judgement and rapid decision-making during emergencies and night duties.
Team leadership on duty, guiding Junior Residents, interns and nursing staff with clarity and respect.
Collaboration with faculty, nursing, allied health and other clinical departments.
Strong professional ethics, integrity, patient confidentiality and respect for child rights and safeguarding.
Teaching aptitude, patience and a willingness to mentor learners.
Time management, reliability on rosters and accountability for patient outcomes.
Cultural sensitivity and the ability to communicate with patients from diverse linguistic and social backgrounds.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Valid NRP, PALS and Basic Life Support (BLS) certifications.
Fellowship or certificate training in Neonatology, Paediatric Critical Care or a related paediatric subspecialty.
Publications, case reports or conference presentations in Paediatrics or Neonatology.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research and exposure to medical education workshops.
Membership of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (IAP) or National Neonatology Forum (NNF).
Exposure to hospital quality, accreditation and patient safety programmes.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate has completed MD or DNB Paediatrics at a reputed NMC-recognised medical college or NBEMS-accredited hospital with a high patient load, and has trained across neonatal, paediatric intensive care, emergency and general paediatric services. Candidates with 0–3 years of post-MD/DNB experience as Senior Resident, Specialist or Registrar in recognised teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary care centres are preferred, as are those with a stable, verifiable work record. The role suits doctors building a career in academic paediatrics or preparing for super-speciality training, as Senior Resident experience in a recognised teaching institution is relevant to NMC eligibility norms for teaching faculty positions.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is offered as a competitive annual CTC (Total Cost to Company) in Indian Rupees (), commensurate with qualification, experience and institutional norms. Benefits follow institutional policy and are shared with shortlisted candidates at the offer stage. The role offers structured clinical exposure across neonatal and paediatric critical care, protected involvement in teaching and research, and the experience of working in a super speciality academic environment.

Application Instructions
Send your resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – Paediatrics", via email to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message, or by WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include copies of your MBBS and MD/DNB certificates, your medical registration, a summary of NICU and PICU exposure, and your current notice period. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete the screening questionnaire and appear for an interview.

Description:
Role Overview
The Senior Resident General Surgery is a full-time, post-MS/DNB clinical and academic position in the Department of General Surgery of a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university. The role combines hands-on operative surgery, round-the-clock emergency and trauma care, ward and outpatient management, and structured teaching of undergraduate and postgraduate students. The Senior Resident reports to the Head of Department and works under the supervision of Professors, Associate Professors and Assistant Professors, while supervising Junior Residents, interns and the unit's clinical team. The position bridges postgraduate training and an independent teaching-faculty career, building the Senior Residency experience recognised under National Medical Commission (NMC) regulations.

Work Mode
Work from hospital (on-site at the teaching hospital), duty days per NMC norms, including rostered on-call, night and emergency duties; no regular travel is expected.

Key Responsibilities
Perform elective general surgical procedures as primary surgeon or first assistant, including hernia repair, appendicectomy, cholecystectomy, and breast, thyroid and soft-tissue surgery, with consultant supervision as appropriate.
Manage acute surgical emergencies and polytrauma, including resuscitation, primary and secondary survey, emergency laparotomy and timely escalation to consultants.
Conduct surgical outpatient clinics, evaluating new and follow-up patients and planning investigations, conservative treatment or surgery.
Lead daily ward rounds, preoperative assessment and optimisation, and postoperative care, with early recognition and management of complications.
Obtain valid, documented informed consent and counsel patients and families on diagnosis, procedure, risks and expected outcomes.
Perform and assist in laparoscopic procedures, such as diagnostic laparoscopy, laparoscopic appendicectomy and laparoscopic cholecystectomy, progressively building minimal access skills.
Carry out bedside and minor procedures, including incision and drainage, biopsies, chest tube insertion, central venous access and suprapubic catheterisation.
Teach and assess MBBS students and postgraduate residents through bedside clinics, lectures, case presentations, skills-lab sessions and competency-based medical education (CBME) activities.
Supervise and mentor Junior Residents and interns, overseeing clinical decisions, handovers, duty rosters and logbook entries.
Maintain accurate and timely case records, operative notes, discharge summaries and medico-legal documentation in the hospital information system.
Apply and promote patient safety, infection prevention and control, the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist, antimicrobial stewardship and accreditation standards.
Coordinate with anaesthesia, critical care, radiology, pathology and other specialities for multidisciplinary care of complex surgical patients.
Contribute to clinical audits, morbidity and mortality meetings, journal clubs, research projects and publications of the department.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from an institution recognised by the National Medical Commission (NMC).
MS (General Surgery) from an NMC-recognised institution, or DNB (General Surgery) awarded by the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS), recognised as per prevailing NMC regulations.
Permanent registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and eligibility to register with the Sikkim Medical Council.
Age within the NMC upper limit for Senior Residents in broad specialities, currently 45 years.

Required Experience
Experience range: 03 years of post-MS/DNB experience in General Surgery; freshly qualified MS/DNB General Surgery graduates are eligible. Preferred: 1–3 years as Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist in General Surgery at an NMC-recognised medical college or a tertiary-care multispeciality hospital. Relevant experience includes a documented operative logbook with procedures performed as primary surgeon, independent first-line management of surgical emergencies and trauma, and exposure to undergraduate teaching. Experience in high-volume emergency surgical services is valued.

Technical and Functional Skills
Open general surgery: inguinal and ventral hernia repair, appendicectomy, breast and thyroid surgery, excision of soft-tissue swellings and wound management.
Emergency surgery: laparotomy for perforation, obstruction and abdominal trauma, bowel resection and anastomosis, and stoma creation.
Minimal access surgery at basic to intermediate level: safe port placement, diagnostic laparoscopy, and laparoscopic appendicectomy and cholecystectomy.
Trauma care aligned with ATLS principles, including primary and secondary survey and bedside FAST interpretation.
Perioperative care: fluid and electrolyte balance, surgical nutrition, sepsis management, thromboprophylaxis and pain control.
Interpretation of ultrasound, CT, MRI and laboratory investigations for surgical decision-making.
Working knowledge of infection prevention and control, biomedical waste management, medico-legal procedures and hospital information systems.
CBME-based teaching, logbook supervision and formative assessment of students and residents.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Sound clinical judgement and composure under pressure; clear, empathetic communication with patients and families, including breaking difficult news; teamwork and leadership within the surgical unit; commitment to teaching and mentoring; ethical, professional conduct with medico-legal awareness; disciplined time management across clinical, academic and on-call duties; resilience during demanding rosters; and respect for a culturally diverse patient population.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
ATLS or an equivalent trauma course, and current BLS/ACLS certification; FMAS, FIAGES or other structured laparoscopic training; completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME); MRCS or FRCS examination progress; membership of the Association of Surgeons of India (ASI); thesis-based or indexed-journal publications and conference presentations; prior teaching experience in a medical college; and the ability to communicate in Hindi, with working knowledge of Nepali an advantage.

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate trained at an NMC-recognised medical college or an NBEMS-accredited teaching hospital with substantial elective and emergency surgical volumes, and shows a consistent academic record through MBBS and MS/DNB. Prior Senior Resident, Registrar or Specialist tenure at a reputed government or private medical college or a tertiary-care hospital strengthens the application. The career trajectory should point towards academic surgery or a teaching-faculty role, with stable tenures and verifiable references.

Compensation and Benefits
Compensation is competitive and aligned with the candidate's qualifications, experience and institutional norms for Senior Residents. The role offers broad elective, emergency and teaching exposure in an academic setting. Leave, academic support and any other benefits follow institutional policy and NMC norms, and will be detailed at the offer stage.

Application Instructions
Send your updated resume, mentioning the role "Senior Resident – General Surgery", by email to careers@execvera.com, LinkedIn message, or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. Include your MBBS and MS/DNB details, medical council registration number, a summary of your operative logbook, current employer and notice period in days, current and expected annual CTC in , and any certifications or publications. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview and document verification.

Job descriptionfor Food and Beverage On Job Trainee - Steward
A Food and Beverage On Job Trainee -Steward is responsible to assist the senior steward inensuring that the kitchen and dining areas are clean and well-organized, servingfood and beverages to guests, and guests' needs and requests are met promptlyand efficiently. On job trainee is responsible for ensuring that all necessarycutlery, crockery, and glassware are available to the guests. It is alsoexpected to learn and follow all health and safety guidelines, includingmaintaining personal hygiene, ensuring food is stored properly, and maintaininga clean and sanitary work environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Welcome the guests by greeting them asper the standards. Respond to customer queries by resolving issues in a timelyand efficient manner to ensure customer satisfaction.
Serving food and drinks: assist in servingfood and drinks to guests. This includes taking orders, delivering food totables, and ensuring that guests have everything they need.
Learning the facilities of the hotel /casino and the daily events and functions in order to satisfy guest enquiries.
Handling guest requests andcomplaints: handle guest requests and complaints. This includes addressing anyissues they may have and providing them with a satisfactory solution.
Learning and following safety andhygiene procedures: required to learn and follow safety and hygiene proceduresto ensure that the kitchen and dining areas are safe and sanitary for guestsand staff.
Learning and following companypolicies: learn and follow the company policies and procedures, including thoserelated to dress code, attendance, and customer service standards.
Attend training sessions to learn new skills and improve existing ones.
Qualifications:
Min HSSC pass, diploma or equivalent required; additional training or certification in food service or hospitality may be preferred.
Strong knowledge of food service operations, including hygiene and sanitation practices.
Excellent communication, interpersonal and problem solving skill with the ability to prioritize tasks.
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
Throughout training period, on job trainee will be supervised byexperienced stewards or captains, who will guide in performing dutieseffectively and efficiently. Hence performance will be evaluated regularly, andwill be provided with feedback and support to help to improve skills andknowledge. Overall, the role of an on-the-job trainee steward in the food andbeverage service department is an important one that requires attention todetail, excellent customer service skills, and a strong commitment to teamworkand collaboration.

POSITION SUMMARY
The Senior Resident in the Department of Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (FMT) at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim, is a pivotal training and operational role for postgraduate-qualified doctors seeking structured hands-on experience in forensic medical practice within a university teaching hospital. The incumbent will contribute to undergraduate MBBS teaching, forensic laboratory operations, mortuary supervision, and medico-legal documentation under the guidance of senior faculty. This role serves as a critical stepping stone toward an academic career as Assistant Professor, fulfilling the NMC-mandated Senior Resident experience requirement in a recognized medical institution.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures and tutorial classes in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology as assigned by the Head of Department.
Conduct undergraduate clinical classes, practical demonstrations, and case-based learning sessions for MBBS students and interns.
Assist senior faculty in postgraduate teaching activities including seminars, journal clubs, and case presentations.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required to ensure uninterrupted academic programme delivery.

B. Clinical & Forensic Responsibilities
Collect, record, and maintain accurate patient and case information in accordance with institutional and medico-legal documentation standards.
Assist in forensic laboratory activities including collection of forensic samples such as viscera, blood, and tissues for toxicological analysis.
Ensure proper preservation and timely dispatch of forensic samples for toxicology analysis, adhering to institutional and legal protocols.
Maintain strict chain of custody for all forensic evidence ensuring proper labelling, packaging, documentation, and secure transfer at every stage.
Supervise mortuary operations and enforce safety protocols including infection control, documentation standards, and dignified handling procedures.
Assist in medico-legal autopsy procedures under the supervision of faculty, including documentation of findings.
Support preparation of medico-legal certificates, injury reports, and other forensic documentation as required.
Cover duties of other Senior Residents when required, ensuring continuity of clinical and forensic operations.

C. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Maintain meticulous records of all forensic cases, samples, and medico-legal proceedings handled by the department.
Participate in departmental quality improvement initiatives and NABH compliance activities.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME) programmes, workshops, and departmental academic activities.
Complete the NMC-mandated Basic Course in Biomedical Research within the stipulated timeframe.
Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Department or senior faculty.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MD / MS / DNB in Forensic Medicine & Toxicology (or equivalent recognized qualification) from a permitted/recognized medical college or institution, as per NMC guidelines.
Regulatory & Compliance Requirements
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission is mandatory.
Appointment must comply with current NMC guidelines for Senior Resident positions in recognized medical institutions.
Must complete or be willing to complete the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (NMC-mandated) during the tenure.
Preference for candidates seeking to fulfill NMC-recognized SR experience for future Assistant Professor eligibility.

Chain of custody maintenance
Mortuary supervision & safety

Medico-legal record keeping

UG MBBS lecture & clinical teaching
Practical demonstration skills
NMC regulatory awareness
Medical documentation & reporting
Forensic laboratory procedures
Biomedical research basics

Interpersonal & Soft Skills
Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Detail-oriented & organized
Ethical & professional conduct
Team collaboration skills
Composure in forensic environments

Professor - Department of Ophthalmology - Job Description

Department: Ophthalmology.

Employment Type: Full-time faculty position.

Role Overview
The Professor of Ophthalmology is a senior faculty position at a leading super speciality teaching hospital and medical college run by a renowned university, uniting patient care, teaching and research. The role combines evidence-based general and subspeciality eye care with delivery of the Competency Based Medical Education (CBME) curriculum prescribed by the National Medical Commission (NMC). The Professor mentors junior faculty, residents and interns, guides postgraduate theses, and strengthens the department's research output and academic standing. The position reports to the Head of the Department of Ophthalmology, or to the Dean and Medical Superintendent where the Professor heads the department, as per institutional structure.
Work Mode

Work mode: Work from office, on-campus at the teaching hospital, with working days and on-campus attendance as per teaching hospital and NMC norms, including NMC-mandated faculty attendance recording. No routine travel requirement has been specified; occasional academic, examiner or community outreach duties may be assigned as per institutional needs.

Key Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) Ophthalmology teaching through lectures, small-group sessions, clinical postings and skills-lab training as per the NMC CBME curriculum, including AETCOM components.
Lead postgraduate training of MS Ophthalmology residents through seminars, journal clubs, case presentations, wet-lab sessions and supervised surgical training, where the programme is offered.
Guide and co-guide postgraduate theses, ensuring sound methodology, ethics committee approval and timely submission.
Perform and supervise cataract surgery, including phacoemulsification and manual small incision cataract surgery (MSICS), with documented outcomes and complication audits.
Manage general and subspeciality cases across glaucoma, retina, cornea, oculoplasty, paediatric ophthalmology, strabismus and neuro-ophthalmology, co-managing or referring as clinically appropriate.
Conduct outpatient clinics, inpatient rounds and ophthalmic emergency care, including ocular trauma, with accurate and complete clinical documentation.
Supervise and interpret ophthalmic diagnostics such as slit-lamp biomicroscopy, perimetry, optical coherence tomography (OCT), fundus imaging, biometry and B-scan ultrasonography.
Initiate, conduct and publish original research in indexed journals, and pursue intramural and extramural research funding.
Design and conduct formative and summative assessments, and serve as internal or external examiner for university examinations as assigned.
Ensure departmental compliance with NMC Minimum Standard Requirements, faculty norms and documentation for NMC and university inspections.
Mentor and appraise junior faculty, senior residents, postgraduate residents and interns to support their academic and professional growth.
Contribute to community eye-care activities aligned with the National Programme for Control of Blindness and Visual Impairment (NPCBVI), including screening camps where organised.
Uphold patient safety, infection control, informed consent and quality standards, and participate in clinical audits, morbidity reviews and accreditation activities.
Participate in institutional committees, continuing medical education (CME) programmes and departmental planning, including equipment and service development.

Required Qualifications
MBBS from a recognised institution, with valid registration with the NMC or a State Medical Council, and registration with the State Medical Council of the work-location state as required by norms.
MS Ophthalmology, MD Ophthalmology or DNB Ophthalmology recognised by the NMC; DNB holders must meet NMC equivalence conditions for teaching appointments. A Diploma in Ophthalmology (DO) alone does not qualify for this position.
Eligibility for the post of Professor under the prevailing NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications (TEQ) regulations, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in Ophthalmology in an NMC-recognised or permitted medical college.
At least four research publications in indexed journals (PubMed/Medline, Scopus, Embase, Science Citation Index or DOAJ) as first, second, third or corresponding author, with at least two published as Associate Professor, as per NMC criteria.
Completion of the Basic Course in Biomedical Research (BCBR) and the Basic Course in Medical Education (BCME), as required by the NMC.

Required Experience
Experience range: 820 years of post-PG teaching experience in Ophthalmology in NMC-recognised or permitted medical colleges. Minimum: 8 years of post-PG teaching experience, including at least 3 years as Associate Professor in Ophthalmology. Preferred: 12–20 years combining teaching, high-volume surgical practice and postgraduate thesis guidance; experience as Professor or Head of Department is an advantage. Relevant experience includes faculty roles (Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, Professor) in medical colleges and university teaching hospitals; senior consultant service in NBEMS-accredited teaching departments of government institutions counts only where it meets NMC equivalence norms.

Technical and Functional Skills
Cataract surgery: phacoemulsification and MSICS, including complicated cataracts and management of intraoperative complications.
Glaucoma: gonioscopy, perimetry interpretation, trabeculectomy and laser procedures such as YAG peripheral iridotomy.
Retina: diabetic retinopathy and retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) screening, retinal laser photocoagulation and intravitreal injections.
Cornea and oculoplasty: infective keratitis and ocular surface disease, familiarity with keratoplasty, and lid, lacrimal (such as DCR) and ocular trauma procedures.
Diagnostics and other: paediatric, strabismus and neuro-ophthalmology evaluation; OCT, fundus photography, automated perimetry, biometry, B-scan ultrasonography and corneal topography.
Medical education: CBME delivery, competency-based assessment, logbook supervision, and skills-lab and wet-lab teaching.
Research: study design, biostatistics, ethics committee processes, Good Clinical Practice and scientific writing.
Regulatory: NMC Minimum Standard Requirements, TEQ regulations, inspection documentation and NPCBVI norms.

Soft Skills and Behavioural Competencies
Academic leadership and the ability to build a cohesive, high-performing teaching department.
Clear, compassionate communication with patients, families and multidisciplinary teams.
Mentorship and constructive feedback for students, residents and junior faculty.
Ethical judgement, professionalism and sound decision-making in surgical and emergency settings.
Collaboration with other departments, administration and research teams, and effective time management across clinical, teaching and research duties.

Preferred or Value-Added Qualifications
Subspeciality fellowship (glaucoma, vitreoretina, cornea, oculoplasty or paediatric ophthalmology) from a reputed eye institute.
Prior experience as Head of Department or as a university-recognised postgraduate guide.
Advanced Course in Medical Education (ACME), Curriculum Implementation Support Program (CISP) training or a recognised medical education fellowship.
Funded research as principal or co-investigator, publications beyond the NMC minimum, and peer-review or editorial roles.
Experience preparing departments for NMC or university inspections, and membership of professional bodies such as the All India Ophthalmological Society (AIOS).

Professional Tenure and Background
The ideal candidate will show a progressive academic career from Senior Resident to Assistant Professor, Associate Professor and Professor (or eligibility for Professor) in Ophthalmology, with stable tenures in NMC-recognised medical colleges, university teaching hospitals or reputed tertiary eye-care institutes. Candidates from government, deemed-university and established private medical colleges with active postgraduate programmes are well suited. A consistent record of surgical volume, documented publications and postgraduate guidance is expected, and career gaps or frequent short tenures should be explained in the application.

Compensation and Benefits
The compensation package is competitive and commensurate with qualifications, academic seniority and experience, in line with norms for senior medical faculty. Benefits are as per institutional policy, within an academic environment that supports teaching, research and professional growth. Compensation details will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.

Application Instructions
Send an updated CV mentioning the role "Professor – Ophthalmology" to careers@execvera.com, or by LinkedIn message or WhatsApp message to 9071197415. The CV should list qualifications with year and institution, NMC or State Medical Council registration number, designation-wise teaching experience with dates, indexed publications with author position, BCBR and BCME completion, annual surgical volumes, theses guided, current and expected annual CTC in , and notice period in days. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next steps.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title Associate Professor

Department Ophthalmology

Reporting To Head of the Department / Professor

Location Northeast India

Institution Type Premier 500-bed NABH-Accredited Multi-Super
Speciality Teaching Hospital.

Employment Type Full-Time | Teaching Faculty

Regulatory Framework National Medical Commission (NMC) Compliant

POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Professor in the Department of Ophthalmology will serve as a senior academic and clinical faculty leader at SMIMS & Central Referral Hospital, Gangtok, Sikkim. The incumbent will be responsible for delivering advanced undergraduate and postgraduate medical education in ophthalmology, providing specialist eye care across OPD, IPD, emergency, and Operation Theatre settings, and contributing meaningfully to research and publication activities. This role demands an accomplished ophthalmologist with strong academic credentials, surgical expertise, and a demonstrable commitment to shaping the next generation of eye care specialists in a NABH-accredited, NMC-compliant teaching hospital environment.

CRITICAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

A. Academic & Teaching Responsibilities
Deliver undergraduate (MBBS) theory lectures, tutorials, and clinical classes in Ophthalmology as per university curriculum requirements.
Conduct postgraduate (MS/DNB) classes, bedside clinics, case presentations, seminars, and journal clubs for PG students and interns.
Participate in ward rounds with PG trainees and interns to develop clinical reasoning and examination skills.
Mentor postgraduate residents in thesis formulation, surgical skills, and research methodology.
Participate in curriculum development, examination setting, and academic assessment processes.
Cover duties of other Associate Professors when required to ensure academic continuity.

B. Clinical & Surgical Responsibilities
Attend and manage Outpatient Department (OPD) patients during assigned slots providing specialist ophthalmology consultation, diagnosis, and management.
Manage inpatients admitted under the unit and attend to inpatient referrals from other departments requiring ophthalmic consultation.
Attend to emergency ophthalmic patients during assigned on-call duties including ocular trauma, acute angle-closure glaucoma, and other ophthalmic emergencies.
Attend scheduled Operation Theatre sessions perform ophthalmic surgical procedures independently and supervise and train postgraduate students in surgical techniques.
Provide specialist ophthalmology services across the full spectrum of OPD, IPD, and emergency ophthalmic care.
Participate in ward rounds and case discussions with junior faculty, residents, and students.
Ensure accurate clinical documentation, NABH protocol compliance, and high standards of patient safety.

C. Research & Publications
Publish a minimum of two research papers in indexed national or international journals as per NMC requirements, with the candidate among the first three authors.
Submit articles and medical commentary to professional media and publications on a regular basis.
Lead or participate in departmental research projects in clinical ophthalmology, surgical outcomes, and ophthalmic sciences.
Guide postgraduate thesis work and support research training of PG residents.

D. Administrative & Other Responsibilities
Assist the Head of Department in departmental administration, academic planning, and resource management.
Participate in NABH accreditation activities, hospital quality improvement committees, and patient safety initiatives.
Engage in Continuing Medical Education (CME), national ophthalmology conferences, and professional development activities.
Undertake any additional duties assigned by the Head of Department or institutional management.

MANDATORY QUALIFICATIONS & ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

Educational Qualifications
MBBS from a recognized medical institution.
Postgraduate degree: MS / DNB / MD in Ophthalmology from a recognized institution, as per NMC regulations.

Teaching Experience (as per NMC Regulations)

Candidates must meet one of the following experience criteria:
(a)(i) Minimum 4 years as Assistant Professor in Ophthalmology at a recognized medical institution; OR minimum 5 years for those directly appointed as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; OR
(a)(ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least 5 years post-PG clinical experience in Ophthalmology, of which at least 3 years as Assistant Professor in an Armed Forces teaching hospital; OR
(b) Non-teaching Consultant / Specialist / Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 10 years of experience in a Government hospital of at least 220 beds (must complete Basic Course in Medical Education and Basic Course in Biomedical Research within 2 years of appointment).
Note (Aviation / Marine Medicine): Up to 4 years of experience in Flying Squadrons or Diving/Escape Training Schools counts as equivalent to 2 years of teaching experience for Associate Professor eligibility.

Research & Compliance Requirements
Minimum 2 research publications in indexed journals after becoming Assistant Professor (first three authors).
Completed Basic Course in Biomedical Research from an NMC-designated institution.
Must have undergone (or be willing to undergo) the Basic Course in Medical Education, as Ophthalmology is covered under undergraduate training.
Valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Commission.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE & COMPETENCIES

Clinical & Surgical Expertise
Cataract surgery (phacoemulsification)
Glaucoma diagnosis & management
Retinal disease management
Ophthalmic emergency care
Slit-lamp & fundus examination
Surgical training & OT supervision
Academic & Research
• UG & PG medical teaching
Bedside clinical teaching
NMC regulatory compliance
Indexed journal publication
PG thesis guidance & mentoring
Curriculum development
Interpersonal & Soft Skills
• Excellent interpersonal skills
Strong verbal & written communication
Team leadership & collaboration
Organised & detail-oriented
Patient-centric approach
Adaptability in teaching hospital
