Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Overview
AtkinsRalis Global Technology Centre (GTC) Transporation Business is looking to appoint a number of Technical Manager s to support the delivery of complex civil engineering and multidisciplinary designs across a range of major projects.Drawing upon a diverse skill set and a proven track record of delivery, AtkinsRalis GTC's Transporation business is playing an integral role in some of the most challenging and exciting engineering projects in the Transportation realm. Leading the team and Produce AutoCAD and MicroStation 2D drawings and other deliverables.

Excellent time management skills.Experience of using written and spoken English within a business environment.
A Bachelor's degree or Diploma holder in Civil Engineering with minimum of 15 to 20 years of industry experience, preferably in the Highways Domain.Constantly striving towards continuous improvement and innovation.
Flexible and engaging with resilience, drive and self-motivationAbility to exercise initiative and take ownership of project issues.
Ability to collaborate successfully within a project and team environment but also to work independently and in a client environment.
Ability to adapt to different cultures and working environments to build rapport with customersHighly IT literate, excellent command of standard office software, knowledge of IT infrastructure and hardware.


Rewards Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive - at every stage of your life and your career.

Flexible and hybrid work solutions.
Remote work opportunities outside of country.
Company gratuity scheme.
Discretionary bonus program.

Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
The Associate Network Design (Logistics) is responsible for optimizing Delhiverys network by designing efficient transportation routes, improving vehicle and hub utilization, reducing logistics costs, and ensuring high service levels across the Express and Surface networks.
The role involves transportation route analysis, linehaul and carting optimization, data-driven decision-making, capacity planning, and close collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.

KEY DELIVERABLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Analyze transportation routes and recommend network optimization opportunities.
Design and optimize linehaul and carting routes to improve cost efficiency and service reliability.
Ensure optimal vehicle capacity utilization while managing dynamic demand patterns.
Identify cost-saving opportunities through network redesign, process improvements, and operational innovations.
Track and analyze key network performance metrics such as vehicle utilization, transit time,service levels, and cost per shipment.
Monitor time, distance, and capacity utilization of fixed and ad-hoc carting vehicles.
Support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Vehicle Routing Problem
(VRP) and Vehicle Capacity Planning (VCP) models.
Modify transportation routes based on network changes such as opening, closure, or relocation of
Distribution Centers (DCs), Hubs, Processing Centers (PCs), Service Centers (SCs), and Intermediate Processing Centers (IPCs).
Drive cross-utilization and contract optimization across Pickup, Delivery, Carting, Business Partner(BP), and Full Truck Load (FTL) vehicles.
Recommend changes in fleet deployment based on volume forecasts, seasonal demand, and business growth.
Collaborate with Operations, Procurement, and Product teams to implement network optimization initiatives.
Prepare dashboards, reports, and actionable insights to support strategic and operational decision-making.
Conduct root cause analysis for network inefficiencies, recommend corrective actions, and direct/coordinate cross-functional execution.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS
Educational Qualification
Bachelors or Masters degree from a reputed engineering college in India.

Technical Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis.
Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Lookup & Filter functions, Dashboarding).
Understanding of transportation network optimization and logistics planning.
Knowledge of forecasting and capacity planning techniques.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Amazon QuickSight is preferred.
Familiarity with Python for analytics is an added advantage.

Behavioral Competencies
Strong ownership and execution mindset.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
Attention to detail with a structured approach to problem-solving.
Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize effectively.

Preferred Experience
0-2 years of experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Transportation Planning, Network Design, or Operations Analytics.
Experience in e-commerce, logistics, express transportation, or supply chain consulting is preferred.
Exposure to linehaul planning, carting optimization, vehicle utilization, or network planning will be an advantage.

Job Title Retail Service Reinvention Manager
Management Level: L07 Manager
Location: Bangalore, Gurgaon, Mumbai (India; global remit)
Experience: 10+ Years (L07)
Must have skills: Retail Service Reinvention / Customer Service Strategy Transformation; a blend of industry and consulting experience with deep understanding of the end-to-end retail value chain and how it drives service demand, volume and exceptions; experience shaping AI-native / agentic service operating models.
The Practice A Brief Sketch
The practice works with clients across their marketing, commerce, sales and service functions to reinvent how they engage customers. As part of the Reinvention Services Customer Service team, you will help the worlds leading retailers transform service from a reactive, cost-driven function into an intelligence-led, AI-native capability that senses signals in real time, resolves issues before they escalate, and continuously improves from every interaction across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystem driving customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience.
Job summary
As a Retail Service Reinvention Senior Manager / Associate Director, you will advise C-suite executives, shape AI-native service operating models, and lead end-to-end transformation for the worlds leading retailers. Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. The role requires a strong blend of retail domain expertise, consulting leadership, end-to-end value chain understanding, executive stakeholder management, and business development capability to shape and deliver scalable, future-ready retail service solutions.
Roles and responsibilities
Service Strategy Advisory
Define enterprise and omnichannel service strategy across the shopper, store, supplier and fulfilment ecosystems.
Shape AI-native service vision, target operating models and multi-year transformation roadmaps.
Develop business cases, prioritize investment and establish value-realization frameworks.
Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.
Experience Design
Map end-to-end journeys for shoppers (order, delivery, returns, loyalty, complaints), associates (store, picker, contact centre) and suppliers (onboarding, purchase orders, invoicing, disputes).
Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.
Identify moments of truth and design service recovery for stock-outs, failed deliveries, substitutions and disputed refunds.
Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.
Operating Model Process Transformation
Design target operating models spanning shopper services, supplier services, store workforce services, and fulfilment/ecosystem services.
Design the workforce across shoppers, store associates, pickers and inventory teams, contact-centre specialists and leads, supplier account teams, and delivery partners/dispatchers.
Establish governance frameworks policy and business rules, approval/escalation thresholds, SLAs and entitlements, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.
Technology AI Transformation
Set CRM and CCaaS platform strategy (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect).
Shape knowledge and case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk).
Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.
Integrate across order, store and supply-chain systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, supplier/EDI portals) and IoT/GPS-enabled field and delivery tracking.
Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations
Design hybrid workforce models blending advisors, associates, AI copilots and autonomous agents across the shopper, supplier, store and fulfilment domains.
Design agents for high-volume service capabilities order status, substitutions, returns, refunds, delivery orchestration, supplier collaboration and dispute resolution.
Lead change management, upskilling and adoption programmes for frontline and support teams.
Establish AI governance, ethics and bias controls, and ongoing model/agent performance oversight.
Enterprise Transformation Delivery
Lead end-to-end programmes from strategy through implementation, adoption and value realisation.
Orchestrate multi-workstream delivery across business, experience, operations, technology and data/AI teams.
Manage executive steering committees and track value against committed business cases.
Practice Building
Develop market-leading thought leadership and intellectual property.
Build reusable methods, accelerators, assets and AI workflows for retail reinvention services.
Coach and mentor consulting teams.
Support business development and strategic pursuits collaborating with Song leadership to identify new opportunities and with Songs Consulting, Technology and Data AI teams for delivery.
Professional Technical Skills
Deep expertise in grocery, apparel or large omnichannel retail, with working knowledge of the end-to-end value chain merchandising and assortment planning, inventory and price management, promotions execution, digital commerce, in-store operations, supplier and partner operations, and last-mile fulfilment and how each stage drives customer demand, service volume and service exceptions.
First-hand practitioner experience inside leading grocery, apparel or omnichannel retailers (not advisory-only) having lived these operations, partnered with frontline teams, and redesigned them at enterprise scale.
Proven track record across service strategy advisory, experience design, operating model transformation, technology AI transformation, and enterprise delivery; consulting background is valuable but strong industry leadership experience counts equally.
Hands-on shopper/customer service experience across the lifecycle: order status and delivery-exception handling; substitutions, out-of-stock and refund/credit resolution; returns and reverse-logistics servicing; loyalty, rewards and membership servicing; complaint, feedback and social/review response; and multi-channel delivery (mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social) with consistent resolution regardless of entry channel.
Supplier and partner service experience: onboarding, compliance and account management; forecast, purchase-order and inventory collaboration; quality issues, disputes and score-carding; invoice, payment and reconciliation servicing; and supplier/partner portals, EDI exchanges and account-management workflows.
Store and workforce service experience: inventory accuracy, price integrity and promotion execution at store level; pick, pack and in-store fulfilment; store-to-contact-centre escalation and case hand-off; associate empowerment tools (store apps, picker/associate devices, knowledge assistants); and workforce scheduling, service standards and frontline performance management.
Fulfilment and ecosystem service experience: delivery orchestration, routing and ETA/live tracking; failed-delivery, missed-slot and delivery-recovery workflows; reverse logistics and returns-to-warehouse operations; driver, dispatcher and 3PL partner management; and last-mile SLAs, on-time performance and partner score-carding.
Working knowledge of core retail service processes order-to-delivery, returns refunds, complaint case management, store-to-contact-centre escalation, substitution/refund workflows and supplier dispute resolution with the SLAs and benchmarks that define operational excellence, and fluency in how cases move end-to-end (detect, triage/categorise, route/assign, investigate/enrich, decide/approve, orchestrate, execute/communicate, confirm/close).
Exposure to the retail service technology and AI stack: CRM CCaaS (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce Service Cloud, Five9, Amazon Connect); knowledge case management (ServiceNow, Zendesk); conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow); systems of record (OMS, POS, WMS, TMS, ERP, PIM/MDM, pricing and promotions engines); supplier/EDI portals and IoT/GPS-enabled tracking; and the underlying AI/ML stack (intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs, policy/rules engines, predictive/prescriptive models, decisioning/optimisation and root-cause analytics).
Experience designing target operating models that combine human and AI/agentic capacity reusable service capability design, hybrid workforce design, and governance/guardrail frameworks (policy business rules, approvals escalation, human-in-the-loop controls, SLAs entitlements, privacy consent, security access, compliance audit, model/agent performance governance, ethics bias controls, and data quality traceability).
Demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes customer value (NPS/CSAT, trust, advocacy); growth (repeat purchase rate, average order value, attach rate, customer lifetime value); service quality productivity (first-contact and overall resolution, reduced cost-to-serve and contact volume, higher associate productivity); and availability resilience (in-stock rate, on-time delivery/payment, margin protection, and supply/compliance resilience).
Executive stakeholder management, communication and storytelling; ability to build and defend a business case at board level; fluency across business, experience, operations, technology and AI/data teams; and comfort translating complex operating models into a clear enterprise narrative.
Additional information
Experience in retail, customer service or enterprise service transformation, including large-scale programmes delivered end-to-end from strategy through implementation; the ideal candidate blends industry and consulting experience.
Reports to the Customer Service Managing Director; builds and leads a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts, with accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M.
Employment type: Permanent. Work arrangement: remote / hybrid / onsite, flexed to client and project needs; travel expectation varies by client engagement.
MBA or postgraduate qualification in retail preferred. Relevant certifications a plus CCXP, Six Sigma/Lean, ITIL, PMP, CSCP/APICS, Agile or Design Thinking, or platform certifications (Genesys, NICE, Salesforce).

SUMMARY
Job Description
Title: Field Sales Executive
Location:  Ranchi
Job Type: Contract (For more than 1 year)
Industry: Paint - Chemical
Summary :
This field sales role is pivotal in driving business growth by building strong relationships with key stakeholders such as painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. The ideal candidate will be responsible for consistently achieving and surpassing sales targets through proactive customer engagement, daily site visits, and active presence at assigned retail locations. By organizing regular shop meetings, maintaining accurate sales records, and leveraging a strong understanding of the market, the sales representative will play a critical role in expanding market reach and enhancing brand visibility. The position requires a self-driven, results-oriented professional with a proven ability to thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment.
Responsibilities :
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales targets.
Develop and nurture long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key customers.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
Spend at least two hours daily at the assigned store to engage customers and support sales activities.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to drive product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports via the online portal.


Requirements

Valid two-wheeler is mandatory for field operations.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
Self - motivated, disciplined, and driven by performance targets.
Minimum qualification: Graduation preferred.
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with sales aptitude are also encouraged to apply.
Other pointers regarding this job:
Location:    Ranchi, Gumla
Age Criteria: 18years old to 30years old are eligible
Gender: Only Male can apply
Eligibility: Freshers and candidates with 1+ year experience in field sales, channel sales, banking, or insurance sales can apply.
Location: Only candidates based in Jharkhand are eligible.
Qualification: Graduate or Post Graduate (any year pass - out).


Benefits

Net Take Home: 18K-22K (Negotiable)
MWA 2000/ -
Lucrative Performance driven Incentives.
Absorption after 1 year on performance basis.
Travel allowance up to 2000- 5000 per month based on profile.

Role & responsibilities
Substation & Grid Management: Direct the O&M of the site's outdoor switchyard, power transformers, Vacuum Circuit Breakers (VCBs), and lightning arrestors. Coordinate with local electricity distribution companies to manage load scheduling, power quality, and unexpected line faults.
Heavy-Duty Rotating Equipment: Manage preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance for HT Motors (11kV) and LT Motors driving vertical turbine and centrifugal raw/clear water pumps. Oversee associated drive systems including large-scale Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), soft starters, etc. Coordinate equipment repair or replacement such that all approved limits are maintained as per set norms. Oversees maintenance of pumps, motors, various kinds of valves and water meters. Knowledge of the methods, materials, tools, and equipment used in the operation, maintenance, inspection, repair, and installation of water treatment plants.
Intake Well Engineering: Ensure vertical shaft electricals, and moisture-resistant switchgear exposed to river-side high humidity
Switchgear & Power Quality Optimization: Supervise HT/LT panels, Main Distribution Boards, and Motor Control Centers (MCCs). Actively monitor Automatic Power Factor Correction (APFC) panels and harmonic filters to maintain power factor near unity, mitigating utility penalties. Energy Bill monitoring & certification.
Backup Power & Control Networks: Maintain absolute readiness of heavy-capacity Diesel Generators (DG sets) and industrial Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS) feeding automated PLC/SCADA control networks. Knowledge in HMI and SCADA.
Safety & Statutory Compliance: Deploy Tata Steel UISL Safety Standard in Office & work site by preparing SWP, trainings related to SWP to own and contractors employees. Strictly implement Positive isolation systems, permit-to-work protocols, and high-voltage safety norms. Ensuring compliance to CEA Regulations with respect to O&M and Safety. Liaise with the Central/State Electricity Authority (CEA) for annual structural clearance and licensing renewals.
Preferred candidate profile

Plans, organizes, assigns, directs, and reviews the work of employees engaged in the operation and maintenance of various facilities related to municipal water supply including River Water Withdrawal & treatment system.
Develops and implements techniques and methods of process control which increase plant efficiency. Preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual reports. Ensuring the work of others contracted to work on plant. Ensuring emergency and unscheduled work to assure appropriate follow through.
Ensuring Customer engagement initiatives (Complaint Management, Customer visits, etc.). To lead a team of Engineers, Operators, Technicians / Asst. Technicians etc. To ensure implementation of goals and targets for the department/section in line with the ABP.
Person will be responsible to coordinate with both internal & external customers and to meet the demand time to time. Responsible for trouble shooting and analyzing of problems during course of job execution and site management.
Must possess working knowledge on Computers (MS Office). Knowledge of QMS and TQM principles to establish quality standards & control measures and ensure total quality management of the project.

Drawing on Tata Steels century-long legacy, the company transformed essential services into a customer-focused, sustainable enterprise. Guided by the Tata Group’s purpose of enhancing community life, Tata Steel UISL delivers a wide range of services including EPC, power distribution, water and wastewater management, and integrated town operations. It collaborates with civic bodies, governments, and businesses to address urbanization challenges and promote accessible, high-quality urban living across India.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. CSR Strategy & Program Design
Lead the formulation of CSR strategies with a primary focus on public health and community well-being.
Drive evidence-based planning through field assessments using PRA, FGDs, baseline surveys, and stakeholder consultations.
Develop Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) for health and rural development initiatives.
Collaborate with senior leadership to align CSR strategy with organizational priorities and SDGs.
Provide actionable recommendations to enhance impact, scalability, and sustainability.
2. Public Health Program Development & Implementation
Conceptualize and implement public health interventions (e.g., nutrition, maternal & child health, communicable diseases, sanitation, health system strengthening).

3. Administrative & Operational Leadership
Oversee program administration, including budgeting, vendor management, compliance, and documentation.
Ensure adherence to CSR regulations, audit requirements, and internal governance standards.
Manage implementation partners (NGOs/agencies) and ensure performance accountability.
Manage direct reporting team and strengthen internal processes for efficient program execution and reporting.
4. CSR Communication & Reporting
Develop structured communication strategies for CSR and employee volunteering initiatives.
Prepare high-quality internal and external reports, impact assessments, and case studies.
Support leadership communication through presentations, dashboards, and annual CSR disclosures.
5. Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships
Build and manage partnerships with government bodies, Tata Group entities, NGOs, CSR implementing agencies, and community institutions.
Act as a key interface with district/state administration, PRI institutions, and development partners.
Facilitate CSR audits, reviews, and third-party evaluations.
6. Digitization, MIS & Data-Driven Monitoring
Drive adoption of digital tools and MIS platforms for real-time project monitoring and reporting.
Design dashboards for data visualization, decision-making, and impact tracking.
Ensure data integrity, transparency, and usage compliance across stakeholders.
Apply scientific and TQM methodologies to improve program efficiency and outcomes

Preferred candidate profile
5to11 years of experience in CSR / development sector
Strong experience in public health program design and implementation
Prior experience with NGOs, CSR implementing agencies, or government health programs preferred
Demonstrated exposure to program administration and team/partner management

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Patrol all areas of the property; secure rooms; assist guests with room access. Conduct emergency response drills, daily physical hazard/safety inspections, investigations, interviews, and key control audit. Monitor Closed Circuit Televisions and alarm systems. Authorize, monitor, and document access to secured areas. Assist guests/employees during emergency situations. Respond to accidents, contact EMS or administer first aid/CPR as required. Gather information and complete reports. Maintain confidentiality of reports/documents, release information to authorized individuals. Defuse disturbances in accordance with company policies and procedures. Resolve safety hazard situations. Handle all interruptions and complaints. Escort unwelcome persons from the property. Ensure compliance with alcoholic beverage control laws. Call for assistance using proper code responses. Provide proper paperwork to employees.
Assist management in training, motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model and first point of contact of the Guarantee of Fair Treatment/Open Door Policy process. Follow all company policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. In addition, some states may have additional licensing/registration requirements to be considered for this position. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Enter and locate work-related information using computers and/or point of sale systems. Move at a speed required to respond to work situations (e.g., run, walk, jog). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 75 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 2 years of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: At least 1 year of supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None

Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Customer Centricity - Be AMLI brand ambassador a customer champion.

Customer Centricity - Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need.
Customer Centricity - Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per AMLI standard.


Measures of Success
Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications Experience
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience, At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
Position Summary
The ideal candidate must be well versed with Paint shop process and equipment.
Must be able to recognize the abnormalities in Conveyors, ASU-exhaust system, Rotary equipment like Pumps and blowers, Baking ovens (Direct & indirect type both), Electrified Monorail Hoists, Paint line circuits and related components.
Working exposure with robot maintenance is preferable.
Must have key expertise for basic Trouble shooting and fast restoration of system /equipment.
Must have knowledge about condition Based Monitoring (Vibration analysis and Thermography).
Should be able to handle shift operation independently by ensuring smooth & reliable operation of equipment. Personnel shall also be responsible for spares management i.e., keeping track of spares stock and raising requisitions timely to ensure timely availability of spares. Must be an expert with Microsoft Office applications and SAP- PM module.
Must have knowledge of annual budgeting cycle, defining scope of activities for Service requests, Creation of Purchase requisitions, chasing up with service purchase for creation of Purchase order.
Daily Job involves handling / manning of 15-20 blue collar employees and contractual service providers.

Key Responsibilities:
Carrying out PM activities as per schedule.
Trouble shooting & Breakdown Maintenance
Spares Management
Breakdown analysis, PSR and Corrective actions.
Implementing improvement projects.
Maintaining records and documentation related to IATF standard
Records and documentation for OHSMS (ISO 45001), EMS (ISO 14001)
Updating and monitoring assigned key deliverables i.e. MPs and CPs in TQM way
Daily Work Management as per defined Key Performance Indicators
Updating and monitoring assigned key deliverables i.e. MPs and CPs in TQM way
Records keeping related to contractual services
Creation of Service PRs and Machinery Spare PRs
Chasing up with service purchase for PO creations of services
Manpower and Job Planning for periodic shutdowns to carry out scheduled maintenance activities.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Experience
5-10 years of experience in Mechanical Maintenance
Preferred Industry
Automobile Industry preferably from Paint Shop

Job Summary
Function SummaryThe agency channel refers to a distribution method where insurance products are sold through agents. These agents act as intermediaries between the insurance company and customers, facilitating the sale of policies, providing customer support, and offering advisory services. This initiative is expected to improve customer experience especially in markets where customers prefer human interaction. It also supports customer in a)Resolving policy service needb)Renewal collection to resolve policy holder s service needs, Cross sale opportunity.


Responsibilities
Agent Quality Recruitment
Agent Development
Meeting WFYP Business targets
Conducting Career Seminars for Agents
Communicating Agent RnR regularly


Key Responsibilities / Key Deliverables
Agent Recruitment -Develop various sources of agent hiring build a team of agent agent pipe line.
Conduct activity to enhance existing agent footfall to generate fresh referral for new agent hiring
Conduct Career Seminar of prospects-Follow agent hiring mechanism other hiring norms

Improve agent productivity persistency by regular PRP/IID/GID etc
Ensure companies product mix sales ratio and adhere to the business norms.
Maintain agent pro activity as per business plan
Customer Centricity -Be Amli brand ambassador a customer champion
Follow Amli sales practice to develop deep customer loyalty
Hold periodical customer meet to understand customer pulse need
Ensure customer queries are responded to satisfactorily as per Amli standard.
Measures of Success:-Achievement of business plan GPA
Recruitment / Development Activation of agent as per plan.
Number MTD Active
Persistency as per grid
Number of EC/MDRT agent


Qualifications / Requirements
Sales Background
Minimum 2 Years Experience , At least 6 Months in last Job
Age Criteria : 24 Years to 35 Years
Should be employed in BFSI/Structured Company
Not more than 2 Job Changes in one year
Should be in City for at least 1 Year

Description:
Job Summary
Company Name: Axis Max Life Insurance Job Title: Assistant Relationship Manager - Broca. The Assistant Relationship Manager at Axis Max Life Insurance will be responsible for managing and nurturing client relationships to enhance customer satisfaction and retention. The primary focus will be to support the sales team in achieving targets by providing excellent service and aiding in plan implementation and customer inquiries. The role includes conducting client meetings, preparing reports, managing client data, and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory guidelines. The Assistant Relationship Manager will also assist in onboarding new clients and will act as a point of contact for any support or queries from clients. This role presents an excellent opportunity to develop a career in relationship management within the insurance industry while contributing to the growth and success of Axis Max Life Insurance.


Responsibilities
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to promote customer loyalty and retention.
Support senior relationship managers in executing sales strategies and achieving targets.
Address client inquiries and provide timely and accurate information regarding insurance products and services.
Prepare and present reports on client feedback, sales performance, and market trends to enhance service offerings.
Assist in the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a seamless transition and satisfaction.
Ensure adherence to regulatory standards and company policies during all client interactions.
Utilize CRM tools to manage client information and interactions, maintaining up-to-date records.


Skills and Tools Required
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with clients and team members.
Proficiency in CRM software to manage client relationships and data.
Analytical skills to assess client needs and market trends effectively.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team environment to achieve organizational goals.
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills to manage multiple client accounts.
Basic understanding of insurance products and financial principles is desirable.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for report generation and presentations.
Prior experience in customer service or sales, preferably in the insurance or financial sector, is a plus.
This role presents an excellent opportunity to develop a career in relationship management within the insurance industry while contributing to the growth and success of Axis Max Life Insurance.

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow thebusiness and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities

Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team ( reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).
Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition


Desired Skills

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

What drives us?
Imagine: a single tap on your phone unlocks a world that transforms your entire car ownership journey, covering every milestone - from finding your perfect match to keeping it running smoothly, to selling it later. That's the future we're building at Cars24. Our mission is to ensure car ownership is stress-free. We want our customers to focus on the open road, not roadside worries. What will you drive?
Perform comprehensive vehicle inspections at customer sites, adhering to the highest standards of productivity and precision.
Kick off daily operations with the first inspection by 9:00 AM sharp.
Efficiently manage communications, ensuring all client interactions happen within specified timelines.
Complete detailed reports and document findings in our proprietary system for all inspections conducted within allocated time slots.
Navigate a daily route covering a 35-45 km radius, executing an average of 6 vehicle inspections per day.

Who are we looking for?
A motivated professional with a robust work ethic, ready to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
An owner of a two-wheeler with adeptness in operating manual and automatic vehicles.
A holder of a valid drivers licence.
Possess excellent observational, analytical, and reporting skills.
Skilled in communication and interpersonal interactions, capable of delivering high-quality customer service.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary
We are seeking dynamic, results-oriented Sales & Application Engineers to join our team, offering an exciting career path for Diploma and Engineering graduates. This pivotal role combines technical expertise with business development to drive revenue growth and foster strong client partnerships. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving territory-specific sales targets, identifying new market opportunities, and delivering tailored technical solutions that meet customer needs while maintaining a deep understanding of market trends and competitor activities.

Responsibilities
Achieve assigned sales targets specific to the designated territory.
Identify and cultivate new business relationships with customers, OEMs, and industrial accounts.
Generate business opportunities through strategic market visits and proactive lead generation.
Conduct regular on-site customer visits and facilitate detailed technical discussions.
Promote product offerings and provide appropriate technical solutions to client challenges.
Manage the sales cycle from generating enquiries to following up on quotations and converting opportunities into confirmed orders.
Maintain robust customer relationships to encourage repeat business and long-term loyalty.
Monitor market trends, track competitor activities, and identify emerging business opportunities.
Accurately maintain CRM records and sales reports to ensure data integrity.



Requirements
A Diploma or Engineering degree in a relevant technical field.
Strong passion for technical sales, business development, and customer relationship management.
Proven ability to build and maintain effective relationships with diverse clients.
Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and commercial discussions.
Capability to analyze market trends and competitor actions to drive strategic growth.
Proficiency with CRM tools and sales documentation management.
Willingness to travel and work across assigned locations, including Sambalpur, Cuttack, Kolkata, Jamshedpur, and Bhilai.
Educational Qualification
B.E./B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience
Freshers are welcome.
1 3 years of relevant experience in field sales, industrial sales, technical sales or business development preferred.


Benefits
Salary Structure
Freshers:
15,000 20,000 per month.
Experienced Candidates (1 3 Years):
25,000 40,000 per month, depending on current salary and relevant experience.

Travel Allowance:
Fixed travel allowance of 8,000 per month for local travel within an approximate 40 km radius.
Travel beyond this radius may be reimbursed subject to Reporting Manager approval.
For senior-level employees, customer visit expenses will be reviewed internally on a case-by-case basis.

Job Description (JD)
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit
Location: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai & Bangalore
Function: Governance, Risk and Compliance Services (GRCS) Department: Risk Consulting
Role Overview
Consultant / Assistant Manager Internal Audit will be responsible for managing and executing internal audit, risk consulting and process improvement engagements across multiple industries. The role involves leading project teams, managing client relationships, ensuring quality deliverables, supporting business development activities and contributing to the growth of the GRCS practice
Key Responsibilities
A. Internal Audit & Risk Advisory
Lead risk-based internal audits, process audits and risk consulting engagements.
Conduct Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and risk assessments.
Evaluate business processes, identify operational risks and assess internal controls.
Perform SOX 404, Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and regulatory compliance reviews.
Identify control gaps and recommend process improvements and risk mitigation measures.
Execute control self-assessments, revenue assurance and continuous monitoring activities.
B. Project Management & Execution
Manage multiple internal audit and risk consulting projects simultaneously.
Lead project teams and oversee project planning, execution and delivery.
Ensure project quality, profitability and adherence to timelines and budgets.
Report project progress and key risks to the Director / Partner.
Act as the primary client contact throughout project execution.
C. Client & Stakeholder Management
Manage client relationships and understand business requirements.
Conduct stakeholder discussions and management presentations.
Communicate audit findings, control gaps and recommendations.
Support clients in implementing corrective actions and process improvements.
D. Team Management & Leadership
Supervise, coach and mentor junior team members.
Review team deliverables and ensure quality standards.
Conduct training and support team capability development.
Manage team performance and promote effective collaboration.
E. Business Development & Practice Growth
Identify business opportunities and contribute to lead generation and deal closure.
Support proposals, pre-sales activities and RFP responses.
Identify cross-selling opportunities across KPMG service lines.
Contribute to revenue growth and client relationship development.
F. Thought Leadership
Contribute to developing new solutions and service offerings.
Participate in knowledge management and practice development initiatives.
Stay updated on industry trends, regulatory developments and emerging risks.
3. Key Service Offerings
Risk-Based Internal Audit
Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Risk Assessment
Business Process Consulting
SOX 404 and Internal Financial Controls (IFC)
Regulatory and Contractual Compliance
Corporate Governance Advisory
Revenue Assurance and Control Self-Assessment
Continuous Auditing / Monitoring
Accounting Manuals Development
Capital Projects Audits
Project-Focused Control Assessment
Setting Up Internal Audit Functions
4. Educational Qualifications
- MBA / Chartered Accountant (CA)
Preferred Certifications:
CIA Certified Internal Auditor
CISA Certified Information Systems Auditor
CPA Certified Public Accountant
CMA Certified Management Accountant
ACCA Association of Chartered Certified Accountants

Description:
Role Summary

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value
(GMV) per month.
The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and
specific geographies assigned

Responsibilities
Account & Partner Relationship Management
Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with internal stakeholders
Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is correct and image coverage is high
Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions formonth-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.
Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc. to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.
Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers and partners at the restaurants
Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:
Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance metrics to the partner
Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable conversions and grow the business.
Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale, conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.
Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts, commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:
Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations (competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (
reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

Functional Competencies
Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.
Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)
Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate
Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

Desired Skills
Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working
knowledge of English
Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing channels
Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality
Effective communication skills
Attitude & Aptitude for Sales
Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.
Analytical, good Excel skills.
The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules
Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.
Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.
Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness and success of campaigns.
Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

Description:
Job Description
Overview
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants-learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners success. Youll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
Key Responsibilities
Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy s products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants arent growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction
80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month Qualifications
What Were Looking For
Experience Background:
0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in fmcg, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
Comfort with data, especially Excel-you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Job Purpose


This position is open with Bajaj Finance ltd.





General Admin (Facility Management RM)
1. Control branch OPEX expenses within set budget.
2. Maintain regular Maintenance Hygiene of branches.
3. Timely closer on Issues including RM activity.
4. Timely Payment of branch expense bills.
5. Expense control of general expenses of branches.
6. Branch Feedback of employees seniors visiting branches.
7. Maintain proper data / records of all expenses of all locations managers supervised.

1. Ensuring the LOI is signed well within the TAT. (within 5 working days from receiving the legal clearance stability
2. Ensuring the lease agreement is signed well within the TAT. (within 10 working days from signing the LOI
3. Ensuring the lease agreement is registered well within the TAT. (within 20 working days of receiving the approval from H.O)
4.the shops establishments application is applied the certificate is received well within the TAT. (within 10 days of branch completion)
5.security related equipments are up to date under AMC renewals are done prior to expiry of contract.
6. Renewals of all Lease agreements AMC contract done prior to the expiry date.
7. Ensuring all statutory documents / certificates are displayed at the common area (reception) in line to compliance.





1. Graduate in any discipline with experience of working in Administration preferred
2. Inclination to have knowledge/ exposure on legal/ compliance matters.
3. Exposure in handling govt. / legal Issues
4. Team management interpersonal Skills
5. Good on negotiations and Vendor development Management
6. Well versed with MS Word, Excel, Power Point
7. Willing to Travel

-Excellent Communication and Negotiation Skill

Description:
World Change Starts with Educated Children
Important: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.
Position Overview: The Project Lead, State Project Management Unit (SPMU-QE) in partnership with Jharkhand Education Project Council (JEPC), will oversee the design and implementation of Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) initiatives for primary-grade students across Jharkhand, covering content and curriculum, teacher training, research and insights, governance and communication, and district implementation. The position is based in JEPC campus, supported by a team of 8-10 Room to Read India staff and will involve working directly with JEPC and JECRT officials, partner organizations and education stakeholders to achieve Room to Read objectives and NIPUN Mission goals in alignment with state education department quality education. Reporting to the National Lead-SPMU with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the State Lead, Jharkhand. The base location will be Ranchi, Jharkhand.
Responsibilities
Government Liaison and Strategic Partnerships
Establish and maintain strong working relationships with key state-level stakeholders including the Department of Education SSA (Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan), SCERT (State Council of Educational Research and Training), and WCD (Women and Child Development).
Represent Room to Read and SPMU-QE at state- and district-level government meetings and events.
Advocate Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (FLN) priorities and objectives with senior officials and align project activities with government policies and frameworks.
Serve as the primary representative of the State Project Management Unit (SPMU) to external partners including donors, NGOs, private sector, CBOs, and civil society organizations.
Oversight of Project Implementation
Develop strong understanding on NEP 2020, FLN Mission, State FLN guidelines, and other national and state level education policies and guidelines.
Provide strategic direction and overall leadership for the planning, execution, and monitoring of FLN interventions across the state.
Ensure alignment of SPMU activities with government FLN objectives and donor commitments.
Coordinate closely with Room to Read India country office departments for administrative and technical support.
Lead project governance mechanisms and provide guidance for state, district, and block-level implementation.
Lead and support additional activities and responsibilities that get added periodically during the duration of the project.
Program Management, Monitoring Reporting
Oversee the development and execution of Annual Work Plans and ensure timely achievement of milestones and deliverables.
Lead the design and implementation of monitoring, evaluation, and learning systems to track progress and inform decision-making.
Ensure timely preparation and submission of high-quality programmatic and financial reports to Room to Read India Country Office and state government officials.
Facilitate regular project reviews, technical working group meetings, and learning exchanges to drive continuous improvement.
Maintain data quality standards and promote evidence-based reporting.
Manage budget, procurement and payments strictly as per organization policies, processes and compliances.
Advocacy and Knowledge Dissemination
Lead advocacy efforts to build awareness and drive policy engagement on FLN goals and strategies.
Organize and participate in events, presentations, and dissemination activities to share program progress, innovations, and best practices.
Develop strategic communication materials and ensure consistent messaging with all stakeholders.
Build and maintain formal and informal communication channels with government and non-governmental partners.
Lead project campaigns and events at state, district and block level.
Team Leadership and Capacity Building
Lead and manage the SPMU team, including setting goals, performance evaluation, and professional development.
Supervise and mentor the SPMU team, fostering a high-performing, collaborative work culture. Ensure that all SPMU staff have appropriate individual operational plans linked to project priority and annual work plans. Complete all performance management activities including performance planning, monitoring, and annual performance appraisals.
Promote and ensure organization s core values, policies and procedures.
Cultivate a learning-focused team culture that values accountability, innovation, and shared ownership of results.
Qualifications
Required
Master's degree in Education, Public Policy, Social Sciences, or related field.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in large-scale education programs, preferably with government or NGO partnerships.
Demonstrated experience in leading multi-disciplinary teams and complex program operations.
Proven ability to work with government bodies and influence policy and practice in the education sector.
Strong project management, analytical, and communication skills.
Familiarity with FLN Mission, National Initiative for Proficiency in Reading with Understanding and Numeracy (NIPUN) Bharat, and state education systems.
Proficiency in English and Hindi; knowledge of local languages will be an advantage.
Room to Read is a child-safe organization
Read is a child-safe organization; all personnel must adhere to Room to Read s Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Policy.
Room to Read is an equal opportunity employer committed to identifying and developing the skills and leadership of people from diverse backgrounds.
Child Protection Principles
Room to Read is committed to the education and welfare of children and protecting them from abuse and exploitation
Room to Read has zero tolerance for child abuse and exploitation.
All children have the right to be free from abuse and exploitation, including neglect, maltreatment, and physical, mental or sexual violence, injury or abuse.
All children should be treated with respect and dignity.
The well-being of the child is Room to Read s first priority when dealing with all identified or suspected cases of child abuse.
Room to Read shall integrate child protection into all its organizational strategies, structures and work practices.
Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Principles
Room to Read Representatives must create and maintain an environment that prevents sexual exploitation and sexual abuse.
Room to Read has zero tolerance for adult sexual exploitation and abuse.
Sexual exploitation and abuse are serious violations of fundamental human rights and will not be accepted or tolerated.
All adults should be treated with respect and dignity.
Room to Read implements a survivor-centered approach, putting the survivor s rights and dignity at the forefront.

Description:
Manager - Operations
About the company
Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratizing the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market economy to mid-market to cater to the next
100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.
We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:
Itsy (10001500)
Treebo and Treebo Premium (15003000)
Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (3000–6000 per night)
We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10 across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

About the Role
As an Area General Manager, you will be responsible for executing the company’s strategic vision of democratizing the joy of travel. You will be responsible for a given area and the portfolio there in to ensure highest levels of guest experience, product quality and business & profitability of the assets. While managing the operations and enabling sales for your portfolio, you will also drive the expansion of our hotel portfolio
across your area and beyond through your network. This is a mission critical role that requires a perfect balance of delivering operational excellence, relationship management, and a business development mindset.
Key Responsibilities -
1) Operational Excellence
Oversee day-to-day operations across multiple hotel properties in your area, ensuring adherence to brand standards and service benchmarks
Drive compliance with Treebo's brand standards and SOPs, health and safety guidelines, and service quality norms
Conduct audits, quality assurance checks, and drive corrective/preventive actions through hotel partners to maintain Treebo standards
Act as the key liaison between the company and hotel partners, ensuring seamless coordination and timely issue resolution
Monitor and enhance overall guest satisfaction by ensuring prompt and effective service recovery mechanisms
2) Business Development & Growth
Identify, evaluate, and onboard new hotel properties to expand the company’s portfolio within the assigned area
Negotiate terms of the agreement and ensure complete alignment with Treebo's operating procedures before onboarding any hotel
Collaborate with the central business development team to oversee launch process of the signed properties
3) Sales & MICE
Drive regional sales performance by collaborating with internal sales teams and property owners to achieve revenue targets for your portfolio
Identify and push sales POCs to close MICE deals for your portfolio properties
Support pricing, promotions, and campaigns to drive business at the property level
Engage with local corporate clients, event organizers, and travel planners to push business to your portfolio if needed
4) Team & Partner Management
Lead, mentor, and develop on-ground portfolio hotel teams to deliver exceptional guest experience in the segment
Train hotel staff in brand values, SOPs, and customer service skills to ensure consistency
Build strong relationships with hotel owners and partners to foster collaboration and long-term association
What Are We Looking For -
Strong communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
4–6 years of experience in hospitality management with demonstrated success in both operations and business development.
Proven experience in property acquisition and/or sales in hospitality.
Knowledge and experience in the MICE segment is highly desirable.
Analytical mindset with problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned geography.
Entrepreneurial approach with a strong focus on execution and accountability

Job Summary
The Assistant will provide operational and technical IT support to approximately field staff across districts, ensuring the availability, functionality, security, and effective use of IT equipment and digital tools required for programme implementation. The position will serve as the first point of contact for field-level IT issues, providing timely troubleshooting, coordinating repairs and replacements, supporting new employee onboarding, supporting procurements and maintaining accurate records of IT assets. The role will also facilitate coordination between district teams and the Country Office/State IT/Admin function to ensure consistent IT service delivery across geographically dispersed locations. Regular inter-district travel will be required, with frequency determined by support requests and field requirements. The base location will be Palamu/Hazaribagh.
Responsibilities
Field-Level IT Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to field staff for laptop, desktop, printer, scanner, and other IT-related issues.
Diagnose and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, and application-related problems.
Support staff with email configuration, account access, password resets, software installation, system updates, and basic device configuration, subject to access permissions.
Troubleshoot internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, mobile hotspots, and network-related issues at district offices and field locations.
Provide remote support wherever feasible and undertake field visits for issues that cannot be resolved remotely.
Escalate complex technical issues to the designated IT team at Country Office or authorized service provider, as the case may be, and track them through resolution.
IT Equipment Deployment and Employee Onboarding
Configure and deploy laptops and other IT equipment for new joiners and replacement requirements.
Coordinate with HR, Administration, and district teams to ensure timely IT readiness before employees join.
Support device allocation, user account setup, installation of approved applications, and access to required systems.
Facilitate the collection, reconfiguration, and reassignment of IT equipment during employee transfers, exits, or role changes.
Ensure that devices are configured in accordance with organizational IT standards and security requirements.
IT Asset Management and Inventory Control
Maintain an updated inventory of IT assets across all districts, including laptops, desktops, printers, accessories, and other assigned equipment.
Record asset allocation, serial numbers, asset tags, user details, location, warranty status, and movement history.
Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets in coordination with the relevant district and state teams.
Track damaged, non-functional, obsolete, lost, or unutilized equipment and recommend appropriate action.
Monitor equipment under repair, warranty claims, and replacement requirements.
Ensure timely collection and return of IT assets during employee separation and maintain supporting documentation.
Update the designated asset management system or tracker and report discrepancies for resolution.
Internet Connectivity and Field Infrastructure
Assess internet connectivity requirements at district offices and other designated programme locations.
Troubleshoot connectivity issues affecting access to programme systems, virtual meetings, email, and online reporting tools.
Coordinate with internet service providers and authorized vendors for installation, maintenance, and fault resolution.
Maintain records of connectivity-related complaints, downtime, recurring issues, and resolution timelines.
Identify locations with recurring connectivity challenges and recommend practical solutions, such as alternative connectivity options, where approved.
Support the basic setup and troubleshooting of routers, Wi-Fi devices, and other approved networking equipment.
Software, Applications, and Digital Tools
Assist field staff in installing, configuring, and using organization-approved software and programme-related digital tools.
Support basic troubleshooting of productivity applications, video-conferencing tools, browsers, printers, and document-sharing platforms.
Assist staff in accessing organizational systems and applications, coordinating with the relevant system administrator where required.
Support the rollout of software updates, security patches, and approved IT tools.
Help field staff understand basic IT procedures and the appropriate use of organizational devices and systems.
IT Security and Data Protection
Ensure that organizational IT equipment is used in accordance with approved IT guidelines.
Support implementation of device security requirements, including antivirus protection, system updates, screen locks, and approved security configurations.
Guide staff on password security, phishing awareness, safe internet use, and secure handling of organizational information.
Immediately report suspected malware, unauthorized access, lost or stolen devices, and potential data breaches to the designated IT/security team.
Support secure device handover, data backup where authorised, and device sanitisation or wiping in accordance with approved procedures.
Ensure that confidential data is not transferred, accessed, or shared through unauthorized applications or storage devices.
IT Support for Programme Activities and Meetings
Provide technical support for virtual meetings, online trainings, workshops, and programme review meetings.
Assist with the setup and troubleshooting of audio-visual equipment, projectors, displays, webcams, microphones, and speakers where available.
Support connectivity and device readiness for field-level digital data collection, online assessments, reporting, and other programme activities.
Help district teams prepare equipment and test connectivity before important programme events.
Provide on-site IT support for designated programme activities when required.
IT Helpdesk, Reporting, and Service Monitoring
Maintain a centralized log of IT requests, complaints, and incidents received from the nine districts.
Categorise issues by urgency, impact, and type, and priorities critical issues affecting programme delivery.
Track issue resolution, pending requests, vendor interventions, and recurring technical problems.
Provide periodic reports on IT support requests, resolution timelines, equipment downtime, asset status, and recurring challenges.
Maintain a district-wise tracker of IT assets, equipment under repair, connectivity issues, and pending requirements.
Identify recurring issues and recommend preventive measures to reduce service interruptions.
