Job Description - Senior AWS Data Engineer
Position: Senior AWS Data Engineer
Experience: 4-7 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Type: Work from Office (WFO)
Location: Indore
Primary Technology: AWS Databricks
Job Overview
We are looking for an experienced Senior AWS Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in AWS Databricks, Python, PySpark, SQL, and the AWS data ecosystem.
The ideal candidate should have experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines, building cloud-based lakehouse architectures, implementing ETL/ELT workflows, and optimizing large-scale data processing solutions on AWS.
The candidate will work closely with architects, BI developers, analysts, and cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance data platforms.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
Build and optimize batch and incremental ETL/ELT workflows for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data.
Implement lakehouse solutions using Delta Lake and Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold).
Build data ingestion pipelines using AWS Glue, Databricks Auto Loader, APIs, databases, and file-based sources.
Work with Amazon S3 for data lake storage, lifecycle management, and secure data access.
Develop complex SQL queries, data transformations, stored procedures, and data models.
Implement Databricks Workflows and Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines for orchestration and pipeline management.
Apply Unity Catalog for data governance, access control, lineage, and data discovery.
Optimize Spark jobs, cluster configurations, partitioning, and query performance to manage processing costs.
Implement data quality checks, validation, monitoring, logging, and error-handling mechanisms.
Integrate data from Amazon Redshift, Amazon RDS, relational databases, REST APIs, and other enterprise systems.
Apply AWS security practices, including IAM roles and policies, KMS encryption, Secrets Manager, and least-privilege access.
Implement version control and CI/CD practices using Git, AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, or equivalent tools.
Collaborate with BI developers and business stakeholders to deliver analytics-ready datasets.
Participate in requirement analysis, technical discussions, solution design, effort estimation, client communication, and end-to-end project execution.
Required Technical Skills Databricks & Big Data
Strong hands-on experience with Databricks on AWS, Apache Spark, PySpark, and Delta Lake.
Experience designing Lakehouse and Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold).
Strong understanding of Databricks Workflows, Unity Catalog, Asset Bundles, and Spark performance tuning.
Practical knowledge of Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Auto Loader, Change Data Feed, and incremental data processing.
Experience with batch and streaming data processing; Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon MSK, or Spark Structured Streaming knowledge is an advantage.
AWS Data Services
Strong working knowledge of Amazon S3 and AWS data lake architecture.
Hands-on experience with AWS Glue for data cataloging, ETL, and integration.
Familiarity with Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena, AWS Lake Formation, and AWS Step Functions is an advantage.
Understanding of AWS IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, networking, monitoring, and cloud security fundamentals.
Experience integrating data from APIs, relational databases, enterprise applications, and cloud storage.
Programming & Databases
Strong proficiency in Python, PySpark, and advanced SQL.
Experience with relational databases such as Amazon RDS, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.
Knowledge of query optimization, data modeling, and database performance tuning.
NoSQL database experience, including Amazon DynamoDB, is a plus.
Data Engineering Practices
Experience with data warehousing, ETL/ELT design, orchestration, scheduling, and incremental loading.
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, and deployment best practices.
Understanding of data quality, observability, logging, monitoring, and production support.
Good to Have
Experience with Amazon Redshift and modern cloud data warehouse architectures.
Knowledge of Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon MSK, or Spark Structured Streaming.
Experience with Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric.
Experience with enterprise-scale data migrations and modernization projects.
Familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or Amazon QuickSight.
Certifications - Good to Have
Candidates with any of the following certifications will be preferred:
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate.
Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
Databricks Certified Apache Spark Developer Associate.
AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate.
AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (additional advantage).
Note: Certifications are preferred but not mandatory. Practical hands-on experience and real-world project exposure are more important.
Candidate Expectations
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and technical explanation skills.
Ability to independently understand requirements and deliver production-ready solutions.
Experience working with international clients and cross-functional teams.
Ability to lead technical discussions, review code, and mentor team members.
Willingness to learn and adopt evolving AWS and Databricks technologies.
Preferred Experience
Experience building enterprise-level AWS data engineering and lakehouse solutions.
Experience handling large datasets and high-volume data processing.
Experience in industries such as FinTech, Healthcare, Logistics, eCommerce, or SaaS.

Job Title: Software Tester / QA Tester
Experience: 02 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-site / Remote
Location: Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh

Job Summary:

We are looking for enthusiastic and detail-oriented Software Testers to join our team. The ideal candidates should have a basic understanding of software testing concepts, strong analytical skills, and an interest in ensuring software quality.

Freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:
Perform manual testing of web and mobile applications.
Identify, report, and track software bugs and defects.
Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios.
Perform functional, regression, and usability testing.
Verify software functionality against business requirements.
Collaborate with developers to identify and resolve issues.
Ensure software quality and reliability.

Required Skills:
Basic knowledge of Software Testing and QA concepts.
Understanding of SDLC and STLC.
Knowledge of Manual Testing and Test Case Writing.
Basic understanding of Bug Tracking and Reporting.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Basic knowledge of SQL, API Testing, or Automation Testing will be an added advantage.
Good communication and teamwork skills.

Eligibility Criteria:
B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. (Computer Science) or equivalent qualification.
Freshers and candidates with 02 years of experience can apply.
Basic understanding of software testing methodologies.
Willingness to learn new testing tools and technologies.

What We Offer:
Opportunity to work on real-world software projects.
Learning and professional development opportunities.
Supportive and collaborative work environment.
Career growth in Software Testing and Quality Assurance.

Description:
SUMMARY
Summary:
The Field Sales Executive plays a vital role in driving business expansion within the paint-chemical industry by cultivating strong, lasting relationships with key trade partners, including painters, contractors, builders, architects, and engineers. This position demands consistent performance, proactive engagement, and a hands-on approach to achieve and exceed sales targets. The ideal candidate will conduct daily site visits, maintain a strong presence at assigned retail outlets, organize shop meetings, and ensure accurate reporting all contributing to enhanced market penetration and brand visibility. With a focus on customer-centric strategies and performance excellence, this role is essential to sustaining growth and strengthening market position across the assigned territories.

Location: Faridabad

Achieve and consistently exceed assigned sales targets.
Build and maintain long-term relationships with painters, contractors, builders, architects, engineers, and other key stakeholders.
Conduct a minimum of two site visits per day to identify new opportunities and support customer needs.
Dedicate at least two hours daily to on-site presence at assigned retail stores to drive sales and customer engagement.
Organize and lead weekly shop meetings with applicators to promote product adoption and team alignment.
Submit accurate and timely daily sales reports through the designated online portal.



Requirements
A valid two-wheeler license is mandatory for field operations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a proven ability to build relationships.
Self-motivated, disciplined, and highly driven by performance goals.
Minimum educational qualification: Graduation (preferred).
6 months to 12 months of experience in channel sales (e.g., AP/Akzo, Laminates, Plywood, Electricals, Lubricants, building materials).
Fresh graduates or professionals from insurance or banking sectors with demonstrated sales aptitude are encouraged to apply.




Benefits
Net Take Home: 18k to 23k (Negotiable)
MWA: 5,000/ -
Lucrative performance-based incentives
Absorption after 1 year based on performance
Travel allowance: 5,000 per month, depending on profile

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will develop and implement hygiene protocols and procedures to ensure all areas of the hotel meet the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene and comply with health and safety regulations. As a Hygiene Assistant Manager / Manager , you re not just ensuring cleanliness and hygiene - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e. g. , CompTIA, Cisco, Microsoft).
Manager: Minimum of 3 years in a hygiene management role, preferably in the hospitality industry.
Assistant Manager: Minimum of 2-3 years in hygiene roles within the hospitality industry, with a preference for supervisory or management positions
Supervisor: 2-3 years of experience in hygiene roles within the hospitality industry.
Excellent reading, writing, and oral proficiency in the English language.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Strategic Planning & Compliance: Develop hygiene policies and ensure adherence to health, safety, and regulatory standards.
Team Leadership & Training: Lead the hygiene team and provide ongoing training to maintain performance and standards.
Cleaning Expertise: Apply knowledge of cleaning procedures, chemicals, and equipment to ensure effective practices.
Quality Assurance: Monitor cleanliness and hygiene levels, implementing quality control measures across all areas.
Budget & Resource Management: Oversee hygiene supply budgets and ensure efficient use of resources.
Issue Resolution: Address hygiene-related concerns promptly to maintain a safe and sanitary environment.

Description:
What does an Operations Manager really do? Think of yourself as a leader and the master of
your department, so not just anyone is qualified for this role! Here at TaskUs we make sure we
get the best of the best, after all, we are a ridiculously good company so we make sure our
employees are top notch. Come on now, we need your full attention because its time to
imagine what it’s like being an Operations Manager.
Imagine yourself going to work with one thing on your mind: that in most companies, it’s all
about the KPIs but in TaskUs it’s all about solving business problems through innovation. As you
tackle your new tasks for the day, you know that it will all lead to one thing that your
department believes in: to provide the best possible customer experience to your clients.
As Operations Manager, you are also responsible for making sure that KPIs are being met
consistently. You need to come up with ways in which to effectively make each employee reach
their best potential. With this, you must also be creative because you need to devise effective
plans on how to make each employee reach their target. As a leader, you must also gain the
trust and respect of your employees because let’s face it -- how can you lead when people don’t
believe you?
You need to be able to reach out to them, drop by their workstations, have short chit-chats, and
make them feel important. You need to be able to identify their strengths and weaknesses, take
advantage of them and assign them tasks that will help them work on their weaknesses and
showcase their talents. This way, you are able to manage relationships better and develop
people at the same time.
Requirements:
So, what is it we’re looking for?
Since this is an Operations Manager post, we’d need someone who already has the skills to even
call themselves a Manager. We’re looking for someone who has strong interpersonal skills,
verbal and written communication skills and most importantly empathy. Someone who has a
high affinity and cultural awareness of political and social situations regarding the relevant
market and region that will be supported.
Someone who has at least three years of related working experience, preferably someone who
already knows how the system works -- specializing in customer experience operations and
management.

We need someone who is responsible and has a good track record of meeting and delivering
targets. Someone who can articulate him/herself well enough with others, like teammates and
clients. We need someone who can multitask and work in a fast-paced environment. Someone
who can lead and is great in analyzing situations and data.
BAU Transactions:
Handling multiple SOW for different verticals of campaign
Demonstrate achievement of results eg. business improvements, cost savings, revenue
generation
Liaising with different department to ensure smooth and effective operational delivery
Translate business strategy into day to day delivery
Collaborating with different stakeholders for new launches if any stakeholder
management ensures there is smooth communication between all the departments.
Responsible for all aspects of operations which include monitoring staffing,temporary
coverage and training, delivering excellent client service
Client Relationship Management:
Ensure delivery of Client KPIs/ targets including day to day service levels, customer
experience, quality and compliance measures
Manage and develop the operational client relationships by conducting (where
appropriate) operational client review meetings and day to day ops liaison with client
build and maintain strong client relationships
Ensuring smooth transition of new business
Ensuring all the KPI’s delivery as per SOW agreement with client
Profitability Enablement and Purview of finance & revenue
Timecard management to ensure no loss of productive hours
Timely updation of v7 revenue file to ensure zero discrepancy on projected vs actual
revenue
Timely generation of invoice
Team and People Management
Execute a well-defined Communication and Engagement model in place to ensure
that the team understands the performance of our business and also that they
understand the needs of their teams effectively managing and coaching Operations Managers
and Team Leaders

Eligibility Criteria
Must have the ability to work well in a team environment, as well as alone
Must demonstrate the ability to effectively manage time, prioritize tasks and work
within deadlines
Excellent ability to delegate responsibilities while maintaining organizational control
of team and customer service
Highly trained in conflict management and business negotiation processes
Knowledge of general business software and aptitude to learn new applications;
Proficiency in G-suite (Word, Spreadsheet etc)
Minimum 1 year of on-paper Operations Manager experience

Organization: EY LLP India – Forensic & Integrity Services
Location: Bhopal (Full-time, On-site)

About the Role
EY's Forensic & Integrity Services helps organizations strengthen trust by improving compliance and supporting effective governance. The Contract Management Expert will provide end-to-end legal and contractual support for the procurement of services, including comprehensive legal review of procurement documents, drafting and reviewing contracts, negotiating terms, and supporting contract execution and ongoing management.
The role requires a legal professional with an LLB/LLM and a Company Secretary (CS) qualification, with at least five years of relevant experience in contract management, procurement-related legal review and negotiation. Experience with government procurement and contracts is preferred. The selected candidate will work with procurement teams, business stakeholders, government authorities where applicable, and service providers to identify legal risks, support compliant procurement processes and safeguard the organization's contractual interests.
Key Responsibilities
Provide end-to-end legal and contract management support for procurement services, from procurement planning and tender documentation through negotiation, execution, administration and closure.
Conduct comprehensive legal review of requests for proposals (RFPs), tender documents, bid conditions, procurement terms, service agreements, statements of work, purchase orders and related documents.
Draft, review and revise service procurement contracts, confidentiality agreements, amendments, addenda, extensions and renewals to ensure clarity, consistency and appropriate legal safeguards.
Lead or support negotiations with service providers and counterparties on legal and commercial terms, in coordination with procurement, finance and business teams.
Assess contractual provisions covering scope of services, deliverables, service levels, acceptance criteria, payment terms, performance security, warranties, indemnities, liability, confidentiality, data protection, intellectual property, termination and dispute resolution.
Review procurement documents and proposed contractual arrangements for compliance with applicable laws, procurement rules, government guidelines where relevant, internal policies and approval requirements.
Identify legal and contractual risks, prepare review notes and risk assessments, recommend mitigation measures, and escalate material deviations for appropriate approvals.
Coordinate stakeholder reviews, resolve contractual queries, document negotiated positions and support completion of approvals and execution formalities.
Maintain contract repositories, obligation trackers and records of approvals, amendments, key milestones, notice periods and renewals to support ongoing compliance and audit readiness.
Provide legal support on contract interpretation, changes in scope, service delivery issues, contractual notices, claims, disputes, termination and closure, coordinating with the legal team or external counsel where required.
Develop and improve procurement contract templates, clause libraries, review checklists and guidance materials, and prepare periodic reports on contract status, risks and outstanding actions.
Educational Qualifications
Essential: LLB/LLM from a recognized university/institution, together with a completed Company Secretary (CS) qualification from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).
Desirable: Additional training or certification in contract management, public procurement or commercial law.
Experience Requirements
At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in contract management, procurement-related legal review, drafting and negotiation of service contracts.
Demonstrated experience conducting comprehensive legal reviews of procurement documentation and negotiating service agreements, including identifying and resolving legal and commercial risks.
Experience managing the contract lifecycle, including approvals, execution, amendments, renewals, obligation tracking and contract closure.
Experience in government procurement or government contracts, including service procurement for government departments, public sector undertakings or government-funded projects, is preferred.
Skills & Competencies
Strong knowledge of contract law, commercial agreements and legal principles relevant to procurement of services.
Ability to interpret and apply procurement policies, tender conditions and government procurement requirements where applicable.
Excellent legal drafting, contract review and negotiation skills.
Sound legal judgment, analytical thinking and the ability to recommend practical risk mitigation measures.
Attention to detail when reviewing complex procurement documents, contractual obligations and cross-document consistency.
Ability to manage multiple contracts, prioritize time-sensitive reviews and meet procurement timelines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain legal issues clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
Effective stakeholder coordination, professional integrity and discretion in handling confidential procurement and contractual information.
Proficiency in contract documentation, redlining, report preparation and use of contract repositories or contract management tools.
Preferred Experience
Hands-on experience reviewing government tenders, RFPs and service procurement contracts, and coordinating with government departments or public sector entities.
Experience supporting procurement of consulting, professional, technology, outsourced or other services, including review of service levels and performance obligations.
Exposure to procurement governance, legal due diligence, contract compliance reviews and audit support within government or regulated environments.

Description:
Job Summary
The Workforce Management Lead/Supervisor oversees the daily operations of the WFM team and orchestrates the staffing strategies of the organization. This role involves analyzing historical data to predict future volume, creating optimized staff schedules, and leading real-time "command center" operations to respond to intraday spikes or outages. You will serve as the bridge between senior leadership and frontline operations.
Core Responsibilities
1. Forecasting & Strategic Planning
Analyze historical trends (seasonality, marketing campaigns, product launches) to develop accurate long-term and short-term volume forecasts.
Collaborate with Finance and Operations to create capacity plans and headcount requirements.
Conduct "What-If" scenario modeling to determine the impact of process changes or new business initiatives.
2. Scheduling & Optimization
Lead the creation and maintenance of employee schedules that balance service level goals with employee preferences and labor laws.
Manage "shrinkage" (vacation, training, coaching, and sick time) to ensure it does not compromise service levels.
Oversee the shift-bidding process and manage requests for schedule changes or time off.
3. Real-Time Management (RTM)
Supervise real-time analysts to monitor queue performance and agent adherence. Trigger "bridge" actions during emergencies, such as re-routing calls, canceling meetings, or offering voluntary time off (VTO) or overtime (OT).
Serve as the primary escalation point for system outages or severe staffing gaps.
4. Reporting & Analysis
Present weekly and monthly performance dashboards to senior leadership. Identify root causes for missed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and propose actionable solutions.
Audit WFM software data to ensure accuracy in payroll and performance reporting.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
A WFM Lead is typically measured by:
Service Level (SL): e.g., 80% of calls answered within 20 seconds.
Forecast Accuracy: The variance between predicted volume and actual volume. Schedule Adherence: The percentage of time agents follow their assigned schedules. Occupancy: The percentage of time logged-in agents are actively handling work. Cost per Contact: Ensuring staffing levels do not result in excessive waste or overtime.
Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills
WFM Software Mastery: Expert proficiency in tools like NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or Genesys Cloud.
Advanced Data Analytics: High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas) and experience with SQL or Power BI/Tableau is a plus.
Operational Knowledge: Deep understanding of Contact Center metrics (AHT, ACW, ASA).
Soft Skills
Crisis Management: Ability to remain calm and make data-driven decisions during high-pressure outages.
Communication: Translating complex data into simple stories for non-technical stakeholders.
Leadership: Experience mentoring analysts and driving a culture of accountability.

About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by trackingcontrolling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

CTC Upto 2

37 Lacs ( for Non Metro) / 2

8Lacs ( for Metro )
Incentives extra - Best in the industry

About IIFL Finance
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Job Title Customer Care Executive (Gold Loans)
Job Description -
Responsible toacquire New Customers for generating Gold Loan business and for other cross sell products

Participate in field- marketing activities toimprove the brand visibility of IIFL Finance Limited branch in the catchment areas and generate leads of prospective customers

Drive & ensure continuous customer engagement through various channels

Maintaining quality portfolio by tracking& controlling ROI

Provide after salesservice to existing customers and obtain references from them to increase thecustomer base

Strong follow up on interest collectionsto keep NPAs (non-performing assets) under control

Desired Candidate Profile (CCE) -
Candidateswith 6 months of sales experience in Banking & Financial Services can applyfor the role

Fresherswith flair in Sales can also apply

In summary,the role focuses heavily on sales - acquiring new customers, engaging withexisting ones, ensuring portfolio quality, and collecting payments to minimizedefaults

Brand building through field marketing is also a key component

Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Check figures, postings, and documents for correct entry, mathematical accuracy, and proper codes. Organize, secure, and maintain all files, records, cash and cash equivalents in accordance with policies and procedures. Record, store, access, and/or analyze computerized financial information. Maintain accurate electronic spreadsheets for financial and accounting data. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to compile and keep financial records, using journals, ledgers, and/or computers. Prepare, maintain, and distribute statistical, financial, accounting, auditing, or payroll reports and tables. Complete period-end closing procedures and reports as specified. Prepare, review, reconcile, and issue bills, invoices, and account statements according to company procedures.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets; protect the privacy and security of guests and coworkers. Address guests service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely; answer telephones and emails using appropriate etiquette. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, which is focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform by offering them a variety of payment use cases. Superpowers/ Skills that will help you succeed in this role

We aim at bringing half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy, and everyone working here is striving to achieve that goal. Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled Spark Scala Engineer with 5-7 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining large-scale data processing applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Apache Spark, Scala, AWS services, and hands-on experience working on data migration projects. Experience with MongoDB schema validation, cloud-native architectures, and data pipeline optimization is highly desirable.
Roles & Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and optimize scalable batch and real-time data processing solutions using Apache Spark and Scala.
Build and maintain robust data ingestion frameworks for processing high-volume data from multiple source systems.
Participate in large-scale data migration projects, including data analysis, transformation, validation, and reconciliation activities.
Develop and manage ETL/ELT pipelines using AWS services such as EMR, S3, and Step Functions.
Analyze and resolve data quality issues, ensure data consistency, and support production troubleshooting.
Work closely with business stakeholders, data architects, and cross-functional teams to gather and translate requirements into technical solutions.
Implement monitoring, logging, and performance tuning of Spark applications.
Perform schema design, validation, and data modeling activities in MongoDB.
Conduct root cause analysis for data ingestion and processing issues and implement preventive measures.
Ensure adherence to coding standards, security guidelines, and best practices.
Required Skills & QualificationsTechnical Skills
3-6 years of hands-on experience in Scala and Apache Spark development.
Strong experience in building ETL/Data Ingestion pipelines.
Extensive knowledge of AWS Cloud Services, including:
Amazon EMR
Amazon S3
AWS Step Functions
IAM and CloudWatch (preferred)
Experience working on data migration projects involving legacy-to-cloud or platform modernization initiatives.
Strong SQL skills and experience with large-scale data processing.
Hands-on experience with MongoDB, including:
Schema design
Schema validation
Data modeling
Query optimization
Experience in handling structured and semi-structured datasets (JSON, CSV, Avro, Parquet, etc.).
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Agile development methodologies.
l scripting for automating tasks.

Pathologist-Full Time
Patna
Lab Operations
Role summary
Managerial Responsibilities:
Overall Management of the laboratory
Consumption management
Quality management

Technical Responsibilities:
Up gradation of advanced technologies Quality of the results.
What the role entails - Key accountabilities/ responsibilities
1. Provide advice to those requesting information about the choice of tests, the use of the laboratory service and the interpretation of laboratory data.
2. Serve as an active member of the medical staff in main lab, collection center,
3. Relate and function effectively with NABL & other accrediting agencies, Appropriate administrative officials, healthcare community, the patient / clients.
4. Define, implement, and monitor standards of performance and quality improvement of the medical laboratory service orservices.
5. Monitor all processes in the laboratory to determine that reliable data is being generated.
6. Ensure availability of sufficiently qualified personnel with adequate training and experience to meet the needs of the laboratory.
7. Plan, set goals, develop, and allocate resources appropriate to the medical environment.
8. Provide effective and efficient administration of the medical laboratory service, including budget planning and control with responsible financial management, in accordance with institutional assignment of such responsibilities.
9. Provide educational programs for the medical and laboratory staff and participate in educational programs of the institution.
10. Implement a safe laboratory environment in compliance with good practice and applicable regulations.
11. Address any complaint, request, or suggestion from users of laboratory services. Ensure good staff morale.
12. Report authorization of Hematology, Biochemistry, Immunoassay, Clinical Pathology, and serology
13. Routine review of QC for all departments with review of reports including CBC, MP, PS, Reticulocyte count, Fluid routine, ICT/DCT, Blood group before approving
14. Formulate review and recheck policies for all tests and ensure compliance with the help of Lab supervisor and technicians.
15. Verification of critical, unusual, and abnormal test results before release
16. Interpret, Correlate, and generate medically significant laboratory data.
17. Attending all sorts of client queries related to test enquiries and interpretation of test results.
18. Approval of SOPs for use and ensure compliance with respect to accreditation requirements.
19. Ensure review of monthly MIS
20. Ensure results are reported within turnaround time with the help of section head.
21. Review and improvement of reports formats.
22. To identify new equipment, tests, technology, products and standardization of assays.
23. Identify needs for resources (human / equipment / infrastructure) and submit to senior management for approval.
24. Attending conferences/workshops to ensure updated knowledge about recent trends.
25. To spend time reviewing daily pendency status on reports not released as well as sample received cases to avoid patient dissatisfaction.
26. To keep a watchful eye on instrument maintenance and hygiene of lab and practice 0 tolerance in this area. Any instrument failure due to user s should be avoided totally as it affects our patient and business.
27. To ensure sample processing is not stopped due to KIT non availability.
28. To ensure that every PR is approved on time and any gaps are highlighted.
29. COL/ Lab Head should work with BU Heads in forecasting CAMP s and other seasonal activities and order KITs sufficiently.
30. To keep a close watch on technical complaints. Ensure analytical complaints get logged, DE flagging is minimized. For recorded complaints and initiate proper CAPA and must also discuss in weekly calls with the team on learning and preventive actionsand timely escalation of analytical complaints/ Legal threats
31. To spend quality time on understanding patient and customer VOC especially on cases we are not resolving on time. COL/Lab Head should guide the team to resolve issues on time andsupport them wherever technical input is required.
32. To participate in weekly meetings along with BU/SBU Heads to resolve issues as well as seek support wherever needs from nontechnical team.
33. To take responsibility to train the non-technical team for better business and customer engagement.
34. COL/Lab Head must contribute at least 8 hours in a month in training and sharing knowledge to the team through a formal mechanism.
35. To promote MHL test to larger communities of clinician through KOL Connects. They must use our report as a tool to promote test by recommending new test based on diagnosis in the report.
36. To make time at least once a month to meet B2B clients, collection centers, customers to understand the pulse of the market.
37. To follow guidelines objectively as per MHL Policy and ensure a culture of data-based decision making and discussions; hence every month compliance is very important. It is at most importance for to have self-Compliance from every lab and noncompliance is given utmost importance for closure.
38. To give sufficient time to check and review the Lab managers /Technical team on quality, material consumption and technical performance.
39. Ensure that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented, and maintained.
40. Reporting to laboratory management, at the level at which decisions are made on laboratory policy, objectives, and resources, on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement.
41. Ensuring the promotion of awareness of users needs and requirements throughout the laboratory organization.
What we are looking for in you
Excellent communication and analytical skill.

Lab Operations Team

Yes

A strong growth prospective.

Job description
Area Business Manager / First Line Manager (FLM)
Paediatric and Kids Nutrition
Target Age Group: 32-38 years

Experience: 7+ years in Pharmaceutical Sales (Minimum 2 years as FLM in Nutrition OR 23 years in Pediatrics)

About Panacea Biotec
Panacea Biotec is an integrated Indian biotechnology company with over 30 years of innovation and care. We have played a pivotal role in the eradication of Poliomyelitis supplying over 10 billion doses of the polio vaccine and over 220 million doses of the world's first fully liquid combination vaccines. A two-time recipient of Thomson Reuters Top 50 Innovator of the Year award.

Our consumer business offers science-driven solutions for newborns and children Staart Prime (infant formula free from maltodextrin, palm oil, fructose, and table sugar, fortified with prebiotics), NikoMom (baby care range diapers, wet wipes, massage oil, head-to-toe wash, lotion, diaper rash cream), and ChilRun (clinically proven nutrition with over 18% higher protein absorption for ages 2+ and 7+).

Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced First Line Manager (FLM) to lead a team of Territory Business Managers / Medical Representatives. In this role, you will be the custodian of the Paediatric and Kids Nutrition portfolio in your area responsible for how customers perceive, trust, and recommend our brands. You will build brand equity in your geography while delivering sustainable business outcomes.
You are a business leader for your territory not just a field supervisor. You will balance three equally important dimensions: building your brands, developing your people, and delivering consistent business results.

Key Responsibilities
Therapy Ownership and Brand Building
Own the paediatric and kids nutrition therapy category in your territory. You are accountable for how deeply our brands are understood, trusted, and prescribed by every relevant doctor in your geography.
Build and maintain a structured engagement plan for high-potential accounts — from awareness to advocacy — ensuring our brands are the preferred choice.
Execute brand strategies at the clinic level with precision. Ensure every brand communication is therapeutically relevant, and scientifically accurate.
Drive brand salience and consideration among paediatricians through consistent, high-quality detailing and patient-centric conversations.
Continuously gather market intelligence — competitor activity, prescription trends, emerging therapy preferences — and feed insights back to the marketing team for strategy refinement.
Protect and enhance brand reputation in the market through ethical engagement and scientific credibility.

Team Leadership and People Development
Conduct Joint Field Work (JFW) with each team member regularly — observe in-clinic performance, communication effectiveness, and objection handling.
Diagnose root causes of underperformance and execute corrective action plans through structured coaching and mentorship.
Perform weekly performance reviews with team members covering sales progress, doctor conversions, and coverage deviations amongst others.
Identify learning and development needs within the team and provide continuous coaching tailored to each individual's growth stage.
Sales Execution and Business Outcomes
Drive business objectives (Primary and Secondary) for the assigned area.
Execute systematic conversion plans to grow the prescriber base month on month.
Conduct regular Retail Chemist Prescription Audits (RCPA) to evaluate retail availability, monitor real brand demand, and course-correct field efforts to make our brands widely available.
Manage stockist and distributor relationships to ensure wide product availability and healthy channel inventory.

Process Discipline and Operational Rigour
Ensure strict adherence to Sales Force Automation (SFA) compliance — daily call reports (DCR), campaign logs, and monthly tour plan submissions.
Monitor coverage deviations and visit frequencies — prioritise visits to core missed doctors at the earliest opportunity.
Maintain data integrity in all field reporting. Accuracy and timeliness are non-negotiable.

Who You Are
Experience and Background

Qualification: B.Pharm or B.Sc.
Experience: 7+ years in pharmaceutical sales, with minimum 1–2 years as an FLM in Nutrition or 2–3 years in Pediatrics.
Track record of working with leading pharmaceutical or paediatric nutrition companies.
A strong existing network of 30–40 prominent Paediatricians in the target territory is preferred.

Competencies and Mindset
Therapy depth: Strong domain knowledge in Paediatrics and Nutritional therapy.
Territory intelligence: Deep understanding of territory dynamics, stockist/distributor networks, and competitor strategies.
Coaching ability: Proven team management and mentoring skills with the ability to diagnose and develop individual capability.
Analytical thinking: Ability to analyse territory data, identify patterns, and make informed decisions.
Results orientation: Highly self-motivated with a consistent track record of achievement.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication with strong interpersonal skills.

What We Offer
Fast-track career growth and personal development opportunities.
Competitive compensation with attractive sales incentives.
An open, collaborative culture within a high-growth biopharmaceutical company that values how you achieve result

Description:
Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales
Department: PSD
Function: Institutional Sales
Designation: Product Sales Executive (PSE)
Reporting To: ABM/ Regional Manager
Experience: 3 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Location - Mumbai, Kolkata, Patna, Bihar


Job Purpose
The Product Sales Executive (PSE) Institutional Sales will be responsible for driving product
sales and business growth through institutional customers. The role involves identifying new
business opportunities, developing relationships with key institutional clients, generating
enquiries, preparing quotations, negotiating commercial terms, and ensuring achievement of assigned sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and develop new institutional customers and business opportunities.
- Manage relationships with existing institutional clients and ensure repeat business.
- Conduct regular customer visits and understand product requirements.
- Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and other business development activities.
- Present and demonstrate products to institutional customers as required.
- Prepare and submit quotations, proposals and commercial offers.
- Coordinate with internal teams for pricing, product availability, dispatch and delivery.
- Follow up on enquiries, quotations and orders to ensure timely conversion.
- Negotiate with customers within approved company guidelines.
- Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
- Maintain an updated database of institutional customers, prospects and sales activities.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements.
- Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments in coordination with the finance team.
- Handle customer queries and coordinate for resolution of complaints.
- Maintain regular sales reports, visit reports and pipeline updates.
- Support the organization in developing new territories, accounts and product opportunities.

Key Accountabilities / KPIs
- Achievement of assigned sales targets.
- New institutional customer acquisition.
- Revenue and product-wise sales growth.
- Enquiry-to-order conversion.
- Number and quality of customer visits.
- Development of active sales pipeline.
- Customer retention and repeat orders.
- Timely payment/collection follow-up.
- Gross margin as per company guidelines.
- Accuracy and timely submission of sales reports.

Target Customer Segments
The candidate may be responsible for developing business from:
- Corporates and large organizations
- Educational institutions
- Hospitals and healthcare institutions
- Government/semi-government institutions
- Hotels and hospitality organizations
- Dealers/distributors and institutional buyers
- NGOs and other bulk purchasers
- Other B2B/institutional customers relevant to the company's product portfolio

Candidate Profile
Qualification:
- Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

Experience:
- 3 years of experience in B2B, institutional sales, corporate sales or field sales.
- Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude may also be considered.
Skills Required:
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills.
- Ability to generate leads and convert prospects into customers.
- Target-oriented and self-motivated approach.
- Good presentation and convincing skills.
- Basic knowledge of MS Office/Excel and CRM systems.
- Willingness to travel extensively for customer meetings.
- Ability to work independently.

Desired Competencies
- Business development
- Customer relationship management
- Sales planning and execution
- Negotiation skills
- Market intelligence
- Follow-up and closing skills
- Problem-solving ability
- Time management
- Result orientation

Description:
Job Summary
The role will be responsible to drive sales and customer acquisition for home loan and mortgage products, and contribute to the organizations revenue growth through direct sourcing and strategic networking. This role involves generating leads, managing customer relationships, conducting field visits, and ensuring end-to-end loan processing with a focus on delivering a seamless customer experience.
Key Responsibilities
Go on field visits to meet customers and explain loan products
Work to achieve sales targets and help grow the company's business
Build good relationships with customers by meeting them regularly and following up for more business
Meet new customers and ask happy customers to refer others who may need a home loan
Coordinate with credit team for smooth processing and disbursal of loans
Maintain credit quality
Onboard new channel partners
Find and add new housing projects (APFs) and agents to bring in more loan applications
Requirements
1-5 years of experience in Home Loan or Mortgage Sales within the BFSI/NBFC sector
Prior experience in direct customer acquisition and channel sales preferred; Freshers with strong sales aptitude may also be considered
Strong local market knowledge and established network in the region
Excellent interpersonal skills
Customer handling and relationship-building abilities
Result-oriented and self-motivated
Strong negotiation and influencing skills
Educational Qualifications
Minimum: Graduate in any discipline (Bachelors degree required)
Having a two-wheeler will be an added advantage

Description:
Job Summary
Function Summary: IRDA Regulation on IMF was released, where companies which are LLP / Pvt limited / cooperative societies were allowed to distribute financial products. IMFs are allowed to deal in Insurance of 6 companies (2LI, 2GI, 2HI), mutual funds, banking products, post etc. Max Life spotted this opportunity to attract established financial distributors from the market to engage and distribute Max Life products - Pearl Acquisition. A dedicated team of 50 CDMs were recruited in two phases and trained to hire and foster these relationships. Currently we have 95 licensed IMFs on board and expected to touch 150 which are work in progress. The pool of IMFs primarily comprises top Agents in Insurance, Wealth Managers, Loan DSA, CA, ex-employees from financial services with an existing customer base. Present IMFs carry avg. 2500 customers and big turnover book. As a later part of Pearl acquisition strategy, Insurance Managers is a career option provided to establish financial distributors who are not able to meet the requirements of forming an IMF. This has also proven to be an exciting opportunity. Insurance Manager is a part-time employee model which provides a platform to the pearl to associate with MLI and improve their earnings, flexible working hours and better choices for their customers. IMFs will be different from an ADM/APC as they will not be recruiting and mentoring Agents and will only source business by penetrating into their existing client base. Avg book size with them is also 750 customers.


Key Responsibilities
Understand the IMF regulation, value proposition registration process
Independently implement the IMF acquisition plan in the territory
Identify potential leads and sources for prospective IMFs, coordinate with HO for referred leads
Connect with prospects, organize seminars for IMF acquisition
Ensure conversion of leads through effective pitch of IMF value proposition
Ensure quality of IMFs in sync with desired profile
Enable the setup of IMFs of agreed prospects
Understand all regulatory requirements and manage the IMF registration process with IRDA
Oversee technology support to enrolled IMFs
Ensure seamless contracting of IMFs with Max Life
Manage performance of setup IMFs in steady state
Develop understanding of products, coach IMF staff on product USP s
Implement a performance management and rewards system
Drive IMF profitability through improving productivity of IMF s, sellers, controlling cost of sales
Provide marketing, training and operational support to IMFs
Manage attrition of IMFs through revival or replacement


Measures of Success
IMF Acquisition
Revenue
IMF Activity Retention
Quality of Business


Qualifications and Experience
Educational Background: Preferably a graduate
Work Experience: At least 5-6 years of experience in Sales Distribution, Key Account Management


Knowledge / Skills / Abilities
Written communication
Presentation skills
Interpersonal skills
Stakeholder management
Partner management
Strategic initiatives management
Program management
Training
Coaching the Partner employees

Key Responsibilities

Verify customer documentation, KYC records, loan files, and related documents for completeness and compliance.
Review adherence to company policies, operational procedures, and regulatory guidelines governing gold loan operations.
Examine gold quality assessment, weight verification, valuation practices, and safe custody procedures.
Identify operational risks, control gaps, policy deviations, irregularities, and instances of non-compliance.
Prepare detailed audit reports highlighting observations, risk assessments, and recommendations for improvement.
Discuss audit findings with branch staff and management to ensure clarity and understanding of observations.
Monitor and follow up on audit observations to ensure timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
Maintain accurate audit documentation and working papers in accordance with audit standards.
Escalate significant risks, fraud indicators, or control deficiencies to the Audit Manager as required.
Support special audits, investigations, and compliance reviews when assigned.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
14 years of experience in internal audit, operational audit, or gold loan operations.
Knowledge of gold loan processes, KYC requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
Understanding of audit methodologies, risk assessment, and internal controls.
Skills Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy in audit verification.
Good report-writing and documentation skills.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and travel extensively for onsite audits.
Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel and Word.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in NBFC, banking, or gold loan industry.
Exposure to branch audits and operational risk assessments.
Knowledge of fraud detection and compliance monitoring practices.
Working Conditions
Frequent travel to branch locations for onsite audits.
Ability to manage multiple audit assignments and meet deadlines.
Willingness to work across assigned regions as per business requirements.

Preparing the Operation Theater for all elective and emergency operative procedures.
Communication & informing Sr. Consultants, Anesthetist, other OT technician & support staff about all Posted, Elective/Emergency procedure, for timely execution.
Explain patients all required information about procedure in Ward and patient query resolution.

Collecting, labeling & transporting advised tissue/blood sample, along with TRF to laboratory for testing.
Shifting & Monitoring Patient in Recovery Ward.
Following all standard rules, guideline and achieving compliances as per the policies of universal precaution, Biomedical Hazard, infection control.
Regularly doing emergency drill along with other staff like CPR/AED drills

Job title: Customer Service Assistant
Reporting to: Commercial Manager/ Store Manager
Job Summary
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations. Your key responsibilities include:
Responsibilities
Greet & Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.
Support Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the store's appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling: Ensure products are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.
Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering: When needed, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.
On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.
Qualifications
Essential: Minimum 12th Pass
Preferred: Any Graduate

Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.

Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
License or Certification: None
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving B2B customer acquisition for PTL vertical. As a sales professional, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
New Business Development: Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular
PTL freight movement needs.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
1+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's leading supply chain services company.
The company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, LTL and FTL freight, reverse logistics, cross-border, B2B & B2C warehousing and technology services.
Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities

Description:
To provide high-quality psychological assessment, short-term counselling, and evidence-based therapeutic interventions to outpatients and inpatients. The role acts as a bridge between mental and physical healthcare, working within a multidisciplinary medical team to improve patient outcomes while rigorously adhering to NABH Standards regarding patient care, rights, informed consent, and clinical documentation.

Key Responsibilities1. Core Psychological & Therapeutic Duties
Assessments: Conduct systematic psychological, emotional, and behavioral evaluations to identify patient distress patterns related to chronic illnesses, lifestyle diseases, surgeries, trauma, or psychiatric conditions.
Therapy Delivery: Provide evidence-based individual, group, or family counselling to address anxiety, clinical depression, stress, grief, and treatment adherence issues.
Crisis Intervention: Deliver emergency psychological first aid for patients experiencing acute trauma, severe diagnoses, or self-harm ideation within the hospital.
Specialized Care Support: Collaborate with departments like Oncology, Cardiology, Diabetology, Palliative Care, and Bariatrics to help patients cope with chronic medical conditions.
2. NABH Standard Compliance & Quality Control
Standardized Documentation (COP - Care of Patients): Maintain flawless, highly precise electronic and manual case files. Document all psychological evaluations, customized care plans, progress tracking, and discharge notes according to standard templates approved by the hospital's quality desk.
Patient Rights & Education (PRE): Ensure the absolute protection of patient data and medical confidentiality. Formally educate the patient and their family members regarding treatment plans, therapeutic expectations, and available support systems.
Informed Consent: Strictly obtain and document informed consent before executing specialized psychotherapeutic strategies or assessments.
Incidents & Medication Safety: Report any adverse behavioral events or psychological crises immediately via the hospital's standardized incident reporting system. Ensure clear separation between psychological therapies and psychotropic prescription tracking.
Audits & KPIs: Participate in routine internal clinical audits and track psychology department Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure the department remains fully prepared for NABH surveillance audits.
3. Interdisciplinary Collaboration
Participate actively in multidisciplinary case conferences alongside psychiatrists, neurologists, physicians, and medical social workers to enable holistic recovery paths.
Provide consultation, basic counselling skills training, and burnout management workshops for the hospital's nursing and allied health staff.

Qualifications and Skills
Education:
Masters Degree (M.A./M.Sc.) in Counselling Psychology or Clinical Psychology from a UGC-recognized university.
Preferred: M.Phil in Clinical/Counselling Psychology or a relevant doctoral degree (Ph.D./Psy.D.).
Note: Registration with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) or Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) is highly valued depending on specific clinical assessment duties.
Experience: Minimum 2–5 years of practice in a multi-specialty or psychiatric hospital setting (prior exposure to NABH or JCI accredited workflows is a significant advantage).
Core Competencies: Active listening, high emotional intelligence, crisis de-escalation, and proficiency in clinical information systems (HIS/EMR tools)

Description:
Communications Executive (1 Post): To support organisational communication through content development, programme coordination, documentation, storytelling and communication planning. The role involves working closely with programme teams to gather information, document activities and develop content for the organisation's digital platforms, publications and outreach materials.


Key Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field.
2-3 years of relevant experience in communications, content writing, documentation or related work.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Good research, storytelling, coordination and organisational skills.
Ability to work collaboratively with multiple teams and manage deadlines.


Desirable Skills
Experience in content writing, editing, journalism, public relations or organisational communications.
Familiarity with social media platforms, digital communication and content management systems.
Basic photography, videography and content creation skills.
Working knowledge of Canva, MS Office and Google Workspace.
Experience in NGO, development or community-based programmes.


Key Responsibilities
Develop and edit content for social media, website, newsletters, reports, press releases and other communication materials.
Coordinate with programme teams to gather updates, information, stories, photographs and communication requirements.
Document programmes, events, activities and outcomes through written reports, case studies, success stories and testimonials.
Support the planning and execution of organisational and programme-specific communication campaigns.
Prepare content briefs, captions, scripts, articles and communication materials in coordination with the Multimedia team.
Assist with media coordination, public relations, interviews and organisational announcements.
Maintain content calendars, communication records, media archives and documentation repositories.
Ensure accuracy, consistency and timely delivery of communication outputs.


Additional Responsibilities as Required
Support communication and documentation during events, workshops, campaigns and field activities.
Assist in preparing organisational profiles, presentations, brochures, newsletters and publications.
Undertake field visits, interviews and programme documentation.
Support other communication-related activities as assigned.

Description:
Job Summary
Title Technical Expert Organisation YR Gaitonde Medical Educational Research Foundation (YRGMERF) Project Disha Experience Required 5 years


Responsibilities
Mentoring and Supervision: Based at the cluster level, provide mentoring support to 4 to 5 DISHA cluster units or DISHA single units.
Conduct monthly visits to all assigned DISHA units to provide on-site mentoring and supportive supervision.
Provide evidence-based technical guidance on all components of NACP V to the DISHA units.
Coordination and Collaboration: Strengthen coordination with allied health departments at the district level (NHM, NTEP, NVHCP) for enhanced referral linkages.
Make field visits to NACP facilities along with DISHA staff for supportive supervision and capacity building.
Reporting and Data Quality: Ensure the timely and quality submission of monthly reports for DISHA.
Verify data reported by at least 3 facilities per district each month and provide inputs to ensure data quality.
Guidance and Capacity Building: Guide the DISHA team on advocacy, stakeholder coordination, and coordination with other departments in the district.
Assist DISHA in developing district profiles, integrated action plans, and DISHA-specific IEC materials.
Orient and ensure optimal implementation of all component activities as per NACP V in the district/DISHA cluster.
Implementation of Strategies: Guide DISHA units on implementing new strategies of NACP V, such as CSS, SSS, SOA, use of virtual media, APN, index case, etc.
Provide component-wise inputs and guidance to enhance the overall performance of DISHA units.
Performance Improvement: Responsible for periodic improvement in the 95-95-95 performance targets of the DISHA cluster.
Field Visits: Conduct field visits for a minimum of 20 days per month to provide on-site support and supervision.


Requirements
Master's Degree in Social Work, Sociology, Public Health, Humanities, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in public health projects, particularly in HIV/AIDS programs.
Strong understanding of NACP V and public health systems.
Excellent mentoring, supervisory, and capacity-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Proficiency in data analysis and reporting.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Flexibility to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
Position : Consultant- State Coordinator Tele Law

Organization: CSC e-Governance Services India Limited
CSC e-Governance Services India Limited is a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) under the Ministry of Electronics & IT. It serves as a key implementation agency for the Digital India programme, delivering Government-to-Citizen (G2C) services, digital literacy, and financial inclusion through a network of over 5.8 lakh CSC centres across the country.

Website: https://cscspv.in/index.html

Location:
Chandigarh( Punjab)- One position
Dimapur (Nagaland)- One position
Hyderabad (Telangana)- One position


Job Purpose
The incumbent will be responsible for the effective implementation and coordination of the project in the State. The role will involve training and capacity building of VLEs and Nyaye Sahayaks, coordination with key stakeholders, field-level monitoring, achievement of project targets, management of Panel Advocates, and timely preparation of project reports.

Key Responsibilities
Training & Capacity Building
Conduct training and capacity-building activities for Village Level Entrepreneurs (VLEs) and Nyaye Sahayaks.
Orient and support VLEs and Nyaye Sahayaks regarding project processes, guidelines, service delivery and operational requirements.
Identify training and capacity-building requirements and coordinate appropriate interventions.
Stakeholder Coordination
Coordinate with key stakeholders including State Legal Services Authority (SLSA), Panel Advocates, VLEs and Nyaye Sahayaks for effective implementation of the project.
Maintain regular communication with stakeholders and resolve operational issues in a timely manner.
Coordinate with concerned officials and field teams for smooth delivery of project activities.
Field Visits & Monitoring
Undertake regular field visits to monitor project implementation and service delivery.
Visit VLE/Nyaye Sahayak locations to assess performance, identify challenges and provide necessary support.
Monitor field-level activities and ensure adherence to project guidelines and processes.
Document field observations and follow up on corrective actions.
Reporting & Documentation
Prepare and submit weekly and monthly project reports as per prescribed formats and timelines.
Maintain accurate records of project activities, training programmes, field visits, stakeholder meetings and target achievement.
Provide regular updates to the reporting manager on project progress, challenges and key developments.
Target Achievement
Work towards achievement of allocated project targets and KPIs.
Monitor performance against assigned targets and take appropriate measures to improve achievement.
Coordinate with VLEs, Nyaye Sahayaks and Panel Advocates to ensure timely delivery of project services.
Panel Advocate Management
Coordinate and manage Panel Advocates associated with the project.
Facilitate communication between Panel Advocates, SLSA, VLEs and Nyaye Sahayaks.
Monitor the participation and performance of Panel Advocates and escalate operational issues where required.
Maintain relevant records and reports relating to Panel Advocates and their engagement in project activities.
Project Coordination
Support the State/Project Head in the overall implementation and monitoring of the project.
Ensure timely execution of activities as per project guidelines, timelines and targets.
Identify operational challenges and provide suitable solutions in coordination with the concerned stakeholders.
Perform any other project-related responsibilities assigned by the reporting manager from time to time.

Educational Qualification
Bachelor's Degree in Law / Social Work / Management / Public Administration / Rural Development / Humanities or any relevant discipline from a recognized university.
LLB / relevant legal qualification will be an added advantage.

Experience
2- 5 years of relevant experience in project coordination, legal services, government projects, social-sector projects, training/capacity building or field operations.
Experience of working with SLSA/DLSA, Panel Advocates, VLEs, government departments or similar stakeholders will be preferred.

Key Skills
Stakeholder management and coordination
Training and capacity building
Field-level project monitoring
Target-oriented approach
Report preparation and documentation
Team and Panel Advocate coordination
Good communication and interpersonal skills
MS Office / Excel / PowerPoint
Ability to work independently and undertake frequent field visits

Key Competencies
Excellent coordination and communication skills
Strong follow-up and execution skills
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders
Result-oriented approach
Problem-solving ability
Good reporting and documentation skills
Willingness to travel extensively for field visits
Ability to work in a target-driven environment

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of allocated project targets
Number and quality of training/capacity-building activities
Effective coordination with SLSA, Panel Advocates, VLEs and Nyaye Sahayaks
Timely completion of field visits
Timely submission of weekly and monthly reports
Effective management and engagement of Panel Advocates
Resolution of field-level operational issues
Overall project implementation and stakeholder satisfaction

Description:
Job Summary
Lead Facilitator - Nagaland - East Hub
Location: Kohima, Nagaland
Responsibilities
Design
Ability to design contextualized training structure with new activities and workshops based on local emerging needs and context.
Improvise contents of the workshop in the moment and be aware of the plan / curriculum being only a guiding document.
Converse, make sense and contextualize content of the workshop based on the group.
Facilitation
Keep the process connected to the program goals.
Hold space for the group and individuals to express themselves deeply.
Invite individual and group creativity.
Improvise and be spontaneous in front of a group.
Hold an attitude of welcome and inclusion.
Develop the culture of appreciation.
Managing Strong Emotions in a group (Manage Triggers).
Be able to track the journey of the group and individuals.
Training
Train other facilitators / stakeholders on the Principles / Practices / Processes of facilitation with a minimum of 10-day TOT workshop.
Provide one-on-one mentoring on principles of facilitation.
Accountability
Accountable for ensuring high-quality implementation of the SEL Teacher s Handbook by strengthening the facilitation capacity of SRGs, identifying emerging learning needs, enabling continuous improvement, and supporting coherence across implementation partners.
Accountable for nurturing a facilitative culture of reflection, appreciation, feedback, and collaborative learning within the team and across stakeholders. Accountable for making thoughtful real-time facilitation and design decisions that respond to emerging group needs while remaining aligned to programme intent.
Accountable for independent designing, facilitating, and adapting sessions based on the context.
Delivering complex facilitation spaces in alignment with program goals.
Accountable for mentoring peers, managing emotions in groups, and building a culture of feedback, reflection, and appreciation.
Supports cross-team alignment and champions inclusion and care in all spaces held.
Accountability for quality, alignment, and transformation - ensuring that sessions stay connected to program goals and that spaces remain inclusive, adaptive, and deeply engaging.
Qualifications
Be able to facilitate with young people and adults.
Be able to facilitate / train both in in-person and on-line modes.
Be able to recognize the needs of the program, people, and deliverables, and respond effectively keeping the core values of Dream a Dream in mind.
Ability to solve problems, make decisions independently and take initiative.
Focus and invest in developing the Being of a facilitator.
Designing, developing, and contextualizing the workshops and content, meeting the needs of the target audience.
Be able to hold space for the people, team, and target audience, where they feel heard, seen and respected for who they are.
Design and deliver by applying the Arc of Transformation in workshops / trainings.
Have creative practice of their own.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of experience in facilitation and training roles within education or nonprofit sectors, focusing on complex program management and strategic partnerships.
Earlier experience of working in Northeast or Nagaland with knowledge of local culture, landscape, and language (Nagamese) will be an advantage.
Travel Requirement
This role requires flexibility to travel locally and nationally based on program needs.
General Responsibilities
Contribute to East Hub and state strategy and cross-state learning.
Collaborate with other internal teams.
Uphold Dream a Dream's values of equity, dignity, and inclusion.
Travel across different parts of the state as required.
