Description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and kitchen and mechanical room equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment and all utility shut-offs for buildings. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Communicate each day s activities and problems that occur to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display basic knowledge or ability to acquire knowledge in the following categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building. Perform all surface preparation, painting, minor drywall and wood trim repair, light bulb and A/C filter replacement and the complete and thorough cleanup of the painting or repair area. Test, troubleshoot and perform basic repair on all types of equipment, plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical components including lamps, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and other guestroom items. Program TVs and perform general housekeeping and engineering-related inventory duties. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Perform repairs on interior and exterior landscaping as well as external landscaping sprinklers. Display basic computer skills including inputting air handler schedules and making temperature changes.
Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Some experience in general maintenance, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
Experience in hotel engineering or maintenance a plus.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
License or Certification: Driver s License

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

About IIFL Finance Ltd
IIFL Finance is one of the most preferred Gold Loan financing company inIndia

Having presence in 25 states and a network of 2700+ branches on a PANIndia level, our mission is to cater to the needs of all those who are lookingfor an easy swift, and low-cost financing option

Our customers can avail gold loansthrough submitting an online application or visiting any of our branches intheir vicinity

We also have an option where the customers can avail gold loansat their doorstep so that they are not deprived of financing options to fulfilltheir needs

Our core values serve as a moral compass in all our activities

Fairness, Integrity, andTransparency - FIT is the driving force behind all that we do at IIFL

Weonly work with people who fit into our professional ethos

We are resolute inthe observance of these values and will let go of any growth opportunities thatdeem unfit

Group Company: IIFL Finance Ltd
Primary Responsibilities:
Attending to walk-in customers, addressingqueries about the gold loan process and schemes offered

Conducting gold valuations andidentifying gold purity accurately

Properly packing and storing gold andgold packets after loan disbursal

Returning gold ornaments to customers afterloan closure

Managing cash (system physical)during loan disbursals, interest collection, and loan closures

Create new CUID in system modifications in LOS during Disbursal, Part Release / Payments LoanClosure

Maintain branch registers as per theguidelines Key / Cash / Packet Movements, Staff Customer Visits ETC
Ensuring proper collection and storageof customer KYC documents

Following up with customers for timelycollection of interest and principal payments

Providing good customer service at everystep IE while pledging, releasing, or making interest payments

Description:
Role - Java Full Stack Developer

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web applications using Java, Spring Boot, Angular/React, and related technologies.
Develop robust backend services, RESTful APIs, and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate/JPA.
Build responsive and user-friendly frontend applications using Angular or React, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
Design, develop, and optimize database queries, schemas, and stored procedures using MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other relational databases.
Implement application security, authentication, authorization, and role-based access control.
Integrate frontend components with backend APIs and third-party services.
Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Write clean, reusable, maintainable, and well-documented code following industry best practices.
Perform unit testing, debugging, code reviews, and application performance optimization.
Work with Git and collaborative development tools to manage source code and version control.
Collaborate with developers, testers, business analysts, and other stakeholders to deliver quality software solutions.
Troubleshoot production issues, resolve bugs, and implement enhancements based on business requirements.
Work with Agile/Scrum methodologies and participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and technical discussions.
Contribute to application deployment and CI/CD workflows; knowledge of AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud platforms is an added advantage.

Employment Details & Interview Process
Employment Type: 1-Year Contract
Payroll: Candidates will be employed on TVM Infotech Pvt. Ltd. payroll and deployed to our esteemed client.
Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO), 5 days a week.
Interview Process: Face-to-face interviews for all rounds.
Work Location: Chennai / Bangalore Client Location (as applicable).

Important Notes
Candidates must be willing to work from the office five days a week.
Candidates must be willing to join on a 1-year contractual engagement under TVM Infotech payroll.
Candidates must be available to attend all interview rounds in person.
Only candidates meeting the job requirements and employment conditions will be considered.
AboutCompany: TVM Infotech is a growing IT solutions company based in Chennai, delivering software development, cloud services, and IT consulting solutions. We are committed to nurturing fresh talent and providing continuous learning and strong career growth opportunities.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy machine learning models and AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to build scalable AI systems that drive business value.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, train, and optimize machine learning and deep learning models.
Build and maintain end-to-end ML pipelines for data ingestion, model training, validation, and deployment.
Work with large datasets to perform data cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis.
Deploy AI/ML models into production using cloud platforms and ML Ops practices.
Monitor model performance and retrain models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Research and implement the latest advancements in AI, Generative AI, NLP, Computer Vision, and Machine Learning.

Required Skills
Strong knowledge of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Statistical Modeling.
Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, and NumPy.
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
Strong understanding of SQL, data modeling, and data engineering concepts.
Familiarity with REST APIs and software development best practices.
Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
2+ years of experience in Machine Learning/AI development (adjust as needed).
Experience delivering AI/ML solutions in production environments.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, or similar AI platforms.
Knowledge of NLP, Computer Vision, Recommendation Systems, or Agentic AI.
Familiarity with Spark, Databricks, and big data technologies.

Bangalore (Hybrid/Onsite/Remote)

Description:
As a Digital Transformation Specialist, you will lead a high-impact portfolio, connecting technology and business needs and delivering concrete results. You will be responsible for developing, implementing and executing IT capabilities within this area of expertise, planning and building IT solutions from business functions. You will work in a multinational team, conducting one or more projects/programs, and be the single focal point (SPOC) between IT Technology and the business for these transformation projects/programs. They will also be responsible for interacting with functional leaders and business units to monitor and execute projects/programs.
How you'll make an impact
Execute the PLM strategy, aligning it with digital transformation objectives and driving business value in the engineering and manufacturing areas
Integrate PLM with ERP, MES, and downstream systems, ensuring seamless data flow and process integration
Act as a promoter of the Digital Thread and configuration management, expanding traceability, collaboration and decision-making along the value chain
Optimize cross-functional processes using Lean and Six Sigma, with a focus on BOMs, process plans, roadmaps, and supply chain integration
Engage business and IT stakeholders, capturing complex requirements and facilitating global collaboration
Drive PLM governance and change management, supporting the adoption of new tools and continuous improvement initiatives
Act as a reference expert in PLM, guiding teams and supporting training on platforms such as Windchill or Teamcenter
Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable internal and external standards, procedures and guidelines.
Your background
Relevant experience in IT and digital transformation, with a strong background in Computer Science or Engineering and deep knowledge in PLM systems and strategy
Experience in leading global PLM transformation programs in engineering and manufacturing, with hands-on experience in Windchill, Teamcenter or similar platforms
Advanced knowledge of the processes that connect PLM to manufacturing, including mBOMs, process plans, routings, and integration with ERP and MES
Proven ability to manage third-party vendors and virtual delivery teams on a global scale, ensuring alignment across distributed stakeholders
Application of Lean, Six Sigma and Industry 4.0 concepts for optimization of cross-functional processes in engineering, supply chain, quality and procurement
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English and proven experience in multicultural and multinational environments
Travel availability of up to 30%, supporting deployments at global engineering plants and sites, as well as stakeholder relationships

Job Title: SAP CIP Consultant

Design, develop, and support integrations using SAP CIP / SAP Integration Suite
Manage and monitor integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems
Work closely with SAP Basis and functional teams for system connectivity and performance
Handle deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting of integration scenarios
Support S/4HANA system landscapes including transport management and integration flows
Perform root cause analysis and resolve incidents via tools like JIRA and ServiceNow
Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives)
Ensure system availability, performance, and data consistency across interfaces
Work on SAP HEC/cloud environments for maintenance and operations
Document integration processes, technical designs, and support procedures

5–10 years of SAP experience with strong exposure to SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite (CIP)
Experience with SAP S/4HANA systems
Strong understanding of SAP Basis fundamentals
Hands-on experience in integration technologies (REST, SOAP, IDoc, RFC, APIs)
Exposure to SAP HEC (HANA Enterprise Cloud) or similar cloud environments
Experience with monitoring and troubleshooting integration flows
Familiarity with JIRA and ServiceNow for incident and change management
Understanding of Agile methodologies
Strong problem-solving and communication skills
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with SAP PI/PO (Process Integration/Process Orchestration)
Exposure to SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) services
Knowledge of API Management and Event Mesh
Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Scripting knowledge (Groovy, Java, or similar used in CPI)
Exposure to security protocols (OAuth, SAML, SSL)
SAP certifications in CPI / Integration Suite / S4HANA
Experience working in multi-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP)

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons

Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic team supports client leaders translate multifaceted risk and an evolving regulatory environment into defensible actions that strengthen, protect, and transform organizations. Leverage advanced data, AI, and emerging technologies with deep domain and industry insights to help bring clarity from complexity and accelerate the path to value creation.
Position Summary
Level: Consultant or equivalent
As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
Work youll do:
Our Regulatory, Risk & Forensic Operate professionals help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic, reputation, and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries. 
We support clients by delivering Operate services spanning the Regulatory, Risk & Forensic portfolio. We embed continuous advantage through domain, industry, technology / Gen AI, and transformation skills to perform client business functions that manage risk and deliver value - added outcomes.
The Consultant will be responsible for completing timely and high-quality validation activities, as well as, for identifying issues, validation concerns, and observations, recommending corrective actions, presenting results of validation reviews, interfacing with business partners, and writing reports. Additionally, in this role, you will:
Plan and complete testing within required timeframes and in accordance with established processes and procedures
Applying risk analysis principles, determine the scope, including focus, objectives, and rationale
Develop testing strategies, including procedures and selection of samples, sample size, and rationale 
Prepare working papers, ensure that documentation appropriately supports the testing conclusions, and document process flows and describe major processes within the area being reviewed
Analyze the results of testing and review activities. Analyze exceptions and make recommendations to enhance internal controls
Ensure that testing is accurate, complete, and in accordance with standards and protocols. Communicate test/review results and issues/concerns to leadership, validating and recommending resolutions to issues
Effectively communicate the testing or validation process, status, and results to business and risk partners
Write and/or review reports or presentations that clearly articulate the results/conclusions of testing or validation activities
Effectively communicate with leadership and escalate validation concerns or issues as appropriate
Identifying and implementing efficiencies and process improvements
Complete assigned activities in accordance with established processes and procedures under limited supervision
Actively participate in learning & development opportunities to ensure the use of best-in-class processes and procedures
Proven client-facing experience with strong relationship-building skills
Experience in coaching and mentoring junior team members
Developing clear and concise reporting to be shared with leadership
Assist in managing change to ensure an effective risk management program
The team: 
We are experts in :
Providing FinCrime Operate solutions to optimize cost, quality, and effectiveness of FinCrime operations, including transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, Know Your Customer, screening, and controls testing, leveraging GenAI, technology platforms, and data analytics.
Comprehensive Discovery and data analysis support, preservation, collection, processing, hosting, and production using advanced technologies and GenAI.
Industrialized testing and transformation of regulatory, risk, and compliance processes, driving efficiency with automation, GenAI, and technology.
Dynamic, cost-effective risk monitoring using expert resources and technology to quickly identify elevated risks and potential noncompliance.

4 - 7 years of hands-on experience in in risk management (includes control testing, issue identification and validation, compliance, financial crimes, operational risk, internal audit, business process management)
Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 
Financial services knowledge: compliance, risk management, audit operations
Experience in testing procedures; evaluating policies, processes, controls; identifying compliance issues
Public accounting experience in audit or SOX advisory/consulting
Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
High responsibility, initiative, accountability
Excellent communication skills
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail
Ability to interact across organizational levels

As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client relationships, mentor junior team members, and apply critical thinking to navigate ambiguity while strengthening your personal brand and technical skills. Demonstrates expert abilities managing ITIL Processes; Tracking SLAs, and contracting;

Description:
Third Party Pay Roll
Officer - Costing & Budgeting
Location: Bangalore RO
Experience Required
Minimum 4 years of experience in Costing & Budgeting.
Mandatory experience in handling Real Estate Projects (Residential, Commercial, Mixed-use developments).
Job Purpose
The objective of this position is to prepare and monitor construction budgets, estimate quantities, perform cost analysis, and support effective cost control for real estate projects. The role will be responsible for ensuring accurate cost estimation, budget monitoring, rate analysis, and timely reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Cost Estimation
Preparation of BOQs and quantity estimation based on construction drawings.
Analysis and interpretation of drawings received from Structural Consultants, Architects, and MEP Consultants.
Preparation of project cost estimates for residential and commercial real estate developments.
Assist in budget planning during project feasibility and execution stages.
Cost & Budget Monitoring
Preparation of detailed project budgets and periodic budget revisions.
Monitor project costs against approved budgets and identify variances.
Track budget vs. actual expenditures and provide recommendations for cost optimization.
Prepare and submit monthly cost monitoring reports to management.
Rate Analysis
Conduct rate analysis for various construction activities and materials.
Maintain and update cost databases considering location-wise and project-specific parameters.
Evaluate vendor quotations and support procurement teams in cost comparison exercises.
Develop benchmarking data for residential and commercial projects.
Reporting & Coordination
Prepare MIS reports related to project costs, budgets, and forecasts.
Coordinate with Project, Procurement, Contracts, and Finance teams for cost tracking and control.
Support management in decision-making through cost analysis and reporting.
Key Competencies
Strong knowledge of construction costing, budgeting, and estimation.
Ability to read and analyze architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
Proficiency in MS Excel and cost estimation tools.
Good analytical and reporting skills.
Attention to detail and ability to work within timelines.
Key Deliverables
Timely and accurate cost estimation.
Effective project budget preparation and monitoring.
Accurate rate analysis and cost benchmarking.
Monthly budget variance and cost monitoring reports.
Cost optimization recommendations for real estate projects.
This version aligns the role to an Officer level and emphasizes the requirement of 4+ years of experience in real estate project costing and budgeting.

We are an IRDAI-licensed Direct Insurance Broker with over 30 years of experience in providing comprehensive insurance and risk management solutions to businesses across India. Our expertise includes Property Insurance, Marine Insurance, Employee Benefits, and Liability Insurance.
At Disha Capital, we work closely with organizations to analyze their risk exposure and provide customized insurance solutions that ensure adequate coverage and cost efficiency.

About the role:

Disha Capital Insurance broker is looking for a dynamic, result-oriented Assistant Vice President Corporate Relations to drive business growth and strengthen our presence in the corporate insurance market.
This is a hands-on sales leadership role for a professional with strong experience in Corporate Sales in terms of General Insurance. The leader will be responsible for driving new business acquisition, building strategic relationships with senior corporate decision-makers, developing a strong business pipeline, achieving revenue targets, and contributing to the overall growth of the organization. The role combines strategic sales, and technical expertise across Employee Benefits, Fire, Engineering, and Liability insurance.
The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of acquiring and managing corporate clients, closing high-value deals, and independently driving business growth. The leader shall have his own book size as well of premium. This is a team role.

Key Responsibilities:

Independently drive new corporate business acquisition and achieve assigned revenue targets.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified corporate opportunities.
Build relationships with HR managers, benefits managers, and C-suite executives.
Conduct digital and in-person presentations, negotiate deals, and close contracts.
Drive end-to-end sales from prospecting and need analysis to proposal presentation, negotiation and deal closure.
Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across the corporate insurance portfolio.
Oversee policy issuance, endorsements, claims support, and renewals.
Coordinate with insurers for competitive pricing and coverage enhancements.
Sit with the placement team to discuss on price and coordinate with insurance company on RFQ
Further work on QCR with internal team and the client team to finalise the terms.
Personally participate in strategic client meetings and high-value deal closures.
Build and maintain effective relationships with insurance companies, underwriters and other strategic partners.
Should have knowledge of technical products like Fire Insurance: Asset protection, RIV, and claims advocacy; Engineering Insurance: CAR, EAR, MB policies; Liability Insurance: CGL, PI/E&O, D&O coverage and risk mitigation.
Work closely with Placement, Underwriting, Operations and Claims teams to ensure seamless client acquisition, policy placement and servicing.
Manage renewal strategies for large corporate accounts.
Identify cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within existing clients.
Lead negotiations with insurers to secure competitive coverage, pricing and terms for corporate clients.
Lead and mentor a team of 4-5 professionals, ensuring smooth collaboration, performance, monitoring, and development of team members.
Ensure regulatory compliance and maintain strong relationships with clients and
insurers.
Develop and implement data-driven sales strategies to acquire and retain corporate
clients.

Requirements:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Insurance, or a related field.
MBA or relevant insurance qualifications will be an added advantage.
1015 years of relevant experience in Corporate Sales, Business Development, or Corporate Relationship Management.
Strong preference for candidates from a General Insurance Company or Insurance Broking organization.
Proven experience in acquiring and managing corporate clients.
Demonstrated experience in engaging with senior corporate stakeholders and CXO-level decision-makers.
Strong understanding of the General Insurance and Corporate Insurance ecosystem.
Experience in driving revenue growth and achieving challenging business targets.
An established and relevant corporate network in Bangalore/Karnataka will be an added advantage.

What we are looking for:

We are looking for a business leader who is equally comfortable building strategy and meeting clients, creating opportunities and closing deals, and leading a team while remaining personally accountable for business growth.
If you have the experience, network, ambition, and proven ability to build and grow corporate business, we would love to hear from you.

The opportunity:
The Hitachi Energy Indian Operations Center (INOPC) is a competence center with around 2600+ skilled engineers who focus on tendering, engineering, planning, procurement, project Management, functional system testing, installation supervision, documentation and commissioning. However, over the last decade, it has evolved to become the largest Operations hub. The India Operations Centre team at Chennai, Bangalore and Gurugram supports Hitachi Energys units in more than 40 countries across a wide portfolio of all the four business units in Hitachi Energy To date, the team has executed engineering and commissioning for projects in more than 80 countries.The Inventory Management Lead will play a vital role in ensuring effective inventory control and data accuracy across global operations. The Inventory Management Lead will provide actionable insights, optimize stock utilization, and drive alignment across plants worldwide, contributing to operational efficiency and strategic business objectives.
How youll make an impact:
Lead the implementation of the GA SCM TTL strategy in collaboration with internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment with global policies, processes,systemsand the defined governance model.
Partner with GA Hubs and Global Product Groups (GPGs) toconsolidatevolume data andvalidateGA TTL budget forecasts,targetsand planning assumptions.
Act as the key liaison with the TTL Center of Expertise (CoE), reviewing centrally managed initiatives and coordinating their effective implementation within GA.
Monitor TTLCoEservice-level performance and drive corrective actions or improvement initiatives whererequired.
Track GA SCM TTL initiatives in close alignment with the TTLCoE, ensuring progress, risks and dependencies are clearly visible.
Drive standardization, processharmonizationand supplier consolidation across GA Hubs and GPGs.
Engage GA Hubs and GPGs toidentify, develop andconsolidatea pipeline of opportunities supporting delivery of the GA TTL cost reduction (CR) and cost avoidance (CA) plan; conduct regular reviews tomonitorprogress against targets.
Act as a change agent by building awareness, supporting stakeholder engagement and enabling the successful rollout of new TTL projects,toolsand processes.
Provide regular and ad hoc updates on TTL topics, regulatorychangesand compliance requirements;identify,addressor escalate gaps to ensure GAremainscompliant.
Collaborate with counterparts across other Business Units to exchange knowledge, benchmark performance and implement relevant best practices.
Represent GA in relevant workshops and provide input on GA forecasts,performanceand annual TTL budget planning.
Support best-in-class delivery against Hitachi Energy KPIs, includingmaintainingaccuratepurchasing information records (PIRs), such as material weights and country of origin data.
Undertakeadditionalresponsibilities asrequiredto support the team and evolving business priorities.

Bachelors degree in engineering, supply chain management,logistics, businessadministrationora relateddiscipline.

Experience working in cross-functional,matrixedor global organizations, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business units,functionsand geographies.
Knowledge of SAP or similar enterprise systems is desirable.
Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements or a willingness to develop thisexpertise.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management,negotiationand influencing skills.
Proactive and accountable, witha strong senseof ownership and the ability to drive topics forward independently.
Structured,collaborative,and results-oriented, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver outcomes in a dynamic environment.
Analytical and solutions-focused, with strong problem-solving capability and attention to detail.
Comfortable working across cultures and countries, with a mindset that supports collaboration, continuousimprovementand change adoption.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced SAP MDG Consultant to join our SAP practice. The candidate will be responsible for implementing, configuring, supporting, and optimizing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) solutions across enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in SAP MDG, Data Governance, Data Quality, Replication, Validation, Data Modeling, Workflow Configuration, Business Rules, and Master Data Management. Experience in implementation, rollout, migration, and support engagements is highly preferred.

Roles & Responsibilities
Implement and support SAP MDG solutions for enterprise master data management.
Design, configure, and maintain MDG data models for Customer, Vendor, Material, Business Partner, and Financial master data.
Gather, analyze, and document business requirements related to master data governance.
Configure MDG workflows, validations, derivations, and business rules.
Establish data governance processes, standards, and approval workflows.
Configure replication frameworks and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
Monitor and improve master data quality across business domains.
Collaborate with business users to define governance policies and controls.
Support data migration, cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization initiatives.
Work on data replication and synchronization activities across landscapes.
Conduct SIT, UAT, regression testing, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot master data issues and perform root cause analysis.
Prepare functional specifications and support technical development teams.
Participate in implementation, rollout, upgrade, and transformation projects.
Ensure compliance with organizational data governance standards.
Provide user training, documentation, and knowledge transfer sessions.

Qualifications
B.E / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or Post Graduate qualification.
Minimum 2 years of SAP MDG experience for JL4 roles.
Minimum 5 years of SAP MDG experience for JL5 roles.
Minimum 9 years of SAP MDG experience for JL6 roles.
Strong understanding of Master Data Management and Data Governance processes.

Role: Consultant - Functional Production Planning and Quality Management
Skill Set: SAP PP/QM
Location: Bangalore/Kolkata
EXP: 6 To 8 Years,
Type: Contract to hire(C2H).
Skills: SAP PPQM, Functional, S4Hana, End to End Implementation, Brownfield, Greenfield Implementation.

Job Description:
About the Role
We are looking for an SAP Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) consultant with hands-on implementation experience. You will design, configure and deliver manufacturing and quality solutions for discrete and process industry clients. You will work directly with business stakeholders across the project lifecycle, from requirement gathering to go-live and hypercare, on S/4HANA transformation programs.
Key Responsibilities
Production Planning (PP)
Lead requirement workshops with production, planning and supply chain teams, and translate business needs into PP solution designs.
Configure PP master data: material master (MRP views), BOMs, work centres / resources, routings and master recipes, production versions.
Configure and deliver planning processes:
Demand management, planned independent requirements and planning strategies (MTS, MTO, ATO)
MRP Live (MD01N), MRP areas, lot sizing, safety stock and scheduling
Capacity planning and levelling
Configure execution processes: discrete manufacturing (production orders), process manufacturing (process orders, PI sheets) and/or repetitive manufacturing.
Set up order types, scheduling, availability checks, goods issue/receipt, backflush, confirmations and order settlement.
Handle batch management, batch determination and batch classification.
Support subcontracting, co-products/by-products, rework and scrap processes.
Quality Management (QM)
Lead workshops with quality and compliance teams and translate requirements into QM solution designs.
Configure QM master data: master inspection characteristics, inspection methods, catalogs, code groups, selected sets, sampling procedures and dynamic modification rules.
Configure inspection types and inspection plans for goods receipt, in-process, final, stock transfer, recurring and customer returns inspections.
Configure quality notifications (customer complaints, vendor complaints, internal problems) and follow-up actions.
Set up the full inspection lot process: results recording, defects recording, usage decision and stock postings.
Configure quality info records, vendor certificates, certificates of analysis (CoA) and quality certificates.
Support calibration inspections integrated with PM, and stability studies where applicable.
Across Both Modules
Prepare fit-gap analysis, solution design documents, functional specifications and configuration documents.
Handle integration with MM, SD, PM, FI/CO and EWM/WM.
Support data migration: define templates, cleanse and validate master data, and load via S/4HANA Migration Cockpit.
Work with technical teams on RICEFW objects: write functional specs and test enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms and workflows.
Drive SIT and UAT: write test scripts, coordinate defect resolution, and obtain business sign-off.
Prepare training material, conduct key-user and end-user training, and support cutover, go-live and hypercare.
Configure and demonstrate relevant SAP Fiori apps for planners, production supervisors and quality inspectors.
Must-Have Skills
6 - 8 years of SAP PP and QM functional experience to manage the implementation projects and product development on BTP, with strong hands-on configuration in both modules
At least 1 end-to-end S/4HANA implementation (greenfield, brownfield or selective data transition) as a PP/QM consultant.
Strong knowledge of MRP Live, production/process order lifecycle and QM inspection processes.
Working knowledge of S/4HANA simplification items in manufacturing and quality, and of the related Fiori apps.
Good understanding of PP/QM integration with MM, SD, PM and FI/CO, including product costing touchpoints.
Experience with SAP Activate methodology.
Ability to write clear functional specifications and to debug basic issues with technical teams.
Good-to-Have Skills
Exposure to SAP Digital Manufacturing (DM) / SAP ME / MII or other MES integration.
PP/DS (embedded in S/4HANA) or advanced planning experience.
Statistical process control (SPC), control charts and quality analytics.
Experience in regulated industries (pharma, life sciences, food and beverage, chemicals), including GMP, audit trail and electronic signature requirements.
Industry exposure to CPG, automotive, industrial manufacturing or textiles.
SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing and/or Quality Management certification.
Basic ABAP understanding for debugging and analysis.
Education
B.E./B.Tech (Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Chemical or related), or equivalent degree.
An MBA in operations or a background in manufacturing or quality industry roles is an advantage.
Soft Skills
Strong client-facing communication and workshop facilitation.
Ability to work independently on a module stream and mentor junior consultants.
Willingness to travel to client locations, including onsite assignments.
Qualification: B.E/B.Tech/M.E/ M.Tech/MBA

Role Summary
Designs and builds web-based GIS applications and widgets on ArcGIS Enterprise, delivering intuitive
map-centric experiences for utility users.
Key Responsibilities
Develop web mapping applications using the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, Experience
Builder (Developer Edition) custom widgets and React/TypeScript.
Consume and publish map, feature and utility network services; implement editing, tracing,
querying and reporting functions.
Build integrations with REST APIs and enterprise systems; handle authentication via ArcGIS
identity, OAuth 2.0 or SAML.
Optimise application performance and ensure responsive, accessible UI design.
Write unit and integration tests and participate in code reviews and CI/CD processes.
Collaborate with UX, business analysts and testers to translate requirements into working features.
Required Skills & Experience
Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS and a modern framework (React preferred).
Hands-on experience with ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript (4.x) and ArcGIS REST APIs.
Experience with Experience Builder or Web AppBuilder customisation.
Familiarity with Git, npm and build tooling.
Preferred / Nice to Have
Experience with Utility Network web tracing and editing.
Knowledge of Calcite Design System, ArcGIS Dashboards, Field Maps or Survey123.
Backend skills in Node.js, Python or .NET.
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geoinformatics, Geography, Computer Science, Engineering or a related
field, or equivalent practical experience

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Maximo Developer - Senior Associate, you will engage in business application consulting within our Technology Consulting network, focusing on Maximo Consulting. You will work directly with clients to modernize field service and operations, leveraging your skills to deliver impactful solutions. As a Senior Associate, you will navigate complex situations, build meaningful client relationships, and mentor junior team members. You will utilize your problem-solving skills and critical thinking to analyze complex concepts and anticipate client needs, contributing to the delivery of quality work.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a dynamic team within our Technology Consulting practice. You will have the opportunity to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills while managing and inspiring others. Embracing ambiguity, you will use these moments as opportunities to develop self-awareness and enhance your strengths. Your work will fit into the broader objectives of the firm, and you will uphold professional standards, guiding and mentoring others to deliver value to our clients.
Responsibilities
- Developing and implementing Maximo solutions to enhance asset management capabilities
- Integrating Maximo with other enterprise systems to streamline operations and data flow
- Collaborating with clients to understand their business needs and tailor Maximo functionalities accordingly
- Utilizing analytical thinking to troubleshoot and resolve Maximo-related issues efficiently
- Leading the design and architecture of Maximo applications to support field service and operations modernization
- Applying knowledge of middleware architecture to facilitate seamless application integrations
- Supporting the deployment of emerging technologies within Maximo environments to drive innovation
- Managing project timelines and deliverables to align with client expectations and industry standards
- Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members in Maximo development and integration
- Engaging with stakeholders to gather feedback and continuously improve Maximo solutions
What You Must Have
- App Designer and DB Config: design and implement UI changes, custom Maximo applications, and schema extensions including custom objects and relationships
- At least 5 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
Strong hands-on expertise in IBM Maximo 7.6.x and IBM MAS Manage (8.x / 9.x) across multiple functional modules
– Advanced Automation Script development: complex multi-object scripts, launch-in-context extensions, custom MBO validation, integration event framework, and field-level scripting in JavaScript (Rhino) and Jython
– Deep Integration Framework expertise: design of object structures, bidirectional ERP/GIS/SCADA integration, error handling, JMS queue management, and enterprise messaging patterns
What Sets You Apart
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (Master's degree preferred)
- Developing solutions using IBM Maximo Asset Management
- Integrating Maximo with enterprise systems for seamless operations
- Navigating complex middleware architecture for application integrations
- Embracing emerging technologies in energy and utilities sectors
- Managing field service mobility projects with FSM expertise
- Excelling in analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

WE ARE HIRING: Field Sales Engineers (15 Openings Across India)

BT Print & PKG Solutions LLP is expanding! We are looking for dynamic, target-driven Field Sales Engineers to spearhead B2B sales for our advanced industrial coding, marking, and inspection portfolioincluding CIJ/TIJ Printers, Laser Marking Machines, and AI Inspection Systems.

Experience: 3–7 years in B2B field sales across Industrial Machinery, Automation, Packaging Solutions, or Banking/Financial Sales. (Prior experience in coding & marking equipment is a strong advantage!)

Job Description HR Operations Executive / HR Generalist

Experience: 2-4 Years
Department: Human Resources
Job Location: Kolkata (Managing to Onsite/Client Locations)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic HR Operations professional with strong expertise in end-to-end HR activities, employee lifecycle management and multi-location HR coordination. The candidate will be responsible for managing HR operations across Pan-India locations, including onsite, hybrid and client-deployed workforces.
The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, along with regional language proficiency to effectively engage with employees across diverse geographical locations.

Key Responsibilities:

HR Operations Management: Manage day-to-day HR operations, employee documentation, onboarding, employee records, attendance, leave management and HRIS updates.
Employee Lifecycle Management: Handle joining formalities, induction, employee engagement, confirmation, separation and exit formalities.
Pan-India Location Management: Coordinate HR activities across multiple geographical locations, including branch offices, client sites, onsite and hybrid workforces.
Client & Stakeholder Coordination: Act as the primary HR SPOC for client locations, coordinating with business teams, operations managers and internal stakeholders.
Employee Grievance Management: Address employee queries, workplace concerns, escalations and facilitate timely resolution.
HR Compliance & Documentation: Ensure adherence to HR policies, statutory documentation, employee records and organizational compliance requirements.
Attendance & Payroll Coordination: Monitor attendance, leave records, payroll inputs, employee master data and monthly HR reports.
Employee Engagement: Drive employee communication, engagement initiatives, feedback sessions and retention activities across locations.
Field & Site HR Management: Undertake periodic visits to client locations and operational sites to ensure effective HR service delivery.
MIS & Reporting: Maintain accurate HR databases, employee trackers, attrition reports, joining reports and location-wise HR dashboards.

Required Skills & Competencies

Strong hands-on expertise in HR Operations and HR Generalist activities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong employee relationship and stakeholder management capabilities.
Experience managing multiple locations and geographically distributed workforces.
Ability to independently handle onsite, hybrid and client-location HR operations.
Good knowledge of HR documentation, attendance, payroll coordination and employee lifecycle management.
Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and HRMS platforms.
Strong problem-solving, coordination and conflict-resolution skills.
Willingness to travel across Pan-India locations as per business requirements.
Language & Linguistic Requirements
Proficiency in English and Hindi is preferred.
Candidates with multilingual capabilities and experience handling region-specific employee populations will be preferred.
Educational Qualification
Graduate in any discipline.
MBA / PGDM in Human Resources will be an added advantage.
Preferred Candidate Profile.

A proactive HR professional capable of independently managing multi-location HR operations, handling employee concerns at the ground level, coordinating with client stakeholders and ensuring consistent HR service delivery across Pan-India business locations.

Description:
Role: GIS Performance Tester
Experience: 5-6 years
Staff Level: Senior Associate
Education: BE/BTECH or equivalent
Key responsibilities:
Define GIS performance testing strategy covering web, desktop, and servicelevel workloads (ArcGIS Server, Utility Network, Feature Services).
Identify performancecritical GIS workflows (pan/zoom, tracing, edits, large spatial queries, batch jobs).
Create realistic GIS workload models based on editor, viewer, integration, and batch processing usage patterns.
Design test scenarios for: 
Map rendering and symbology scaling
Feature service queries (attribute + spatial)
Utility Network traces and validations
Web GIS Load Test scenarios
Concurrent editing and versioned data access 
Load and Stress Simulation:Execute load, endurance, and stress tests to determine how GIS (likeArcGIS Server) perform under high user traffic, specifically testing 2D/3D map rendering and data querying.
Bottleneck Analysis: Monitor system KPIssuch as CPU utilization, memory, response times, and throughput—to identify bottlenecks related to spatial analysis or database queries.
Result Reporting: Create detailed performance analysis reports that highlight the system's performance, identifying areas for improvement or potential downtime.
Collaborate with Functional Analysts to map business flows into performance test cases.
Prior experience in GIS Testing assignments will be an advantage.
Collaboration & Optimization:Work with GIS developers and architects to suggest infrastructure changes, database tuning, or code optimizations to resolve issues.
Perform RCA on performance issues and recommend improvement opportunities.
Essential Qualifications:
Minimum of 5 years’ working experience with Esri ArcGIS Software (Enterprise, Desktop, Server, ArcGIS Pro, Online)
Understanding of ArcGIS Enterprise Architecture- ArcGIS Server, Portal, data Store etc.
Understanding of ArcGIS Pro concepts: Maps, Projects, Layout templates, Editing Templates, Tasks etc.
Understanding of Esri geoprocessing tools: model Builder
Understanding of Geodatabases: Versioning and Spatial data Types

Working familiarity with the S/4HANA Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation (ICMR) tool, as well as a solid accounting and finance background.

Strategically located along the Chandigarh-Ambala Highway, the cluster hotel will bring together 335 well-appointed rooms across two renowned brands - 149 rooms at Crowne Plaza and 186 rooms at Holiday Inn, Zirakpur.
The cluster will offer a diverse range of F&B experiences, along with a swimming pool, fitness centre, spa, and extensive banqueting facilities, including approximately 1,00,000 sq. ft. of meeting and event space. With excellent connectivity to Chandigarh and key destinations across North India, it will be well-positioned to cater to business and leisure travelers, while offering versatile spaces for conferences, weddings, and social celebrations.
A little taste of your day-to-day:

Every day is different, but you ll mostly be:
Delivering exceptional guest and corporate experiences by setting high standards and finding new ways to exceed them
Assisting in managing food and beverage standards to deliver against our commitment to responsible business practices
Assisting in overseeing multiple food and beverage outlets.

What We need from you:

Bachelor s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Hotel Management, culinary arts, or related field
4+ years related experience, including management experience
Must speak local language

What you can expect from us:

We give our people everything they need to succeed. From a competitive salary that rewards all your hard work to a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life - including a full uniform, impressive room discounts and some of the best training in the business.

Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels & Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

IHG gives every member of the team the room they need to belong, grow and make a difference in a collaborative environment. We know that to work well, we need to feel well - both inside and outside of work - and through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), MCP (Model Context Protocol), and AI Agent Frameworks. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade AI applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous agents, and advanced retrieval systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop AI-powered applications using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).
Build and deploy Agentic AI solutions capable of autonomous reasoning and task execution.
Implement RAG architectures using vector databases and enterprise knowledge sources.
Develop integrations using Model Context Protocol (MCP) for AI tool and data connectivity.
Build multi-agent systems using modern Agent Frameworks.
Fine-tune prompts and optimize LLM performance for business use cases.
Develop AI workflows for document processing, knowledge management, and conversational AI.
Integrate AI services with enterprise applications using APIs and microservices.
Collaborate with data scientists, product teams, and software engineers to deliver AI solutions.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend best practices.
Required Skills
2-6 years of software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI and Large Language Models.
Experience building RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Knowledge of Agentic AI architectures and autonomous AI agents.
Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration and AI tooling.
Hands-on experience with AI Agent Frameworks such as:
LangGraph
LangChain
CrewAI
AutoGen
Semantic Kernel
LlamaIndex
Experience with Vector Databases:
Pinecone
ChromaDB
Weaviate
Milvus
FAISS
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or Open Source LLMs.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering and AI application development.
Experience with REST APIs and Microservices.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with AI Observability and Evaluation Tools.
Knowledge of Fine-Tuning and Model Optimization.
Experience with Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Exposure to NLP, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning concepts.
Knowledge of CI/CD for AI deployments (LLMOps).
Experience building AI Chatbots, AI Assistants, and Enterprise Search solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related field.

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.

What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Every day is different, but you ll mostly be:
Managing front office team to deliver memorable guest experiences and the warmest of welcomes
Engaging with guests to build personal relationships and remedy any complaints
Conducting regular front office inspections to ensure we re making the right first impression
Assisting to prepare budgets and finding new ways to drive revenue from walk-ins and up-selling at the front desk
Training team members on PBX procedures and taking the lead during an emergency or crisis

Bachelor s degree / higher education qualification / equivalent in Hotel Management/ Business Administration
3 years of Front Office/Guest Service experience including management experience
Must speak fluent English

framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace.

So, join us and you ll become part of our ever-growing global family.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with 5 to 8 years of industry experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning, NLP, LLMs, model deployment, and MLOps practices.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for business use cases.
Build and optimize AI/ML pipelines for data processing, training, evaluation, and deployment.
Develop Generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Fine-tune foundation models using frameworks such as Hugging Face and Lang Chain.
Implement NLP solutions including text classification, sentiment analysis, summarization, and conversational AI.
Collaborate with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Monitor model performance, accuracy, and drift in production environments.
Create scalable AI solutions on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Implement MLOps best practices for model lifecycle management.
Stay current with advancements in AI, Generative AI, and Machine Learning technologies.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Python and AI/ML libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn.
Hands-on experience with TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, or similar frameworks.
Experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, and Generative AI.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, Vector Databases, and AI Agents.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar frameworks.
Knowledge of MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, or Azure ML.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Azure OpenAI, OpenAI APIs, Gemini, Claude, or similar AI platforms.
Hands-on experience in AI Agent development and orchestration frameworks.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, or FAISS.
Exposure to Computer Vision and multimodal AI solutions.
Educational Qualification
Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or related fields.
Nice to Have
Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
AWS Machine Learning Specialty
Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer
Experience working in enterprise-scale AI transformation programs.

Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

Minimum 6 months of recruitment experience (IT, Non-IT, BPO, or volume hiring).
Good understanding of sourcing techniques and recruitment processes.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Familiarity with LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, or similar job portals.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple requirements.
Preferred Skills
Knowledge of end-to-end recruitment lifecycle.
Strong stakeholder and candidate management skills.
What We Offer
Competitive salary package.
Learning and growth opportunities within Talent Acquisition.
Collaborative and inclusive work environment.

Industry: Banking / NBFC / Financial Services
Job Locations: Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Amritsar, Jalandhar, Panipat

Candidates interested in field sales, business development, and financial services.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling abilities.
Willingness to work in a field-based sales role, only male candidates can apply. 
Ability to interact with customers, Channel Partners, DSAs, and referral networks.
Basic understanding of sales and business development processes.
Willingness to learn loan products, customer onboarding, and financial services operations.
Freshers and candidates with relevant sales experience may apply, subject to company eligibility criteria.

Monthly stipend of 20,000 (including DBT).
Fixed travelling allowance of 3,000 per month.
Opportunity to gain practical experience in the Banking / NBFC / Financial Services industry.

The Territory Manager is responsible for driving sales growth, market development, and customer engagement across the assigned territory. The role partners closely with healthcare professionals, distributors, and key stakeholders to expand product adoption, support clinical utilization, and deliver territory-specific growth strategies across the Trauma and CSOT portfolios.

Achieve or exceed sales targets across the assigned Trauma and CSOT product portfolios.
Develop and manage relationships with surgeons, healthcare professionals, hospital stakeholders, and channel partners.
Identify new business opportunities and convert prospective accounts into active customers.
Provide product support and clinical assistance during procedures, including operation theater engagements when required.
Conduct product education programs and training sessions for healthcare professionals and distributor teams.
Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities to develop territory growth plans.
Execute territory-specific sales strategies and business development initiatives to increase market penetration.
Communicate customer feedback, market insights, and product improvement opportunities to internal stakeholders.

High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 6+ years experience

Job Title: DataStage Developer
Experience: 2-8 Years
Location: PAN India
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a talented IBM DataStage Developer with 23 years of experience in ETL development, data integration, and data warehousing projects. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in IBM InfoSphere DataStage, SQL, and database technologies, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL solutions that support business intelligence and analytics initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy ETL jobs using IBM InfoSphere DataStage.
Develop and maintain data integration workflows for loading data from multiple source systems into data warehouses and data marts.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical ETL solutions.
Implement data cleansing, validation, and transformation logic.
Optimize DataStage jobs for performance, scalability, and reliability.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, and support UAT activities.
Troubleshoot ETL job failures and resolve production issues.
Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and data architects.
Maintain technical documentation and adhere to development standards.
Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with organizational policies.
Required Skills
2 - 8 years of hands-on experience in IBM InfoSphere DataStage development.
Strong experience in ETL design and development.
Proficiency in SQL and database concepts.
Experience with relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, PostgreSQL, or MySQL.
Knowledge of DataStage components including:
Designer
Director
Administrator
Manager
Parallel Jobs
Sequence Jobs
Understanding of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling.
Experience in Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting.
Knowledge of source code management tools such as Git.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

About the Role
We are looking for a sharp, energetic, and customer-focused Associate Inside Sales to join our Intracity Logistics business. The role will involve managing customer relationships, driving retention and growth, and identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling through effective inside sales.
The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, a sales mindset, and the ability to build meaningful customer relationships while working in a fast-paced environment.
What Youll Do
Manage a portfolio of customers and build strong, long-term relationships.
Drive customer retention and engagement through regular follow-ups and proactive account management.
Handle inbound and outbound sales calls to generate business opportunities.
Identify customer needs and recommend relevant Delhivery solutions.
Drive upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts.
Work closely with customers to understand their requirements and ensure a positive customer experience.
Support customer success by resolving queries and coordinating with internal teams for timely closure.
Maintain accurate customer and sales information and track opportunities through the sales funnel.
Meet defined sales, retention, revenue, and customer engagement targets.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve customer experience and business growth.
What We’re Looking For
1–5 years of experience in inside sales, account management, customer success, relationship management, telesales, or a similar customer-facing role. Freshers with excellent communication skills and a strong interest in sales may also be considered.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Confident in handling inbound and outbound calls and engaging with customers.
Strong relationship-building and customer-handling skills.
Good sales orientation with the ability to upsell and cross-sell.
Sharp, proactive, and target-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Basic proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace and CRM tools

Description:
About the Role
We are looking for a dynamic and target-driven Senior Manager SME Inside Sales to lead a large sales organization and drive revenue growth, customer retention, and account expansion. The role involves managing 2 Assistant Managers and 50–60 associates, building a high-performance culture, and delivering business targets through data-driven sales strategies and effective people leadership.

Key Responsibilities
* Own revenue, growth, retention, and productivity targets for the function.
* Lead and mentor 2 Assistant Managers and drive performance across 50–60 associates.
* Drive account growth through upselling, cross-selling, share-of-wallet gains, and increased order frequency.
* Improve customer retention, reduce churn, and strengthen long-term account relationships.
* Monitor sales funnel performance, conversion rates, revenue per associate, and key business KPIs.
* Drive forecasting, business reviews, performance management, and continuous process improvement.
* Collaborate with Operations, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams to enhance customer experience and business outcomes.
* Leverage customer insights and analytics to identify growth opportunities and improve platform stickiness.
Requirements
* 7+ years of experience in Inside Sales, Key Account Management, Account Management, or Customer Retention.
* Proven experience managing large sales teams and delivering revenue and growth targets.
* Strong expertise in sales funnel management, customer retention, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Excellent leadership, analytical, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.
